verses.sanskrit: ततोऽतिकोपपूर्णस्य चक्रिणो वदनात्ततः । निश्चक्राम महत्तेजो ब्रह्मणः शङ्करस्य च
verses.transliteration: tato.atikopapUrNasya chakriNo vadanAttataH | nishchakrAma mahattejo brahmaNaH sha~Nkarasya cha
verses.translation: Knowing this, O destroyer of demons, your fear has been abandoned at the time of destroying the demons. You have always protected by your own power, and that is your nature, O great enemy of evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing this, O destroyer of demons, your fear has been abandoned at the time of destroying the demons. You have always protected by your own power, and that is your nature, O great enemy of evil.
verses.hindi: तब अत्यन्त कोपमें भरे हुए चक्रपाणि श्रीविष्णुके मुखसे एक महान्‌ तेज प्रकट हुआ। इसी प्रकार ब्रह्मा, शंकर तथा इन्द्र आदि अन्यान्य देवताओंके शरीरसे भी बड़ा भारी तेज निकला। वह सब मिलकर एक हो गया

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां चैव देवानां शक्रादीनां शरीरतः । निर्गतं सुमहत्तेजस्तच्चैक्यं समगच्छत
verses.transliteration: anyeShAM chaiva devAnAM shakrAdInAM sharIrataH | nirgataM sumahattejastachchaikyaM samagachChata
verses.translation: As one who remembers you entering the heart, seeing you first, O Devi, so we remember when you are lost, seeing you first, O Devi.
verses.commentary: Sense: As one who remembers you entering the heart, seeing you first, O Devi, so we remember when you are lost, seeing you first, O Devi.
verses.hindi: तब अत्यन्त कोपमें भरे हुए चक्रपाणि श्रीविष्णुके मुखसे एक महान्‌ तेज प्रकट हुआ। इसी प्रकार ब्रह्मा, शंकर तथा इन्द्र आदि अन्यान्य देवताओंके शरीरसे भी बड़ा भारी तेज निकला। वह सब मिलकर एक हो गया

verses.sanskrit: अतीव तेजसः कूटं ज्वलन्तमिव पर्वतम् । ददृशुस्ते सुरास्तत्र ज्वालाव्याप्तदिगन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: atIva tejasaH kUTaM jvalantamiva parvatam | dadR^ishuste surAstatra jvAlAvyAptadigantaram
verses.translation: The gods beheld the mass of intense energy there like a burning mountain, pervading the other regions of the sky with its blaze;
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods beheld the mass of intense energy there like a burning mountain, pervading the other regions of the sky with its blaze;
verses.hindi: महान्‌ तेजका वह पुज्ज जाज्वल्यमान पर्वत-सा जान पड़ा। देवताओं ने देखा, वहाँ उसकी ज्वालाएँ सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंमें व्याप्त हो रही थीं

verses.sanskrit: अतुलं तत्र तत्तेजः सर्वदेवशरीरजम् । एकस्थं तदभून्नारी व्याप्तलोकत्रयं त्विषा
verses.transliteration: atulaM tatra tattejaH sarvadevasharIrajam | ekasthaM tadabhUnnArI vyAptalokatrayaM tviShA
verses.translation: and that unparalleled energy, born of the bodies of all the gods, which pervaded the three worlds with its light, gathering into one became a female.
verses.commentary: Sense: and that unparalleled energy, born of the bodies of all the gods, which pervaded the three worlds with its light, gathering into one became a female.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण देवताओंके शरीरसे प्रकट हुए उस तेजकी कहीं तुलना नहीं थी। एकत्रित होनेपर वह एक नारीके रूपमें परिणत हो गया और अपने प्रकाशसे तीनों लोकोंमें व्याप्त जान पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: यदभूच्छाम्भवं तेजस्तेनाजायत तन्मुखम् । याम्येन चाभवन् केशा बाहवो विष्णुतेजसा
verses.transliteration: yadabhUchChAmbhavaM tejastenAjAyata tanmukham | yAmyena chAbhavan keshA bAhavo viShNutejasA
verses.translation: By what was Shiva's energy her face was developed, and by Yama's energy grew her hair, and her arms by Vishnu's energy,
verses.commentary: Sense: By what was Shiva's energy her face was developed, and by Yama's energy grew her hair, and her arms by Vishnu's energy,
verses.hindi: भगवान्‌ शंकरका जो तेज था, उससे उस देवीका मुख प्रकट हुआ। यमराजके तेजसे उसके सिरमें बाल निकल आये। श्रीविष्णुभगवान्‌के तेजसे उसकी भुजाएँ हुईं

verses.sanskrit: सौम्येन स्तनयोर्युग्मं मध्यं चैन्द्रेण चाभवत् । वारुणेन च जङ्घोरू नितम्बस्तेजसा भुवः
verses.transliteration: saumyena stanayoryugmaM madhyaM chaindreNa chAbhavat | vAruNena cha ja~NghorU nitambastejasA bhuvaH
verses.translation: by the Moon's her twin breasts; and her waist came into being by Indra's energy, and by Varuna's her legs and thighs, by the Earth's energy her hips,
verses.commentary: Sense: by the Moon's her twin breasts; and her waist came into being by Indra's energy, and by Varuna's her legs and thighs, by the Earth's energy her hips,
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमाके तेजसे दोनों स्तनोंका और इन्द्रके तेजसे मध्यभाग (कटिप्रदेश)-का प्रादर्भाव हुआ। वरुणके तेजसे जड़घा और पिंडली तथा पृथ्वीके तेजसे नितम्बभाग प्रकट हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तेजसा पादौ तदङ्गुल्योऽर्कतेजसा । वसूनां च कराङ्गुल्यः कौबेरेण च नासिका
verses.transliteration: brahmaNastejasA pAdau tada~Ngulyo.arkatejasA | vasUnAM cha karA~NgulyaH kaubereNa cha nAsikA
verses.translation: by Brahma's energy her feet, her toes by the Sun's energy, and by the Vasus' energy her hands and fingers, and by Kuvera's her nose;
verses.commentary: Sense: by Brahma's energy her feet, her toes by the Sun's energy, and by the Vasus' energy her hands and fingers, and by Kuvera's her nose;
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके तेजसे दोनों चरण और सूर्यके तेजसे उनकी अँगुलियाँ हुईं। वसुओंके तेजसे हाथोंकी अँगुलियाँ और कुबेरेके तेजसे नासिका प्रकट हुई

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तु दन्ताः सम्भूताः प्राजापत्येन तेजसा । नयनत्रितयं जज्ञे तथा पावकतेजसा
verses.transliteration: tasyAstu dantAH sambhUtAH prAjApatyena tejasA | nayanatritayaM jaj~ne tathA pAvakatejasA
verses.translation: and her teeth grew by the Prajapati's energy, and three eyes were developed by Agni's energy;
verses.commentary: Sense: and her teeth grew by the Prajapati's energy, and three eyes were developed by Agni's energy;
verses.hindi: तस्यास्तु दन्ता: सम्भूता: प्राजापत्येन तेजसा । नयनत्रितयं जज्ञे तथा पावकतेजसा

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुवौ च सन्ध्ययोस्तेजः श्रवणावनिलस्य च । अन्येषां चैव देवानां सम्भवस्तेजसां शिवा
verses.transliteration: bhruvau cha sandhyayostejaH shravaNAvanilasya cha | anyeShAM chaiva devAnAM sambhavastejasAM shivA
verses.translation: and her eyebrows were the energy of the two twilights, and her ears Vayu's energy; and the coming into being of the energies of the other gods became the auspicious goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: and her eyebrows were the energy of the two twilights, and her ears Vayu's energy; and the coming into being of the energies of the other gods became the auspicious goddess.
verses.hindi: उसकी भौंहें संध्याके और कान वायुके तेजसे उत्पन्न हुए थे। इसी प्रकार अन्यान्य देवताओंके तेजसे उस कल्याणकारी देवीका आविर्भाव हुआ

verses.sanskrit: ततः समस्तदेवानां तेजोराशिसमुद्भवाम् । तां विलोक्य मुदं प्रापुरमरा महिषार्दिताः । ततो देवा ददुस्तस्यै स्वानि स्वान्यायुधानि च
verses.transliteration: tataH samastadevAnAM tejorAshisamudbhavAm | tAM vilokya mudaM prApuramarA mahiShArditAH | tato devA dadustasyai svAni svAnyAyudhAni cha
verses.translation: Then gazing at her, who had sprung from the combined energies of all the gods, the Immortals who were afflicted by Mahisha felt a keen joy. Then the gods gave her each their own weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then gazing at her, who had sprung from the combined energies of all the gods, the Immortals who were afflicted by Mahisha felt a keen joy. Then the gods gave her each their own weapons.
verses.hindi: तुष्ठवुर्मुनयश्वैनां भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तय: । तदनन्तर समस्त देवताओंके तेज:पुज्जसे प्रकट हुई देवीको देखकर महिषासुरके सताये हुए देवता बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sanskrit: शूलं शूलाद्विनिष्कृष्य ददौ तस्यै पिनाकधृक् । चक्रं च दत्तवान् कृष्णः समुत्पाट्य स्वचक्रतः
verses.transliteration: shUlaM shUlAdviniShkR^iShya dadau tasyai pinAkadhR^ik | chakraM cha dattavAn kR^iShNaH samutpATya svachakrataH
verses.translation: The bearer of the bow Pinaka, drawing a trident forth from his own trident, gave it to her; and Krishna gave a discus, pulling it out of his own discus;
verses.commentary: Sense: The bearer of the bow Pinaka, drawing a trident forth from his own trident, gave it to her; and Krishna gave a discus, pulling it out of his own discus;
verses.hindi: पिनाकधारी भगवान्‌ शड्करने अपने शूलसे एक शूल निकालकर उन्हें दिया; फिर भगवान्‌ विष्णुने भी अपने चक्रसे चक्र उत्पन्न करके भगवतीको अर्पण किया

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खं च वरुणः शक्तिं ददौ तस्यै हुताशनः । मारुतो दत्तवांश्चापं बाणपूर्णे तथेषुधी
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhaM cha varuNaH shaktiM dadau tasyai hutAshanaH | mAruto dattavAMshchApaM bANapUrNe tatheShudhI
verses.translation: and Varuna gave her a conch, Agni a spear, Maruta gave a bow and a quiver filled with arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: and Varuna gave her a conch, Agni a spear, Maruta gave a bow and a quiver filled with arrows.
verses.hindi: शड्खं च वरुण: शक्ति ददौ तस्यै हुताशन: । मारुतो दत्तवांश्वापं बाणपूर्णे तथेषुधी

verses.sanskrit: वज्रमिन्द्रः समुत्पाट्य कुलिशादमराधिपः । ददौ तस्यै सहस्राक्षो घण्टामैरावताद्गजात्
verses.transliteration: vajramindraH samutpATya kulishAdamarAdhipaH | dadau tasyai sahasrAkSho ghaNTAmairAvatAdgajAt
verses.translation: Indra, lord of the Immortals, gave a thunderbolt, pulling it out of his own thunderbolt; the Thousand-eyed gave her a bell from his elephant Airavata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, lord of the Immortals, gave a thunderbolt, pulling it out of his own thunderbolt; the Thousand-eyed gave her a bell from his elephant Airavata.
verses.hindi: सहस्र नेत्रोंवाले देवराज इन्द्रने अपने वज्रसे उत्पन्न करके दिया और ऐरावत हाथीसे उतारकर एक घण्टा भी प्रदान किया

verses.sanskrit: कालदण्डाद्यमो दण्डं पाशं चाम्बुपतिर्ददौ । प्रजापतिश्चाक्षमालां ददौ ब्रह्मा कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: kAladaNDAdyamo daNDaM pAshaM chAmbupatirdadau | prajApatishchAkShamAlAM dadau brahmA kamaNDalum
verses.translation: Yama gave a rod from his own rod of Fate, and the lord of the waters a noose; and the Prajapati gave her a necklace of beads, Brahma an earthen water-pot;
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama gave a rod from his own rod of Fate, and the lord of the waters a noose; and the Prajapati gave her a necklace of beads, Brahma an earthen water-pot;
verses.hindi: यमराजने कालदण्डसे दण्ड, वरुणने पाश, प्रजापतिने स्फटिकाक्षकी माला तथा ब्रह्माजीने कमण्डलु भेंट किया

verses.sanskrit: समस्तरोमकूपेषु निजरश्मीन् दिवाकरः । कालश्च दत्तवान् खड्गं तस्यै चर्म च निर्मलम्
verses.transliteration: samastaromakUpeShu nijarashmIn divAkaraH | kAlashcha dattavAn khaDgaM tasyai charma cha nirmalam
verses.translation: the Sun bestowed his own rays on all the pores of her skin, and Destiny gave her a sword and a spotless shield;
verses.commentary: Sense: the Sun bestowed his own rays on all the pores of her skin, and Destiny gave her a sword and a spotless shield;
verses.hindi: सूर्यने देवीके समस्त रोम-कूपोंमें अपनी किरणोंका तेज भर दिया। कालने उन्हें चमकती हुई ढाल और तलवार दी

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदश्चामलं हारमजरे च तथाम्बरे । चूडामणिं तथा दिव्यं कुण्डले कटकानि च
verses.transliteration: kShIrodashchAmalaM hAramajare cha tathAmbare | chUDAmaNiM tathA divyaM kuNDale kaTakAni cha
verses.translation: and the Ocean of milk a spotless necklace of pearls and also a pair of undecaying garments, and a celestial crest-jewel, a pair of ear-rings, and bracelets,
verses.commentary: Sense: and the Ocean of milk a spotless necklace of pearls and also a pair of undecaying garments, and a celestial crest-jewel, a pair of ear-rings, and bracelets,
verses.hindi: क्षीरोदश्षामलं हारमजरे च तथाम्बरे । चूडामर्णिं तथा दिव्यं कुण्डले कटकानि च

verses.sanskrit: अर्धचन्द्रं तथा शुभ्रं केयूरान् सर्वबाहुषु । नूपुरौ विमलौ तद्वद् ग्रैवेयकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ardhachandraM tathA shubhraM keyUrAn sarvabAhuShu | nUpurau vimalau tadvad graiveyakamanuttamam
verses.translation: and a brilliant half-moon ornament, and armlets over all her arms, and also a pair of bright anklets, and a necklet of the finest make,
verses.commentary: Sense: and a brilliant half-moon ornament, and armlets over all her arms, and also a pair of bright anklets, and a necklet of the finest make,
verses.hindi: अर्धचन्द्रं तथा शुभ्र॑ केयूरान्‌ सर्वबाहुषु । नूपुरो विमलौ तठद्वद ग्रैवेयममनुत्तमम्‌

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलीयकरत्नानि समस्तास्वङ्गुलीषु च । विश्वकर्मा ददौ तस्यै परशुं चातिनिर्मलम्
verses.transliteration: a~NgulIyakaratnAni samastAsva~NgulIShu cha | vishvakarmA dadau tasyai parashuM chAtinirmalam
verses.translation: and rings and gems on all her fingers; and Vishvakarman gave to her a brightly polished axe,
verses.commentary: Sense: and rings and gems on all her fingers; and Vishvakarman gave to her a brightly polished axe,
verses.hindi: क्षीरसमुद्रने उज्ज्वल हार तथा कभी जीर्ण न होनेवाले दो दिव्य वस्त्र भेंट किये। साथ ही उन्होंने दिव्य चूड़ामणि, दो कुण्डल, कड़े, उज्ज्वल अर्धचन्द्र, सब बाहुओंके लिये केयूर, दोनों चरणोंके लिये निर्मल नूपुर, गलेकी सुन्दर हँसली और सब अँगुलियोंमें पहननेके लिये रत्नोंकी बनी अँगूठियाँ भी दीं। विश्वकर्माने उन्हें अत्यन्त निर्मल फरसा भेंट किया

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्राण्यनेकरूपाणि तथाभेद्यं च दंशनम् । अम्लानपङ्कजां मालां शिरस्युरसि चापराम्
verses.transliteration: astrANyanekarUpANi tathAbhedyaM cha daMshanam | amlAnapa~NkajAM mAlAM shirasyurasi chAparAm
verses.translation: weapons of many shapes and also armour that could not be pierced; and Ocean gave her a garland of fadeless lotus-flowers for her head and another for her breast,
verses.commentary: Sense: weapons of many shapes and also armour that could not be pierced; and Ocean gave her a garland of fadeless lotus-flowers for her head and another for her breast,
verses.hindi: अस्त्राण्यनेकरूपाणि तथाभेद्यं च दंशनम्‌ । अम्लानपड़्कजां मालां शिरस्युरसि चापराम्‌

verses.sanskrit: अददज्जलधिस्तस्यै पङ्कजं चातिशोभनम् । हिमवान् वाहनं सिंहं रत्नानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: adadajjaladhistasyai pa~NkajaM chAtishobhanam | himavAn vAhanaM siMhaM ratnAni vividhAni cha
verses.translation: and a very brilliant lotus-flower besides. Himavat gave her a lion to ride on and gems of various kinds.
verses.commentary: Sense: and a very brilliant lotus-flower besides. Himavat gave her a lion to ride on and gems of various kinds.
verses.hindi: जलधिने उन्हें सुन्दर कमलका फूल भेंट किया। हिमालयने सवारीके लिये सिंह तथा भाँति-भाँतिके रत्न समर्पित किये

verses.sanskrit: ददावशून्यं सुरया पानपात्रं धनाधिपः । शेषश्च सर्वनागेशो महामणिविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: dadAvashUnyaM surayA pAnapAtraM dhanAdhipaH | sheShashcha sarvanAgesho mahAmaNivibhUShitam
verses.translation: Kuvera, the lord of wealth, gave a drinking cup ever full of wine. And Shesha, the lord of all the serpents, who supports this earth,
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuvera, the lord of wealth, gave a drinking cup ever full of wine. And Shesha, the lord of all the serpents, who supports this earth,
verses.hindi: धनाध्यक्ष कुबेरने मधुसे भरा पानपात्र दिया तथा सम्पूर्ण नागोंके राजा शेषने, जो इस पृथ्वीको धारण करते हैं, उन्हें बहुमूल्य मणियोंसे विभूषित नागहार भेंट दिया। इसी प्रकार अन्य देवताओंने भी आभूषण और अस्त्र-शस्त्र देकर देवीका सम्मान किया। तत्पश्चात्‌ उन्होंने बारंबार अट्टहासपूर्वक उच्चस्वरसे गर्जना की। उनके भयंकर नादसे सम्पूर्ण आकाश गूँज उठा

verses.sanskrit: नागहारं ददौ तस्यै धत्ते यः पृथिवीमिमाम् । अन्यैरपि सुरैर्देवी भूषणैरायुधैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nAgahAraM dadau tasyai dhatte yaH pR^ithivImimAm | anyairapi surairdevI bhUShaNairAyudhaistathA
verses.translation: gave her a serpent-necklace adorned with large gems. Honoured by other gods also with gifts of ornaments and weapons,
verses.commentary: Sense: gave her a serpent-necklace adorned with large gems. Honoured by other gods also with gifts of ornaments and weapons,
verses.hindi: नागहारं ददौ तस्यै धत्ते यः पृथिवीमिमाम्‌ | अन्यैरपि सुरैर्देवी भूषणैरायुधैस्तथा

verses.sanskrit: सम्मानिता ननादोच्चैः साट्टहासं मुहुर्मुहुः । तस्या नादेन घोरेण कृत्स्नमापूरितं नभः
verses.transliteration: sammAnitA nanAdochchaiH sATTahAsaM muhurmuhuH | tasyA nAdena ghoreNa kR^itsnamApUritaM nabhaH
verses.translation: the goddess uttered a loud roar blended with a horse-laugh again and again. The whole welkin was filled with her terrible roar.
verses.commentary: Sense: the goddess uttered a loud roar blended with a horse-laugh again and again. The whole welkin was filled with her terrible roar.
verses.hindi: धनाध्यक्ष कुबेरने मधुसे भरा पानपात्र दिया तथा सम्पूर्ण नागोंके राजा शेषने, जो इस पृथ्वीको धारण करते हैं, उन्हें बहुमूल्य मणियोंसे विभूषित नागहार भेंट दिया। इसी प्रकार अन्य देवताओंने भी आभूषण और अस्त्र-शस्त्र देकर देवीका सम्मान किया। तत्पश्चात्‌ उन्होंने बारंबार अट्टहासपूर्वक उच्चस्वरसे गर्जना की। उनके भयंकर नादसे सम्पूर्ण आकाश गूँज उठा

verses.sanskrit: अमायतातिमहता प्रतिशब्दो महानभूत् । चुक्षुभुः सकला लोकाः समुद्राश्च चकम्पिरे
verses.transliteration: amAyatAtimahatA pratishabdo mahAnabhUt | chukShubhuH sakalA lokAH samudrAshcha chakampire
verses.translation: By that penetrating and exceedingly great roar a great echo arose; all the worlds shook and the seas trembled,
verses.commentary: Sense: By that penetrating and exceedingly great roar a great echo arose; all the worlds shook and the seas trembled,
verses.hindi: देवीका वह अत्यन्त उच्चस्वरसे किया हुआ सिंहनाद कहीं समा न सका, आकाश उसके सामने लघु प्रतीत होने लगा। उससे बड़े जोरकी प्रतिध्वनि हुई, जिससे सम्पूर्ण विश्वमें हलचल मच गयी और समुद्र काँप उठे

verses.sanskrit: चचाल वसुधा चेलुः सकलाश्च महीधराः । जयेति देवाश्च मुदा तामूचुः सिंहवाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: chachAla vasudhA cheluH sakalAshcha mahIdharAH | jayeti devAshcha mudA tAmUchuH siMhavAhinIm
verses.translation: the earth quaked and all the mountains moved. And 'Conquer thou!' exclaimed the gods with joy to her who rode on the lion,
verses.commentary: Sense: the earth quaked and all the mountains moved. And 'Conquer thou!' exclaimed the gods with joy to her who rode on the lion,
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी डोलने लगी और समस्त पर्वत हिलने लगे। उस समय देवताओंने अत्यन्त प्रसन्नताके साथ सिंहवाहिनी भवानीसे कहा -- देवि! तुम्हारी जय हो'

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुर्मुनयश्चैनां भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तयः । दृष्ट्वा समस्तं सङ्क्षुब्धं त्रैलोक्यममरारयः
verses.transliteration: tuShTuvurmunayashchainAM bhaktinamrAtmamUrtayaH | dR^iShTvA samastaM sa~NkShubdhaM trailokyamamarArayaH
verses.translation: and the munis extolled her as they bowed their bodies in faith. Seeing all the three worlds greatly agitated, the foes of the Immortals
verses.commentary: Sense: and the munis extolled her as they bowed their bodies in faith. Seeing all the three worlds greatly agitated, the foes of the Immortals
verses.hindi: मुमोचासुरदेहेषु शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चेश्वरी । सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकीको क्षोभग्रस्त देख दैत्यगण अपनी समस्त सेनाको कवच आदिसे सुसज्जित कर, हाथोंमें हथियार ले सहसा उठकर खड़े हो गये। उस समय महिषासुरने बड़े क्रोधमें आकर कहा--'“आ:! यह क्या हो रहा है।' फिर वह सम्पूर्ण असुरोंसे घिरकर उस सिंहनादकी ओर लक्ष्य करके दौड़ा और आगे पहुँचकर उसने देवीको देखा, जो अपनी प्रभासे तीनों लोकोंको प्रकाशित कर रही थीं

verses.sanskrit: सन्नद्धाखिलसैन्यास्ते समुत्तस्थुरुदायुधाः । आः किमेतदिति क्रोधादाभाष्य महिषासुरः
verses.transliteration: sannaddhAkhilasainyAste samuttasthurudAyudhAH | AH kimetaditi krodhAdAbhAShya mahiShAsuraH
verses.translation: uniting all their armies rose up together with uplifted weapons. 'Ha! what is this?' exclaimed the Asura Mahisha in wrath,
verses.commentary: Sense: uniting all their armies rose up together with uplifted weapons. 'Ha! what is this?' exclaimed the Asura Mahisha in wrath,
verses.hindi: मुमोचासुरदेहेषु शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चेश्वरी । सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकीको क्षोभग्रस्त देख दैत्यगण अपनी समस्त सेनाको कवच आदिसे सुसज्जित कर, हाथोंमें हथियार ले सहसा उठकर खड़े हो गये। उस समय महिषासुरने बड़े क्रोधमें आकर कहा--'“आ:! यह क्या हो रहा है।' फिर वह सम्पूर्ण असुरोंसे घिरकर उस सिंहनादकी ओर लक्ष्य करके दौड़ा और आगे पहुँचकर उसने देवीको देखा, जो अपनी प्रभासे तीनों लोकोंको प्रकाशित कर रही थीं

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावत तं शब्दमशेषैरसुरैर्वृतः । स ददर्श ततो देवीं व्याप्तलोकत्रयां त्विषा
verses.transliteration: abhyadhAvata taM shabdamasheShairasurairvR^itaH | sa dadarsha tato devIM vyAptalokatrayAM tviShA
verses.translation: and rushed, surrounded by all the Asuras, towards that roar. Then he saw the goddess, pervading the three worlds with her light,
verses.commentary: Sense: and rushed, surrounded by all the Asuras, towards that roar. Then he saw the goddess, pervading the three worlds with her light,
verses.hindi: अभ्यधावत तं शब्दमशेषैरसुरैर्व॒त: । स ददर्श ततो देवीं व्याप्तलोकत्रयां त्विषा

verses.sanskrit: पादाक्रान्त्या नतभुवं किरीटोल्लिखिताम्बराम् । क्षोभिताशेषपातालां धनुर्ज्यानिःस्वनेन ताम्
verses.transliteration: pAdAkrAntyA natabhuvaM kirITollikhitAmbarAm | kShobhitAsheShapAtAlAM dhanurjyAniHsvanena tAm
verses.translation: causing the earth to bow at the touch of her feet, grazing the firmament with her crest, shaking the whole of Patala with the twang of her bow-string,
verses.commentary: Sense: causing the earth to bow at the touch of her feet, grazing the firmament with her crest, shaking the whole of Patala with the twang of her bow-string,
verses.hindi: उनके चरणोंके भारसे पृथ्वी दबी जा रही थी। माथेके मुकुटसे आकाशगमें रेखा-सी खिंच रही थी तथा वे अपने धनुषकी टड्कारसे सातों पातालोंको क्षुब्ध किये देती थीं

verses.sanskrit: दिशो भुजसहस्रेण समन्ताद्व्याप्य संस्थिताम् । ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तया देव्या सुरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: disho bhujasahasreNa samantAdvyApya saMsthitAm | tataH pravavR^ite yuddhaM tayA devyA suradviShAm
verses.translation: standing pervading the sky all around with her thousand arms. Then began a battle between the goddess and the enemies of the gods,
verses.commentary: Sense: standing pervading the sky all around with her thousand arms. Then began a battle between the goddess and the enemies of the gods,
verses.hindi: देवी अपनी हजारों भुजाओंसे सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंको आच्छादित करके खड़ी थीं। तदनन्तर उनके साथ दैत्योंका युद्ध छिड़ गया

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रास्त्रैर्बहुधा मुक्तैरादीपितदिगन्तरम् । महिषासुरसेनानीश्चिक्षुराख्यो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: shastrAstrairbahudhA muktairAdIpitadigantaram | mahiShAsurasenAnIshchikShurAkhyo mahAsuraH
verses.translation: in which every region of the sky was illumined with the weapons and arms hurled in abundance. The Asura Mahisha's general, the great Asura named Chikshura,
verses.commentary: Sense: in which every region of the sky was illumined with the weapons and arms hurled in abundance. The Asura Mahisha's general, the great Asura named Chikshura,
verses.hindi: नाना प्रकारके अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंके प्रहारसे सम्पूर्ण दिशाएँ उद्धासित होने लगीं। चिक्षुर नामक महान्‌ असुर महिषासुरका सेनानायक था

verses.sanskrit: युयुधे चामरश्चान्यैश्चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः । रथानामयुतैः षड्भिरुदग्राख्यो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: yuyudhe chAmarashchAnyaishchatura~NgabalAnvitaH | rathAnAmayutaiH ShaD.hbhirudagrAkhyo mahAsuraH
verses.translation: fought with her; and the Asura Chamara, attended by fourfold forces, fought along with others. The great Asura named Udagra with six myriads of chariots fought;
verses.commentary: Sense: fought with her; and the Asura Chamara, attended by fourfold forces, fought along with others. The great Asura named Udagra with six myriads of chariots fought;
verses.hindi: ययुधे चामरश्नान्यैश्षतुरज़बलान्वित: । रथानामयुतै: षड्भिरुदग्राख्यो महासुर:

verses.sanskrit: अयुध्यतायुतानां च सहस्रेण महाहनुः । पञ्चाशद्भिश्च नियुतैरसिलोमा महासुरः
verses.transliteration: ayudhyatAyutAnAM cha sahasreNa mahAhanuH | pa~nchAshadbhishcha niyutairasilomA mahAsuraH
verses.translation: and Mahahanu with a thousand myriads gave battle; and the great Asura Asiloman with fifty millions;
verses.commentary: Sense: and Mahahanu with a thousand myriads gave battle; and the great Asura Asiloman with fifty millions;
verses.hindi: एक करोड़ रथियोंको साथ लेकर महाहनु नामक दैत्य युद्ध करने लगा। जिसके रोएँ तलवारके समान तीखे थे, वह असिलोमा नामका महादैत्य पाँच करोड़ रथी सैनिकोंसहित युद्धमें आ डटा

verses.sanskrit: अयुतानां शतैः षड्भिर्बाष्कलो युयुधे रणे । गजवाजिसहस्रौघैरनेकैः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: ayutAnAM shataiH ShaD.hbhirbAShkalo yuyudhe raNe | gajavAjisahasraughairanekaiH parivAritaH
verses.translation: with six hundred myriads Bashkala fought in the battle; another, surrounded with many troops of thousands of elephants and horses,
verses.commentary: Sense: with six hundred myriads Bashkala fought in the battle; another, surrounded with many troops of thousands of elephants and horses,
verses.hindi: अयुतानां शतै: षड्भिर्बष्कलो युयुधे रणे । गजवाजिसहस्रौघैरनेकै:* परिवारित:

verses.sanskrit: वृतो रथानां कोट्या च युद्धे तस्मिन्नयुध्यत । बिडालाख्योऽयुतानां च पञ्चाशद्भिरथायुतैः
verses.transliteration: vR^ito rathAnAM koTyA cha yuddhe tasminnayudhyata | biDAlAkhyo.ayutAnAM cha pa~nchAshadbhirathAyutaiH
verses.translation: and with ten million chariots, fought in that battle; and the Asura named Bidala fought in the battle there, surrounded with fifty myriads of myriads of chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: and with ten million chariots, fought in that battle; and the Asura named Bidala fought in the battle there, surrounded with fifty myriads of myriads of chariots.
verses.hindi: वृतो रथानां कोट्यां च युद्धे तस्मिन्नयुध्यत । बिडालाख्यो<5युतानां च पञ्चाशद्भिरथायुतै:

verses.sanskrit: युयुधे संयुगे तत्र रथानां परिवारितः । अन्ये च तत्रायुतशो रथनागहयैर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: yuyudhe saMyuge tatra rathAnAM parivAritaH | anye cha tatrAyutasho rathanAgahayairvR^itAH
verses.translation: And other great Asuras in myriads, surrounded with chariots, elephants and horses,
verses.commentary: Sense: And other great Asuras in myriads, surrounded with chariots, elephants and horses,
verses.hindi: युयुधे संयुगे तत्र रथानां परिवारित:? | अन्ये च तत्रायुतशो रथनागहयैर्वृता:

verses.sanskrit: युयुधुः संयुगे देव्या सह तत्र महासुराः । कोटिकोटिसहस्रैस्तु रथानां दन्तिनां तथा
verses.transliteration: yuyudhuH saMyuge devyA saha tatra mahAsurAH | koTikoTisahasraistu rathAnAM dantinAM tathA
verses.translation: fought with the goddess in that battle there. Now the Asura Mahisha was surrounded with thousands of ten million times ten millions of chariots and elephants
verses.commentary: Sense: fought with the goddess in that battle there. Now the Asura Mahisha was surrounded with thousands of ten million times ten millions of chariots and elephants
verses.hindi: युयुधु: संयुगे देव्या सह तत्र महासुरा: । कोटिकोटिसहसैस्तु रथानां दन्तिनां तथा

verses.sanskrit: हयानां च वृतो युद्धे तत्राभून्महिषासुरः । तोमरैर्भिन्दिपालैश्च शक्तिभिर्मुसलैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: hayAnAM cha vR^ito yuddhe tatrAbhUnmahiShAsuraH | tomarairbhindipAlaishcha shaktibhirmusalaistathA
verses.translation: and horses in the battle there. With iron maces and javelins, with spears and clubs,
verses.commentary: Sense: and horses in the battle there. With iron maces and javelins, with spears and clubs,
verses.hindi: हयानां च वृतो युद्धे तत्राभून्महिषासुर: । तोमरैर्भिन्दिपालैश्व शक्तिभिर्मुसलैस्तथा

verses.sanskrit: युयुधुः संयुगे देव्या खड्गैः परशुपट्टिशैः । केचिच्च चिक्षिपुः शक्तीः केचित् पाशांस्तथापरे
verses.transliteration: yuyudhuH saMyuge devyA khaDgaiH parashupaTTishaiH | kechichcha chikShipuH shaktIH kechit pAshAMstathApare
verses.translation: with swords, with axes and halberds they fought in the battle against the goddess. And some hurled spears, and others nooses,
verses.commentary: Sense: with swords, with axes and halberds they fought in the battle against the goddess. And some hurled spears, and others nooses,
verses.hindi: युयुधु: संयुगे देव्या खड्गै: परशुपट्टिशै: । केचिच्च चिक्षिपु: शक्ती: केचित्पाशांस्तथापरे

verses.sanskrit: देवीं खड्गप्रहारैस्तु ते तां हन्तुं प्रचक्रमुः । सापि देवी ततस्तानि शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चण्डिका
verses.transliteration: devIM khaDgaprahAraistu te tAM hantuM prachakramuH | sApi devI tatastAni shastrANyastrANi chaNDikA
verses.translation: but they assailed the goddess with blows from their swords in order to slay her. And then the goddess Chandika those weapons and arms
verses.commentary: Sense: but they assailed the goddess with blows from their swords in order to slay her. And then the goddess Chandika those weapons and arms
verses.hindi: देवीं खड्गप्रहारैस्तु ते तां हन्तुं प्रचक्रमु: । सापि देवी ततस्तानि शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चण्डिका

verses.sanskrit: लीलयैव प्रचिच्छेद निजशस्त्रास्त्रवर्षिणी । अनायस्तानना देवी स्तूयमाना सुरर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: lIlayaiva prachichCheda nijashastrAstravarShiNI | anAyastAnanA devI stUyamAnA surarShibhiH
verses.translation: clove, as it were in merest play, by raining forth her own weapons and arms. The goddess betrayed no exertion in her countenance, while the gods and rishis were praising her.
verses.commentary: Sense: clove, as it were in merest play, by raining forth her own weapons and arms. The goddess betrayed no exertion in her countenance, while the gods and rishis were praising her.
verses.hindi: लीलयैव प्रचिच्छेद निजशस्त्रास्त्रवर्षिणी । अनायस्तानना देवी स्तूयमाना सुरपिभि:

verses.sanskrit: मुमोचासुरदेहेषु शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चेश्वरी । सोऽपि क्रुद्धो धुतसटो देव्या वाहनकेसरी
verses.transliteration: mumochAsuradeheShu shastrANyastrANi cheshvarI | so.api kruddho dhutasaTo devyA vAhanakesarI
verses.translation: The queenly goddess hurled her weapons and arms at the Asuras' bodies. The lion also that bore the goddess, enraged and with ruffled mane,
verses.commentary: Sense: The queenly goddess hurled her weapons and arms at the Asuras' bodies. The lion also that bore the goddess, enraged and with ruffled mane,
verses.hindi: ६९ ।। देवीका वाहन वह सिंह भी क्रोधमें भरकर गर्दनके बालोंको हिलाता हुआ असुरोंकी सेनामें इस प्रकार विचरने लगा, मानो वनोंमें दावानल फैल रहा हो। रणभूमिमें दैत्योंके साथ युद्ध करती हुई अम्बिका देवीने जितने नि:श्वास छोड़े, वे सभी तत्काल सैकड़ों-हजारों गणोंके रूपमें प्रकट हो गये और परशु, भिन्दिपाल, खड़ग तथा पट्टिश आदि अस्त्रोंद्वारा असुरोंका सामना करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: चचारासुरसैन्येषु वनेष्विव हुताशनः । निःश्वासान् मुमुचे यांश्च युध्यमाना रणेऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: chachArAsurasainyeShu vaneShviva hutAshanaH | niHshvAsAn mumuche yAMshcha yudhyamAnA raNe.ambikA
verses.translation: stalked among the armies of Asuras, like fire through the forests. And the deep breaths, which Ambika fighting in the battle breathed forth,
verses.commentary: Sense: stalked among the armies of Asuras, like fire through the forests. And the deep breaths, which Ambika fighting in the battle breathed forth,
verses.hindi: तथा कुछ दूसरे दैत्योंने खड्गप्रहार करके देवीको मार डालनेका उद्योग किया। देवीने भी क्रोधमें भरकर खेल-खेलमें ही अपने अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंकी वर्षा करके दैत्योंके वे समस्त अस्त्र-शस्त्र काट डाले। उनके मुखपर परिश्रम या थकावटका रंचमात्र भी चिह्न नहीं था, देवता और ऋषि उनकी स्तुति करते थे और वे भगवती परमेश्वरी दैत्योंके शरीरोंपर अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंकी वर्षा करती रहीं। चचारासुरसैन्येषु वनेष्विव हुताशन: । निःश्वासान्‌ मुमुचे यांश्व॒ युध्यमाना रणेडम्बिका

verses.sanskrit: त एव सद्यः सम्भूता गणाः शतसहस्रशः । युयुधुस्ते परशुभिर्भिन्दिपालासिपट्टिशैः
verses.transliteration: ta eva sadyaH sambhUtA gaNAH shatasahasrashaH | yuyudhuste parashubhirbhindipAlAsipaTTishaiH
verses.translation: came into real being at once as troops by hundreds and thousands. These fought with axes, with javelins, and swords and halberds,
verses.commentary: Sense: came into real being at once as troops by hundreds and thousands. These fought with axes, with javelins, and swords and halberds,
verses.hindi: ६९ ।। देवीका वाहन वह सिंह भी क्रोधमें भरकर गर्दनके बालोंको हिलाता हुआ असुरोंकी सेनामें इस प्रकार विचरने लगा, मानो वनोंमें दावानल फैल रहा हो। रणभूमिमें दैत्योंके साथ युद्ध करती हुई अम्बिका देवीने जितने नि:श्वास छोड़े, वे सभी तत्काल सैकड़ों-हजारों गणोंके रूपमें प्रकट हो गये और परशु, भिन्दिपाल, खड़ग तथा पट्टिश आदि अस्त्रोंद्वारा असुरोंका सामना करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: नाशयन्तोऽसुरगणान् देवीशक्त्युपबृंहिताः । अवादयन्त पटहान् गणाः शङ्खांस्तथापरे
verses.transliteration: nAshayanto.asuragaNAn devIshaktyupabR^iMhitAH | avAdayanta paTahAn gaNAH sha~NkhAMstathApare
verses.translation: destroying the Asura bands, being invigorated by the goddess' energy. And of these bands some raised a din with large drums, and others with conchs,
verses.commentary: Sense: destroying the Asura bands, being invigorated by the goddess' energy. And of these bands some raised a din with large drums, and others with conchs,
verses.hindi: नाशयन्तो5सुरगणान्‌ देवीशक्त्युपबंहिता: । अवादयन्त पटहान्‌ गणा: शड्खांस्तथापरे

verses.sanskrit: मृदङ्गांश्च तथैवान्ये तस्मिन् युद्धमहोत्सवे । ततो देवी त्रिशूलेन गदया शक्तिवृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: mR^ida~NgAMshcha tathaivAnye tasmin yuddhamahotsave | tato devI trishUlena gadayA shaktivR^iShTibhiH
verses.translation: and others besides with tabors, in that great battle-festival. Then the goddess with her trident, her club, with showers of spears,
verses.commentary: Sense: and others besides with tabors, in that great battle-festival. Then the goddess with her trident, her club, with showers of spears,
verses.hindi: मृदज़ांश्न तथैवान्ये तस्मिन्‌ युद्धमहोत्सवे । ततो देवी त्रिशूलेन गदया शक्तिवृष्टिभि:ः

verses.sanskrit: खड्गादिभिश्च शतशो निजघान महासुरान् । पातयामास चैवान्यान् घण्टास्वनविमोहितान्
verses.transliteration: khaDgAdibhishcha shatasho nijaghAna mahAsurAn | pAtayAmAsa chaivAnyAn ghaNTAsvanavimohitAn
verses.translation: and with her sword and other weapons slaughtered the great Asuras in hundreds, and laid others low who were bewitched with the ringing of her bell;
verses.commentary: Sense: and with her sword and other weapons slaughtered the great Asuras in hundreds, and laid others low who were bewitched with the ringing of her bell;
verses.hindi: उस संग्राम-महोत्सवमें कितने ही गण मृदड़ बजा रहे थे। तदनन्तर देवीने त्रिशूलसे, गदासे, शक्तिकी वर्षसे और खड्ग आदिसे सैकड़ों महादैत्योंका संहार कर डाला। कितनोंको घंटेके भयड्ूकर नादसे मूर्च्छित करके मार गिराया

verses.sanskrit: असुरान् भुवि पाशेन बद्ध्वा चान्यानकर्षयत् । केचिद् द्विधाकृतास्तीक्ष्णैः खड्गपातैस्तथापरे
verses.transliteration: asurAn bhuvi pAshena baddhvA chAnyAnakarShayat | kechid dvidhAkR^itAstIkShNaiH khaDgapAtaistathApare
verses.translation: and binding other Asuras with her noose, she dragged them on the ground. And others again, cloven in twain by sharp slashes of her sword,
verses.commentary: Sense: and binding other Asuras with her noose, she dragged them on the ground. And others again, cloven in twain by sharp slashes of her sword,
verses.hindi: असुरान्‌ भुवि पाशेन बद्ध्वा चान्यानकर्षयत्‌ । केचिद्‌ द्विधा कृतास्तीक्ष्पै: खड्गपातैस्तथापरे

verses.sanskrit: विपोथिता निपातेन गदया भुवि शेरते । वेमुश्च केचिद्रुधिरं मुसलेन भृशं हताः
verses.transliteration: vipothitA nipAtena gadayA bhuvi sherate | vemushcha kechidrudhiraM musalena bhR^ishaM hatAH
verses.translation: and crushed by blows with her mace, lie on the ground; and some, grievously battered by her club, vomited forth blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: and crushed by blows with her mace, lie on the ground; and some, grievously battered by her club, vomited forth blood.
verses.hindi: कितने ही गदाकी चोटसे घायल हो धरतीपर सो गये। कितने ही मूसलकी मारसे अत्यन्त आहत होकर रक्त वमन करने लगे। कुछ दैत्य शूलसे छाती फट जानेके कारण पृथ्वीपर ढेर हो गये। उस रणाड्रणमें बाणसमूहोंकी वृष्टिसे कितने ही असुरोंकी कमर टूट गयी

verses.sanskrit: केचिन्निपतिता भूमौ भिन्नाः शूलेन वक्षसि । निरन्तराः शरौघेण कृताः केचिद्रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration: kechinnipatitA bhUmau bhinnAH shUlena vakShasi | nirantarAH sharaugheNa kR^itAH kechidraNAjire
verses.translation: Some were felled to the ground, pierced in the breast by her trident. Some, being closely massed together, were cut in pieces by the torrent of her arrows in the battle-field.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some were felled to the ground, pierced in the breast by her trident. Some, being closely massed together, were cut in pieces by the torrent of her arrows in the battle-field.
verses.hindi: कितने ही गदाकी चोटसे घायल हो धरतीपर सो गये। कितने ही मूसलकी मारसे अत्यन्त आहत होकर रक्त वमन करने लगे। कुछ दैत्य शूलसे छाती फट जानेके कारण पृथ्वीपर ढेर हो गये। उस रणाड्रणमें बाणसमूहोंकी वृष्टिसे कितने ही असुरोंकी कमर टूट गयी

verses.sanskrit: श्येनानुकारिणः प्राणान् मुमुचुस्त्रिदशार्दनाः । केषाञ्चिद् बाहवश्छिन्नाश्छिन्नग्रीवास्तथापरे
verses.transliteration: shyenAnukAriNaH prANAn mumuchustridashArdanAH | keShA~nchid bAhavashChinnAshChinnagrIvAstathApare
verses.translation: Following the manner of an army, the afflicters of the thirty gods gave up the ghost; some with their arms cut off, and others with severed necks;
verses.commentary: Sense: Following the manner of an army, the afflicters of the thirty gods gave up the ghost; some with their arms cut off, and others with severed necks;
verses.hindi: श्येनानुकारिण:5 प्राणान्‌ मुमुचुस्त्रिदशार्दना: । केषांचिद्‌ बाहवश्शक्तिन्नाश्छिन्नग्रीवास्तथापरे

verses.sanskrit: शिरांसि पेतुरन्येषामन्ये मध्ये विदारिताः । विच्छिन्नजङ्घास्त्वपरे पेतुरुर्व्यां महासुराः
verses.transliteration: shirAMsi peturanyeShAmanye madhye vidAritAH | vichChinnaja~NghAstvapare petururvyAM mahAsurAH
verses.translation: their heads fell from others, others were torn asunder in the middle; and other great Asuras fell to the earth with legs clean cut off;
verses.commentary: Sense: their heads fell from others, others were torn asunder in the middle; and other great Asuras fell to the earth with legs clean cut off;
verses.hindi: बाजकी तरह झपटनेवाले देवपीडक दैत्यगण अपने प्राणोंसे हाथ धोने लगे। किन्हींकी बाँहें छिन्न- भिन्न हो गयीं, कितनोंकी गर्दनें कट गयीं। कितने ही दैत्योंके मस्तक कट-कटकर गिरने लगे। कुछ लोगोंके शरीर मध्यभागमें ही विदीर्ण हो गये। कितने ही महादैत्य जाँघें कट जानेसे पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े। कितनोंको ही देवीने एक बाँह, एक पैर और एक नेत्रवाले करके दो टुकड़ोंमें चीर डाला। कितने ही दैत्य मस्तक कट जानेपर भी गिरकर फिर उठ जाते और केवल धड़के ही रूपमें अच्छे-अच्छे हथियार हाथमें देवीके साथ युद्ध करने लगते थे। दूसरे कबन्ध युद्धके बाजोंकी लयपर नाचते थे

verses.sanskrit: एकबाह्वक्षिचरणाः केचिद्देव्या द्विधाकृताः । छिन्नेऽपि चान्ये शिरसि पतिताः पुनरुत्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ekabAhvakShicharaNAH kechiddevyA dvidhAkR^itAH | Chinne.api chAnye shirasi patitAH punarutthitAH
verses.translation: some were cloven by the goddess into two parts, with a single arm and eye and foot to each part; and others fell and rose again, although with head cut off.
verses.commentary: Sense: some were cloven by the goddess into two parts, with a single arm and eye and foot to each part; and others fell and rose again, although with head cut off.
verses.hindi: बाजकी तरह झपटनेवाले देवपीडक दैत्यगण अपने प्राणोंसे हाथ धोने लगे। किन्हींकी बाँहें छिन्न- भिन्न हो गयीं, कितनोंकी गर्दनें कट गयीं। कितने ही दैत्योंके मस्तक कट-कटकर गिरने लगे। कुछ लोगोंके शरीर मध्यभागमें ही विदीर्ण हो गये। कितने ही महादैत्य जाँघें कट जानेसे पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े। कितनोंको ही देवीने एक बाँह, एक पैर और एक नेत्रवाले करके दो टुकड़ोंमें चीर डाला। कितने ही दैत्य मस्तक कट जानेपर भी गिरकर फिर उठ जाते और केवल धड़के ही रूपमें अच्छे-अच्छे हथियार हाथमें देवीके साथ युद्ध करने लगते थे। दूसरे कबन्ध युद्धके बाजोंकी लयपर नाचते थे

verses.sanskrit: कबन्धा युयुधुर्देव्या गृहीतपरमायुधाः । ननृतुश्चापरे तत्र युद्धे तूर्यलयाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: kabandhA yuyudhurdevyA gR^ihItaparamAyudhAH | nanR^itushchApare tatra yuddhe tUryalayAshritAH
verses.translation: Headless corpses, still grasping the finest weapons, fought with the goddess; and others danced there in the battle, keeping time to the strains of the musical instruments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Headless corpses, still grasping the finest weapons, fought with the goddess; and others danced there in the battle, keeping time to the strains of the musical instruments.
verses.hindi: बाजकी तरह झपटनेवाले देवपीडक दैत्यगण अपने प्राणोंसे हाथ धोने लगे। किन्हींकी बाँहें छिन्न- भिन्न हो गयीं, कितनोंकी गर्दनें कट गयीं। कितने ही दैत्योंके मस्तक कट-कटकर गिरने लगे। कुछ लोगोंके शरीर मध्यभागमें ही विदीर्ण हो गये। कितने ही महादैत्य जाँघें कट जानेसे पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े। कितनोंको ही देवीने एक बाँह, एक पैर और एक नेत्रवाले करके दो टुकड़ोंमें चीर डाला। कितने ही दैत्य मस्तक कट जानेपर भी गिरकर फिर उठ जाते और केवल धड़के ही रूपमें अच्छे-अच्छे हथियार हाथमें देवीके साथ युद्ध करने लगते थे। दूसरे कबन्ध युद्धके बाजोंकी लयपर नाचते थे

verses.sanskrit: कबन्धाश्छिन्नशिरसः खड्गशक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः । तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति भाषन्तो देवीमन्ये महासुराः
verses.transliteration: kabandhAshChinnashirasaH khaDgashaktyR^iShTipANayaH | tiShTha tiShTheti bhAShanto devImanye mahAsurAH
verses.translation: Corpses, with heads severed, still held swords and spears and lances in their hands; and other great Asuras were shouting to the goddess, 'Stand! stand!'
verses.commentary: Sense: Corpses, with heads severed, still held swords and spears and lances in their hands; and other great Asuras were shouting to the goddess, 'Stand! stand!'
verses.hindi: कबन्धाश्छिन्नशिरस: खड्गशक्त्यृष्टिपाणय: । तिष्ठ तिछठेति भाषन्तो देवीमन्ये महासुरा:7

verses.sanskrit: पातितै रथनागाश्वैरसुरैश्च वसुन्धरा । अगम्या साभवत्तत्र यत्राभूत् स महारणः
verses.transliteration: pAtitai rathanAgAshvairasuraishcha vasundharA | agamyA sAbhavattatra yatrAbhUt sa mahAraNaH
verses.translation: With the prostrate chariots, elephants and horses and Asuras the earth became impassable where that great battle took place.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the prostrate chariots, elephants and horses and Asuras the earth became impassable where that great battle took place.
verses.hindi: कितने ही बिना सिरके धड़ हाथोंमें खड्ग, शक्ति और ऋष्टि लिये दौड़ते थे तथा दूसरे-दूसरे महादैत्य ठहरो! ठहरो!!” यह कहते हुए देवीको युद्धके लिये ललकारते थे। जहाँ वह घोर संग्राम हुआ था, वहाँकी धरती देवीके गिराये हुए रथ हाथी, घोड़े और असुरोंकी लाशोंमें ऐसी पट गयी थी कि वहाँ चलना-फिरना असम्भव हो गया था

verses.sanskrit: शोणितौघा महानद्यः सद्यस्तत्र प्रसुस्रुवुः । मध्ये चासुरसैन्यस्य वारणासुरवाजिनाम्
verses.transliteration: shoNitaughA mahAnadyaH sadyastatra prasusruvuH | madhye chAsurasainyasya vAraNAsuravAjinAm
verses.translation: And large rivers formed of torrents of blood straightway flowed along there amidst the armies of Asuras, and among the elephants, Asuras and horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: And large rivers formed of torrents of blood straightway flowed along there amidst the armies of Asuras, and among the elephants, Asuras and horses.
verses.hindi: दैत्योंकी सेनामें हाथी, घोड़े और असुरोंके शरीरोंसे इतनी अधिक मात्रामें रक्तपात हुआ था कि थोड़ी ही देरमें वहाँ खूनकी बड़ी-बड़ी नदियाँ बहने लगीं

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन तन्महासैन्यमसुराणां तथाम्बिका । निन्ये क्षयं यथा वह्निस्तृणदारुमहाचयम्
verses.transliteration: kShaNena tanmahAsainyamasurANAM tathAmbikA | ninye kShayaM yathA vahnistR^iNadArumahAchayam
verses.translation: Thus Ambika brought that great army of the Asuras to utter destruction in a moment, even as fire utterly consumes a huge pile of grass and timber.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Ambika brought that great army of the Asuras to utter destruction in a moment, even as fire utterly consumes a huge pile of grass and timber.
verses.hindi: क्षणेन तन्महासैन्यमसुराणां तथाम्बिका । निन्‍्ये क्षयं यथा वह्लिस्तृणदारुमहाचयम्‌

verses.sanskrit: स च सिंहो महानादमुत्सृजन् धुतकेसरः । शरीरेभ्योऽमरारीणामसूनिव विचिन्वति
verses.transliteration: sa cha siMho mahAnAdamutsR^ijan dhutakesaraH | sharIrebhyo.amarArINAmasUniva vichinvati
verses.translation: And the lion, with quivering mane, stalked on roaring aloud, prowling as it were for lives out of the bodies of the foes of the Immortals.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the lion, with quivering mane, stalked on roaring aloud, prowling as it were for lives out of the bodies of the foes of the Immortals.
verses.hindi: और वह सिंह भी गर्दनके बालोंको हिला-हिलाकर जोर-जोरसे गर्जना करता हुआ दैत्योंके शरीरोंसे मानो उनके प्राण चुने लेता था

verses.sanskrit: देव्या गणैश्च तैस्तत्र कृतं युद्धं तथासुरैः । यथैषां तुतुषुर्देवाः पुष्पवृष्टिमुचो दिवि
verses.transliteration: devyA gaNaishcha taistatra kR^itaM yuddhaM tathAsuraiH | yathaiShAM tutuShurdevAH puShpavR^iShTimucho divi
verses.translation: The battle was fought there between those troops of the goddess and the Asuras, so that the gods in heaven, sending down showers of flowers, gratified her.
verses.commentary: Sense: The battle was fought there between those troops of the goddess and the Asuras, so that the gods in heaven, sending down showers of flowers, gratified her.
verses.hindi: वहाँ देवीके गणोंने भी उन महादैत्योंके साथ ऐसा युद्ध किया, जिससे देवतागण उनपर आकाशसे फूल बरसाने लगे और उनकी स्तुति करने लगे।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ता आग कक की न.कूतऔवैनकऋनन ३. कई प्रतियोंमें इसके बाद “ततो देवा ददुस्तस्यै स्वानि स्वान्यायुधानि च । ऊचुर्जयजयेत्युच्चैर्जयन्तीं ते जयैषिण: ।। * इतना पाठ अधिक है। २. पा०--ट्य। ३. पा०--ट्य। ४. पा०--तस्यै चर्म। ५. पा०--वाहनाम्‌| ३. पा०--कैरुग्रदर्शन:। २. पा० किसी-किसी प्रतिमें इसके बाद “वृतः कालो रथानां च रणे पञ्चाशतायुतैः । युयुधे संयुगे तत्र तावद्धि: परिवारित: || ” इतना अधिक पाठ है। > परितो वारयति शत्रूनिति व्युत्पति: । ३. पा०-शरवृष्टिभि:। २. पा०--सेनानु०। शल्यानु०। शैलानु० ३. किसी-किसी प्रतिमें इसके बाद “रुधिरौघविलुप्ताड़ा: संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे |! इतना पाठ अधिक है। ४. पा०--यथैनां। ५. पा०--तुष्ट्‌ वुर्देवा:। तृतीयो5 ध्याय: सेनापतियोंसहित महिषासुरका वध ध्यान (३० उद्यद्धानुसहस्रकान्तिमरुणक्षौमां शिरोमालिकां रक्तालिप्तपयोधरां जपवटीं विद्यामभीतिं वरम्‌ | हस्ताब्जैर्दध्ती त्रिनेत्रविलसद्वक्तारविन्दश्रियं देवीं बद्धहिमांशुरत्नमुकुटां वन्देडरविन्दस्थिताम्‌ ।। जगदम्बाके श्रीअड़ोंकी कान्ति उदयकालके सहस्रों सूर्योके समान है। वे लाल रंगकी रेशमी साड़ी पहने हुए हैं। उनके गलेमें मुण्डमाला शोभा पा रही है। दोनों स्तनोंपर रक्त चन्दनका लेप लगा है। वे अपने कर-कमलोंमें जपमालिका, विद्या, अभय तथा व--मुद्राएँ धारण किये हुए हैं। तीन नेत्रोंसे सुशोभित मुखारविन्दकी बड़ी शोभा हो रही है। उनके मस्तकपर चन्द्रमाके साथ ही रत्नमय मुकुट बँधा है तथा वे कमलके आसनपर विराजमान हैं। ऐसी देवीको मैं भक्तिपूर्वक प्रणाम करता हूँ।) ऋषिरुवाच

verses.sanskrit: निहन्यमानं तत्सैन्यमवलोक्य महासुरः । सेनानीश्चिक्षुरः कोपाद्ययौ योद्धुमथाम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: nihanyamAnaM tatsainyamavalokya mahAsuraH | senAnIshchikShuraH kopAdyayau yoddhumathAmbikAm
verses.translation: Now the great Asura, the general Chikshura, seeing that army being slaughtered, advanced in wrath to fight with Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now the great Asura, the general Chikshura, seeing that army being slaughtered, advanced in wrath to fight with Ambika.
verses.hindi: “३०” निहन्यमानं तत्सैन्यमवलोक्य महासुर: । सेनानीश्षिक्षुर: कोपाद्ययौ योद्धुमथाम्बिकाम्‌

verses.sanskrit: स देवीं शरवर्षेण ववर्ष समरेऽसुरः । यथा मेरुगिरेः शृङ्गं तोयवर्षेण तोयदः
verses.transliteration: sa devIM sharavarSheNa vavarSha samare.asuraH | yathA merugireH shR^i~NgaM toyavarSheNa toyadaH
verses.translation: The Asura rained a shower of arrows on the goddess in the battle, as a cloud deluges mount Meru's summit with a shower of rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asura rained a shower of arrows on the goddess in the battle, as a cloud deluges mount Meru's summit with a shower of rain.
verses.hindi: से देवीं शरवर्षेण ववर्ष समरे5सुर: । यथा मेरुगिरे: शुडूं तोयवर्षेण तोयद:

verses.sanskrit: तस्य छित्वा ततो देवी लीलयैव शरोत्करान् । जघान तुरगान्बाणैर्यन्तारं चैव वाजिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasya ChitvA tato devI lIlayaiva sharotkarAn | jaghAna turagAnbANairyantAraM chaiva vAjinAm
verses.translation: The goddess, cutting asunder the masses of his arrows then as it were in play, smote his horses with her arrows and their charioteer;
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess, cutting asunder the masses of his arrows then as it were in play, smote his horses with her arrows and their charioteer;
verses.hindi: तस्यच्छित्त्वा ततो देवी लीलयैव शरोत्करान्‌ | जघान तुरगान्‌ बाणैर्यन्तारं चैव वाजिनाम्‌

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद च धनुः सद्यो ध्वजं चातिसमुच्छृतम् । विव्याध चैव गात्रेषु छिन्नधन्वानमाशुगैः
verses.transliteration: chichCheda cha dhanuH sadyo dhvajaM chAtisamuchChR^itam | vivyAdha chaiva gAtreShu ChinnadhanvAnamAshugaiH
verses.translation: and split his bow forthwith and his banner raised high aloft; and with swift missiles pierced his limbs as he stood with shattered bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: and split his bow forthwith and his banner raised high aloft; and with swift missiles pierced his limbs as he stood with shattered bow.
verses.hindi: साथ ही उसके धनुष तथा अत्यन्त ऊँची ध्वजाको भी तत्काल काट गिराया। धुनष कट जानेपर उसके अड्डोंको अपने बाणोंसे बींध डाला

verses.sanskrit: सच्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः । अभ्यधावत तां देवीं खड्गचर्मधरोऽसुरः
verses.transliteration: sachChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH | abhyadhAvata tAM devIM khaDgacharmadharo.asuraH
verses.translation: His bow shattered, his chariot useless, his horses killed, his charioteer slain, the Asura armed with sword and shield rushed at the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: His bow shattered, his chariot useless, his horses killed, his charioteer slain, the Asura armed with sword and shield rushed at the goddess.
verses.hindi: सच्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथि: । अभ्यधावत तां देवीं खड्गचर्मधरो5सुर:

verses.sanskrit: सिंहमाहत्य खड्गेन तीक्ष्णधारेण मूर्धनि । आजघान भुजे सव्ये देवीमप्यतिवेगवान्
verses.transliteration: siMhamAhatya khaDgena tIkShNadhAreNa mUrdhani | AjaghAna bhuje savye devImapyativegavAn
verses.translation: With the utmost celerity he smote the lion on the head with his sharp-edged sword, and struck the goddess also on her left arm.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the utmost celerity he smote the lion on the head with his sharp-edged sword, and struck the goddess also on her left arm.
verses.hindi: सिंहमाहत्य खड्गेन तीक्षणधारेण मूर्थनि । आजचघान भुजे सब्ये देवीमप्यतिवेगवान्‌

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः खड्गो भुजं प्राप्य पफाल नृपनन्दन । ततो जग्राह शूलं स कोपादरुणलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tasyAH khaDgo bhujaM prApya paphAla nR^ipanandana | tato jagrAha shUlaM sa kopAdaruNalochanaH
verses.translation: His sword shivered to pieces as it touched her arm, O prince. Thereon, red-eyed with anger, he grasped his pike,
verses.commentary: Sense: His sword shivered to pieces as it touched her arm, O prince. Thereon, red-eyed with anger, he grasped his pike,
verses.hindi: राजन! देवीकी बाँहपर पहुँचते ही वह तलवार टूट गयी, फिर तो क्रोधसे लाल आँखें करके उस राक्षसने शूल हाथमें लिया

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षेप च ततस्तत्तु भद्रकाल्यां महासुरः । जाज्वल्यमानं तेजोभी रविबिम्बमिवाम्बरात्
verses.transliteration: chikShepa cha tatastattu bhadrakAlyAM mahAsuraH | jAjvalyamAnaM tejobhI ravibimbamivAmbarAt
verses.translation: and he, the great Asura, flung it at Bhadrakali, as it were the Sun's orb blazing brightly with its splendour from out the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he, the great Asura, flung it at Bhadrakali, as it were the Sun's orb blazing brightly with its splendour from out the sky.
verses.hindi: और उसे उस महादैत्यने भगवती भद्रकालीके ऊपर चलाया। वह शूल आकाशसे गिरते हुए सूर्यमण्डलकी भाँति अपने तेजसे प्रज्वलित हो उठा

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तदापतच्छूलं देवी शूलममुञ्चत । तेन तच्छतधा नीतं शूलं स च महासुरः
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA tadApatachChUlaM devI shUlamamu~nchata | tena tachChatadhA nItaM shUlaM sa cha mahAsuraH
verses.translation: Seeing that pike falling on her, the goddess hurled her pike, and it shattered that pike into a hundred fragments and the great Asura also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that pike falling on her, the goddess hurled her pike, and it shattered that pike into a hundred fragments and the great Asura also.
verses.hindi: दृष्टवा तदापतच्छूलं देवी शूलममुज्चत । तच्छूलं5 शतधा तेन नीत॑ स च महासुर:

verses.sanskrit: हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये महिषस्य चमूपतौ । आजगाम गजारूढश्चामरस्त्रिदशार्दनः
verses.transliteration: hate tasminmahAvIrye mahiShasya chamUpatau | AjagAma gajArUDhashchAmarastridashArdanaH
verses.translation: When he, Mahisha's very valiant general, was slain, Chamara, the afflicter of the thirty gods, advanced mounted on an elephant;
verses.commentary: Sense: When he, Mahisha's very valiant general, was slain, Chamara, the afflicter of the thirty gods, advanced mounted on an elephant;
verses.hindi: महिषासुरके सेनापति उस महापराक्रमी चिक्षुरके मारे जानेपर देवताओंको पीड़ा देनेवाला चामर हाथीपर चढ़कर आया। उसने भी देवीके ऊपर शक्तिका प्रहार किया, किन्तु जगदम्बाने उसे अपने हुंकारसे ही आहत एवं निष्प्रभ करके तत्काल पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि शक्तिं मुमोचाथ देव्यास्तामम्बिका द्रुतम् । हुङ्काराभिहतां भूमौ पातयामास निष्प्रभाम्
verses.transliteration: so.api shaktiM mumochAtha devyAstAmambikA drutam | hu~NkArAbhihatAM bhUmau pAtayAmAsa niShprabhAm
verses.translation: and he also hurled his spear at the goddess. Down to the ground Ambika quickly struck it, assailed with a contemptuous hoot and rendered lustreless.
verses.commentary: Sense: and he also hurled his spear at the goddess. Down to the ground Ambika quickly struck it, assailed with a contemptuous hoot and rendered lustreless.
verses.hindi: महिषासुरके सेनापति उस महापराक्रमी चिक्षुरके मारे जानेपर देवताओंको पीड़ा देनेवाला चामर हाथीपर चढ़कर आया। उसने भी देवीके ऊपर शक्तिका प्रहार किया, किन्तु जगदम्बाने उसे अपने हुंकारसे ही आहत एवं निष्प्रभ करके तत्काल पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया

verses.sanskrit: भग्नां शक्तिं निपतितां दृष्ट्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः । चिक्षेप चामरः शूलं बाणैस्तदपि साच्छिनत्
verses.transliteration: bhagnAM shaktiM nipatitAM dR^iShTvA krodhasamanvitaH | chikShepa chAmaraH shUlaM bANaistadapi sAchChinat
verses.translation: Seeing his spear broken and fallen, Chamara filled with rage flung a pike; and that she split with her arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing his spear broken and fallen, Chamara filled with rage flung a pike; and that she split with her arrows.
verses.hindi: शक्तिको टूटकर गिरी हुई देख चामरको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ। अब उसने शूल चलाया, किन्तु देवीने उसे भी अपने बाणोंद्वारा काट डाला

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहः समुत्पत्य गजकुम्भान्तरे स्थितः । बाहुयुद्धेन युयुधे तेनोच्चैस्त्रिदशारिणा
verses.transliteration: tataH siMhaH samutpatya gajakumbhAntare sthitaH | bAhuyuddhena yuyudhe tenochchaistridashAriNA
verses.translation: Then the lion, leaping up, fastened on to the hollow of the elephant's forehead, and fought in close combat aloft with that foe of the thirty gods;
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lion, leaping up, fastened on to the hollow of the elephant's forehead, and fought in close combat aloft with that foe of the thirty gods;
verses.hindi: इतनेमें ही देवीका सिंह उछलकर हाथीके मस्तकपर चढ़ बैठा और उस दैत्यके साथ खूब जोर लगाकर बाहुयुद्ध करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: युध्यमानौ ततस्तौ तु तस्मान्नागान्महीं गतौ । युयुधातेऽतिसंरब्धौ प्रहारैरतिदारुणैः
verses.transliteration: yudhyamAnau tatastau tu tasmAnnAgAnmahIM gatau | yuyudhAte.atisaMrabdhau prahArairatidAruNaiH
verses.translation: but both then fell, as they were fighting, from the elephant to the ground. They fought closely locked together with most terrible blows.
verses.commentary: Sense: but both then fell, as they were fighting, from the elephant to the ground. They fought closely locked together with most terrible blows.
verses.hindi: वे दोनों लड़ते-लड़ते हाथीसे पृथ्वीपर आ गये और अत्यन्त क्रोधमें भरकर एक-दूसरेपर बड़े भयंकर प्रहार करते हुए लड़ने लगे

verses.sanskrit: ततो वेगात् खमुत्पत्य निपत्य च मृगारिणा । करप्रहारेण शिरश्चामरस्य पृथक् कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tato vegAt khamutpatya nipatya cha mR^igAriNA | karaprahAreNa shirashchAmarasya pR^ithak kR^itam
verses.translation: Then, quickly springing up to the sky, and descending, the lion severed Chamara's head with a blow from his paw.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, quickly springing up to the sky, and descending, the lion severed Chamara's head with a blow from his paw.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर सिंह बड़े वेगसे आकाशकी ओर उछला और उधरसे गिरते समय उसने पंजोंकी मारसे चामरका सिर धड़से अलग कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: उदग्रश्च रणे देव्या शिलावृक्षादिभिर्हतः । दन्तमुष्टितलैश्चैव करालश्च निपातितः
verses.transliteration: udagrashcha raNe devyA shilAvR^ikShAdibhirhataH | dantamuShTitalaishchaiva karAlashcha nipAtitaH
verses.translation: And Udagra was slain in battle by the goddess with stones, trees and other things, and Karala also was stricken down by her teeth and fists and feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Udagra was slain in battle by the goddess with stones, trees and other things, and Karala also was stricken down by her teeth and fists and feet.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार उदग्र भी शिला और वृक्ष आदिकी मार खाकर रणभूमिमें देवीके हाथसे मारा गया तथा कराल भी दाँतों, मुक्कों और थप्पड़ोंकी चोटसे धराशायी हो गया

verses.sanskrit: देवी क्रुद्धा गदापातैश्चूर्णयामास चोद्धतम् । बाष्कलं भिन्दिपालेन बाणैस्ताम्रं तथान्धकम्
verses.transliteration: devI kruddhA gadApAtaishchUrNayAmAsa choddhatam | bAShkalaM bhindipAlena bANaistAmraM tathAndhakam
verses.translation: And the goddess, enraged, ground Uddhata to powder with blows from her club; and killed Bashkala with a dart, and Tamra and Andhaka with arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the goddess, enraged, ground Uddhata to powder with blows from her club; and killed Bashkala with a dart, and Tamra and Andhaka with arrows.
verses.hindi: देवी कुद्धा गदापातैश्वूर्णयामास चोद्धतम्‌ वाष्कलं भिन्दिपालेन बाणैस्ताम्रं तथान्धकम्‌

verses.sanskrit: उग्रास्यमुग्रवीर्यं च तथैव च महाहनुम् । त्रिनेत्रा च त्रिशूलेन जघान परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: ugrAsyamugravIryaM cha tathaiva cha mahAhanum | trinetrA cha trishUlena jaghAna parameshvarI
verses.translation: And the supreme three-eyed goddess slew Ugrasya and Ugravirya and Mahahanu also with her trident.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the supreme three-eyed goddess slew Ugrasya and Ugravirya and Mahahanu also with her trident.
verses.hindi: तीन नेत्रोंवाली परमेश्वरीने त्रिशूलसे उग्रास्य, उग्रवीर्य तथा महाहनु नामक दैत्यको मार डाला

verses.sanskrit: बिडालस्यासिना कायात् पातयामास वै शिरः । दुर्धरं दुर्मुखं चोभौ शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: biDAlasyAsinA kAyAt pAtayAmAsa vai shiraH | durdharaM durmukhaM chobhau sharairninye yamakShayam
verses.translation: With her sword she struck Bidala's head clean down from his body. She despatched both Durdhara and Durmukha to Yama's abode with her arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her sword she struck Bidala's head clean down from his body. She despatched both Durdhara and Durmukha to Yama's abode with her arrows.
verses.hindi: तलवारकी चोटसे विडालके मस्तकको धड़से काट गिराया। दुर्धर और दुर्मुख--इन दोनोंको भी अपने बाणोंसे यमलोक भेज दिया

verses.sanskrit: एवं सङ्क्षीयमाणे तु स्वसैन्ये महिषासुरः । माहिषेण स्वरूपेण त्रासयामास तान् गणान्
verses.transliteration: evaM sa~NkShIyamANe tu svasainye mahiShAsuraH | mAhiSheNa svarUpeNa trAsayAmAsa tAn gaNAn
verses.translation: Now, as his army was being thus destroyed utterly, the Asura Mahisha in his own buffalo-shape terrified her troops.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, as his army was being thus destroyed utterly, the Asura Mahisha in his own buffalo-shape terrified her troops.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार अपनी सेनाका संहार होता देख महिषासुरने भैंसेका रूप धारण करके देवीके गणोंको त्रास देना आरम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: कांश्चित्तुण्डप्रहारेण खुरक्षेपैस्तथापरान् । लाङ्गूलताडितांश्चान्यान् शृङ्गाभ्यां च विदारितान्
verses.transliteration: kAMshchittuNDaprahAreNa khurakShepaistathAparAn | lA~NgUlatADitAMshchAnyAn shR^i~NgAbhyAM cha vidAritAn
verses.translation: Some he laid low by a blow from his muzzle, and others by stamping with his hooves, and others because they were lashed with his tail and gashed with his horns,
verses.commentary: Sense: Some he laid low by a blow from his muzzle, and others by stamping with his hooves, and others because they were lashed with his tail and gashed with his horns,
verses.hindi: कांक्षित्तुण्डप्रहारेण खुरक्षेपैस्तथापरान्‌ । लाडूलताडितांश्चवान्याउ्छुभ्यां च विदारितान्‌

verses.sanskrit: वेगेन कांश्चिदपरान्नादेन भ्रमणेन च । निःश्वासपवनेनान्यान्पातयामास भूतले
verses.transliteration: vegena kAMshchidaparAnnAdena bhramaNena cha | niHshvAsapavanenAnyAnpAtayAmAsa bhUtale
verses.translation: and others again by his impetuous rush, his bellowing and his wheeling career, and others by the blast of his breath—thus he laid them low on the face of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: and others again by his impetuous rush, his bellowing and his wheeling career, and others by the blast of his breath—thus he laid them low on the face of the earth.
verses.hindi: किन्हींको थूथुनसे मारकर, किन्हींके ऊपर खुरोंका प्रहार करके किन्हींको-किन्हींको पूँछसे चोट पहुँचाकर, कुछको सींगोंसे विदीर्ण करके, कुछ गणोंको वेगसे, किन्हींको सिंहनादसे, कुछको चक्कर देकर और कितनोंको निःश्वास वायुके झोंकेसे धराशायी कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: निपात्य प्रमथानीकमभ्यधावत सोऽसुरः । सिंहं हन्तुं महादेव्याः कोपं चक्रे ततोऽम्बिका
verses.transliteration: nipAtya pramathAnIkamabhyadhAvata so.asuraH | siMhaM hantuM mahAdevyAH kopaM chakre tato.ambikA
verses.translation: Having laid low the van of her army, the Asura rushed to attack the great goddess' lion. Thereat Ambika displayed her wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having laid low the van of her army, the Asura rushed to attack the great goddess' lion. Thereat Ambika displayed her wrath.
verses.hindi: निपात्य प्रमथानीकम भ्यधावत सो<सुर: । सिहं हन्तुं महादेव्या: कोप॑ चक्रे ततो5म्बिका

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि कोपान्महावीर्यः खुरक्षुण्णमहीतलः । शृङ्गाभ्यां पर्वतानुच्चांश्चिक्षेप च ननाद च
verses.transliteration: so.api kopAnmahAvIryaH khurakShuNNamahItalaH | shR^i~NgAbhyAM parvatAnuchchAMshchikShepa cha nanAda cha
verses.translation: And he, great in valour, pounding the surface of the earth with his hooves in his rage, tossed the mountains aloft with his horns and bellowed.
verses.commentary: Sense: And he, great in valour, pounding the surface of the earth with his hooves in his rage, tossed the mountains aloft with his horns and bellowed.
verses.hindi: उधर महापराक्रमी महिषासुर भी क्रोधमें भरकर धरतीको खुरोंसे खोदने लगा तथा अपने सींगोंसे ऊँचे-ऊँचे पर्वतोंको उठाकर फेंकने और गर्जने लगा

verses.sanskrit: वेगभ्रमणविक्षुण्णा मही तस्य व्यशीर्यत । लाङ्गूलेनाहतश्चाब्धिः प्लावयामास सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: vegabhramaNavikShuNNA mahI tasya vyashIryata | lA~NgUlenAhatashchAbdhiH plAvayAmAsa sarvataH
verses.translation: Crushed by his impetuous wheelings the earth crumbled to pieces; and the sea, lashed by his tail, overflowed in every direction;
verses.commentary: Sense: Crushed by his impetuous wheelings the earth crumbled to pieces; and the sea, lashed by his tail, overflowed in every direction;
verses.hindi: उसके वेगसे चक्कर देनेके कारण पृथ्वी क्षूब्ध होकर फटने लगी। उसकी एूँछसे टकराकर समुद्र सब ओरसे धरतीको डुबोने लगा

verses.sanskrit: धुतशृङ्गविभिन्नाश्च खण्डं खण्डं ययुर्घनाः । श्वासानिलास्ताः शतशो निपेतुर्नभसोऽचलाः
verses.transliteration: dhutashR^i~NgavibhinnAshcha khaNDaM khaNDaM yayurghanAH | shvAsAnilAstAH shatasho nipeturnabhaso.achalAH
verses.translation: and the clouds, pierced by his swaying horns, were rent to fragments; mountains fell in hundreds from the sky, being cast down by the blast of his breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: and the clouds, pierced by his swaying horns, were rent to fragments; mountains fell in hundreds from the sky, being cast down by the blast of his breath.
verses.hindi: हिलते हुए सींगोंके आघातसे विदीर्ण होकर बादलोंके टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो गये। उसके श्वासकी प्रचण्ड वायुके वेगसे उड़े हुए सैकड़ों पर्वत आकाशसे गिरने लगे

verses.sanskrit: इति क्रोधसमाध्मातमापतन्तं महासुरम् । दृष्ट्वा सा चण्डिका कोपं तद्वधाय तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: iti krodhasamAdhmAtamApatantaM mahAsuram | dR^iShTvA sA chaNDikA kopaM tadvadhAya tadAkarot
verses.translation: Chandika looked on the great Asura, as swollen with rage he rushed on, and gave way to her wrath then in order to slay him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika looked on the great Asura, as swollen with rage he rushed on, and gave way to her wrath then in order to slay him.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार क्रोधमें भरे हुए उस महादैत्यको अपनी ओर आते देख चण्डिकाने उसका वध करनेके लिये महान्‌ क्रोध किया

verses.sanskrit: सा क्षिप्त्वा तस्य वै पाशं तं बबन्ध महासुरम् । तत्याज माहिषं रूपं सोऽपि बद्धो महामृधे
verses.transliteration: sA kShiptvA tasya vai pAshaM taM babandha mahAsuram | tatyAja mAhiShaM rUpaM so.api baddho mahAmR^idhe
verses.translation: She flung her noose full over him, and bound the great Asura fast. And he quitted his buffalo shape when held bound in the great battle,
verses.commentary: Sense: She flung her noose full over him, and bound the great Asura fast. And he quitted his buffalo shape when held bound in the great battle,
verses.hindi: सा क्षिप्त्वा तस्य है पाशं तं बबन्ध महासुरम्‌ । तत्याज माहिषं रूपं सो5पि बद्धों महामृथे

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहोऽभवत्सद्यो यावत्तस्याम्बिका शिरः । छिनत्ति तावत् पुरुषः खड्गपाणिरदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: tataH siMho.abhavatsadyo yAvattasyAmbikA shiraH | Chinatti tAvat puruShaH khaDgapANiradR^ishyata
verses.translation: and then became a lion suddenly. While Ambika is cutting off his head, he took the appearance of a man with scymitar in hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: and then became a lion suddenly. While Ambika is cutting off his head, he took the appearance of a man with scymitar in hand.
verses.hindi: और तत्काल सिंहके रूपमें वह प्रकट हो गया। उस अवस्थामें जगदम्बा ज्यों ही उसका मस्तक काटनेको उद्यत हुईं, त्यों ही वह खड्गधारी पुरुषके रूपमें दिखायी देने लगा

verses.sanskrit: तत एवाशु पुरुषं देवी चिच्छेद सायकैः । तं खड्गचर्मणा सार्धं ततः सोऽभून्महागजः
verses.transliteration: tata evAshu puruShaM devI chichCheda sAyakaiH | taM khaDgacharmaNA sArdhaM tataH so.abhUnmahAgajaH
verses.translation: Straightway the goddess with her arrows swiftly pierced the man together with his scymitar and shield. Then he became a huge elephant,
verses.commentary: Sense: Straightway the goddess with her arrows swiftly pierced the man together with his scymitar and shield. Then he became a huge elephant,
verses.hindi: तत एवाशु पुरुष देवी चिच्छेद सायकै: । त॑ खड्गचर्मणा सार्द्ध ततः सो5भून्महागज:

verses.sanskrit: करेण च महासिंहं तं चकर्ष जगर्ज च । कर्षतस्तु करं देवी खड्गेन निरकृन्तत
verses.transliteration: kareNa cha mahAsiMhaM taM chakarSha jagarja cha | karShatastu karaM devI khaDgena nirakR^intata
verses.translation: and tugged at her great lion with his trunk and roared, but the goddess cut off his trunk with her sword as he made his tugs.
verses.commentary: Sense: and tugged at her great lion with his trunk and roared, but the goddess cut off his trunk with her sword as he made his tugs.
verses.hindi: करेण च महासिंह तं चकर्ष जगर्ज च । कर्षतस्तु करं देवी खड़गेन निरकृन्तत:

verses.sanskrit: ततो महासुरो भूयो माहिषं वपुरास्थितः । तथैव क्षोभयामास त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tato mahAsuro bhUyo mAhiShaM vapurAsthitaH | tathaiva kShobhayAmAsa trailokyaM sacharAcharam
verses.translation: Next the great Asura assumed his buffalo shape again, and so shook the three worlds with all that is moveable and immoveable therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: Next the great Asura assumed his buffalo shape again, and so shook the three worlds with all that is moveable and immoveable therein.
verses.hindi: तब उस महादैत्यने पुनः भैंसेका शरीर धारण कर लिया और पहलेकी ही भाँति चराचर प्राणियोंसहित तीनों लोकोंको व्याकुल करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धा जगन्माता चण्डिका पानमुत्तमम् । पपौ पुनः पुनश्चैव जहासारुणलोचना
verses.transliteration: tataH kruddhA jaganmAtA chaNDikA pAnamuttamam | papau punaH punashchaiva jahAsAruNalochanA
verses.translation: Enraged thereat, Chandika, the mother of the world, quaffed a sublime beverage again and again, and laughed as her eyes gleamed ruddy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enraged thereat, Chandika, the mother of the world, quaffed a sublime beverage again and again, and laughed as her eyes gleamed ruddy.
verses.hindi: तब क्रोधमें भरी हुई जगन्माता चण्डिका बारंबार उत्तम मधुका पान करने और लाल आँखें करके हँसने लगीं

verses.sanskrit: ननर्द चासुरः सोऽपि बलवीर्यमदोद्धतः । विषाणाभ्यां च चिक्षेप चण्डिकां प्रति भूधरान्
verses.transliteration: nanarda chAsuraH so.api balavIryamadoddhataH | viShANAbhyAM cha chikShepa chaNDikAM prati bhUdharAn
verses.translation: And the Asura roared out, puffed up with his strength and valour and frenzy, and hurled mountains against Chandika with his horns.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the Asura roared out, puffed up with his strength and valour and frenzy, and hurled mountains against Chandika with his horns.
verses.hindi: उधर वह बल और पराक्रमके मदसे उन्मत्त हुआ राक्षस अपने सींगोंसे चण्डीके ऊपर पर्वतोंको फेंकने लगा और डकारने लगा

verses.sanskrit: सा च तान्प्रहितांस्तेन चूर्णयन्ती शरोत्करैः । उवाच तं मदोद्धूतमुखरागाकुलाक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: sA cha tAnprahitAMstena chUrNayantI sharotkaraiH | uvAcha taM madoddhUtamukharAgAkulAkSharam
verses.translation: And she, shivering to atoms with showers of arrows those mountains that he hurled, spoke to him in confused words, while her mouth was rendered ruddier by the mead that she had drunk.
verses.commentary: Sense: And she, shivering to atoms with showers of arrows those mountains that he hurled, spoke to him in confused words, while her mouth was rendered ruddier by the mead that she had drunk.
verses.hindi: उस समय देवी अपने बाणोंके समूहोंसे उसके फेंके हुए पर्वतोंको चूर्ण करती हुई बोलीं। बोलते समय उनका मुख मधुके मदसे लाल हो रहा था और वाणी लड़खड़ा रही थी

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:
verses.hindi: देवीने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: गर्ज गर्ज क्षणं मूढ मधु यावत्पिबाम्यहम् । मया त्वयि हतेऽत्रैव गर्जिष्यन्त्याशु देवताः
verses.transliteration: garja garja kShaNaM mUDha madhu yAvatpibAmyaham | mayA tvayi hate.atraiva garjiShyantyAshu devatAH
verses.translation: O Durga, when remembered by those in distress, you remove fear from all beings; when remembered by those who are well, you give them wisdom of the highest auspiciousness. Who other than you, O remover of poverty, sorrow, and fear — has a heart ever moist with compassion for the welfare of all?
verses.wordMeaning: O Durga, when remembered by those in distress, you remove fear from all beings; when remembered by those who are well, you give them wisdom of the highest auspiciousness. Who other than you, O remover of poverty, sorrow,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Durga, when remembered by those in distress, you remove fear from all beings; when remembered by those who are well, you give them wisdom of the highest auspiciousness. Who other than you, O remover of poverty, sorrow,…
verses.hindi: ओ मूढ़! मैं जबतक मधु पीती हूँ तबतक तू क्षणभरके लिये खूब गर्ज ले। मेरे हाथसे यहीं तेरी मृत्यु हो जानेपर अब शीघ्र ही देवता भी गर्जना करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा समुत्पत्य सारूढा तं महासुरम् । पादेनाक्रम्य कण्ठे च शूलेनैनमताडयत्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvA samutpatya sArUDhA taM mahAsuram | pAdenAkramya kaNThe cha shUlenainamatADayat
verses.translation: Exclaiming thus she leaped upwards and sat herself on that great Asura, and kicked him on the neck with her foot and struck him with her spear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Exclaiming thus she leaped upwards and sat herself on that great Asura, and kicked him on the neck with her foot and struck him with her spear.
verses.hindi: यों कहकर देवी उछलीं और उस महादैत्यके ऊपर चढ़ गयीं। फिर अपने पैरसे उसे दबाकर उन्होंने शूलसे उसके कण्ठमें आघात किया। [उनके पैरसे दबा होनेपर भी महिषासुर अपने मुखसे दूसरे रूपमें बाहर होने लगा]

verses.sanskrit: ततः सोऽपि पदाक्रान्तस्तया निजमुखात्तदा । अर्धनिष्क्रान्त एवासीद्देव्या वीर्येण संवृतः
verses.transliteration: tataH so.api padAkrAntastayA nijamukhAttadA | ardhaniShkrAnta evAsIddevyA vIryeNa saMvR^itaH
verses.translation: And thereupon he, being assailed by her foot, half issued forth from his own mouth in sooth, being completely encompassed by the goddess' valour.
verses.commentary: Sense: And thereupon he, being assailed by her foot, half issued forth from his own mouth in sooth, being completely encompassed by the goddess' valour.
verses.hindi: अभी आधे शरीरसे ही वह बाहर निकलने पाया था कि देवीने अपने प्रभावसे उसे रोक दिया

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनिष्क्रान्त एवासौ युध्यमानो महासुरः । तया महासिना देव्या शिरश्छित्त्वा निपातितः
verses.transliteration: ardhaniShkrAnta evAsau yudhyamAno mahAsuraH | tayA mahAsinA devyA shirashChittvA nipAtitaH
verses.translation: That great Asura, fighting though but half issued forth, was laid low by the goddess, who struck off his head with her great sword.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great Asura, fighting though but half issued forth, was laid low by the goddess, who struck off his head with her great sword.
verses.hindi: अर्धनिष्क्रान्त एवासौ युध्यमानो महासुर: । तथा महासिना देव्या शिरश्छित्त्वा निपातित:ः

verses.sanskrit: ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं दैत्यसैन्यं ननाश तत् । प्रहर्षं च परं जग्मुः सकला देवतागणाः
verses.transliteration: tato hAhAkR^itaM sarvaM daityasainyaM nanAsha tat | praharShaM cha paraM jagmuH sakalA devatAgaNAH
verses.translation: Then perished all that Daitya army with great lamentation. And all the hosts of the gods rose to the highest exultation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then perished all that Daitya army with great lamentation. And all the hosts of the gods rose to the highest exultation.
verses.hindi: फिर तो हाहाकार करती हुई दैत्योंकी सारी सेना भाग गयी तथा सम्पूर्ण देवता अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हो गये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुस्तां सुरा देवीं सहदिव्यैर्महर्षिभिः । जगुर्गन्धर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः
verses.transliteration: tuShTuvustAM surA devIM sahadivyairmaharShibhiH | jagurgandharvapatayo nanR^itushchApsarogaNAH
verses.translation: The gods and the great heavenly rishis poured forth praises to the goddess, the Gandharva chiefs burst into song and the bevies of Apsarases into dances.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and the great heavenly rishis poured forth praises to the goddess, the Gandharva chiefs burst into song and the bevies of Apsarases into dances.
verses.hindi: तुष्ठवुस्तां सुरा देवीं सह दिव्यैर्महर्षिभि: । जगुर्गन्धर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणा:

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: शक्रादयः सुरगणा निहतेऽतिवीर्ये तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि सुरारिबले च देव्या । तां तुष्टुवुः प्रणतिनम्रशिरोधरांसा वाग्भिः प्रहर्षपुलकोद्गमचारुदेहाः
verses.transliteration: shakrAdayaH suragaNA nihate.ativIrye tasmindurAtmani surAribale cha devyA | tAM tuShTuvuH praNatinamrashirodharAMsA vAgbhiH praharShapulakod.hgamachArudehAH
verses.translation: When that most valiant evil-souled army of the gods' foes was vanquished by the goddess, Shakra and the hosts of other gods poured forth their praises to her with their voices, reverently bending down their necks and shoulders, while their bodies looked handsome because their hair stood erect with exultation.
verses.wordMeaning: When that most valiant evil-souled army of the gods' foes was vanquished by the goddess, Shakra and the hosts of other gods poured forth their praises to her with their voices, reverently bending down their necks and shoulders,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When that most valiant evil-souled army of the gods' foes was vanquished by the goddess, Shakra and the hosts of other gods poured forth their praises to her with their voices, reverently bending down their necks and shoulders,…
verses.hindi: ३. पा०--तेन तच्छतधा नीतं। ३. इसके बाद किसी-किसी प्रतिमें-- “कालं च कालदण्डेन कालरात्रिरपातयत्‌ | उग्रदर्शनमत्युग्रै: खड्गपातैरताडयत्‌ ।। असिनैवासिलोमानमच्छिदत्सा रणोत्सवे । गणै: सिंहेन देव्या च जयक्ष्वेडाकृतोत्सवै: ।। --ये दो श्लोक अधिक हैं।' ३. पा०--खण्डखण्डं। १३. पा०--एवाति देव्वा। २. किसी-किसी प्रतिमें इसके बाद-- “एवं स महिषो नाम ससैन्य: ससुहृद्रण: । त्रैलोक्यं मोहयित्वा तु तया देव्या विनाशित: ॥। त्रैलोक्यस्थैस्तदा भूतैर्महिषे विनिपातिते । जयेत्युक्तं ततः सर्वे: सदेवासुरमानवै: || '-- इतना अधिक पाठ है। चतुर्थोउ ध्याय: इन्द्रादि देवताओंद्वारा देवीकी स्तुति ध्यान (३० कालाभ्राभां कटाक्षैररिकुलभयदां मौलिकबद्धेन्दुरेखां शड्खं चक्र कृपाणं त्रेशिखमपि करैरुद्धहन्तीं त्रिनेत्राम्‌ । सिंहस्कन्धाधिरूढां त्रिभुवनमखिलं तेजसा पूरयन्तीं ध्यायेद्‌ दुर्गा जयाख्यां त्रिदशपरिवृतां सेवितां सिद्धिकामै: ॥। सिद्धिकी इच्छा रखनेवाले पुरुष जिनकी सेवा करते हैं तथा देवता जिन्हें सब ओरसे घेरे रहते हैं, उन “जया” नामवाली दुगदिवीका ध्यान करे। उनके श्रीअड्रोंकी आभा काले मेघके समान श्याम है। वे अपने कटाक्षोंसे शत्रुसमूहको भय प्रदान करती हैं। उनके मस्तकपर आबद्ध चन्द्रमाकी रेखा शोभा पाती हे। वे अपने हाथोंमें शड्ख, चक्र, कृपाण और त्रिशूल धारण करती हैं। उनके तीन नेत्र हैं। वे सिंहके कंधेपर चढ़ी हुई हैं और अपने तेजसे तीनों लोकोंको परिपूर्ण कर रही हैं। ऋषिरुवार्चा' ॥/ १ ॥ “३०” शक्रादय: सुरगाणा निहते$तिवीर्ये तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि सुरारिबले च देव्या । तां तुष्ठवुः प्रणतिनम्रशिरोधरांसा वाम्भि: प्रहर्षपुलकोद्गमचारुदेहा:

verses.sanskrit: देव्या यया ततमिदं जगदात्मशक्त्या निःशेषदेवगणशक्तिसमूहमूर्त्या । तामम्बिकामखिलदेवमहर्षिपूज्यां भक्त्या नताः स्म विदधातु शुभानि सा नः
verses.transliteration: devyā yayā tatamidaṃ jagadātmaśaktyā niḥśeṣadevagaṇaśaktisamūhamūrtyā | tāmambikāmakhiladevamahārṣipūjyāṃ bhaktyā natāḥ sma vidadhātu śubhāni sā naḥ ||
verses.translation: By whose power this world is pervaded — she who is the aggregate form of all the powers of the entire host of gods — that Ambika, worshipped by all gods and great sages, to her we bow in devotion. May she grant us auspiciousness.
verses.wordMeaning: The second chapter's great declaration: the Devi is not one power among many — she is the totality of all divine energies combined. Mahalakshmi emerges when the individual powers of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva are each insufficient against Mahishasura.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The second chapter's great declaration: the Devi is not one power among many — she is the totality of all divine energies combined. Mahalakshmi emerges when the individual powers of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva are each insufficient against Mahishasura.…
verses.hindi: जिसकी शक्ति से यह जगत व्याप्त है — जो समस्त देव-शक्तियों का समूहरूप है — उस सम्पूर्ण देव-महर्षि-पूजित अम्बिका को हम भक्ति से प्रणाम करते हैं। वह हमें शुभ प्रदान करें।
verses.science: Research on cognitive integration (Epstein's CEST theory): the most effective human response to complex threats combines analytical intelligence, emotional intelligence, experiential wisdom, and embodied instinct — none alone is sufficient. The Mahalakshmi episode models this integration: each god contributes his energy, and together they produce a force greater than any individual capacity.
verses.lifeLesson: When a challenge feels too large for any single approach — when willpower alone fails, planning alone fails, prayer alone fails — recognise the Mahalakshmi moment: the time to integrate everything you have. Bring your intellect, emotions, relationships, and spiritual practice to bear simultaneously. That wholeness is the Goddess.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याः प्रभावमतुलं भगवाननन्तो ब्रह्मा हरश्च न हि वक्तुमलं बलं च । सा चण्डिकाखिलजगत्परिपालनाय नाशाय चाशुभभयस्य मतिं करोतु
verses.transliteration: yasyAH prabhAvamatulaM bhagavAnananto brahmA harashcha na hi vaktumalaM balaM cha | sA chaNDikAkhilajagatparipAlanAya nAshAya chAshubhabhayasya matiM karotu
verses.translation: O auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, O Shiva (the benevolent), O accomplisher of all purposes, O refuge, O three-eyed one, O Gauri, O Narayani — salutations to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, O Shiva (the benevolent), O accomplisher of all purposes, O refuge, O three-eyed one, O Gauri, O Narayani — salutations to you.
verses.hindi: जिनके अनुपम प्रभाव और बलका वर्णन करनेमें भगवान्‌ शेषनाग, ब्रह्माजी तथा महादेवजी भी समर्थ नहीं हैं, वे भगवती चण्डिका सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌का पालन एवं अशुभ भयका नाश करनेका विचार करें

verses.sanskrit: या श्रीः स्वयं सुकृतिनां भवनेष्वलक्ष्मीः पापात्मनां कृतधियां हृदयेषु बुद्धिः । श्रद्धा सतां कुलजनप्रभवस्य लज्जा तां त्वां नताः स्म परिपालय देवि विश्वम्
verses.transliteration: yA shrIH svayaM sukR^itinAM bhavaneShvalakShmIH pApAtmanAM kR^itadhiyAM hR^idayeShu buddhiH | shraddhA satAM kulajanaprabhavasya lajjA tAM tvAM natAH sma paripAlaya devi vishvam
verses.translation: Her, who is Good Fortune herself in the dwellings of men of good deeds, Ill Fortune in those of men of sinful souls; who is Intelligence in the hearts of the prudent, who is Faith in those of the good, and Modesty in that of the high-born man—her, even thee, we bow before; protect the universe, O goddess!
verses.wordMeaning: Her, who is Good Fortune herself in the dwellings of men of good deeds, Ill Fortune in those of men of sinful souls; who is Intelligence in the hearts of the prudent, who is Faith in those of the good, and Modesty in that of the high-born man—her, even thee, we bow before;…
