verses.commentary: Sense: Her, who is Good Fortune herself in the dwellings of men of good deeds, Ill Fortune in those of men of sinful souls; who is Intelligence in the hearts of the prudent, who is Faith in those of the good, and Modesty in that of the high-born man—her, even thee, we bow before;…
verses.hindi: जो पुण्यात्माओंके घरोंमें स्वयं ही लक्ष्मीरूपसे, पापियोंके यहाँ दरिद्रतारूपसे, शुद्ध अन्तःकरणवाले पुरुषोंके हृदयमें बुद्धिरूपसे, सत्पुरुषोंमें श्रद्धारूपसे तथा कुलीन मनुष्यमें लज्जारूपसे निवास करती हैं, उन आप भगवती दुर्गाको हम नमस्कार करते हैं। देवि! सम्पूर्ण विश्वका पालन कीजिये

verses.sanskrit: किं वर्णयाम तव रूपमचिन्त्यमेतत् किञ्चातिवीर्यमसुरक्षयकारि भूरि । किं चाहवेषु चरितानि तवाति यानि सर्वेषु देव्यसुरदेवगणादिकेषु
verses.transliteration: kiM varNayAma tava rUpamachintyametat ki~nchAtivIryamasurakShayakAri bhUri | kiM chAhaveShu charitAni tavAti yAni sarveShu devyasuradevagaNAdikeShu
verses.translation: Can we describe this thy thought-transcending form? Or thy abundant surpassing valour that destroyed the Asuras? Or thy surpassing feats which were displayed in battles among all the hosts of Asuras, gods and others, O goddess?
verses.commentary: Sense: Can we describe this thy thought-transcending form? Or thy abundant surpassing valour that destroyed the Asuras? Or thy surpassing feats which were displayed in battles among all the hosts of Asuras, gods and others, O goddess?
verses.hindi: देवि! आपके इन अचिन्त्य रूपका, असुरोंका नाश करनेवाले भारी पराक्रमका तथा समस्त देवताओं और दैत्योंके समक्ष युद्धमें प्रकट किये हुए आपके अद्भुत चरित्रोंका हम किस प्रकार वर्णन करें

verses.sanskrit: हेतुः समस्तजगतां त्रिगुणापि दोषै- र्न ज्ञायसे हरिहरादिभिरप्यपारा । सर्वाश्रयाखिलमिदं जगदंशभूत- मव्याकृता हि परमा प्रकृतिस्त्वमाद्या
verses.transliteration: hetuH samastajagatAM triguNApi doShai\- rna j~nAyase hariharAdibhirapyapArA | sarvAshrayAkhilamidaM jagadaMshabhUta\- mavyAkR^itA hi paramA prakR^itistvamAdyA
verses.translation: Thou art the cause of all the worlds! Though characterized by the three qualities, by faults thou art not known! Even by Hari, Hara and the other gods thou art incomprehensible! Thou art the resort of all; thou art this entire world which is composed of parts! Thou verily art sublime original Nature untransformed!
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art the cause of all the worlds! Though characterized by the three qualities, by faults thou art not known! Even by Hari, Hara and the other gods thou art incomprehensible! Thou art the resort of all;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art the cause of all the worlds! Though characterized by the three qualities, by faults thou art not known! Even by Hari, Hara and the other gods thou art incomprehensible! Thou art the resort of all;…
verses.hindi: आप सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌की उत्पत्तिमें कारण हैं। आपमें सत्त्वगुण, रजोगुण और तमोगुण--ये तीनों गुण मौजूद हैं; तो भी दोषोंके साथ आपका संसर्ग नहीं जान पड़ता। भगवान्‌ विष्णु और महादेवजी आदि देवता भी आपका पार नहीं पाते। आप ही सबका आश्रय हैं। यह समस्त जगत्‌ आपका अंशभूत है; क्योंकि आप सबकी आदिभूत अव्याकृता परा प्रकृति हैं

verses.sanskrit: यस्याः समस्तसुरता समुदीरणेन तृप्तिं प्रयाति सकलेषु मखेषु देवि । स्वाहासि वै पितृगणस्य च तृप्तिहेतु- रुच्चार्यसे त्वमत एव जनैः स्वधा च
verses.transliteration: yasyAH samastasuratA samudIraNena tR^iptiM prayAti sakaleShu makheShu devi | svAhAsi vai pitR^igaNasya cha tR^iptihetu\- ruchchAryase tvamata eva janaiH svadhA cha
verses.translation: Thou, whose complete divinity by means of utterance finds satisfaction in all sacrifices, O goddess, art verily Svaha, and givest satisfaction to the Pitri-hosts! Hence thou art in truth declared by men to be Svadha also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, whose complete divinity by means of utterance finds satisfaction in all sacrifices, O goddess, art verily Svaha, and givest satisfaction to the Pitri-hosts! Hence thou art in truth declared by men to be Svadha also.
verses.hindi: देवि! सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंमें जिसके उच्चारणसे सब देवता तृप्ति लाभ करते हैं, वह स्वाहा आप ही हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त आप पितरोंकी भी तृप्तिका कारण हैं, अतएव सब लोग आपको स्वधा भी कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: या मुक्तिहेतुरविचिन्त्यमहाव्रता त्वं अभ्यस्यसे सुनियतेन्द्रियतत्त्वसारैः । मोक्षार्थिभिर्मुनिभिरस्तसमस्तदोषै- र्विद्यासि सा भगवती परमा हि देवि
verses.transliteration: yA muktiheturavichintyamahAvratA tvaM abhyasyase suniyatendriyatattvasAraiH | mokShArthibhirmunibhirastasamastadoShai\- rvidyAsi sA bhagavatI paramA hi devi
verses.translation: Thou art she who effects final emancipation, and performs great thought-transcending penances! Thou art studied by munis who seek final emancipation, who have shed all their faults, with their organs, which are the essence of strength, well-restrained! Thou art The Knowledge, adorable, sublime in sooth, O goddess!
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art she who effects final emancipation, and performs great thought-transcending penances! Thou art studied by munis who seek final emancipation, who have shed all their faults, with their organs, which are the essence of strength, well-restrained! Thou art The Knowledge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art she who effects final emancipation, and performs great thought-transcending penances! Thou art studied by munis who seek final emancipation, who have shed all their faults, with their organs, which are the essence of strength, well-restrained! Thou art The Knowledge,…
verses.hindi: या मुक्तिहेतुरविचिन्त्यमहाव्रता त्वरे- मभ्यस्यसे सुनियतेन्द्रियतत्त्वसारै: । मोक्षार्थिभिम्मुनिभिरस्तसमस्तदोषै- विद्यासि सा भगवती परमा हि देवि

verses.sanskrit: शब्दात्मिका सुविमलर्ग्यजुषां निधान- मुद्गीथरम्यपदपाठवतां च साम्नाम् । देवि त्रयी भगवती भवभावनाय वार्तासि सर्वजगतां परमार्तिहन्त्री
verses.transliteration: shabdAtmikA suvimalargyajuShAM nidhAna\- mudgItharamyapadapAThavatAM cha sAmnAm | devi trayI bhagavatI bhavabhAvanAya vArtAsi sarvajagatAM paramArtihantrI
verses.translation: Sound is thy soul! Thou art the repository of the most spotless ric and yajus hymns, and of the samans, which have the charming-worded texts of the Udgitha! Thou as goddess art the triple Veda, the adorable, and for the existence and production of all the worlds art active; thou art the supreme destroyer of their pains!
verses.wordMeaning: Sound is thy soul! Thou art the repository of the most spotless ric and yajus hymns, and of the samans, which have the charming-worded texts of the Udgitha! Thou as goddess art the triple Veda, the adorable, and for the existence and production of all the worlds art active;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound is thy soul! Thou art the repository of the most spotless ric and yajus hymns, and of the samans, which have the charming-worded texts of the Udgitha! Thou as goddess art the triple Veda, the adorable, and for the existence and production of all the worlds art active;…
verses.hindi: शब्दात्मिका सुविमलर्ग्यजुषां निधान- मुद्वी थरम्यपदपाठवतां च साम्नाम्‌ देवी त्रयी भगवती भवभावनाय वार्त्ता च सर्वजगतां परमार्तिहनत्री

verses.sanskrit: मेधासि देवि विदिताखिलशास्त्रसारा दुर्गासि दुर्गभवसागरनौरसङ्गा । श्रीः कैटभारिहृदयैककृताधिवासा गौरी त्वमेव शशिमौलिकृतप्रतिष्ठा
verses.transliteration: medhAsi devi viditAkhilashAstrasArA durgAsi durgabhavasAgaranaurasa~NgA | shrIH kaiTabhArihR^idayaikakR^itAdhivAsA gaurI tvameva shashimaulikR^itapratiShThA
verses.translation: Thou art Mental Vigour, O goddess! Thou hast comprehended the essence of all the Scriptures! Thou art Durga, the boat to cross the difficult ocean of existence, devoid of attachments! Thou art Shri, who has planted her dominion alone in the heart of Kaitabha's foe! Thou indeed art Gauri, who has fixed her dwelling in the moon-crested god!
verses.wordMeaning: Thou art Mental Vigour, O goddess! Thou hast comprehended the essence of all the Scriptures! Thou art Durga, the boat to cross the difficult ocean of existence, devoid of attachments! Thou art Shri,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Mental Vigour, O goddess! Thou hast comprehended the essence of all the Scriptures! Thou art Durga, the boat to cross the difficult ocean of existence, devoid of attachments! Thou art Shri,…
verses.hindi: देवि! जिससे समस्त शास्त्रोंके सारका ज्ञान होता है, वह मेधाशक्ति आप ही हैं। दुर्गण भवसागरसे पार उतारनेवाली नौकारूप दुर्गदिवी भी आप ही हैं। आपकी कहीं भी आसक्ति नहीं है। कैटभके शत्रु भगवान्‌ विष्णुके वक्ष:स्थलमें एकमात्र निवास करनेवाली भगवती लक्ष्मी तथा भगवान्‌ चन्द्रशेखरद्वारा सम्मानित गौरीदेवी भी आप ही हैं

verses.sanskrit: ईषत्सहासममलं परिपूर्णचन्द्र- बिम्बानुकारि कनकोत्तमकान्तिकान्तम् । अत्यद्भुतं प्रहृतमात्तरुषा तथापि वक्त्रं विलोक्य सहसा महिषासुरेण
verses.transliteration: IShatsahAsamamalaM paripUrNachandra\- bimbAnukAri kanakottamakAntikAntam | atyadbhutaM prahR^itamAttaruShA tathApi vaktraM vilokya sahasA mahiShAsureNa
verses.translation: Slightly smiling, spotless, resembling the full moon's orb, beautiful as the choicest gold, and lovely was thy face! Yet it was very marvellous that, being swayed by anger, the Asura Mahisha suddenly smote thy face when he saw it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slightly smiling, spotless, resembling the full moon's orb, beautiful as the choicest gold, and lovely was thy face! Yet it was very marvellous that, being swayed by anger, the Asura Mahisha suddenly smote thy face when he saw it.
verses.hindi: ईषत्सहासममल परिपूर्णचन्द्र- बिम्बानुकारि कनकोत्तमकान्तिकान्तम्‌ । अत्यद्धुतं प्रहृतमात्तरुषा तथापि वकक्‍त्रं विलोक्य सहसा महिषासुरेण

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु देवि कुपितं भ्रुकुटीकराल- मुद्यच्छशाङ्कसदृशच्छवि यन्न सद्यः । प्राणान् मुमोच महिषस्तदतीव चित्रं कैर्जीव्यते हि कुपितान्तकदर्शनेन
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvA tu devi kupitaM bhrukuTIkarAla\- mudyachChashA~NkasadR^ishachChavi yanna sadyaH | prANAn mumocha mahiShastadatIva chitraM kairjIvyate hi kupitAntakadarshanena
verses.translation: But after seeing thy wrathful face, O goddess, terrible with its frowns, and sheeny in hue like the rising moon, that Mahisha did not forthwith yield up his life—it was passing wonderful! For who can live after beholding the King of Death enraged?
verses.commentary: Sense: But after seeing thy wrathful face, O goddess, terrible with its frowns, and sheeny in hue like the rising moon, that Mahisha did not forthwith yield up his life—it was passing wonderful! For who can live after beholding the King of Death enraged?
verses.hindi: देवि! वही मुख जब क्रोधसे युक्त होनेपर उदयकालके चन्द्रमाकी भाँति लाल और तनी हुई भौंहोंके कारण विकराल हो उठा, तब उसे देखकर जो महिषासुरके प्राण तुरंत नहीं निकल गये, यह उससे भी बढ़कर आश्वर्यकी बात है; क्‍योंकि क्रोधमें भरे हुए यमराजको देखकर भला, कौन जीवित रह सकता है

verses.sanskrit: देवि प्रसीद परमा भवती भवाय सद्यो विनाशयसि कोपवती कुलानि । विज्ञातमेतदधुनैव यदस्तमेत- न्नीतं बलं सुविपुलं महिषासुरस्य
verses.transliteration: devi prasIda paramA bhavatI bhavAya sadyo vinAshayasi kopavatI kulAni | vij~nAtametadadhunaiva yadastameta\- nnItaM balaM suvipulaM mahiShAsurasya
verses.translation: Be gracious, O goddess, as supreme lady, to life! When enraged thou dost forthwith destroy whole families! Known at this very moment is this, that here is brought to its end the Asura Mahisha's most extensive might!
verses.commentary: Sense: Be gracious, O goddess, as supreme lady, to life! When enraged thou dost forthwith destroy whole families! Known at this very moment is this, that here is brought to its end the Asura Mahisha's most extensive might!
verses.hindi: देवि! आप प्रसन्न हों। परमात्मस्वरूपा आपके प्रसन्न होनेपर जगत्‌का अभ्युदय होता है और क्रोधमें भर जानेपर आप तत्काल ही कितने कुलोंका सर्वनाश कर डालती हैं, यह बात अभी अनुभवमें आयी है; क्योंकि महिषासुरकी यह विशाल सेना क्षणभरमें आपके कोपसे नष्ट हो गयी है

verses.sanskrit: ते सम्मता जनपदेषु धनानि तेषां तेषां यशांसि न च सीदति बन्धुवर्गः । धन्यास्त एव निभृतात्मजभृत्यदारा येषां सदाभ्युदयदा भवती प्रसन्ना
verses.transliteration: te sammatA janapadeShu dhanAni teShAM teShAM yashAMsi na cha sIdati bandhuvargaH | dhanyAsta eva nibhR^itAtmajabhR^ityadArA yeShAM sadAbhyudayadA bhavatI prasannA
verses.translation: Esteemed are they among the nations, theirs are riches, theirs are glories, and their sum of righteousness perishes not; happy are they indeed, and they possess devoted children, servants and wives, on whom thou, well-pleased, dost always bestow prosperity, O lady!
verses.commentary: Sense: Esteemed are they among the nations, theirs are riches, theirs are glories, and their sum of righteousness perishes not; happy are they indeed, and they possess devoted children, servants and wives, on whom thou, well-pleased, dost always bestow prosperity, O lady!
verses.hindi: सदा अभ्युदय प्रदान करनेवाली आप जिनपर प्रसन्न रहती हैं; वे ही देशमें सम्मानित हैं, उन्हींको धन और यशकी प्राप्ति होती है, उन्हींका धर्म कभी शिथिल नहीं होता तथा वे ही अपने हृष्ट-पुष्ट स्त्री, पुत्र और भृत्योंके साथ धन्य माने जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: धर्म्याणि देवि सकलानि सदैव कर्मा- ण्यत्यादृतः प्रतिदिनं सुकृती करोति । स्वर्गं प्रयाति च ततो भवती प्रसादा- ल्लोकत्रयेऽपि फलदा ननु देवि तेन
verses.transliteration: dharmyANi devi sakalAni sadaiva karmA\- NyatyAdR^itaH pratidinaM sukR^itI karoti | svargaM prayAti cha tato bhavatI prasAdA\- llokatraye.api phaladA nanu devi tena
verses.translation: All righteous actions ever indeed, O goddess, with utmost respect the man of good deeds daily performs, and gains heaven thereafter by thy favour, O lady. Dost thou not by him bestow rewards even on the three worlds, O goddess?
verses.commentary: Sense: All righteous actions ever indeed, O goddess, with utmost respect the man of good deeds daily performs, and gains heaven thereafter by thy favour, O lady. Dost thou not by him bestow rewards even on the three worlds, O goddess?
verses.hindi: देवि! आपकी ही कृपासे पुण्यात्मा पुरुष प्रतिदिन अत्यन्त श्रद्धापूर्वक सदा सब प्रकारके धर्मानुकूल कर्म करता है और उसके प्रभावसे स्वर्गलोकमें जाता है; इसलिये आप तीनों लोकोंमें निश्चय ही मनोवाजञ्छित फल देनेवाली हैं

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गे स्मृता हरसि भीतिमशेषजन्तोः स्वस्थैः स्मृता मतिमतीव शुभां ददासि । दारिद्र्यदुःखभयहारिणि का त्वदन्या सर्वोपकारकरणाय सदार्द्रचित्ता
verses.transliteration: durge smṛtā harasi bhītimśeṣajantoḥ svasthaiḥ smṛtā matimatīva śubhāṃ dadāsi | dāridryaduḥkhabhayahāriṇi kā tvadanyā sarvopakārakaraṇāya sadā'rdracittā ||
verses.translation: O Durga, when remembered by those in distress, you remove fear from all beings; when remembered by those who are well, you give them wisdom of the highest auspiciousness. Who other than you, O remover of poverty, sorrow, and fear — has a heart ever moist with compassion for the welfare of all?
verses.wordMeaning: Mahishasura — the buffalo-demon — is tamas embodied: the heavy, dark, stubborn inertia that refuses to yield to light. But this verse reveals why the Devi's victory matters: she is not merely a warrior. She is "sadā ārdrа-cittā" — always soft-hearted,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahishasura — the buffalo-demon — is tamas embodied: the heavy, dark, stubborn inertia that refuses to yield to light. But this verse reveals why the Devi's victory matters: she is not merely a warrior. She is "sadā ārdrа-cittā" — always soft-hearted,…
verses.hindi: हे दुर्गे! संकट में स्मरण करने पर तुम सभी प्राणियों का भय हर लेती हो; स्वस्थ अवस्था में स्मरण करने पर उत्कृष्ट शुभ बुद्धि देती हो। हे दारिद्र्य-दुःख-भय-हारिणी! सबके उपकार के लिए सदा आर्द्र चित्त वाली तुम्हारे सिवाय और कौन है?
verses.science: Research on "tender-minded vs. tough-minded" leadership (James MacGregor Burns): the most effective transformational leaders combine high challenge (demanding excellence, confronting hard truths) with high support (genuine care, emotional warmth). Neither alone produces transformation. The Devi's combination of fierce demon-slaying and "ārdra citta" (moist compassion) is the mythic template of this paradox.
verses.lifeLesson: Where in your life do you split strength from softness — believing you must choose between being fierce and being kind? The Devi says: the highest form of each requires the other. Your compassion without fierceness is sentimentality; your fierceness without compassion is cruelty. Cultivate both, simultaneously. That integration is Durga.

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्हतैर्जगदुपैति सुखं तथैते कुर्वन्तु नाम नरकाय चिराय पापम् । सङ्ग्राममृत्युमधिगम्य दिवं प्रयान्तु मत्वेति नूनमहितान्विनिहंसि देवि
verses.transliteration: ebhirhatairjagadupaiti sukhaM tathaite kurvantu nAma narakAya chirAya pApam | sa~NgrAmamR^ityumadhigamya divaM prayAntu matveti nUnamahitAnvinihaMsi devi
verses.translation: By these slain foes the world attains to happiness; thus let these forsooth practise sin so as to descend to hell for long! 'Meeting death in battle let them proceed to heaven'—thinking thus, thou dost assuredly destroy the enemies, O goddess!
verses.commentary: Sense: By these slain foes the world attains to happiness; thus let these forsooth practise sin so as to descend to hell for long! 'Meeting death in battle let them proceed to heaven'—thinking thus, thou dost assuredly destroy the enemies, O goddess!
verses.hindi: देवि! इन राक्षसोंके मारनेसे संसारको सुख मिले तथा ये राक्षस चिरकालतक नरकमें रहनेके लिये भले ही पाप करते रहे हों, इस समय संग्राममें मृत्युको प्राप्त होकर स्वर्गलोकमें जायँ--निश्चय ही यही सोचकर आप शत्रुओंका वध करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैव किं न भवती प्रकरोति भस्म सर्वासुरानरिषु यत्प्रहिणोषि शस्त्रम् । लोकान्प्रयान्तु रिपवोऽपि हि शस्त्रपूता इत्थं मतिर्भवति तेष्वहितेषुसाध्वी
verses.transliteration: dR^iShTvaiva kiM na bhavatI prakaroti bhasma sarvAsurAnariShu yat.hprahiNoShi shastram | lokAnprayAntu ripavo.api hi shastrapUtA itthaM matirbhavati teShvahiteShusAdhvI
verses.translation: Having indeed seen them, why dost thou not, O lady, reduce to ashes all the Asuras, since thou directest thy weapons against the foes? 'Let even enemies, purified by dying in arms, attain in sooth to the bright worlds'—such is thy most kindly intention towards even them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having indeed seen them, why dost thou not, O lady, reduce to ashes all the Asuras, since thou directest thy weapons against the foes? 'Let even enemies, purified by dying in arms, attain in sooth to the bright worlds'—such is thy most kindly intention towards even them.
verses.hindi: आप शत्रुओंपर शस्त्रोंका प्रहार क्यों करती हैं? समस्त असुरोंको दृष्टिपात-मात्रसे ही भस्म क्‍यों नहीं कर देतीं? इसमें एक रहस्य है। “ये शत्रु भी हमारे शस्त्रोंसे पवित्र होकर उत्तम लोकोंमें जायँ'--इस प्रकार उनके प्रति भी आपका विचार अत्यन्त उत्तम रहता है

verses.sanskrit: खड्गप्रभानिकरविस्फुरणैस्तथोग्रैः शूलाग्रकान्तिनिवहेन दृशोऽसुराणाम् । यन्नागता विलयमंशुमदिन्दुखण्ड- योग्याननं तव विलोकयतां तदेतत्
verses.transliteration: khaDgaprabhAnikaravisphuraNaistathograiH shUlAgrakAntinivahena dR^isho.asurANAm | yannAgatA vilayamaMshumadindukhaNDa\- yogyAnanaM tava vilokayatAM tadetat
verses.translation: And though, neither by the sharp flashes of abundant light from thy scymitar, nor by the copious lustre of thy spear-point, the eyes of the Asuras were destroyed; yet, as they gazed upon thy countenance which bore a portion of the radiant moon, this very thing happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: And though, neither by the sharp flashes of abundant light from thy scymitar, nor by the copious lustre of thy spear-point, the eyes of the Asuras were destroyed; yet, as they gazed upon thy countenance which bore a portion of the radiant moon, this very thing happened.
verses.hindi: खड्गके तेज:पुज्जकी भयड्भकर दीप्तिसे तथा आपके त्रिशूलके अग्रभागकी घनीभूत प्रभासे चौंधियाकर जो असुरोंकी आँखें फूट नहीं गयीं, उसमें कारण यही था कि वे मनोहर रश्मियोंसे युक्त चन्द्रमाके समान आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाले आपके इस सुन्दर मुखका दर्शन करते थे

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वृत्तवृत्तशमनं तव देवि शीलं रूपं तथैतदविचिन्त्यमतुल्यमन्यैः । वीर्यं च हन्तृ हृतदेवपराक्रमाणां वैरिष्वपि प्रकटितैव दया त्वयेत्थम्
verses.transliteration: durvR^ittavR^ittashamanaM tava devi shIlaM rUpaM tathaitadavichintyamatulyamanyaiH | vIryaM cha hantR^i hR^itadevaparAkramANAM vairiShvapi prakaTitaiva dayA tvayettham
verses.translation: Thy disposition, O goddess, subdues the conduct of men of evil conduct; and this thy form surpasses thought and rivalry by others; and thy valour vanquishes those who have robbed the gods of their prowess; thou hast as it were manifested pity thus even on enemies!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy disposition, O goddess, subdues the conduct of men of evil conduct; and this thy form surpasses thought and rivalry by others; and thy valour vanquishes those who have robbed the gods of their prowess; thou hast as it were manifested pity thus even on enemies!
verses.hindi: देवि! आपका शील दुराचारियोंके बुरे बर्तावको दूर करनेवाला है। साथ ही यह रूप ऐसा है, जो कभी चिन्तनमें भी नहीं आ सकता और जिसकी कभी दूसरोंसे तुलना भी नहीं हो सकती; तथा आपका बल और पराक्रम तो उन दैत्योंका भी नाश करनेवाला है, जो कभी देवताओंके पराक्रमको भी नष्ट कर चुके थे। इस प्रकार आपने शत्रुओंपर भी अपनी दया ही प्रकट की है

verses.sanskrit: केनोपमा भवतु तेऽस्य पराक्रमस्य रूपं च शत्रुभयकार्यतिहारि कुत्र । चित्ते कृपा समरनिष्ठुरता च दृष्टा त्वय्येव देवि वरदे भुवनत्रयेऽपि
verses.transliteration: kenopamA bhavatu te.asya parAkramasya rUpaM cha shatrubhayakAryatihAri kutra | chitte kR^ipA samaraniShThuratA cha dR^iShTA tvayyeva devi varade bhuvanatraye.api
verses.translation: To what may this thy prowess be compared? And whereto thy form most charming, which strikes fear among foes? Compassion in mind and relentlessness in battle are seen in thee, O goddess, who bestowest boons even on the three worlds!
verses.commentary: Sense: To what may this thy prowess be compared? And whereto thy form most charming, which strikes fear among foes? Compassion in mind and relentlessness in battle are seen in thee, O goddess, who bestowest boons even on the three worlds!
verses.hindi: वरदायिनी देवि! आपके इस पराक्रमकी किसके साथ तुलना हो सकती है। तथा शत्रुओंको भय देनेवाला एवं अत्यन्त मनोहर ऐसा रूप भी आपके सिवा और कहाँ है! हृदयमें कृपा और युद्धमें निछ्ठुरता--ये दोनों बातें तीनों लोकोंके भीतर केवल आपमें ही देखी गयी हैं

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यमेतदखिलं रिपुनाशनेन त्रातं त्वया समरमूर्धनि तेऽपि हत्वा । नीता दिवं रिपुगणा भयमप्यपास्तम् अस्माकमुन्मदसुरारिभवं नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: trailokyametadakhilaM ripunAshanena trAtaM tvayA samaramUrdhani te.api hatvA | nItA divaM ripugaNA bhayamapyapAstam asmAkamunmadasurAribhavaM namaste
verses.translation: Through the destruction of the foes, these three worlds entire have been saved by thee. Having slain them in the battle-front, thou hast led even those hosts of foes to heaven, and dispelled the fear which beset us from the frenzied foes of the gods. Reverence to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: Through the destruction of the foes, these three worlds entire have been saved by thee. Having slain them in the battle-front, thou hast led even those hosts of foes to heaven, and dispelled the fear which beset us from the frenzied foes of the gods. Reverence to thee!
verses.hindi: मातः! आपने शत्रुओंका नाश करके इस समस्त त्रिलोकीकी रक्षा की है। उन शत्रुओंको भी युद्धभूमिमें मारकर स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचाया है तथा उन्मत दैत्योंसे प्राप्त होनेवाले हमलोगोंके भयको भी दूर कर दिया है, आपको हमारा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: शूलेन पाहि नो देवि पाहि खड्गेन चाम्बिके । घण्टास्वनेन नः पाहि चापज्यानिःस्वनेन च
verses.transliteration: shUlena pAhi no devi pAhi khaDgena chAmbike | ghaNTAsvanena naH pAhi chApajyAniHsvanena cha
verses.translation: With thy spear protect us, O goddess! Protect us with thy sword also, O Ambika! By the clanging of thy bell protect us, and by the twanging of the thong of thy bow!
verses.commentary: Sense: With thy spear protect us, O goddess! Protect us with thy sword also, O Ambika! By the clanging of thy bell protect us, and by the twanging of the thong of thy bow!
verses.hindi: देवि! आप शूलसे हमारी रक्षा करें। अम्बिके! खड्गसे भी हमारी रक्षा करें तथा घण्टाकी ध्वनि और धनुषकी टंकारसे भी आप हमलोगोंकी रक्षा करें

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यां रक्ष प्रतीच्यां च चण्डिके रक्ष दक्षिणे । भ्रामणेनात्मशूलस्य उत्तरस्यां तथेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: prAchyAM rakSha pratIchyAM cha chaNDike rakSha dakShiNe | bhrAmaNenAtmashUlasya uttarasyAM tatheshvari
verses.translation: In the east guard us, and in the west; O Chandika, guard us in the south by the brandishing of thy spear, and also in the north, O goddess!
verses.commentary: Sense: In the east guard us, and in the west; O Chandika, guard us in the south by the brandishing of thy spear, and also in the north, O goddess!
verses.hindi: प्राच्यां रक्ष प्रतीच्यां च चण्डिके रक्ष दक्षिणे । भ्रामणेनात्मशूलस्य उत्तरस्यां तथेश्वरि

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यानि यानि रूपाणि त्रैलोक्ये विचरन्ति ते । यानि चात्यन्तघोराणि तै रक्षास्मांस्तथा भुवम्
verses.transliteration: saumyAni yAni rUpANi trailokye vicharanti te | yAni chAtyantaghorANi tai rakShAsmAMstathA bhuvam
verses.translation: Whatever gentle forms of thee wander about in the three worlds, and whatever exceedingly terrible forms wander, by means of them guard us and the earth!
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever gentle forms of thee wander about in the three worlds, and whatever exceedingly terrible forms wander, by means of them guard us and the earth!
verses.hindi: सौम्यानि यानि रूपाणि त्रैलोक्ये विचरन्ति ते । यानि चात्यर्थघोराणि तै रक्षास्मांस्तथा भुवम्‌

verses.sanskrit: खड्गशूलगदादीनि यानि चास्त्रानि तेऽम्बिके । करपल्लवसङ्गीनि तैरस्मान्रक्ष सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: khaDgashUlagadAdIni yAni chAstrAni te.ambike | karapallavasa~NgIni tairasmAnrakSha sarvataH
verses.translation: Thy sword and spear and club, and whatever other weapons, O Ambika, rest in thy pliant hand, with them guard us on every side!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy sword and spear and club, and whatever other weapons, O Ambika, rest in thy pliant hand, with them guard us on every side!
verses.hindi: अम्बिके! आपके कर- पाललवोंमें शोभा पानेवाले खड़ग, शूल और गदा आदि जो-जो अस्त्र हों, उन सबके द्वारा आप सब ओरसे हमलोगोंकी रक्षा करें

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुता सुरैर्दिव्यैः कुसुमैर्नन्दनोद्भवैः । अर्चिता जगतां धात्री तथा गन्धानुलेपनैः
verses.transliteration: evaM stutA surairdivyaiH kusumairnandanodbhavaiH | architA jagatAM dhAtrI tathA gandhAnulepanaiH
verses.translation: Thus was she, the Upholder of the worlds, hymned by the gods, and they paid honour to her with celestial flowers that blossomed in Nandana, and with perfumes and unguents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus was she, the Upholder of the worlds, hymned by the gods, and they paid honour to her with celestial flowers that blossomed in Nandana, and with perfumes and unguents.
verses.hindi: ऋषिरुवाच ।/ २८ ॥। एवं स्तुता सुरैर्दिव्यै: कुसुमैर्नन्दनोद्धवै: । अर्चिता जगतां धात्री तथा गन्धानुलेपनै:

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या समस्तैस्त्रिदशैर्दिव्यैर्धूपैः सुधूपिता । प्राह प्रसादसुमुखी समस्तान् प्रणतान् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyA samastaistridashairdivyairdhUpaiH sudhUpitA | prAha prasAdasumukhI samastAn praNatAn surAn
verses.translation: Moreover all the thirty gods in faith censed her with heavenly incenses. Benignly sweet in countenance, she spoke to all the prostrate gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover all the thirty gods in faith censed her with heavenly incenses. Benignly sweet in countenance, she spoke to all the prostrate gods.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार जब देवताओंने जगन्माता दुर्गाकी स्तुति की और नन्दनवनके दिव्य पुष्पों एवं गन्ध-चन्दन आदिके द्वारा उनका पूजन किया, फिर सबने मिलकर जब भक्तिपूर्वक दिव्य धूपोंकी सुगन्ध निवेदन की, देवीने प्रसन्नचदन होकर प्रणाम करते हुए सब देवताओंसे कहा--

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: व्रियतां त्रिदशाः सर्वे यदस्मत्तोऽभिवाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: vriyatAM tridashAH sarve yadasmatto.abhivA~nChitam
verses.translation: Choose, ye thirty all, whatever ye desire of me, for I grant it with pleasure, being highly honoured by these hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Choose, ye thirty all, whatever ye desire of me, for I grant it with pleasure, being highly honoured by these hymns.
verses.hindi: देवताओ! तुम सब लोग मुझसे जिस वस्तुकी अभिलाषा रखते हो उसे माँगो

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH
verses.translation: The gods spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods spoke:
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--

verses.sanskrit: भगवत्या कृतं सर्वं न किञ्चिदवशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: bhagavatyA kR^itaM sarvaM na ki~nchidavashiShyate
verses.translation: Thou, O adorable lady, hast accomplished all; nought remains undone,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou, O adorable lady, hast accomplished all; nought remains undone,
verses.hindi: भगवतीने हमारी सब इच्छा पूर्ण कर दी, अब कुछ भी बाकी नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: यदयं निहतः शत्रुरस्माकं महिषासुरः । यदि चापि वरो देयस्त्वयास्माकं महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: yadayaM nihataH shatrurasmAkaM mahiShAsuraH | yadi chApi varo deyastvayAsmAkaM maheshvari
verses.translation: in that this Asura Mahisha, our foe, has been slain. Yet if thou must grant us a boon, O great goddess,
verses.commentary: Sense: in that this Asura Mahisha, our foe, has been slain. Yet if thou must grant us a boon, O great goddess,
verses.hindi: क्योंकि हमारा यह शत्रु महिषासुर मारा गया। महेश्वरी! इतनेपर भी यदि आप हमें और वर देना चाहती हैं

verses.sanskrit: संस्मृता संस्मृता त्वं नो हिंसेथाः परमापदः । यश्च मर्त्यः स्तवैरेभिस्त्वां स्तोष्यत्यमलानने
verses.transliteration: saMsmR^itA saMsmR^itA tvaM no hiMsethAH paramApadaH | yashcha martyaH stavairebhistvAM stoShyatyamalAnane
verses.translation: whenever we call thee to mind, do thou away with our direst calamities! And whatever mortal shall praise thee with these hymns, O lady of spotless countenance,
verses.commentary: Sense: whenever we call thee to mind, do thou away with our direst calamities! And whatever mortal shall praise thee with these hymns, O lady of spotless countenance,
verses.hindi: संस्मृता संस्मृता त्वं नो हिंसेथा: परमापद: । यश्न मर्त्य: स्तवैरेभिस्त्वां स्तोष्यत्यमलानने

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वित्तर्द्धिविभवैर्धनदारादिसम्पदाम् । वृद्धयेऽस्मत्प्रसन्ना त्वं भवेथाः सर्वदाम्बिके
verses.transliteration: tasya vittarddhivibhavairdhanadArAdisampadAm | vR^iddhaye.asmatprasannA tvaM bhavethAH sarvadAmbike
verses.translation: to prosper him in wealth and wife and other blessings by means of riches, success and power, do thou incline always, O Ambika, who art propitious to us!
verses.commentary: Sense: to prosper him in wealth and wife and other blessings by means of riches, success and power, do thou incline always, O Ambika, who art propitious to us!
verses.hindi: तस्य वित्तर्द्धिविभवैर्धनदारादिसम्पदाम्‌ | वृद्धयेअस्मत्प्रसन्ना त्वं भवेथा: सर्वदाम्बिके

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इति प्रसादिता देवैर्जगतोऽर्थे तथात्मनः । तथेत्युक्त्वा भद्रकाली बभूवान्तर्हिता नृप
verses.transliteration: iti prasAditA devairjagato.arthe tathAtmanaH | tathetyuktvA bhadrakAlI babhUvAntarhitA nR^ipa
verses.translation: Being thus propitiated by the gods for the good of the world and on their own behalf, 'Be it so!' said she, Bhadrakali, and vanished from their sight, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being thus propitiated by the gods for the good of the world and on their own behalf, 'Be it so!' said she, Bhadrakali, and vanished from their sight, O king.
verses.hindi: ऋषिरुवाच ।/ ३८ ॥। इति प्रसादिता देवैर्जगतो<रथें तथा55त्मन: । तथेत्युक्त्वा भद्रकाली बभूवान्तर्हिता नूप

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्कथितं भूप सम्भूता सा यथा पुरा । देवी देवशरीरेभ्यो जगत्त्रयहितैषिणी
verses.transliteration: ityetatkathitaM bhUpa sambhUtA sA yathA purA | devI devasharIrebhyo jagattrayahitaiShiNI
verses.translation: Thus I have narrated this, O king, how the goddess came into being of yore from out of the gods' bodies, she who desires the good of all the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have narrated this, O king, how the goddess came into being of yore from out of the gods' bodies, she who desires the good of all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: इत्येतत्कथितं भूप सम्भूता सा यथा पुरा | देवी देवशरीरेभ्यो जगत्त्रयहितैषिणी

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च गौरीदेहात्सा समुद्भूता यथाभवत् । वधाय दुष्टदैत्यानां तथा शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: punashcha gaurIdehAtsA samud.hbhUtA yathAbhavat | vadhAya duShTadaityAnAM tathA shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: And again she came into existence, having the body of Gauri, just as she did before, in order to slay the wicked Daityas and Shumbha and Nishumbha,
verses.commentary: Sense: And again she came into existence, having the body of Gauri, just as she did before, in order to slay the wicked Daityas and Shumbha and Nishumbha,
verses.hindi: पुनश्न गौरीदेहात्सा* समुद्धूता यथाभवत्‌ । वधाय दुष्टदैत्यानां तथा शुम्भनिशुम्भयो:

verses.sanskrit: रक्षणाय च लोकानां देवानामुपकारिणी । तच्छृणुष्व मयाख्यातं यथावत्कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: rakShaNAya cha lokAnAM devAnAmupakAriNI | tachChR^iNuShva mayAkhyAtaM yathAvatkathayAmi te
verses.translation: and to preserve the worlds, as benefactress of the gods. Hearken then to what I have declared to thee; I have truly told it thee.
verses.commentary: Sense: and to preserve the worlds, as benefactress of the gods. Hearken then to what I have declared to thee; I have truly told it thee.
verses.hindi: रक्षणाय च लोकानां देवानामुपकारिणी । तच्छुणुष्व मया55ख्यातं यथावत्कथयामि ते ।॥। ही ३०

verses.sanskrit: ॐ क्लीं ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM klIM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Then suddenly, from the frowning forehead-plate of the Goddess, Kali — of terrifying face, bearing sword and noose — sprang forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then suddenly, from the frowning forehead-plate of the Goddess, Kali — of terrifying face, bearing sword and noose — sprang forth.
verses.hindi: १. किसी-किसी प्रतिमें 'ऋषिरुवाच'के बाद “ततः सुरगणा: सर्वे देव्या इन्द्रपुरोगमा: । स्तुतिमारेभिरे कर्तु निहते महिषासुरे ।। ” इतना पाठ अधिक है। २. पा०--च अध्य०। ३. पा०-पैः सुधूपिता। २. मार्कण्डेयपुराणकी आधुनिक प्रतियोंमें--“ददाम्यहमतिप्रीत्या स्तवैरेभि: सुपूजिता।'-- इतना पाठ अधिक है। किसी-किसी प्रतिमें--“कर्त्तव्यमपरं यच्च दुष्करं तन्न विदमहे। इत्याकर्णयय वचो देव्या: प्रत्युचुस्ते दिवौकस: ॥। ” इतना और अधिक पाठ है। ३. किसी-किसी प्रतिमें 'गौरादेहा सा” “गौरी देहासा” इत्यादि पाठ भी उपलब्ध होते हैं। पजञ्चमो5 ध्याय: देवताओंद्वारा देवीकी स्तुति, चण्ड-मुण्डके मुखसे अम्बिकाके रूपकी प्रशंसा सुनकर शुम्भका उनके पास दूत भेजना और दूतका निराश लौटना विनियोग [3 अस्य श्रीउत्तरचरित्रस्य रुद्रऋषि:, महासरस्वती देवता, अनुष्टप्‌ छन्‍्द:, भीमा शक्तिः, भ्रामरी बीजम्‌, सूर्यस्तत््वम, सामवेद: स्वरूपम्‌, महासरस्वतीप्रीत्यर्थे उत्तरचरित्रपाठे विनियोग: । ७ इस उत्तर चरित्रके रुद्र ऋषि हैं, महासरस्वती देवता हैं, अनुष्टप्‌ छनन्‍्द है, भीमा शक्ति हैं, भ्रामरी बीज है, सूर्य तत्त्व है और सामवेद स्वरूप है। महासरस्वतीकी प्रसन्नताके लिये उत्तर चरित्रके पाठमें इसका विनियोग किया जाता है। ध्यान ३० घण्टाशूलहलानि शड्खमुसले चक्र धनु: सायकं हस्ताब्जैर्दधतीं बनानन्‍्तविलसच्छीतांशुतुल्यप्र भाम्‌ । गौरीदेहसमुद्धवां त्रिजगतामाधारभूतां महा- पूर्वामत्र सरस्वतीमनुभजे शुम्भादिदैत्यार्दिनीम्‌ ॥। जो अपने करकमलोंमें घण्टा, शूल, हल, शड्ख, मूसल, चक्र, धनुष और बाण धारण करती हैं, शरदऋतुके शोभासम्पन्न चन्द्रमाके समान जिनकी मनोहर कान्ति है, जो तीनों लोकोंकी आधारभूता और शुम्भ आदि दैत्योंका नाश करनेवाली हैं तथा गौरीके शरीरसे जिनका प्राकट्य हुआ है, उन महासरस्वती देवीका मैं निरन्तर भजन करता हूँ।] “३6 कली! ऋषिरुवाच

verses.sanskrit: पुरा शुम्भनिशुम्भाभ्यामसुराभ्यां शचीपतेः । त्रैलोक्यं यज्ञभागाश्च हृता मदबलाश्रयात्
verses.transliteration: purA shumbhanishumbhAbhyAmasurAbhyAM shachIpateH | trailokyaM yaj~nabhAgAshcha hR^itA madabalAshrayAt
verses.translation: Of yore the Asuras Shumbha and Nishumbha, trusting in their pride and strength, robbed Shachi's lord of the three worlds and of his portions of the sacrifices;
verses.commentary: Sense: Of yore the Asuras Shumbha and Nishumbha, trusting in their pride and strength, robbed Shachi's lord of the three worlds and of his portions of the sacrifices;
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें शुम्भ और निशुम्भ नामक असुरोंने अपने बलके घमंडमें आकर शचीपति इन्द्रके हाथसे तीनों लोकोंका राज्य और यज्ञभाग छीन लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावेव सूर्यतां तद्वदधिकारं तथैन्दवम् । कौबेरमथ याम्यं च चक्राते वरुणस्य च
verses.transliteration: tAveva sUryatAM tadvadadhikAraM tathaindavam | kauberamatha yAmyaM cha chakrAte varuNasya cha
verses.translation: they both usurped likewise the sun's dignity and the moon's dominion, and Kuvera's and Yama's and Varuna's;
verses.commentary: Sense: they both usurped likewise the sun's dignity and the moon's dominion, and Kuvera's and Yama's and Varuna's;
verses.hindi: वे ही दोनों सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, कुबेर, यम और वरुणके अधिकारका भी उपयोग करने लगे। वायु और अग्निका कार्य भी वे ही करने लगे। उन दोनोंने सब देवताओंको अपमानित, राज्यश्रष्ट, पराजित तथा अधिकारहीन करके स्वर्गसे निकाल दिया। उन दोनों महान्‌ असुरोंसे तिरस्कृत देवताओंने अपराजिता देवीका स्मरण किया और सोचा “जगदम्बाने हमलोगोंको वर दिया था कि आपत्तिकालमें स्मरण करनेपर मैं तुम्हारी सब आपत्तियोंका तत्काल नाश कर दूँगी”

verses.sanskrit: तावेव पवनर्द्धिं च चक्रतुर्वह्निकर्म च । ततो देवा विनिर्धूता भ्रष्टराज्याः पराजिताः
verses.transliteration: tAveva pavanarddhiM cha chakraturvahnikarma cha | tato devA vinirdhUtA bhraShTarAjyAH parAjitAH
verses.translation: and they both exercised Vayu's authority and Agni's sphere of action. Thereby the gods were scattered, deprived of their sovereignties and put to rout.
verses.commentary: Sense: and they both exercised Vayu's authority and Agni's sphere of action. Thereby the gods were scattered, deprived of their sovereignties and put to rout.
verses.hindi: चौथा अध्याय पूरा हुआ

verses.sanskrit: हृताधिकारास्त्रिदशास्ताभ्यां सर्वे निराकृताः । महासुराभ्यां तां देवीं संस्मरन्त्यपराजिताम्
verses.transliteration: hR^itAdhikArAstridashAstAbhyAM sarve nirAkR^itAH | mahAsurAbhyAM tAM devIM saMsmarantyaparAjitAm
verses.translation: The thirty gods, bereft of their dominion and set at nought by those two great Asuras, all recall to mind that never-vanquished goddess:
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirty gods, bereft of their dominion and set at nought by those two great Asuras, all recall to mind that never-vanquished goddess:
verses.hindi: ह्ृताधिकारास्त्रिदशास्ता भ्यां सर्वे निराकृता । महासुराभ्यां तां देवीं संस्मरन्त्यपराजिताम्‌

verses.sanskrit: तयास्माकं वरो दत्तो यथापत्सु स्मृताखिलाः । भवतां नाशयिष्यामि तत्क्षणात्परमापदः
verses.transliteration: tayAsmAkaM varo datto yathApatsu smR^itAkhilAH | bhavatAM nAshayiShyAmi tatkShaNAtparamApadaH
verses.translation: 'Thou didst grant us the boon—As ye, when in calamities, shall call me to mind, that very moment will I put an end to all your direst calamities.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Thou didst grant us the boon—As ye, when in calamities, shall call me to mind, that very moment will I put an end to all your direst calamities.'
verses.hindi: तयास्माकं वरो दत्तो यथा55पत्सु स्मृताखिला: । भवतां नाशयिष्यामि तत्क्षणात्परमापद:

verses.sanskrit: इति कृत्वा मतिं देवा हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् । जग्मुस्तत्र ततो देवीं विष्णुमायां प्रतुष्टुवुः
verses.transliteration: iti kR^itvA matiM devA himavantaM nageshvaram | jagmustatra tato devIM viShNumAyAM pratuShTuvuH
verses.translation: Making this resolve, the gods went to Himavat, lord among mountains, and there raised their hymn to the goddess, who is Vishnu's illusive power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making this resolve, the gods went to Himavat, lord among mountains, and there raised their hymn to the goddess, who is Vishnu's illusive power.
verses.hindi: इति कृत्वा मतिं देवा हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम्‌ । जम्मुस्तत्र ततो देवीं विष्णुमायां प्रतुष्टवु:

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH
verses.translation: The gods spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods spoke:
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--

verses.sanskrit: नमो देव्यै महादेव्यै शिवायै सततं नमः । नमः प्रकृत्यै भद्रायै नियताः प्रणताः स्म ताम्
verses.transliteration: namo devyai mahAdevyai shivAyai satataM namaH | namaH prakR^ityai bhadrAyai niyatAH praNatAH sma tAm
verses.translation: Reverence to the goddess, to the great goddess! To her who is auspicious reverence perpetually! Reverence to Prakriti the good! Submissive we fall prostrate before her!
verses.commentary: Sense: Reverence to the goddess, to the great goddess! To her who is auspicious reverence perpetually! Reverence to Prakriti the good! Submissive we fall prostrate before her!
verses.hindi: देवीको नमस्कार है, महादेवी शिवाको सर्वदा नमस्कार है। प्रकृति एवं भद्राको प्रणाम है। हमलोग नियमपूर्वक जगदम्बाको नमस्कार करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रायै नमो नित्यायै गौर्यै धात्र्यै नमो नमः । ज्योत्स्नायै चेन्दुरूपिण्यै सुखायै सततं नमः
verses.transliteration: raudrAyai namo nityAyai gauryai dhAtryai namo namaH | jyotsnAyai chendurUpiNyai sukhAyai satataM namaH
verses.translation: Reverence to her who is terrible, to her who is constant! To Gauri, to Dhatri reverence, yea reverence! And to the Moonlight, to her who has the moon's form, to her who is happy, reverence continually!
verses.commentary: Sense: Reverence to her who is terrible, to her who is constant! To Gauri, to Dhatri reverence, yea reverence! And to the Moonlight, to her who has the moon's form, to her who is happy, reverence continually!
verses.hindi: रौद्राकों नमस्कार है। नित्या, गौरी एवं धात्रीको बारंबार नमस्कार है। ज्योत्स्नामयी, चन्द्ररूपिणी एवं सुखस्वरूपा देवीको सतत प्रणाम

verses.sanskrit: कल्याण्यै प्रणतां वृद्ध्यै सिद्ध्यै कुर्मो नमो नमः । नैरृत्यै भूभृतां लक्ष्म्यै शर्वाण्यै ते नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: kalyANyai praNatAM vR^iddhyai siddhyai kurmo namo namaH | nairR^ityai bhUbhR^itAM lakShmyai sharvANyai te namo namaH
verses.translation: Falling prostrate, to her who is propitious, to Prosperity, to Perfection let us pay reverence, yea reverence! To Nirriti, to the goddess of Good Fortune of kings, to thee, Sharvani, reverence, yea reverence!
verses.commentary: Sense: Falling prostrate, to her who is propitious, to Prosperity, to Perfection let us pay reverence, yea reverence! To Nirriti, to the goddess of Good Fortune of kings, to thee, Sharvani, reverence, yea reverence!
verses.hindi: शरणागतोंका कल्याण करनेवाली वृद्धि एवं सिद्धिरूपा देवीको हम बारंबार नमस्कार करते हैं। नै#ऋती (राक्षसोंकी लक्ष्मी), राजाओंकी लक्ष्मी तथा शर्वाणी (शिवपत्नी)-स्वरूपा आप जगदम्बाको बार-बार नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गायै दुर्गपारायै सारायै सर्वकारिण्यै । ख्यात्यै तथैव कृष्णायै धूम्रायै सततं नमः
verses.transliteration: durgAyai durgapArAyai sArAyai sarvakAriNyai | khyAtyai tathaiva kR^iShNAyai dhUmrAyai satataM namaH
verses.translation: To Durga, to her who is a further shore difficult to be reached, to her who is essential, to her who works all things, and to Fame also, to her who is blue-black, to her who is smoke-dark, reverence continually!
verses.commentary: Sense: To Durga, to her who is a further shore difficult to be reached, to her who is essential, to her who works all things, and to Fame also, to her who is blue-black, to her who is smoke-dark, reverence continually!
verses.hindi: दुर्गा, दुर्गपारा (दुर्गम संकटसे पार उतारनेवाली), सारा (सबकी सारभूता), सर्वकारिणी, ख्याति, कृष्णा और धूम्रादेवीको सर्वदा नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: अतिसौम्यातिरौद्रायै नतास्तस्यै नमो नमः । नमो जगत्प्रतिष्ठायै देव्यै कृत्यै नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: atisaumyAtiraudrAyai natAstasyai namo namaH | namo jagatpratiShThAyai devyai kR^ityai namo namaH
verses.translation: Before her who is at once most gentle and most harsh we fall prostrate; to her reverence, yea reverence! Reverence to her who is the foundation of the world! To the goddess who is Action reverence, yea reverence!
verses.commentary: Sense: Before her who is at once most gentle and most harsh we fall prostrate; to her reverence, yea reverence! Reverence to her who is the foundation of the world! To the goddess who is Action reverence, yea reverence!
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त सौम्य तथा अत्यन्त रौद्ररूपा देवीको हम नमस्कार करते हैं, उन्हें हमारा बारंबार प्रणाम है। जगत्‌की आधारभूता कृति देवीको बारंबार नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: या देवी सर्वभूतेषु विष्णुमायेति शब्दिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.१४-१६॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु चेतनेत्यभिधीयते । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.१७-१९॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु बुद्धिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.२०-२२॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु निद्रारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.२३-२५॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु क्षुधारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.२६-२८॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु छायारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.२९-३१॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.३२-३४॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु तृष्णारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.३५-३७॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु क्षान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.३८-४०॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु जातिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.४१-४३॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु लज्जारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.४४-४६॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.४७-४९॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु श्रद्धारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.५०-५२॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु कान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.५३-५५॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मीरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.५६-५८॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु वृत्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.५९-६१॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु स्मृतिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.६२-६४॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु दयारूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.६५-६७॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु तुष्टिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.६८-७०॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु मातृरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.७१-७३॥ या देवी सर्वभूतेषु भ्रान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.७४-७६॥ इन्द्रियाणामधिष्ठात्री भूतानां चाखिलेषु या । भूतेषु सततं तस्यै व्याप्त्यै देव्यै नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: yā devī sarvabhūteṣu śaktirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Salutations again and again to the Devi who dwells in all beings in the form of power (shakti).
verses.wordMeaning: This is the most famous verse of the Durga Saptashati — repeated as a refrain nine times with different attributes: as consciousness, as sleep, as hunger, as memory, as mercy, as matter, as power, as peace, as faith.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the most famous verse of the Durga Saptashati — repeated as a refrain nine times with different attributes: as consciousness, as sleep, as hunger, as memory, as mercy, as matter, as power, as peace, as faith.…
verses.hindi: जो देवी सभी प्राणियों में शक्ति-रूप में स्थित हैं, उन्हें बार-बार नमस्कार है। नमस्तस्यै, नमस्तस्यै, नमस्तस्यै, नमो नमः।
verses.science: Physics recognizes that all forces in nature — gravity, electromagnetism, the nuclear forces — are expressions of underlying field symmetries. These forces manifest differently in different contexts but share one mathematical structure. The "Ya Devi" refrain — the same power appearing as consciousness, sleep, hunger, memory — is a mythological description of a universe where one fundamental force (Shakti) expresses itself as all apparent multiplicity.
verses.lifeLesson: The next time you feel hungry, tired, curious, loving, or afraid — pause. The same shakti that moves the stars is moving through you right now in this form. Recognizing the divine in the most ordinary experiences — appetite, sleep, longing, fear — is the highest and most accessible form of worship.

verses.sanskrit: चितिरूपेण या कृत्स्नमेतद् व्याप्य स्थिता जगत् । नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥ ५.७८-८०॥ स्तुता सुरैः पूर्वमभीष्टसंश्रया- त्तथा सुरेन्द्रेण दिनेषु सेविता । करोतु सा नः शुभहेतुरीश्वरी शुभानि भद्राण्यभिहन्तु चापदः
verses.transliteration: chitirUpeNa yA kR^itsnametad vyApya sthitA jagat | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaH || 5\.78\-80|| stutA suraiH pUrvamabhIShTasaMshrayA\- ttathA surendreNa dineShu sevitA | karotu sA naH shubhaheturIshvarI shubhAni bhadrANyabhihantu chApadaH
verses.translation: To her who exists pervading this entire world with the form of Thinking Mind—reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence, yea reverence! Praised by the gods aforetime because of eagerly-desired protection, and waited upon by the lord of the gods many days, may she, the goddess, the origin of brightness, accomplish for us bright things, yea good things, and ward off calamities!
verses.wordMeaning: To her who exists pervading this entire world with the form of Thinking Mind—reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence, yea reverence! Praised by the gods aforetime because of eagerly-desired protection, and waited upon by the lord of the gods many days,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To her who exists pervading this entire world with the form of Thinking Mind—reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence to her, reverence, yea reverence! Praised by the gods aforetime because of eagerly-desired protection, and waited upon by the lord of the gods many days,…
verses.hindi: स्तुता सुरै: पूर्वमभीष्टसं श्रया- त्तथा सुरेन्द्रेण दिनेषु सेविता । करोतु सा नः शुभहेतुरी श्वरी शुभानि भद्राण्यभिहन्तु चापद:

verses.sanskrit: या साम्प्रतं चोद्धतदैत्यतापितै- रस्माभिरीशा च सुरैर्नमस्यते । या च स्मृता तत्क्षणमेव हन्ति नः सर्वापदो भक्तिविनम्रमूर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: yA sAmprataM choddhatadaityatApitai\- rasmAbhirIshA cha surairnamasyate | yA cha smR^itA tatkShaNameva hanti naH sarvApado bhaktivinamramUrtibhiH
verses.translation: And she, who is both reverenced as queen by us gods, who are tormented now by the arrogant Daityas, and whom we call to mind as we bow our bodies in faith, she this very moment destroys all our calamities!
verses.commentary: Sense: And she, who is both reverenced as queen by us gods, who are tormented now by the arrogant Daityas, and whom we call to mind as we bow our bodies in faith, she this very moment destroys all our calamities!
verses.hindi: उहण्ड दैत्योंसे सताये हुए हम सभी देवता जिन परमेश्वरीको इस समय नमस्कार करते हैं तथा जो भक्तिसे विनम्र पुरुषोंद्वारा स्मरण की जानेपर तत्काल ही सम्पूर्ण विपत्तियोंका नाश कर देती हैं, वे जगदम्बा हमारा संकट दूर करें

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तवाभियुक्तानां देवानां तत्र पार्वती । स्नातुमभ्याययौ तोये जाह्नव्या नृपनन्दन
verses.transliteration: evaM stavAbhiyuktAnAM devAnAM tatra pArvatI | snAtumabhyAyayau toye jAhnavyA nR^ipanandana
verses.translation: While the gods were thus engaged in offering hymns and other reverential acts, Parvati came there to bathe in the water of the Ganges, O prince.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the gods were thus engaged in offering hymns and other reverential acts, Parvati came there to bathe in the water of the Ganges, O prince.
verses.hindi: राजन्‌ इस प्रकार जब देवता स्तुति कर रहे थे, उस समय पार्वती देवी गड़ाजीके जलमें स्नान करनेके लिये वहाँ आयीं

verses.sanskrit: साब्रवीत्तान् सुरान् सुभ्रूर्भवद्भिः स्तूयतेऽत्र का । शरीरकोशतश्चास्याः समुद्भूताब्रवीच्छिवा
verses.transliteration: sAbravIttAn surAn subhrUrbhavadbhiH stUyate.atra kA | sharIrakoshatashchAsyAH samudbhUtAbravIchChivA
verses.translation: She, the beautiful-browed, said to those gods, 'Whom do ye, lords, hymn here?' And springing forth from the treasure-house of her body, the auspicious goddess spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: She, the beautiful-browed, said to those gods, 'Whom do ye, lords, hymn here?' And springing forth from the treasure-house of her body, the auspicious goddess spoke:
verses.hindi: उन सुन्दर भौंहोंवाली भगवतीने देवताओंसे पूछा--“आपलोग यहाँ किसकी स्तुति करते हैं?” तब उन्हींके शरीरकोशसे प्रकट हुई शिवादेवी बोलीं--

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रं ममैतत्क्रियते शुम्भदैत्यनिराकृतैः । देवैः समेतैः समरे निशुम्भेन पराजितैः
verses.transliteration: stotraM mamaitatkriyate shumbhadaityanirAkR^itaiH | devaiH sametaiH samare nishumbhena parAjitaiH
verses.translation: 'For me this hymn is uttered by the assembled gods, who have been set at nought by the Daitya Shumbha and routed in battle by Nishumbha.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'For me this hymn is uttered by the assembled gods, who have been set at nought by the Daitya Shumbha and routed in battle by Nishumbha.'
verses.hindi: “शुम्भदैत्यसे तिरस्कृत और युद्धमें निशुम्भसे पराजित हो यहाँ एकत्रित हुए ये समस्त देवता यह मेरी ही स्तुति कर रहे हैं'

verses.sanskrit: शरीरकोशाद्यत्तस्याः पार्वत्या निःसृताम्बिका । कौशिकीति समस्तेषु ततो लोकेषु गीयते
verses.transliteration: sharIrakoshAdyattasyAH pArvatyA niHsR^itAmbikA | kaushikIti samasteShu tato lokeShu gIyate
verses.translation: Because Ambika issued forth from the treasure-house of Parvati's body, she is therefore named in song as Kaushiki among all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because Ambika issued forth from the treasure-house of Parvati's body, she is therefore named in song as Kaushiki among all the worlds.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीजीके शरीरकोशसे अम्बिकाका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ था, इसलिये वे समस्त लोकोंमें 'कौशिकी” कही जाती हैं

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां विनिर्गतायां तु कृष्णाभूत्सापि पार्वती । कालिकेति समाख्याता हिमाचलकृताश्रया
verses.transliteration: tasyAM vinirgatAyAM tu kR^iShNAbhUtsApi pArvatI | kAliketi samAkhyAtA himAchalakR^itAshrayA
verses.translation: Now after she had issued forth, the other also, even Parvati, became black; she is celebrated as Kalika; she fixed her abode on Mount Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now after she had issued forth, the other also, even Parvati, became black; she is celebrated as Kalika; she fixed her abode on Mount Himavat.
verses.hindi: कौशिकीके प्रकट होनेके बाद पार्वतीदेवीका शरीर काले रंगका हो गया, अतः वे हिमालयपर रहनेवाली कालिकादेवीके नामसे विख्यात हुईं

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽम्बिकां परं रूपं बिभ्राणां सुमनोहरम् । ददर्श चण्डो मुण्डश्च भृत्यौ शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: tato.ambikAM paraM rUpaM bibhrANAM sumanoharam | dadarsha chaNDo muNDashcha bhR^ityau shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: Thereafter Chanda and Munda, the two servants of Shumbha and Nishumbha, saw Ambika displaying her sublime and most captivating form;
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Chanda and Munda, the two servants of Shumbha and Nishumbha, saw Ambika displaying her sublime and most captivating form;
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर शुम्भ-निशुम्भके भृत्य चण्ड-मुण्ड वहाँ आये और उन्होंने परम मनोहर रूप धारण करनेवाली अम्बिकादेवीको देखा

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां शुम्भाय चाख्याता सातीव सुमनोहरा । काप्यास्ते स्त्री महाराज भासयन्ती हिमाचलम्
verses.transliteration: tAbhyAM shumbhAya chAkhyAtA sAtIva sumanoharA | kApyAste strI mahArAja bhAsayantI himAchalam
verses.translation: and both spake out unto Shumbha: 'What woman then, most surpassingly captivating, dwells here, illuminating Mount Himavat, O great king?'
verses.commentary: Sense: and both spake out unto Shumbha: 'What woman then, most surpassingly captivating, dwells here, illuminating Mount Himavat, O great king?'
verses.hindi: फिर वे शुम्भके पास जाकर बोले--“महाराज! एक अत्यन्त मनोहर स्त्री है, जो अपनी दिव्य कान्तिसे हिमालयको प्रकाशित कर रही है

verses.sanskrit: नैव तादृक् क्वचिद्रूपं दृष्टं केनचिदुत्तमम् । ज्ञायतां काप्यसौ देवी गृह्यतां चासुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: naiva tAdR^ik kvachidrUpaM dR^iShTaM kenachiduttamam | j~nAyatAM kApyasau devI gR^ihyatAM chAsureshvara
verses.translation: 'Such sublime beauty was never in sooth seen by anyone anywhere; let it be ascertained if she is any goddess, and let her be taken possession of, O lord of the Asuras.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Such sublime beauty was never in sooth seen by anyone anywhere; let it be ascertained if she is any goddess, and let her be taken possession of, O lord of the Asuras.'
verses.hindi: नैव तादृक्‌ क्वचिद्रूपं दृष्टं केनचिदुत्तमम्‌ । ज्ञायतां काप्यसौ देवी गृहृतां चासुरेश्वर

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीरत्नमतिचार्वङ्गी द्योतयन्ती दिशस्त्विषा । सा तु तिष्ठति दैत्येन्द्र तां भवान् द्रष्टुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: strIratnamatichArva~NgI dyotayantI dishastviShA | sA tu tiShThati daityendra tAM bhavAn draShTumarhati
verses.translation: 'A gem among women, surpassingly beautiful in body, illuminating the regions of the sky with her lustre—there she is then, O lord of the Daityas; deign, Sir, to look at her.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'A gem among women, surpassingly beautiful in body, illuminating the regions of the sky with her lustre—there she is then, O lord of the Daityas; deign, Sir, to look at her.'
verses.hindi: स्त्रियोंमें तो वह रत्न है, उसका प्रत्येक अड़ बहुत ही सुन्दर है तथा वह अपने श्रीअड़ोंकी प्रभासे सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंमें प्रकाश फैला रही है। दैत्ययाज! अभी वह हिमालयपर ही मौजूद है, आप उसे देख सकते हैं

verses.sanskrit: यानि रत्नानि मणयो गजाश्वादीनि वै प्रभो । त्रैलोक्ये तु समस्तानि साम्प्रतं भान्ति ते गृहे
verses.transliteration: yAni ratnAni maNayo gajAshvAdIni vai prabho | trailokye tu samastAni sAmprataM bhAnti te gR^ihe
verses.translation: 'Moreover, whatever gems, precious stones, elephants, horses and other valuable things indeed exist in the three worlds, O lord, all those display their splendour at this present time in thy house.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Moreover, whatever gems, precious stones, elephants, horses and other valuable things indeed exist in the three worlds, O lord, all those display their splendour at this present time in thy house.'
verses.hindi: प्रभो! तीनों लोकोंमें मणि, हाथी और घोड़े आदि जितने भी रलन हैं, वे सब इस समय आपके घरमें शोभा पाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतः समानीतो गजरत्नं पुरन्दरात् । पारिजाततरुश्चायं तथैवोच्चैःश्रवा हयः
verses.transliteration: airAvataH samAnIto gajaratnaM purandarAt | pArijAtatarushchAyaM tathaivochchaiHshravA hayaH
verses.translation: 'Airavata, gem among elephants, has been captured from Purandara; and this Parijata tree and also the horse Uchchaihshravas.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Airavata, gem among elephants, has been captured from Purandara; and this Parijata tree and also the horse Uchchaihshravas.'
verses.hindi: हाथियोंमें रत्नभूत ऐरावत, यह पारिजातका वृक्ष और यह उच्चै:श्रवा घोड़ा--यह सब आपने इन्द्रसे ले लिया है

verses.sanskrit: विमानं हंससंयुक्तमेतत्तिष्ठति तेऽङ्गणे । रत्नभूतमिहानीतं यदासीद्वेधसोऽद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: vimAnaM haMsasaMyuktametattiShThati te.a~NgaNe | ratnabhUtamihAnItaM yadAsIdvedhaso.adbhutam
verses.translation: 'Here stands the heavenly chariot yoked with swans in thy court-yard; it has been brought here, the wonderful chariot composed of gems, which belonged to Brahma.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Here stands the heavenly chariot yoked with swans in thy court-yard; it has been brought here, the wonderful chariot composed of gems, which belonged to Brahma.'
verses.hindi: हंसोंसे जुता हुआ यह विमान भी आपके आँगनमें शोभा पाता है। यह रत्नभूत अद्भुत विमान, जो पहले ब्रह्माजीके पास था, अब आपके यहाँ लाया गया है

verses.sanskrit: निधिरेष महापद्मः समानीतो धनेश्वरात् । किञ्जल्किनीं ददौ चाब्धिर्मालामम्लानपङ्कजाम्
verses.transliteration: nidhireSha mahApadmaH samAnIto dhaneshvarAt | ki~njalkinIM dadau chAbdhirmAlAmamlAnapa~NkajAm
verses.translation: 'Here is the Nidhi Mahapadma, captured from the Lord of wealth. And the Ocean gave a garland made of filaments and of undying lotus flowers.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Here is the Nidhi Mahapadma, captured from the Lord of wealth. And the Ocean gave a garland made of filaments and of undying lotus flowers.'
verses.hindi: यह महापद्म नामक निधि आप कुबेरसे छीन लाये हैं। समुद्रने भी आपको किज्जल्किनी नामकी माला भेंट की है, जो केसरोंसे सुशोभित है और जिसके कमल कभी कुम्हलाते नहीं

verses.sanskrit: छत्रं ते वारुणं गेहे काञ्चनस्रावि तिष्ठति । तथायं स्यन्दनवरो यः पुरासीत्प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: ChatraM te vAruNaM gehe kA~nchanasrAvi tiShThati | tathAyaM syandanavaro yaH purAsItprajApateH
verses.translation: 'In thy house stands Varuna's umbrella, which streams with gold. And here is the choice chariot that belonged to Prajapati formerly.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'In thy house stands Varuna's umbrella, which streams with gold. And here is the choice chariot that belonged to Prajapati formerly.'
verses.hindi: छत्र॑ ते वारुणं गेहे काउ्चनस्रावि तिष्ठति । तथायं स्यन्दनवरो यः पुरा55सीत्प्रजापते:

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योरुत्क्रान्तिदा नाम शक्तिरीश त्वया हृता । पाशः सलिलराजस्य भ्रातुस्तव परिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: mR^ityorutkrAntidA nAma shaktirIsha tvayA hR^itA | pAshaH salilarAjasya bhrAtustava parigrahe
verses.translation: 'Thou, O lord, hast carried off Death's power, which is named Utkranti-da. The noose of the Ocean-king is in thy brother's possession.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Thou, O lord, hast carried off Death's power, which is named Utkranti-da. The noose of the Ocean-king is in thy brother's possession.'
verses.hindi: दैत्येश्वर! मृत्युकी उत्क्रान्तिदा नामवाली शक्ति भी आपने छीन ली है तथा वरुणका पाश और समुद्रमें होनेवाले सब प्रकारके रत्न आपके भाई निशुम्भके अधिकारमें हैं। अग्निने भी स्वतः शुद्ध किये हुए दो वस्त्र आपकी सेवामें अर्पित किये हैं

verses.sanskrit: निशुम्भस्याब्धिजाताश्च समस्ता रत्नजातयः । वह्निरपि ददौ तुभ्यमग्निशौचे च वाससी
verses.transliteration: nishumbhasyAbdhijAtAshcha samastA ratnajAtayaH | vahnirapi dadau tubhyamagnishauche cha vAsasI
verses.translation: 'And Nishumbha has every kind of gem which is produced in the sea. Agni also gave thee two garments which are purified by fire.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'And Nishumbha has every kind of gem which is produced in the sea. Agni also gave thee two garments which are purified by fire.'
verses.hindi: दैत्येश्वर! मृत्युकी उत्क्रान्तिदा नामवाली शक्ति भी आपने छीन ली है तथा वरुणका पाश और समुद्रमें होनेवाले सब प्रकारके रत्न आपके भाई निशुम्भके अधिकारमें हैं। अग्निने भी स्वतः शुद्ध किये हुए दो वस्त्र आपकी सेवामें अर्पित किये हैं

verses.sanskrit: एवं दैत्येन्द्र रत्नानि समस्तान्याहृतानि ते । स्त्रीरत्नमेषा कल्याणी त्वया कस्मान्न गृह्यते
verses.transliteration: evaM daityendra ratnAni samastAnyAhR^itAni te | strIratnameShA kalyANI tvayA kasmAnna gR^ihyate
verses.translation: 'Thus, O lord of the Daityas, all gems have been captured by thee; why dost thou not seize this auspicious lady, this gem of womankind?'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Thus, O lord of the Daityas, all gems have been captured by thee; why dost thou not seize this auspicious lady, this gem of womankind?'
verses.hindi: दैत्यराज! इस प्रकार सभी रत्न आपने एकत्र कर लिये हैं। फिर जो यह स्त्रियोंमें रतनरूप कल्याणकारी देवी है, इसे आप क्यों नहीं अपने अधिकारमें कर लेते?

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: निशम्येति वचः शुम्भः स तदा चण्डमुण्डयोः । प्रेषयामास सुग्रीवं दूतं देव्या महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: nishamyeti vachaH shumbhaH sa tadA chaNDamuNDayoH | preShayAmAsa sugrIvaM dUtaM devyA mahAsuram
verses.translation: Shumbha, on hearing this speech then from Chanda and Munda, sent the great Asura Sugriva as messenger to the goddess,
verses.commentary: Sense: Shumbha, on hearing this speech then from Chanda and Munda, sent the great Asura Sugriva as messenger to the goddess,
verses.hindi: चण्ड-मुण्डका यह वचन सुनकर शुम्भने महादैत्य सुग्रीवको दूत बनाकर देवीके पास भेजा और कहा--'तुम मेरी आज्ञासे उसके सामने ये-ये बातें कहना और ऐसा उपाय करना जिससे प्रसन्न होकर वह शीघ्र ही यहाँ आ जाय”

verses.sanskrit: इति चेति च वक्तव्या सा गत्वा वचनान्मम । यथा चाभ्येति सम्प्रीत्या तथा कार्यं त्वया लघु
verses.transliteration: iti cheti cha vaktavyA sA gatvA vachanAnmama | yathA chAbhyeti samprItyA tathA kAryaM tvayA laghu
verses.translation: saying, 'Go and address her thus and thus according to my words, and lightly conduct the matter so that she may come to me of her own good pleasure.'
verses.commentary: Sense: saying, 'Go and address her thus and thus according to my words, and lightly conduct the matter so that she may come to me of her own good pleasure.'
verses.hindi: इति चेति च वक्तव्या सा गत्वा वचनान्मम । यथा चाभ्येति सम्प्रीत्या तथा कार्य त्वया लघु

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र गत्वा यत्रास्ते शैलोद्देशेऽतिशोभने । तां च देवीं ततः प्राह श्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: sa tatra gatvA yatrAste shailoddeshe.atishobhane | tAM cha devIM tataH prAha shlakShNaM madhurayA girA
verses.translation: He went to where the goddess sat on a very bright spot in the mountain, and spoke gently with mellifluous voice.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to where the goddess sat on a very bright spot in the mountain, and spoke gently with mellifluous voice.
verses.hindi: स तत्र गत्वा यत्रास्ते शैलोद्देशेइतिशो भने । सा3 देवी तां ततः प्राह श्लक्षणं मधुरया गिरा

verses.sanskrit: दूत उवाच
verses.transliteration: dUta uvAcha
verses.translation: The messenger spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: The messenger spoke:
verses.hindi: दूत बोला:

verses.sanskrit: देवि दैत्येश्वरः शुम्भस्त्रैलोक्ये परमेश्वरः । दूतोऽहं प्रेषितस्तेन त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: devi daityeshvaraH shumbhastrailokye parameshvaraH | dUto.ahaM preShitastena tvatsakAshamihAgataH
verses.translation: O goddess! Shumbha, lord of the Daityas, is supreme lord over the three worlds. A messenger am I, sent by him; to thy presence here I have come.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess! Shumbha, lord of the Daityas, is supreme lord over the three worlds. A messenger am I, sent by him; to thy presence here I have come.
verses.hindi: देवि! दैत्यराज शुम्भ इस समय तीनों लोकोंके परमेश्वर हैं। मैं उन्हींका भेजा हुआ दूत हूँ और यहाँ तुम्हारे ही पास आया हूँ

verses.sanskrit: अव्याहताज्ञः सर्वासु यः सदा देवयोनिषु । निर्जिताखिलदैत्यारिः स यदाह शृणुष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: avyAhatAj~naH sarvAsu yaH sadA devayoniShu | nirjitAkhiladaityAriH sa yadAha shR^iNuShva tat
verses.translation: Hearken to what he has said, whose command is never resisted among all beings of divine origin, and who has vanquished every foe of the Daityas:
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearken to what he has said, whose command is never resisted among all beings of divine origin, and who has vanquished every foe of the Daityas:
verses.hindi: उनकी आज्ञा सदा सब देवता एक स्वरसे मानते हैं। कोई उसका उल्लड्घन नहीं कर सकता। वे सम्पूर्ण देवताओंको परास्त कर चुके हैं। उन्होंने तुम्हारे लिये जो संदेश दिया है, उसे सुनो

verses.sanskrit: मम त्रैलोक्यमखिलं मम देवा वशानुगाः । यज्ञभागानहं सर्वानुपाश्नामि पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: mama trailokyamakhilaM mama devA vashAnugAH | yaj~nabhAgAnahaM sarvAnupAshnAmi pR^ithak pR^ithak
verses.translation: 'Mine are all the three worlds; obedient to my authority are the gods; I eat every portion of the sacrifices separately.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Mine are all the three worlds; obedient to my authority are the gods; I eat every portion of the sacrifices separately.'
verses.hindi: “सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकी मेरे अधिकारमें है। देवता भी मेरी आज्ञाके अधीन चलते हैं। सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंके भागोंको मैं ही पृथक्‌-पृथक्‌ भोगता हूँ

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्ये वररत्नानि मम वश्यान्यशेषतः । तथैव गजरत्नं च हृतं देवेन्द्रवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: trailokye vararatnAni mama vashyAnyasheShataH | tathaiva gajaratnaM cha hR^itaM devendravAhanam
verses.translation: 'The choicest gems in the three worlds are altogether under my power; and so is the finest of elephants, the chariot-beast of the lord of the gods, since I have captured it.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'The choicest gems in the three worlds are altogether under my power; and so is the finest of elephants, the chariot-beast of the lord of the gods, since I have captured it.'
verses.hindi: तीनों लोकोंमें जितने श्रेष्ठ रत्न हैं, वे सब मेरे अधिकारमें हैं। देवराज इन्द्रका वाहन ऐरावत, जो हाथियोंमें रत्नके समान है, मैंने छीन लिया है

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदमथनोद्भूतमश्वरत्नं ममामरैः । उच्चैःश्रवससंज्ञं तत्प्रणिपत्य समर्पितम्
verses.transliteration: kShIrodamathanodbhUtamashvaratnaM mamAmaraiH | uchchaiHshravasasaMj~naM tatpraNipatya samarpitam
verses.translation: 'That gem among horses, named Uchchaihshravas, which came forth at the churning of the sea of milk, was presented to me by the immortals who prostrated themselves before me.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'That gem among horses, named Uchchaihshravas, which came forth at the churning of the sea of milk, was presented to me by the immortals who prostrated themselves before me.'
verses.hindi: क्षीरसागरका मन्‍्थन करनेसे जो अश्वरत्न उच्चै:श्रवा प्रकट हुआ था, उसे देवताओंने मेरे पैरोंपर पड़कर समर्पित किया है

verses.sanskrit: यानि चान्यानि देवेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च । रत्नभूतानि भूतानि तानि मय्येव शोभने
verses.transliteration: yAni chAnyAni deveShu gandharveShUrageShu cha | ratnabhUtAni bhUtAni tAni mayyeva shobhane
verses.translation: 'And whatever other created things in the shape of gems existed among the gods, Gandharvas and Nagas, they were presented even to me, O brilliant lady.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'And whatever other created things in the shape of gems existed among the gods, Gandharvas and Nagas, they were presented even to me, O brilliant lady.'
verses.hindi: सुन्दरी! उनके सिवा और भी जितने रत्नभूत पदार्थ देवताओं, गन्धर्वों और नागोंके पास थे, वे सब मेरे ही पास आ गये हैं

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीरत्नभूतां त्वां देवि लोके मन्यामहे वयम् । सा त्वमस्मानुपागच्छ यतो रत्नभुजो वयम्
verses.transliteration: strIratnabhUtAM tvAM devi loke manyAmahe vayam | sA tvamasmAnupAgachCha yato ratnabhujo vayam
verses.translation: 'I esteem thee, O goddess, to be the gem of womankind in the world; do thou, who art such, approach unto me, since I am an enjoyer of gems.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'I esteem thee, O goddess, to be the gem of womankind in the world; do thou, who art such, approach unto me, since I am an enjoyer of gems.'
verses.hindi: देवि! हमलोग तुम्हें संसारकी स्त्रियोंमें रत्न मानते हैं, अतः तुम हमारे पास आ जाओ; क्‍योंकि रत्नोंका उपभोग करनेवाले हम ही हैं

verses.sanskrit: मां वा ममानुजं वापि निशुम्भमुरुविक्रमम् । भज त्वं चञ्चलापाङ्गि रत्नभूतासि वै यतः
verses.transliteration: mAM vA mamAnujaM vApi nishumbhamuruvikramam | bhaja tvaM cha~nchalApA~Ngi ratnabhUtAsi vai yataH
verses.translation: 'Either to me, or to my younger brother Nishumbha of wide-reaching prowess, approach thou, O lady of quick side-glances, since thou art in truth a gem.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Either to me, or to my younger brother Nishumbha of wide-reaching prowess, approach thou, O lady of quick side-glances, since thou art in truth a gem.'
verses.hindi: हे चञ्चल नेत्रोंवाली सुन्दरी! तुम रत्नस्वरूपा हो, अतः तुम मुझको या मेरे महापराक्रमी छोटे भाई निशुम्भको वरो।

verses.sanskrit: परमैश्वर्यमतुलं प्राप्स्यसे मत्परिग्रहात् । एतद्बुद्ध्या समालोच्य मत्परिग्रहतां व्रज
verses.transliteration: paramaishvaryamatulaM prApsyase matparigrahAt | etadbuddhyA samAlochya matparigrahatAM vraja
verses.translation: 'Supreme dominion beyond compare thou shalt gain by wedding me. Understand and consider this, and come unto wedlock with me.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Supreme dominion beyond compare thou shalt gain by wedding me. Understand and consider this, and come unto wedlock with me.'
verses.hindi: मुझे वरण करनेसे तुम्हें अतुलनीय परमैश्वर्य प्राप्त होगा। ऐसा विचार करके तुम मेरा वरण करो।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ता सा तदा देवी गम्भीरान्तःस्मिता जगौ । दुर्गा भगवती भद्रा ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktA sA tadA devI gambhIrAntaHsmitA jagau | durgA bhagavatI bhadrA yayedaM dhAryate jagat
verses.translation: Thus accosted, the goddess, smiling deeply within herself—she, Durga the adorable and good, who supports this world—sang this reply then.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus accosted, the goddess, smiling deeply within herself—she, Durga the adorable and good, who supports this world—sang this reply then.
verses.hindi: ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ ११५ ॥/ इत्युक्ता सा तदा देवी गम्भीरान्त:स्मिता जगौ | दुर्गा भगवती भद्रा ययेदं धार्यते जगत्‌

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:
verses.hindi: देवीने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमुक्तं त्वया नात्र मिथ्या किञ्चित्त्वयोदितम् । त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः शुम्भो निशुम्भश्चापि तादृशः
verses.transliteration: satyamuktaM tvayA nAtra mithyA ki~nchittvayoditam | trailokyAdhipatiH shumbho nishumbhashchApi tAdR^ishaH
verses.translation: Truly hast thou spoken; nought hast thou uttered falsely herein. Sovereign of the three worlds is Shumbha, and like unto him is Nishumbha also!
verses.commentary: Sense: Truly hast thou spoken; nought hast thou uttered falsely herein. Sovereign of the three worlds is Shumbha, and like unto him is Nishumbha also!
verses.hindi: दूत! तुमने सत्य कहा है, इसमें तनिक भी मिथ्या नहीं है। शुम्भ तीनों लोकोंका स्वामी है और निशुम्भ भी उसीके समान पराक्रमी है

verses.sanskrit: किं त्वत्र यत्प्रतिज्ञातं मिथ्या तत्क्रियते कथम् । श्रूयतामल्पबुद्धित्वात्प्रतिज्ञा या कृता पुरा
verses.transliteration: kiM tvatra yatpratij~nAtaM mithyA tatkriyate katham | shrUyatAmalpabuddhitvAtpratij~nA yA kR^itA purA
verses.translation: But how can that which has been promised concerning this myself be fulfilled falsely? Hearken, what vow I made formerly by reason of my small understanding at that time:
verses.commentary: Sense: But how can that which has been promised concerning this myself be fulfilled falsely? Hearken, what vow I made formerly by reason of my small understanding at that time:
verses.hindi: किंतु इस विषयमें मैंने जो प्रतिज्ञा कर ली है, उसे मिथ्या कैसे करूँ। मैंने अपनी अल्पबुद्धिके कारण पहलेसे जो प्रतिज्ञा कर रखी है, उसको सुनो

verses.sanskrit: यो मां जयति सङ्ग्रामे यो मे दर्पं व्यपोहति । यो मे प्रतिबलो लोके स मे भर्ता भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yo mAM jayati sa~NgrAme yo me darpaM vyapohati | yo me pratibalo loke sa me bhartA bhaviShyati
verses.translation: 'He who vanquishes me in fight, who forces my pride from me, and who is my match in strength in the world, he shall be my husband.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'He who vanquishes me in fight, who forces my pride from me, and who is my match in strength in the world, he shall be my husband.'
verses.hindi: “जो मुझे संग्राममें जीत लेगा, जो मेरे अभिमानको चूर्ण कर देगा तथा संसारमें जो मेरे समान बलवान होगा, वही मेरा स्वामी होगा”

verses.sanskrit: तदागच्छतु शुम्भोऽत्र निशुम्भो वा महाबलः । मां जित्वा किं चिरेणात्र पाणिं गृह्णातु मे लघु
verses.transliteration: tadAgachChatu shumbho.atra nishumbho vA mahAbalaH | mAM jitvA kiM chireNAtra pANiM gR^ihNAtu me laghu
verses.translation: Let Shumbha come here then, or Nishumbha the great Asura; let him vanquish me—what need of delay here?—and let him lightly take my hand in marriage!
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Shumbha come here then, or Nishumbha the great Asura; let him vanquish me—what need of delay here?—and let him lightly take my hand in marriage!
verses.hindi: इसलिये शुम्भ अथवा महादैत्य निशुम्भ स्वयं ही यहाँ पधारें और मुझे जीतकर शीघ्र ही मेरा पाणिग्रहण कर लें, इसमें विलम्बकी क्या आवश्यकता है

verses.sanskrit: दूत उवाच
verses.transliteration: dUta uvAcha
verses.translation: The messenger spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: The messenger spoke:
verses.hindi: दूत बोला:

verses.sanskrit: अवलिप्तासि मैवं त्वं देवि ब्रूहि ममाग्रतः । त्रैलोक्ये कः पुमांस्तिष्ठेदग्रे शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: avaliptAsi maivaM tvaM devi brUhi mamAgrataH | trailokye kaH pumAMstiShThedagre shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: Proud art thou! Talk not so before me, O goddess! What male in the three worlds may stand front to front with Shumbha and Nishumbha?
verses.commentary: Sense: Proud art thou! Talk not so before me, O goddess! What male in the three worlds may stand front to front with Shumbha and Nishumbha?
verses.hindi: देवि! तुम घमण्डमें भरी हो, मेरे सामने ऐसी बातें न करो। तीनों लोकोंमें कौन ऐसा पुरुष है, जो शुम्भ-निशुम्भके सामने खड़ा हो सके

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषामपि दैत्यानां सर्वे देवा न वै युधि । तिष्ठन्ति सम्मुखे देवि किं पुनः स्त्री त्वमेकिका
verses.transliteration: anyeShAmapi daityAnAM sarve devA na vai yudhi | tiShThanti sammukhe devi kiM punaH strI tvamekikA
verses.translation: All the gods verily stand not face to face with even the other Daityas in battle, O goddess; how much less canst thou so stand, a woman single-handed!
verses.commentary: Sense: All the gods verily stand not face to face with even the other Daityas in battle, O goddess; how much less canst thou so stand, a woman single-handed!
verses.hindi: अन्य दैत्योंके सामने भी युद्धमें सब देवता नहीं ठहर सकते, फिर हे देवि! तुम अकेली स्त्री होकर कैसे ठहर सकोगी?

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राद्याः सकला देवास्तस्थुर्येषां न संयुगे । शुम्भादीनां कथं तेषां स्त्री प्रयास्यसि सम्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: indrAdyAH sakalA devAstasthuryeShAM na saMyuge | shumbhAdInAM kathaM teShAM strI prayAsyasi sammukham
verses.translation: With Shumbha and those other Daityas, against whom Indra and all the other gods stood not in battle, how shalt thou, a woman, venture face to face?
verses.commentary: Sense: With Shumbha and those other Daityas, against whom Indra and all the other gods stood not in battle, how shalt thou, a woman, venture face to face?
verses.hindi: जिन शुम्भ आदि दैत्योंके सामने इन्द्र आदि देवता भी युद्धमें खड़े नहीं हुए, उनके सामने तुम स्त्री होकर कैसे जाओगी

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वं गच्छ मयैवोक्ता पार्श्वं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः । केशाकर्षणनिर्धूतगौरवा मा गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: sA tvaM gachCha mayaivoktA pArshvaM shumbhanishumbhayoH | keshAkarShaNanirdhUtagauravA mA gamiShyasi
verses.translation: Do thou, being such, to whom I have in sooth delivered my message, go near unto Shumbha and Nishumbha; let it not be that thou shalt go with thy dignity shattered, in that thou wilt be dragged thither by thy hair!
verses.commentary: Sense: Do thou, being such, to whom I have in sooth delivered my message, go near unto Shumbha and Nishumbha; let it not be that thou shalt go with thy dignity shattered, in that thou wilt be dragged thither by thy hair!
verses.hindi: इसलिये तुम मेरे ही कहनेसे शुम्भ-निशुम्भके पास चली चलो। ऐसा करनेसे तुम्हारे गौरवकी रक्षा होगी; अन्यथा जब वे केश पकड़कर घसीटेंगे, तब तुम्हें अपनी प्रतिष्ठा खोकर जाना पड़ेगा

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतद् बली शुम्भो निशुम्भश्चापितादृशः । किं करोमि प्रतिज्ञा मे यदनालोचिता पुरा
verses.transliteration: evametad balI shumbho nishumbhashchApitAdR^ishaH | kiM karomi pratij~nA me yadanAlochitA purA
verses.translation: So strong as this is Shumbha! and so exceedingly heroic is Nishumbha! What can I do, since there stands my ill-considered promise of long ago?
verses.commentary: Sense: So strong as this is Shumbha! and so exceedingly heroic is Nishumbha! What can I do, since there stands my ill-considered promise of long ago?
verses.hindi: तुम्हारा कहना ठीक है, शुम्भ बलवान्‌ हैं और निशुम्भ भी बड़े पराक्रमी हैं; किंतु क्या करूँ। मैंने पहले बिना सोचे-समझे प्रतिज्ञा कर ली है

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं गच्छ मयोक्तं ते यदेतत्सर्वमादृतः । तदाचक्ष्वासुरेन्द्राय स च युक्तं करोतु यत्
verses.transliteration: sa tvaM gachCha mayoktaM te yadetatsarvamAdR^itaH | tadAchakShvAsurendrAya sa cha yuktaM karotu yat
verses.translation: Go thou thyself; make known respectfully to the lord of the Asuras all this that I have said to thee, and let him do whatever is fitting.
verses.commentary: Sense: Go thou thyself; make known respectfully to the lord of the Asuras all this that I have said to thee, and let him do whatever is fitting.
verses.hindi: अत: अब तुम जाओ; मैंने तुमसे जो कुछ कहा है, वह सब दैत्यराजसे आदरपूर्वक कहना। फिर वे जो उचित जान पड़े, करें

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इत्याकर्ण्य वचो देव्याः स दूतोऽमर्षपूरितः । समाचष्ट समागम्य दैत्यराजाय विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: ityAkarNya vacho devyAH sa dUto.amarShapUritaH | samAchaShTa samAgamya daityarAjAya vistarAt
verses.translation: The messenger, on hearing this speech from the goddess, was filled with indignation, and approaching related it fully to the Daitya king.
