verses.commentary: Sense: The messenger, on hearing this speech from the goddess, was filled with indignation, and approaching related it fully to the Daitya king.
verses.hindi: ३. किसी-किसी प्रतिमें इसके बाद “अन्येषां चाधिकरान्‌ स स्वयमेवाधितिष्ठति” इतना पाठ अधिक है। $. वृद्धयै सिद्धयै च प्रणतां देवीं प्रति नमः नतिं कुर्म इत्यन्वय: । यद्‌ वा प्रणमन्तीति प्रणन्त:, तेषा: प्रणतामिति षष्ठीबहुवचनान्तं बोध्यम्‌ | इति शान्तनव्यां टीकायां स्पष्टम्‌ | *प्रणता:' इति पाठान्तरम्‌ । ३. पा०--समस्तै:। २. पा०--कोषा। ३. पा०--कौषिकी। ४. पा०--श्नापि। ३. पा०--इसके बाद कही-कहीं 'शुम्भ उवाच' इतना अधिक पाठ है। २. पा०--तां च देवीं ततः। ३. पा०--गजरत्नानि हृत्वा। २. पा० हृत॑। ३. पा०--यत्‌। षष्ठोड ध्याय: धूम्रलोचन-वध ध्यान (३० नागाधीश्व्‌रविष्टरां फणिफणीत्तंसोरुरत्नावली- भास्वद्देहलतां दिवाकरनिभां नेत्रत्रयोद्धासिताम्‌ । मालाकुम्भकपालनीरजकरां चन्द्रार्थचूडां परां सर्वज्ञेश्वरभैरवाड्कनिलयां पद्मावती चिन्तये ।। मैं सर्वज्ञेश्वर भैरवके अड्कमें निवास करनेवाली परमोत्कृष्ट पद्मावती देवीका चिन्तन करता हूँ। वे नागराजके आसनपर बैठी हैं, नागोंके फणोंमें सुशोभित होनेवाली मणियोंकी विशाल मालासे उनकी देहलता उद्धासित हो रही है। सूर्यके समान उनका तेज है, तीन नेत्र उनकी शोभा बढ़ा रहे हैं। वे हाथोंमें माला, कुम्भ, कपाल और कमल लिये हुए हैं तथा उनके मस्तकमें अर्द्धचन्द्रका मुकुट सुशोभित है।) ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ १ ॥/ “३० इत्याकर्ण्य वचो देव्या: स दूतो<मर्षपूरित: । समाचपष्ट समागम्य दैत्यराजाय विस्तरात्‌

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दूतस्य तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्यासुरराट् ततः । सक्रोधः प्राह दैत्यानामधिपं धूम्रलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya dUtasya tadvAkyamAkarNyAsurarAT tataH | sakrodhaH prAha daityAnAmadhipaM dhUmralochanam
verses.translation: The Asura monarch then, after hearing that report from his messenger, was wroth and commanded Dhumralochana, a chieftain of the Daityas:
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asura monarch then, after hearing that report from his messenger, was wroth and commanded Dhumralochana, a chieftain of the Daityas:
verses.hindi: दूतके उस वचनको सुनकर दैत्यराज कुपित हो उठा और दैत्यसेनापति धूम्रलोचनसे बोला--

verses.sanskrit: हे धूम्रलोचनाशु त्वं स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः । तामानय बलाद्दुष्टां केशाकर्षणविह्वलाम्
verses.transliteration: he dhUmralochanAshu tvaM svasainyaparivAritaH | tAmAnaya balAdduShTAM keshAkarShaNavihvalAm
verses.translation: 'Ho! Dhumralochana, haste thee together with thy army; fetch by force that shrew, who will be unnerved when dragged along by her hair.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Ho! Dhumralochana, haste thee together with thy army; fetch by force that shrew, who will be unnerved when dragged along by her hair.'
verses.hindi: 'धूम्रलोचन! तुम शीघ्र अपनी सेना साथ लेकर जाओ और उस दुष्टाको केश पकड़कर घसीटते हुए जबरदस्ती यहाँ ले आओ

verses.sanskrit: तत्परित्राणदः कश्चिद्यदि वोत्तिष्ठतेऽपरः । स हन्तव्योऽमरो वापि यक्षो गन्धर्व एव वा
verses.transliteration: tatparitrANadaH kashchidyadi vottiShThate.aparaH | sa hantavyo.amaro vApi yakSho gandharva eva vA
verses.translation: 'Or if any man besides stands up to offer her deliverance, let him be slain, be he an Immortal, a Yaksha or a Gandharva forsooth.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Or if any man besides stands up to offer her deliverance, let him be slain, be he an Immortal, a Yaksha or a Gandharva forsooth.'
verses.hindi: उसकी रक्षा करनेके लिये यदि कोई दूसरा खड़ा हो तो वह देवता, यक्ष अथवा गन्धर्व--कोई भी क्‍यों न हो, उसे अवश्य मार डालना'

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: तेनाज्ञप्तस्ततः शीघ्रं स दैत्यो धूम्रलोचनः । वृतः षष्ट्या सहस्राणामसुराणां द्रुतं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tenAj~naptastataH shIghraM sa daityo dhUmralochanaH | vR^itaH ShaShTyA sahasrANAmasurANAM drutaM yayau
verses.translation: Thereupon at his command the Daitya Dhumralochana went forthwith quickly, accompanied by sixty thousand Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon at his command the Daitya Dhumralochana went forthwith quickly, accompanied by sixty thousand Asuras.
verses.hindi: शुम्भके इस प्रकार आज्ञा देनेपर वह धूम्रलोचन दैत्य साठ हजार असुरोंकी सेनाको साथ लेकर वहाँसे तुरंत चल दिया

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा तां ततो देवीं तुहिनाचलसंस्थिताम् । जगादोच्चैः प्रयाहीति मूलं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: sa dR^iShTvA tAM tato devIM tuhinAchalasaMsthitAm | jagAdochchaiH prayAhIti mUlaM shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: On seeing the goddess stationed on the snowy mountain, he cried aloud to her there: 'Come forward to the presence of Shumbha and Nishumbha;'
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the goddess stationed on the snowy mountain, he cried aloud to her there: 'Come forward to the presence of Shumbha and Nishumbha;'
verses.hindi: स दृष्टवा तां ततो देवीं तुहिनाचलसंस्थिताम्‌ । जगादोच्चै: प्रयाहीति मूलं शुम्भनिशुम्भयो:

verses.sanskrit: न चेत्प्रीत्याद्य भवती मद्भर्तारमुपैष्यति । ततो बलान्नयाम्येष केशाकर्षणविह्वलाम्
verses.transliteration: na chetprItyAdya bhavatI madbhartAramupaiShyati | tato balAnnayAmyeSha keshAkarShaNavihvalAm
verses.translation: 'if thou wilt not, lady, approach my lord with affection now, I will here take thee by force, who wilt be unnerved since thou shalt be dragged along by thy hair!'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'if thou wilt not, lady, approach my lord with affection now, I will here take thee by force, who wilt be unnerved since thou shalt be dragged along by thy hair!'
verses.hindi: वहाँ पहुँचकर उसने हिमालयपर रहनेवाली उन देवीको देखा और ललकारकर कहा--'अरी! तू शुम्भ-निशुम्भके पास चल। यदि इस समय प्रसन्नतापूर्वक मेरे स्वामीके समीप नहीं चलेगी तो मैं बलपूर्वक झोंटा पकड़कर घसीटते हुए तुझे ले चलूँगा'

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: दैत्येश्वरेण प्रहितो बलवान्बलसंवृतः । बलान्नयसि मामेवं ततः किं ते करोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: daityeshvareNa prahito balavAnbalasaMvR^itaH | balAnnayasi mAmevaM tataH kiM te karomyaham
verses.translation: Sent by the king of the Daityas, mighty thyself, and accompanied by an army, thou dost thus take me by force—then what can I do unto thee?
verses.commentary: Sense: Sent by the king of the Daityas, mighty thyself, and accompanied by an army, thou dost thus take me by force—then what can I do unto thee?
verses.hindi: तुम्हें दैत्योंके राजाने भेजा है, तुम स्वयं भी बलवान्‌ हो और तुम्हारे साथ विशाल सेना भी है; ऐसी दशामें यदि मुझे बलपूर्वक ले चलोगे तो मैं तुम्हारा क्या कर सकती हूँ

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः सोऽभ्यधावत्तामसुरो धूम्रलोचनः । हुङ्कारेणैव तं भस्म सा चकाराम्बिका तदा
verses.transliteration: ityuktaH so.abhyadhAvattAmasuro dhUmralochanaH | hu~NkAreNaiva taM bhasma sA chakArAmbikA tadA
verses.translation: At this reply the Asura Dhumralochana rushed towards her. Then Ambika with a mere roar reduced him to ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: At this reply the Asura Dhumralochana rushed towards her. Then Ambika with a mere roar reduced him to ashes.
verses.hindi: देवीके यों कहनेपर असुर धूम्रलोचन उनकी ओर दौड़ा, तब अम्बिकाने “हुं” शब्दके उच्चारणमात्रसे उसको भस्म कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: अथ क्रुद्धं महासैन्यमसुराणां तथाम्बिका । ववर्ष सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तथा शक्तिपरश्वधैः
verses.transliteration: atha kruddhaM mahAsainyamasurANAM tathAmbikA | vavarSha sAyakaistIkShNaistathA shaktiparashvadhaiH
verses.translation: And the great army of Asuras, enraged, poured on Ambika a shower both of sharp arrows and of javelins and axes.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the great army of Asuras, enraged, poured on Ambika a shower both of sharp arrows and of javelins and axes.
verses.hindi: अथ क्ुद्धं महासैन्यमसुराणां तथाम्बिकाः | ववर्ष सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तथा शक्तिपरश्ववै:

verses.sanskrit: ततो धुतसटः कोपात्कृत्वा नादं सुभैरवम् । पपातासुरसेनायां सिंहो देव्याः स्ववाहनः
verses.transliteration: tato dhutasaTaH kopAtkR^itvA nAdaM subhairavam | papAtAsurasenAyAM siMho devyAH svavAhanaH
verses.translation: The lion that carried the goddess, shaking his mane in anger and uttering a most terrific roar, fell on the army of Asuras;
verses.commentary: Sense: The lion that carried the goddess, shaking his mane in anger and uttering a most terrific roar, fell on the army of Asuras;
verses.hindi: इतनेमें ही देवीका वाहन सिंह क्रोधमें भरकर भयंकर गर्जना करके गर्दनके बालोंको हिलाता हुआ असुरोंकी सेनामें कूद पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: कांश्चित्करप्रहारेण दैत्यानास्येन चापरान् । आक्रान्त्या चाधरेणान्यान् जघान स महासुरान्
verses.transliteration: kAMshchitkaraprahAreNa daityAnAsyena chAparAn | AkrAntyA chAdhareNAnyAn jaghAna sa mahAsurAn
verses.translation: he slaughtered some Asuras with a blow from his forepaw, and others with his mouth, and others, very great Asuras, by striking them with his hind foot.
verses.commentary: Sense: he slaughtered some Asuras with a blow from his forepaw, and others with his mouth, and others, very great Asuras, by striking them with his hind foot.
verses.hindi: उसने कुछ दैत्योंको पंजोंकी मारसे, कितनोंको अपने जबड़ोंसे और कितने ही महादैत्योंको पटककर ओठकी दाढ़ोंसे घायल करके मार डाला

verses.sanskrit: केषाञ्चित्पाटयामास नखैः कोष्ठानि केसरी । तथा तलप्रहारेण शिरांसि कृतवान्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: keShA~nchitpATayAmAsa nakhaiH koShThAni kesarI | tathA talaprahAreNa shirAMsi kR^itavAnpR^ithak
verses.translation: With a single humkāra she reduced that demon to ashes. Her lion terrified his attendants and his army of clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a single humkāra she reduced that demon to ashes. Her lion terrified his attendants and his army of clouds.
verses.hindi: केषांचित्पाटयामास नखै: कोष्ठानि केसरी" । तथा तलप्रहारेण शिरांसि कृतवान्‌ पृथक्‌

verses.sanskrit: विच्छिन्नबाहुशिरसः कृतास्तेन तथापरे । पपौ च रुधिरं कोष्ठादन्येषां धुतकेसरः
verses.transliteration: vichChinnabAhushirasaH kR^itAstena tathApare | papau cha rudhiraM koShThAdanyeShAM dhutakesaraH
verses.translation: And he severed arms and heads from others, and shaking his mane drank the blood that flowed from the entrails of others.
verses.commentary: Sense: And he severed arms and heads from others, and shaking his mane drank the blood that flowed from the entrails of others.
verses.hindi: विच्छिन्ननाहुशिरस: कृतास्तेन तथापरे । पपौ च रुधिरं कोष्ठादन्येषां धुतकेसर:

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन तद्बलं सर्वं क्षयं नीतं महात्मना । तेन केसरिणा देव्या वाहनेनातिकोपिना
verses.transliteration: kShaNena tadbalaM sarvaM kShayaM nItaM mahAtmanA | tena kesariNA devyA vAhanenAtikopinA
verses.translation: In a moment all that army was brought to destruction by the high-spirited lion, who bore the goddess and who was enraged exceedingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In a moment all that army was brought to destruction by the high-spirited lion, who bore the goddess and who was enraged exceedingly.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त क्रोधमें भरे हुए देवीके वाहन उस महाबली सिंहने क्षणभरमें ही असुरोंकी सारी सेनाका संहार कर डाला

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तमसुरं देव्या निहतं धूम्रलोचनम् । बलं च क्षयितं कृत्स्नं देवीकेसरिणा ततः
verses.transliteration: shrutvA tamasuraM devyA nihataM dhUmralochanam | balaM cha kShayitaM kR^itsnaM devIkesariNA tataH
verses.translation: When he heard that that Asura Dhumralochana was slain by the goddess, and all his army besides was destroyed by the goddess' lion,
verses.commentary: Sense: When he heard that that Asura Dhumralochana was slain by the goddess, and all his army besides was destroyed by the goddess' lion,
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा तमसुरं देव्या निहतं धूम्रलोचनम्‌ । बलं॑ च क्षयितं कृत्स्नं देवीकेसरिणा तत:

verses.sanskrit: चुकोप दैत्याधिपतिः शुम्भः प्रस्फुरिताधरः । आज्ञापयामास च तौ चण्डमुण्डौ महासुरौ
verses.transliteration: chukopa daityAdhipatiH shumbhaH prasphuritAdharaH | Aj~nApayAmAsa cha tau chaNDamuNDau mahAsurau
verses.translation: Shumbha, the lord of the Daityas, fell into a rage and his lip quivered greatly, and he commanded the two mighty Asuras Chanda and Munda:
verses.commentary: Sense: Shumbha, the lord of the Daityas, fell into a rage and his lip quivered greatly, and he commanded the two mighty Asuras Chanda and Munda:
verses.hindi: २४ ।। शुम्भने जब सुना कि देवीने धूम्रलोचन असुरको मार डाला तथा उसके सिंहने सारी सेनाका सफाया कर डाला, तब उस दैत्यराजको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ। उसका ओठ काँपने लगा। उसने चण्ड और मुण्ड नामक दो महादैत्योंको आज्ञा दी--

verses.sanskrit: हे चण्ड हे मुण्ड बलैर्बहुभिः परिवारितौ । तत्र गच्छत गत्वा च सा समानीयतां लघु
verses.transliteration: he chaNDa he muNDa balairbahubhiH parivAritau | tatra gachChata gatvA cha sA samAnIyatAM laghu
verses.translation: 'Ho, Chanda! Ho, Munda! take with you a multitude of troops and go there; and going there bring her here speedily,'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Ho, Chanda! Ho, Munda! take with you a multitude of troops and go there; and going there bring her here speedily,'
verses.hindi: “हे चण्ड! और हे मुण्ड! तुमलोग बहुत बड़ी सेना लेकर वहाँ जाओ और उस देवीके झोंटे पकड़कर अथवा उसे बाँधकर शीघ्र यहाँ ले आओ। यदि इस प्रकार उसको लानेमें तुम्हें संदेह हो तो युद्धमें सब प्रकारके अस्त्र-शस्त्रों तथा समस्त आसुरी सेनाका प्रयोग करके उसकी हत्या कर डालना

verses.sanskrit: केशेष्वाकृष्य बद्ध्वा वा यदि वः संशयो युधि । तदाशेषायुधैः सर्वैरसुरैर्विनिहन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: kesheShvAkR^iShya baddhvA vA yadi vaH saMshayo yudhi | tadAsheShAyudhaiH sarvairasurairvinihanyatAm
verses.translation: 'dragging her by her hair or binding her; if ye have a doubt of that, then let her be slain outright in fight by all the Asuras brandishing all their weapons.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'dragging her by her hair or binding her; if ye have a doubt of that, then let her be slain outright in fight by all the Asuras brandishing all their weapons.'
verses.hindi: “हे चण्ड! और हे मुण्ड! तुमलोग बहुत बड़ी सेना लेकर वहाँ जाओ और उस देवीके झोंटे पकड़कर अथवा उसे बाँधकर शीघ्र यहाँ ले आओ। यदि इस प्रकार उसको लानेमें तुम्हें संदेह हो तो युद्धमें सब प्रकारके अस्त्र-शस्त्रों तथा समस्त आसुरी सेनाका प्रयोग करके उसकी हत्या कर डालना

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां हतायां दुष्टायां सिंहे च विनिपातिते । शीघ्रमागम्यतां बद्ध्वा गृहीत्वा तामथाम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasyAM hatAyAM duShTAyAM siMhe cha vinipAtite | shIghramAgamyatAM baddhvA gR^ihItvA tAmathAmbikAm
verses.translation: 'When that shrew is slain and her lion stricken down, seize her, Ambika, bind her and bring her quickly!'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'When that shrew is slain and her lion stricken down, seize her, Ambika, bind her and bring her quickly!'
verses.hindi: उस दुष्टाकी हत्या होने तथा सिंहके भी मारे जानेपर उस अम्बिकाको बाँधकर साथ ले शीघ्र ही लौट आना

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञप्तास्ते ततो दैत्याश्चण्डमुण्डपुरोगमाः । चतुरङ्गबलोपेता ययुरभ्युद्यतायुधाः
verses.transliteration: Aj~naptAste tato daityAshchaNDamuNDapurogamAH | chatura~NgabalopetA yayurabhyudyatAyudhAH
verses.translation: Then at his command the Daityas, led by Chanda and Munda, and arrayed in the four-fold order of an army, marched with weapons uplifted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at his command the Daityas, led by Chanda and Munda, and arrayed in the four-fold order of an army, marched with weapons uplifted.
verses.hindi: ३. पा०--तथाम्बिकाम्‌। २. पा०--आक्रान्त्या। 3. पा०--चरणेनान्यान्‌। ४. यहाँ तीन तरहके पाठान्तर मिलते हैं-- संजघान, निजघान, जघान सु महा०। ५. पा०--केशरी। बंगला प्रतिमें सब जगह “केसरी” और “केसर' शब्दमें तालव्य “श' का प्रयोग है। सप्तमो<ध्याय: चण्ड और मुण्डका वध ध्यान (३० ध्यायेयं रत्नपीठे शुककलपठितं शृण्वतीं श्यामलाज़ुीं न्यस्तैकाड्च्रिं सरोजे शशिशकलधरां वलल्‍लकीं वादयन्तीम्‌ | कह्वाराबद्धमालां नियमितविलसच्चोलिकां रक्तवस्त्रां मातज्जीं शड्खपात्रां मधुरमधुमदां चित्रकोद्धासि भालाम्‌ ।। मैं मातड्ी देवीका ध्यान करता हूँ। वे रत्नमय सिंहासनपर बैठकर पढ़ते हुए तोतेका मधुर शब्द सुन रही हैं। उनके शरीरका वर्ण श्याम है। वे अपना एक पैर कमलपर रखे हुए हैं और मस्तकपर अर्धचन्द्र धारण करती हैं। कह्लार-पुष्पोंकी माला धारण किये वीणा बजाती हैं। उनके अड़में कसी हुई चोली शोभा पा रही है। लाल रंगकी साड़ी पहने हाथमें शड्खमय पात्र लिये हुए हैं। उनके वदनपर मधुका हल्का-हल्का नशा जान पड़ता है और ललाटमें बेंदी शोभा दे रही है।) ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ ९ ॥/ “३०” आज्ञप्तास्ते ततो दैत्याश्नण्डमुण्डपुरोगमा: । चतुरड्रबलोपेता ययुरभ्युद्यतायुधा:

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुस्ते ततो देवीमीषद्धासां व्यवस्थिताम् । सिंहस्योपरि शैलेन्द्रशृङ्गे महति काञ्चने
verses.transliteration: dadR^ishuste tato devImIShaddhAsAM vyavasthitAm | siMhasyopari shailendrashR^i~Nge mahati kA~nchane
verses.translation: Soon they saw the goddess, slightly smiling, seated upon the lion, on a huge golden peak of the majestic mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soon they saw the goddess, slightly smiling, seated upon the lion, on a huge golden peak of the majestic mountain.
verses.hindi: ददृशुस्ते ततो देवीमीषद्धासां व्यवस्थिताम्‌ । सिंहस्योपरि शैलेन्द्रशुज़े महति काउचने

verses.sanskrit: ते दृष्ट्वा तां समादातुमुद्यमं चक्रुरुद्यताः । आकृष्टचापासिधरास्तथान्ये तत्समीपगाः
verses.transliteration: te dR^iShTvA tAM samAdAtumudyamaM chakrurudyatAH | AkR^iShTachApAsidharAstathAnye tatsamIpagAH
verses.translation: On seeing her, some of them made a strenuous effort to capture her, and others approached her holding their bows bent and their swords drawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her, some of them made a strenuous effort to capture her, and others approached her holding their bows bent and their swords drawn.
verses.hindi: ते दृष्टवा तां समादातुमुद्यमं चक़ुरुद्यता: । आकृष्टचापासिधरास्तथान्ये तत्समीपगा:

verses.sanskrit: ततः कोपं चकारोच्चैरम्बिका तानरीन्प्रति । कोपेन चास्या वदनं मषीवर्णमभूत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tataH kopaM chakArochchairambikA tAnarInprati | kopena chAsyA vadanaM maShIvarNamabhUttadA
verses.translation: Thereat Ambika uttered her wrath aloud against those foes, and her countenance then grew dark as ink in her wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereat Ambika uttered her wrath aloud against those foes, and her countenance then grew dark as ink in her wrath.
verses.hindi: तब अम्बिकाने उन शत्रुओंके प्रति बड़ा क्रोध किया। उस समय क्रोधके कारण उनका मुख काला पड़ गया

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुकुटीकुटिलात्तस्या ललाटफलकाद्द्रुतम् । काली करालवदना विनिष्क्रान्तासिपाशिनी
verses.transliteration: bhrukuṭīkuṭilāt tasyā lalāṭaphalakād drutam | kālī karāḻavadanā viniṣkrāntāsipāśinī ||
verses.translation: Then suddenly, from the frowning forehead-plate of the Goddess, Kali — of terrifying face, bearing sword and noose — sprang forth.
verses.wordMeaning: One of the most powerful passages in the Devi Mahatmyam. When the Mother's gentleness is met with cruelty, she does not become weak. From her own furrowed brow — from her concentrated awareness — Kali emerges. Kali is not "another goddess" but the Mother's own fierce face.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One of the most powerful passages in the Devi Mahatmyam. When the Mother's gentleness is met with cruelty, she does not become weak. From her own furrowed brow — from her concentrated awareness — Kali emerges. Kali is not "another goddess" but the Mother's own fierce face.…
verses.hindi: तब उसके भ्रू-कुटी के मंडल से सहसा काली निकलीं — विकराल मुख वाली, खड्ग और पाश धारण करने वाली।
verses.science: Research on righteous anger and prosocial aggression: properly channelled anger can be a force for justice (Aaron Sell, et al.). The brain has distinct circuits for predatory aggression (cold, calculating) and protective aggression (hot, defensive of others). Healthy individuals can access protective aggression when needed without losing their ethical core. Kali is the mythic icon of this: protective fierce energy in defence of dharma.
verses.lifeLesson: Are you so committed to "being nice" that you allow injustice — to yourself or to others — to pass unchallenged? Kali whispers: kindness without fierceness is incomplete. Sometimes love requires the noose, the sword, the cutting through of comfortable illusions. The Mother is not always sweet — sometimes she is terrifying. Honour both her faces.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रखट्वाङ्गधरा नरमालाविभूषणा । द्वीपिचर्मपरीधाना शुष्कमांसातिभैरवा
verses.transliteration: vichitrakhaTvA~NgadharA naramAlAvibhUShaNA | dvIpicharmaparIdhAnA shuShkamAMsAtibhairavA
verses.translation: bearing a many-coloured skull-topped staff, decorated with a garland of skulls, clad in a tiger's skin, very appalling because of her emaciated flesh,
verses.commentary: Sense: bearing a many-coloured skull-topped staff, decorated with a garland of skulls, clad in a tiger's skin, very appalling because of her emaciated flesh,
verses.hindi: विचित्र खट्वाड़ धारण किये और चीतेके चर्मकी साड़ी पहने नर-मुण्डोंकी मालासे विभूषित थीं। उनके शरीरका मांस सूख गया था, केवल हड्डियोंका ढाँचा था, जिससे वे अत्यन्त भयंकर जान पड़ती थीं

verses.sanskrit: अतिविस्तारवदना जिह्वाललनभीषणा । निमग्नारक्तनयना नादापूरितदिङ्मुखा
verses.transliteration: ativistAravadanA jihvAlalanabhIShaNA | nimagnAraktanayanA nAdApUritadi~NmukhA
verses.translation: exceedingly wide of mouth, lolling out her tongue terribly, having deep-sunk reddish eyes, and filling the regions of the sky with her roars.
verses.commentary: Sense: exceedingly wide of mouth, lolling out her tongue terribly, having deep-sunk reddish eyes, and filling the regions of the sky with her roars.
verses.hindi: उनका मुख बहुत विशाल था, जीभ लपलपानेके कारण वे और भी डरावनी प्रतीत होती थीं। उनकी आँखें भीतरको धँसी हुई और लाल थीं, वे अपनी भयंकर गर्जनासे सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंको गुँजा रही थीं

verses.sanskrit: सा वेगेनाभिपतिता घातयन्ती महासुरान् । सैन्ये तत्र सुरारीणामभक्षयत तद्बलम्
verses.transliteration: sA vegenAbhipatitA ghAtayantI mahAsurAn | sainye tatra surArINAmabhakShayata tadbalam
verses.translation: She fell upon the great Asuras impetuously, dealing slaughter among the host, and devoured that army of the gods' foes there.
verses.commentary: Sense: She fell upon the great Asuras impetuously, dealing slaughter among the host, and devoured that army of the gods' foes there.
verses.hindi: बड़े-बड़े दैत्योंका वध करती हुई वे कालिकादेवी बड़े वेगसे दैत्योंकी उस सेनापर टूट पड़ीं और उन सबको भक्षण करने लगीं

verses.sanskrit: पार्ष्णिग्राहाङ्कुशग्राहयोधघण्टासमन्वितान् । समादायैकहस्तेन मुखे चिक्षेप वारणान्
verses.transliteration: pArShNigrAhA~NkushagrAhayodhaghaNTAsamanvitAn | samAdAyaikahastena mukhe chikShepa vAraNAn
verses.translation: Taking up the elephants with one hand she flung them into her mouth, together with their rearmen and drivers and their warrior-riders and bells.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up the elephants with one hand she flung them into her mouth, together with their rearmen and drivers and their warrior-riders and bells.
verses.hindi: वे पार्श्वरक्षकों, अंकुशधारी महावतों, योद्धाओं और घंटासहित कितने ही हाथियोंको एक ही हाथसे पकड़कर मुँहमें डाल लेती थीं

verses.sanskrit: तथैव योधं तुरगै रथं सारथिना सह । निक्षिप्य वक्त्रे दशनैश्चर्वयन्त्यतिभैरवम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva yodhaM turagai rathaM sArathinA saha | nikShipya vaktre dashanaishcharvayantyatibhairavam
verses.translation: Flinging likewise warrior with his horses, and chariot with its driver into her mouth, she ground them most frightfully with her teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flinging likewise warrior with his horses, and chariot with its driver into her mouth, she ground them most frightfully with her teeth.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार घोड़े, रथ और सारथिके साथ रथी सैनिकोंको मुँहमें डालकर वे उन्हें बड़े भयानक रूपसे चबा डालती थीं

verses.sanskrit: एकं जग्राह केशेषु ग्रीवायामथ चापरम् । पादेनाक्रम्य चैवान्यमुरसान्यमपोथयत्
verses.transliteration: ekaM jagrAha kesheShu grIvAyAmatha chAparam | pAdenAkramya chaivAnyamurasAnyamapothayat
verses.translation: She seized one by the hair, and another by the neck; and she kicked another with her foot, and crushed another against her breast.
verses.commentary: Sense: She seized one by the hair, and another by the neck; and she kicked another with her foot, and crushed another against her breast.
verses.hindi: किसीके बाल पकड़ लेतीं, किसीका गला दबा देतीं, किसीको पैरोंसे कुचल डालतीं और किसीको छातीके धक्केसे गिराकर मार डालती थीं

verses.sanskrit: तैर्मुक्तानि च शस्त्राणि महास्त्राणि तथासुरैः । मुखेन जग्राह रुषा दशनैर्मथितान्यपि
verses.transliteration: tairmuktAni cha shastrANi mahAstrANi tathAsuraiH | mukhena jagrAha ruShA dashanairmathitAnyapi
verses.translation: And she seized with her mouth the weapons and the great arms which those Asuras abandoned, and crunched them up with her teeth in her fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: And she seized with her mouth the weapons and the great arms which those Asuras abandoned, and crunched them up with her teeth in her fury.
verses.hindi: तैर्मुक्तानि च शस्त्राणि महास्त्राणि तथासुरै: । मुखेन जग्राह रुषा दशनैर्मथितान्यपि

verses.sanskrit: बलिनां तद्बलं सर्वमसुराणां दुरात्मनाम् । ममर्दाभक्षयच्चान्यानन्यांश्चाताडयत्तदा
verses.transliteration: balinAM tadbalaM sarvamasurANAM durAtmanAm | mamardAbhakShayachchAnyAnanyAMshchAtADayattadA
verses.translation: She crushed all that host of mighty and high-spirited Asuras; and devoured some and battered others.
verses.commentary: Sense: She crushed all that host of mighty and high-spirited Asuras; and devoured some and battered others.
verses.hindi: बलिनां तद्‌ बल॑ सर्वमसुराणां दुरात्मनाम्‌ । ममर्दाभक्षयच्चान्यानन्यांश्षञाताडयत्तथा

verses.sanskrit: असिना निहताः केचित्केचित्खट्वाङ्गताडिताः । जग्मुर्विनाशमसुरा दन्ताग्राभिहतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: asinA nihatAH kechitkechitkhaTvA~NgatADitAH | jagmurvinAshamasurA dantAgrAbhihatAstathA
verses.translation: Some were slain with her sword, some were struck with her skull-topped staff, and other Asuras met their death being wounded with the edge of her teeth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some were slain with her sword, some were struck with her skull-topped staff, and other Asuras met their death being wounded with the edge of her teeth.
verses.hindi: असिना निहता: केचित्केचित्खट्वाड्रताडिता:+ | जम्मुर्विनाशमसुरा दन्ताग्राभिहतास्तथा

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन तद्बलं सर्वमसुराणां निपातितम् । दृष्ट्वा चण्डोऽभिदुद्राव तां कालीमतिभीषणाम्
verses.transliteration: kShaNena tadbalaM sarvamasurANAM nipAtitam | dR^iShTvA chaNDo.abhidudrAva tAM kAlImatibhIShaNAm
verses.translation: Seeing all that host of Asuras laid low in a moment, Chanda rushed against her, Kali, who was exceedingly appalling.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing all that host of Asuras laid low in a moment, Chanda rushed against her, Kali, who was exceedingly appalling.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार देवीने असुरोंकी उस सारी सेनाको क्षणभरमें मार गिराया। यह देख चण्ड उन अत्यन्त भयानक कालीदेवीकी ओर दौड़ा

verses.sanskrit: शरवर्षैर्महाभीमैर्भीमाक्षीं तां महासुरः । छादयामास चक्रैश्च मुण्डः क्षिप्तैः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: sharavarShairmahAbhImairbhImAkShIM tAM mahAsuraH | ChAdayAmAsa chakraishcha muNDaH kShiptaiH sahasrashaH
verses.translation: Munda the great Asura covered her, the terrible-eyed goddess, with very terrible showers of arrows and with discuses hurled in thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Munda the great Asura covered her, the terrible-eyed goddess, with very terrible showers of arrows and with discuses hurled in thousands.
verses.hindi: तथा महादैत्य मुण्डने भी अत्यन्त भयडूकर बाणोंकी वर्षासे तथा हजारों बार चलाये हुए चक्रोंसे उन भयानक नेत्रोंवाली देवीको आच्छादित कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: तानि चक्राण्यनेकानि विशमानानि तन्मुखम् । बभुर्यथार्कबिम्बानि सुबहूनि घनोदरम्
verses.transliteration: tAni chakrANyanekAni vishamAnAni tanmukham | babhuryathArkabimbAni subahUni ghanodaram
verses.translation: Those discuses seemed to be penetrating her countenance in multitudes, like as very many solar orbs might penetrate the body of a thunder-cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those discuses seemed to be penetrating her countenance in multitudes, like as very many solar orbs might penetrate the body of a thunder-cloud.
verses.hindi: तानि चक्राण्यनेकानि विशमानानि तन्मुखम्‌ । बभुर्यथार्कबिम्बानि सुबहूनि घनोदरम्‌

verses.sanskrit: ततो जहासातिरुषा भीमं भैरवनादिनी । काली करालवदना दुर्दर्शदशनोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: tato jahAsAtiruShA bhImaM bhairavanAdinI | kAlI karAlavadanA durdarshadashanojjvalA
verses.translation: Thereat Kali, who was roaring frightfully, laughed terribly with excessive fury, showing the gleam of her unsightly teeth within her dreadful mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereat Kali, who was roaring frightfully, laughed terribly with excessive fury, showing the gleam of her unsightly teeth within her dreadful mouth.
verses.hindi: तब भयड्कर गर्जना करनेवाली कालीने अत्यन्त रोषमें भरकर विकट अट्टहास किया। उस समय उनके विकराल वदनके भीतर कठिनतासे देखे जा सकनेवाले दाँतोंकी प्रभासे वे अत्यन्त उज्ज्वल दिखायी देती थीं

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय च महासिंहं देवी चण्डमधावत । गृहीत्वा चास्य केशेषु शिरस्तेनासिनाच्छिनत्
verses.transliteration: utthAya cha mahAsiMhaM devI chaNDamadhAvata | gR^ihItvA chAsya kesheShu shirastenAsinAchChinat
verses.translation: And the goddess, mounting upon her great lion, rushed at Chanda, and seizing him by his hair struck off his head with her sword.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the goddess, mounting upon her great lion, rushed at Chanda, and seizing him by his hair struck off his head with her sword.
verses.hindi: उत्थाय च महासिं हं देवी चण्डमधावत । गृहीत्वा चास्य केशेषु शिरस्तेनासिनाच्छिनतूर

verses.sanskrit: अथ मुण्डोऽभ्यधावत्तां दृष्ट्वा चण्डं निपातितम् । तमप्यपातयद्भूमौ सा खड्गाभिहतं रुषा
verses.transliteration: atha muNDo.abhyadhAvattAM dR^iShTvA chaNDaM nipAtitam | tamapyapAtayadbhUmau sA khaDgAbhihataM ruShA
verses.translation: And Munda also rushed at her when he saw Chanda laid low; him also she felled to the ground, stricken with her scymitar in her fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Munda also rushed at her when he saw Chanda laid low; him also she felled to the ground, stricken with her scymitar in her fury.
verses.hindi: चण्डको मारा गया देख मुण्ड भी देवीकी ओर दौड़ा। तब देवीने रोषमें भरकर उसे भी तलवारसे घायल करके धरतीपर सुला दिया

verses.sanskrit: हतशेषं ततः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा चण्डं निपातितम् । मुण्डं च सुमहावीर्यं दिशो भेजे भयातुरम्
verses.transliteration: hatasheShaM tataH sainyaM dR^iShTvA chaNDaM nipAtitam | muNDaM cha sumahAvIryaM disho bheje bhayAturam
verses.translation: Taking hold of Chanda and Munda, the Goddess Chandika then proclaimed her greatness with a fierce, resounding laugh.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking hold of Chanda and Munda, the Goddess Chandika then proclaimed her greatness with a fierce, resounding laugh.
verses.hindi: महापराक्रमी चण्ड और मुण्डको मारा गया देख मरनेसे बची हुई बाकी सेना भयसे व्याकुल हो चारों ओर भाग गयी

verses.sanskrit: शिरश्चण्डस्य काली च गृहीत्वा मुण्डमेव च । प्राह प्रचण्डाट्टहासमिश्रमभ्येत्य चण्डिकाम्
verses.transliteration: shirashchaNDasya kAlI cha gR^ihItvA muNDameva cha | prAha prachaNDATTahAsamishramabhyetya chaNDikAm
verses.translation: And Kali, holding Chanda's head and Munda also, approached Chandika and said, her voice mingled with passionate loud laughter:
verses.commentary: Sense: And Kali, holding Chanda's head and Munda also, approached Chandika and said, her voice mingled with passionate loud laughter:
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर कालीने चण्ड और मुण्डका मस्तक हाथमें ले चण्डिकाके पास जाकर प्रचण्ड अट्टहास करते हुए कहा--

verses.sanskrit: मया तवात्रोपहृतौ चण्डमुण्डौ महापशू । युद्धयज्ञे स्वयं शुम्भं निशुम्भं च हनिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: mayA tavAtropahR^itau chaNDamuNDau mahApashU | yuddhayaj~ne svayaM shumbhaM nishumbhaM cha haniShyasi
verses.translation: 'Here I have brought thee Chanda and Munda, two great beasts; thou thyself shalt slay Shumbha and Nishumbha in the battle-sacrifice.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Here I have brought thee Chanda and Munda, two great beasts; thou thyself shalt slay Shumbha and Nishumbha in the battle-sacrifice.'
verses.hindi: 'देवि! मैंने चण्ड और मुण्ड नामक इन दो महापशुओं को तुम्हें भेंट किया है। अब युद्धयज्ञमें तुम शुम्भ और निशुम्भका स्वयं ही वध करना”

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:

verses.sanskrit: तावानीतौ ततो दृष्ट्वा चण्डमुण्डौ महासुरौ । उवाच कालीं कल्याणी ललितं चण्डिका वचः
verses.transliteration: tAvAnItau tato dR^iShTvA chaNDamuNDau mahAsurau | uvAcha kAlIM kalyANI lalitaM chaNDikA vachaH
verses.translation: Thereon, seeing those two great Asuras Chanda and Munda brought to her, auspicious Chandika spoke to Kali this witty speech:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereon, seeing those two great Asuras Chanda and Munda brought to her, auspicious Chandika spoke to Kali this witty speech:
verses.hindi: वहाँ लाये हुए उन चण्ड-मुण्ड नामक महादैत्योंकोी देखकर कल्याणमयी चण्डीने कालीसे मधुर वाणीमें कहा --

verses.sanskrit: यस्माच्चण्डं च मुण्डं च गृहीत्वा त्वमुपागता । चामुण्डेति ततो लोके ख्याता देवी भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: yasmAchchaNDaM cha muNDaM cha gR^ihItvA tvamupAgatA | chAmuNDeti tato loke khyAtA devI bhaviShyasi
verses.translation: 'Because thou hast seized both Chanda and Munda and brought them, thou, O goddess, shalt therefore be famed in the world by the name Chamunda!'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Because thou hast seized both Chanda and Munda and brought them, thou, O goddess, shalt therefore be famed in the world by the name Chamunda!'
verses.hindi: देवि! तुम चण्ड और मुण्डको लेकर मेरे पास आयी हो, इसलिये संसारमें चामुण्डाके नामसे तुम्हारी ख्याति होगी

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: चण्डे च निहते दैत्ये मुण्डे च विनिपातिते । बहुलेषु च सैन्येषु क्षयितेष्वसुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: chaNDe cha nihate daitye muNDe cha vinipAtite | bahuleShu cha sainyeShu kShayiteShvasureshvaraH
verses.translation: After both the Daitya Chanda was slain and Munda was laid low, and many soldiers were destroyed, the lord of the Asuras,
verses.commentary: Sense: After both the Daitya Chanda was slain and Munda was laid low, and many soldiers were destroyed, the lord of the Asuras,
verses.hindi: >> कीकि- ४ १३. पा०--मसी०। २. पा०--यत्यति। ३. पा०--ता रणे। ४. शान्तनवी टीकाकारने यहाँ एक श्लोक अधिक पाठ माना है, जो इस प्रकार है-- 'छिन्ने शिरसि दैत्येन्द्रश्नक्रे नादं सुभैरवम्‌ | तेन नादेन महता त्रासितं भुवनत्रयम्‌ ।। ” अष्टमो5 ध्याय: रक्तबीज-वध ध्यान (“३०' अरुणां करुणातरद्विताक्षीं धृतपाशाडकुशबाणचापहस्ताम्‌ | अणिमादिभिरावृतां मयूखैरहमित्येव विभावये भवानीम्‌ ।। मैं अणिमा आदि सिद्धिमयी किरणोंसे आवृत भवानीका ध्यान करता हूँ। उनके शरीरका रंग लाल है। नेत्रोंमें ककूणा लहरा रही है तथा हाथोंमें पाश, अड्कुश, बाण और धनुष शोभा पाते हैं।) ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ ९ ॥/ “३०” चण्डे च निहते दैत्ये मुण्डे च विनिपातिते । बहुलेषु च सैन्येषु क्षयितेष्वसुरेश्वर:

verses.sanskrit: ततः कोपपराधीनचेताः शुम्भः प्रतापवान् । उद्योगं सर्वसैन्यानां दैत्यानामादिदेश ह
verses.transliteration: tataH kopaparAdhInachetAH shumbhaH pratApavAn | udyogaM sarvasainyAnAM daityAnAmAdidesha ha
verses.translation: majestic Shumbha, with mind overcome by wrath, gave command then to array all the Daitya hosts:
verses.commentary: Sense: majestic Shumbha, with mind overcome by wrath, gave command then to array all the Daitya hosts:
verses.hindi: चण्ड और मुण्ड नामक दैत्योंके मारे जाने तथा बहुत-सी सेनाका संहार हो जानेपर दैत्योंके राजा प्रतापी शुम्भके मनमें बड़ा क्रोध हुआ और उसने दैत्योंकी सम्पूर्ण सेनाको युद्धके लिये कूच करनेकी आज्ञा दी

verses.sanskrit: अद्य सर्वबलैर्दैत्याः षडशीतिरुदायुधाः । कम्बूनां चतुरशीतिर्निर्यान्तु स्वबलैर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: adya sarvabalairdaityAH ShaDashItirudAyudhAH | kambUnAM chaturashItirniryAntu svabalairvR^itAH
verses.translation: 'Now let the eighty-six Daityas, upraising their weapons, march forth with all their forces; let the eighty-four Kambus march forth surrounded by their own forces;'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Now let the eighty-six Daityas, upraising their weapons, march forth with all their forces; let the eighty-four Kambus march forth surrounded by their own forces;'
verses.hindi: वह बोला--“आज उदायुध नामके छियासी दैत्य-सेनापति अपनी सेनाओंके साथ युद्धके लिये प्रस्थान करें। कम्बु नामवाले दैत्योंके चौरासी सेनानायक अपनी वाहिनीसे घिरे हुए यात्रा करें

verses.sanskrit: कोटिवीर्याणि पञ्चाशदसुराणां कुलानि वै । शतं कुलानि धौम्राणां निर्गच्छन्तु ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: koTivIryANi pa~nchAshadasurANAM kulAni vai | shataM kulAni dhaumrANAM nirgachChantu mamAj~nayA
verses.translation: 'let the fifty Asura families who excel in valour go forth; let the hundred families of Dhaumra go forth at my command.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'let the fifty Asura families who excel in valour go forth; let the hundred families of Dhaumra go forth at my command.'
verses.hindi: पचास कोटिवीर्य-कुलके और सौ धौम्र-कुलके असुर सेनापति मेरी आज्ञासे सेनासहित कूच करें

verses.sanskrit: कालका दौर्हृदा मौर्वाः कालिकेयास्तथासुराः । युद्धाय सज्जा निर्यान्तु आज्ञया त्वरिता मम
verses.transliteration: kAlakA daurhR^idA maurvAH kAlikeyAstathAsurAH | yuddhAya sajjA niryAntu Aj~nayA tvaritA mama
verses.translation: 'Let the Kalakas, the Daurhritas, the Mauryas, and the Kalakeyas—let these Asuras, hastening at my command, march forth ready for battle.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Let the Kalakas, the Daurhritas, the Mauryas, and the Kalakeyas—let these Asuras, hastening at my command, march forth ready for battle.'
verses.hindi: कालका दौददा मौर्या: कालकेयास्तथासुरा: । युद्धाय सज्जा निर्यान्तु आज्ञया त्वरिता मम

verses.sanskrit: इत्याज्ञाप्यासुरपतिः शुम्भो भैरवशासनः । निर्जगाम महासैन्यसहस्रैर्बहुभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: ityAj~nApyAsurapatiH shumbho bhairavashAsanaH | nirjagAma mahAsainyasahasrairbahubhirvR^itaH
verses.translation: After issuing these commands, Shumbha, the lord of the Asuras, who ruled with fear, went forth, attended by many thousands of great soldiers.
verses.commentary: Sense: After issuing these commands, Shumbha, the lord of the Asuras, who ruled with fear, went forth, attended by many thousands of great soldiers.
verses.hindi: भयानक शासन करनेवाला असुरराज शुम्भ इस प्रकार आज्ञा दे सहस्रों बड़ी-बड़ी सेनाओंके साथ युद्धके लिये प्रस्थित हुआ

verses.sanskrit: आयान्तं चण्डिका दृष्ट्वा तत्सैन्यमतिभीषणम् । ज्यास्वनैः पूरयामास धरणीगगनान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: AyAntaM chaNDikA dR^iShTvA tatsainyamatibhIShaNam | jyAsvanaiH pUrayAmAsa dharaNIgaganAntaram
verses.translation: Chandika, seeing that most terrible army at hand, filled the space between the earth and the firmament with the twanging of her bow-string.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika, seeing that most terrible army at hand, filled the space between the earth and the firmament with the twanging of her bow-string.
verses.hindi: उसकी अत्यन्त भयंकर सेना आती देख चण्डिकाने अपने धनुषकी टंकारसे पृथ्वी और आकाशके बीचका भाग गुँजा दिया

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहो महानादमतीव कृतवान्नृप । घण्टास्वनेन तान्नादानम्बिका चोपबृंहयत्
verses.transliteration: tataH siMho mahAnAdamatIva kR^itavAnnR^ipa | ghaNTAsvanena tAnnAdAnambikA chopabR^iMhayat
verses.translation: Thereon her lion roared exceedingly loud, O king; and Ambika augmented those roars with the clanging of her bell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereon her lion roared exceedingly loud, O king; and Ambika augmented those roars with the clanging of her bell.
verses.hindi: राजन! तदनन्तर देवीके सिंहने भी बड़े जोर-जोरसे दहाड़ना आरम्भ किया, फिर अम्बिकाने घंटेके शब्दसे उस ध्वनिको और भी बढ़ा दिया

verses.sanskrit: धनुर्ज्यासिंहघण्टानां नादापूरितदिङ्मुखा । निनादैर्भीषणैः काली जिग्ये विस्तारितानना
verses.transliteration: dhanurjyAsiMhaghaNTAnAM nAdApUritadi~NmukhA | ninAdairbhIShaNaiH kAlI jigye vistAritAnanA
verses.translation: Kali, filling the regions of the sky with the noise from her bow-string, from the lion and from the bell, and expanding her mouth wide with her terrific roars, had the predominance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali, filling the regions of the sky with the noise from her bow-string, from the lion and from the bell, and expanding her mouth wide with her terrific roars, had the predominance.
verses.hindi: धनुषकी टंकार, सिंहकी दहाड़ और घंटेकी ध्वनिसे सम्पूर्ण दिशाएँ गूँज उठीं। उस भयंकर शब्दसे कालीने अपने विकराल मुखको और भी बढ़ा लिया तथा इस प्रकार वे विजयिनी हुईं

verses.sanskrit: तं निनादमुपश्रुत्य दैत्यसैन्यैश्चतुर्दिशम् । देवी सिंहस्तथा काली सरोषैः परिवारिताः
verses.transliteration: taM ninAdamupashrutya daityasainyaishchaturdisham | devI siMhastathA kAlI saroShaiH parivAritAH
verses.translation: On hearing that roar, the Daitya armies, enraged, surrounded on all four sides the goddess, the lion and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that roar, the Daitya armies, enraged, surrounded on all four sides the goddess, the lion and Kali.
verses.hindi: उस तुमुल नादको सुनकर दैत्योंकी सेनाओंने चारों ओरसे आकर चण्डिकादेवी, सिंह तथा कालीदेवीको क्रोधपूर्वक घेर लिया

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भूप विनाशाय सुरद्विषाम् । भवायामरसिंहानामतिवीर्यबलान्विताः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare bhUpa vinAshAya suradviShAm | bhavAyAmarasiMhAnAmativIryabalAnvitAH
verses.translation: At this moment, O king, in order to destroy the gods' foes, and for the well-being of the lion-like Immortals, there issued forth, endowed with excessive vigour and strength,
verses.commentary: Sense: At this moment, O king, in order to destroy the gods' foes, and for the well-being of the lion-like Immortals, there issued forth, endowed with excessive vigour and strength,
verses.hindi: राजन! इसी बीचमें असुरोंके विनाश तथा देवताओंके अभ्युदयके लिये ब्रह्मा, शिव, कार्तिकेय, विष्णु तथा इन्द्र आदि देवोंकी शक्तियाँ, जो अत्यन्त पराक्रम और बलसे सम्पन्न थीं, उनके शरीरोंसे निकलकर उन्हींके रूपमें चण्डिकादेवीके पास गयीं

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मेशगुहविष्णूनां तथेन्द्रस्य च शक्तयः । शरीरेभ्यो विनिष्क्रम्य तद्रूपैश्चण्डिकां ययुः
verses.transliteration: brahmeshaguhaviShNUnAM tathendrasya cha shaktayaH | sharIrebhyo viniShkramya tad.hrUpaishchaNDikAM yayuH
verses.translation: the Energies from the bodies of Brahma, Shiva, Guha and Vishnu and of Indra also, and went in the forms of those gods to Chandika.
verses.commentary: Sense: the Energies from the bodies of Brahma, Shiva, Guha and Vishnu and of Indra also, and went in the forms of those gods to Chandika.
verses.hindi: त॑ निनादमुपश्रुत्य दैत्यसैन्यैक्षतुर्दिशम्‌ देवी सिंहस्तथा काली सरोषै: परिवारिता:

verses.sanskrit: यस्य देवस्य यद्रूपं यथा भूषणवाहनम् । तद्वदेव हि तच्छक्तिरसुरान्योद्धुमाययौ
verses.transliteration: yasya devasya yadrUpaM yathA bhUShaNavAhanam | tadvadeva hi tachChaktirasurAnyoddhumAyayau
verses.translation: Whatever was the form of each god, and whatever his ornaments and vehicle, in that very appearance his Energy advanced to fight with the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever was the form of each god, and whatever his ornaments and vehicle, in that very appearance his Energy advanced to fight with the Asuras.
verses.hindi: यस्य देवस्य यद्गरूपं यथाभूषणवाहनम्‌ । तद्वदेव हि तच्छक्तिरसुरान्‌ योद्धुमाययौ

verses.sanskrit: हंसयुक्तविमानाग्रे साक्षसूत्रकमण्डलुः । आयाता ब्रह्मणः शक्तिर्ब्रह्माणीत्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: haMsayuktavimAnAgre sAkShasUtrakamaNDaluH | AyAtA brahmaNaH shaktirbrahmANItyabhidhIyate
verses.translation: In the front of a heavenly car drawn by swans advanced Brahma's Energy, bearing a rosary of seeds and an earthen water-pot; she is called Brahmani.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the front of a heavenly car drawn by swans advanced Brahma's Energy, bearing a rosary of seeds and an earthen water-pot; she is called Brahmani.
verses.hindi: सबसे पहले हंसयुक्त विमानपर बैठी हुई अक्षसूत्र और कमण्डलुसे सुशोभित ब्रह्माजीकी शक्ति उपस्थित हुई, जिसे ब्रह्माणी कहते हैं

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरी वृषारूढा त्रिशूलवरधारिणी । महाहिवलया प्राप्ता चन्द्ररेखाविभूषणा
verses.transliteration: mAheshvarI vR^iShArUDhA trishUlavaradhAriNI | mahAhivalayA prAptA chandrarekhAvibhUShaNA
verses.translation: Maheshvara's Energy, seated on a bull, grasping a fine trident, and wearing a girdle of large snakes, arrived, adorned with a digit of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maheshvara's Energy, seated on a bull, grasping a fine trident, and wearing a girdle of large snakes, arrived, adorned with a digit of the moon.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीकी शक्ति वृषभपर आखरूढ़ हो हाथोंमें श्रेष्ठ त्रिशूल धारण किये महानागका कड़कण पहने, मस्तकमें चन्द्ररेखासे विभूषित हो वहाँ आ पहुँची

verses.sanskrit: कौमारी शक्तिहस्ता च मयूरवरवाहना । योद्धुमभ्याययौ दैत्यानम्बिका गुहरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: kaumArI shaktihastA cha mayUravaravAhanA | yoddhumabhyAyayau daityAnambikA guharUpiNI
verses.translation: And Kumara's Energy, Ambika, with spear in hand and riding on a choice peacock, advanced in Guha's shape to attack the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Kumara's Energy, Ambika, with spear in hand and riding on a choice peacock, advanced in Guha's shape to attack the Daityas.
verses.hindi: कार्तिकेयजीकी शक्तिरूपा जगदम्बिका उन्हींका रूप धारण किये श्रेष्ठ मयूरपर आरूढ़ हो हाथमें शक्ति लिये दैत्योंसे युद्ध करनेके लिये आयीं

verses.sanskrit: तथैव वैष्णवी शक्तिर्गरुडोपरि संस्थिता । शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गखड्गहस्ताभ्युपाययौ
verses.transliteration: tathaiva vaiShNavI shaktirgaruDopari saMsthitA | sha~NkhachakragadAshAr~NgakhaDgahastAbhyupAyayau
verses.translation: Likewise Vishnu's Energy, seated upon Garuda, advanced with conch, discus, club, bow and scymitar in hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Likewise Vishnu's Energy, seated upon Garuda, advanced with conch, discus, club, bow and scymitar in hand.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार भगवान्‌ विष्णुकी शक्ति गरुड़पर विराजमान हो शड्ख, चक्र, गदा, शार्ब्धनुष तथा खड़्ग हाथमें लिये वहाँ आयी

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञवाराहमतुलं रूपं या बिभ्रतो हरेः । शक्तिः साप्याययौ तत्र वाराहीं बिभ्रती तनुम्
verses.transliteration: yaj~navArAhamatulaM rUpaM yA bibhrato hareH | shaktiH sApyAyayau tatra vArAhIM bibhratI tanum
verses.translation: The Energy of Hari, who assumes the peerless form of a sacrificial boar, she also advanced there, assuming a boar-like form.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Energy of Hari, who assumes the peerless form of a sacrificial boar, she also advanced there, assuming a boar-like form.
verses.hindi: अनुपम यज्ञवाराहका रूप धारण करनेवाले श्रीहरिकी जो शक्ति है, वह भी वाराह-शरीर धारण करके वहाँ उपस्थित हुई

verses.sanskrit: नारसिंही नृसिंहस्य बिभ्रती सदृशं वपुः । प्राप्ता तत्र सटाक्षेपक्षिप्तनक्षत्रसंहतिः
verses.transliteration: nArasiMhI nR^isiMhasya bibhratI sadR^ishaM vapuH | prAptA tatra saTAkShepakShiptanakShatrasaMhatiH
verses.translation: Narasimha's Energy, assuming a body like Nrisimha's, arrived there, adorned with a cluster of constellations hurled down by the tossing of his mane.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narasimha's Energy, assuming a body like Nrisimha's, arrived there, adorned with a cluster of constellations hurled down by the tossing of his mane.
verses.hindi: नारसिंही शक्ति भी नूसिंहके समान शरीर धारण करके वहाँ आयी। उसकी गर्दनके बालोंके झटकेसे आकाशके तारे बिखरे पड़ते थे

verses.sanskrit: वज्रहस्ता तथैवैन्द्री गजराजोपरि स्थिता । प्राप्ता सहस्रनयना यथा शक्रस्तथैव सा
verses.transliteration: vajrahastA tathaivaindrI gajarAjopari sthitA | prAptA sahasranayanA yathA shakrastathaiva sA
verses.translation: Likewise Indra's Energy, with thunderbolt in hand, seated upon the lord of elephants and having a thousand eyes, arrived; as is Shakra, such indeed was she.
verses.commentary: Sense: Likewise Indra's Energy, with thunderbolt in hand, seated upon the lord of elephants and having a thousand eyes, arrived; as is Shakra, such indeed was she.
verses.hindi: वज्हस्ता तथैवैन्द्री गजराजोपरि स्थिता । प्राप्ता सहस्ननयना यथा शक्रस्तथैव सा

verses.sanskrit: ततः परिवृतस्ताभिरीशानो देवशक्तिभिः । हन्यन्तामसुराः शीघ्रं मम प्रीत्याह चण्डिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tataH parivR^itastAbhirIshAno devashaktibhiH | hanyantAmasurAH shIghraM mama prItyAha chaNDikAm
verses.translation: Then Shiva, surrounded by those Energies of the gods, said to Chandika, 'Let the Asuras be slain forthwith through my good-will.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Shiva, surrounded by those Energies of the gods, said to Chandika, 'Let the Asuras be slain forthwith through my good-will.'
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उन देव-शक्तियोंसे घिरे हुए महादेवजीने चण्डिकासे कहा--'"मेरी प्रसन्नताके लिये तुम शीघ्र ही इन असुरोंका संहार करो'

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवीशरीरात्तु विनिष्क्रान्तातिभीषणा । चण्डिका शक्तिरत्युग्रा शिवाशतनिनादिनी
verses.transliteration: tato devIsharIrAttu viniShkrAntAtibhIShaNA | chaNDikA shaktiratyugrA shivAshataninAdinI
verses.translation: Thereupon from the goddess' body there came forth Chandika's Energy, most terrific, exceedingly fierce, howling like a hundred jackals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon from the goddess' body there came forth Chandika's Energy, most terrific, exceedingly fierce, howling like a hundred jackals.
verses.hindi: ततो देवीशरीरात्तु विनिष्क्रान्तातिभीषणा । चण्डिकाशक्तिरत्युग्रा शिवाशतनिनादिनी

verses.sanskrit: सा चाह धूम्रजटिलमीशानमपराजिता । दूत त्वं गच्छ भगवन् पार्श्वं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: sA chAha dhUmrajaTilamIshAnamaparAjitA | dUta tvaM gachCha bhagavan pArshvaM shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: And she, the unconquered, said to Shiva, who was smoke-coloured and had matted locks, 'Be thou, my lord, a messenger to the presence of Shumbha and Nishumbha.'
verses.commentary: Sense: And she, the unconquered, said to Shiva, who was smoke-coloured and had matted locks, 'Be thou, my lord, a messenger to the presence of Shumbha and Nishumbha.'
verses.hindi: उस अपराजिता देवीने धूमिल जटावाले महादेवजीसे कहा--“भगवन्‌! आप शुम्भ-निशुम्भके पास दूत बनकर जाइये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि शुम्भं निशुम्भं च दानवावतिगर्वितौ । ये चान्ये दानवास्तत्र युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brUhi shumbhaM nishumbhaM cha dAnavAvatigarvitau | ye chAnye dAnavAstatra yuddhAya samupasthitAH
verses.translation: 'Say unto the two overweening Danavas, Shumbha and Nishumbha, and to whatever other Danavas are assembled there to do battle:'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Say unto the two overweening Danavas, Shumbha and Nishumbha, and to whatever other Danavas are assembled there to do battle:'
verses.hindi: और उन अत्यन्त गर्वीले दानव शुम्भ एवं निशुम्भ--दोनोंसे कहिये। साथ ही उनके अतिरिक्त भी जो दानव युद्धके लिये वहाँ उपस्थित हों, उनको भी यह संदेश दीजिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यमिन्द्रो लभतां देवाः सन्तु हविर्भुजः । यूयं प्रयात पातालं यदि जीवितुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: trailokyamindro labhatAM devAH santu havirbhujaH | yUyaM prayAta pAtAlaM yadi jIvitumichChatha
verses.translation: 'Let Indra obtain the three worlds, let the gods be the enjoyers of the oblations; go ye to Patala if ye wish to live.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Let Indra obtain the three worlds, let the gods be the enjoyers of the oblations; go ye to Patala if ye wish to live.'
verses.hindi: *दैत्यो! यदि तुम जीवित रहना चाहते हो तो पातालको लौट जाओ। इन्द्रको त्रिलोकीका राज्य मिल जाय और देवता यज्ञभागका उपभोग करें

verses.sanskrit: बलावलेपादथ चेद्भवन्तो युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । तदागच्छत तृप्यन्तु मच्छिवाः पिशितेन वः
verses.transliteration: balAvalepAdatha chedbhavanto yuddhakA~NkShiNaH | tadAgachChata tR^ipyantu machChivAH pishitena vaH
verses.translation: 'Yet if through pride in your strength ye are longing for battle, come ye on then! Let my jackals be glutted with your flesh.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Yet if through pride in your strength ye are longing for battle, come ye on then! Let my jackals be glutted with your flesh.'
verses.hindi: अथवा यदि अभिमानवश तुम युद्ध करना चाहते हो तो आओ, मेरी सियारिनें तुम्हारे मांस से तृप्त हों।

verses.sanskrit: यतो नियुक्तो दौत्येन तया देव्या शिवः स्वयम् । शिवदूतीति लोकेऽस्मिंस्ततः सा ख्यातिमागता
verses.transliteration: yato niyukto dautyena tayA devyA shivaH svayam | shivadUtIti loke.asmiMstataH sA khyAtimAgatA
verses.translation: Because the goddess appointed Shiva himself to be ambassador, she has hence attained fame as Shivaduti in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because the goddess appointed Shiva himself to be ambassador, she has hence attained fame as Shivaduti in this world.
verses.hindi: चूँकि उस देवीने भगवान्‌ शिवको दूतके कार्यमें नियुक्त किया था, इसलिये वह 'शिवदूती” के नामसे संसारमें विख्यात हुई

verses.sanskrit: तेऽपि श्रुत्वा वचो देव्याः शर्वाख्यातं महासुराः । अमर्षापूरिता जग्मुर्यत्र कात्यायनी स्थिता
verses.transliteration: te.api shrutvA vacho devyAH sharvAkhyAtaM mahAsurAH | amarShApUritA jagmuryatra kAtyAyanI sthitA
verses.translation: Those great Asuras however, on hearing the goddess' speech fully announced, were filled with indignation and went where Katyayani stood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those great Asuras however, on hearing the goddess' speech fully announced, were filled with indignation and went where Katyayani stood.
verses.hindi: वे महादैत्य भी भगवान्‌ शिवके मुँहसे देवीके वचन सुनकर क्रोधमें भर गये और जहाँ कात्यायनी विराजमान थीं, उस ओर बढ़े

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रथममेवाग्रे शरशक्त्यृष्टिवृष्टिभिः । ववर्षुरुद्धतामर्षास्तां देवीममरारयः
verses.transliteration: tataH prathamamevAgre sharashaktyR^iShTivR^iShTibhiH | vavarShuruddhatAmarShAstAM devImamarArayaH
verses.translation: Then, at the very first, the arrogant and indignant foes of the Immortals in front poured on the goddess showers of arrows, javelins and spears.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, at the very first, the arrogant and indignant foes of the Immortals in front poured on the goddess showers of arrows, javelins and spears.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रथममेवाग्रे शरशक्त्यूष्टिवृष्टिभि: । ववर्षुरुद्धतामर्षास्तां देवीममरारय:

verses.sanskrit: सा च तान् प्रहितान् बाणाञ्छूलशक्तिपरश्वधान् । चिच्छेद लीलयाध्मातधनुर्मुक्तैर्महेषुभिः
verses.transliteration: sA cha tAn prahitAn bANA~nChUlashaktiparashvadhAn | chichCheda lIlayAdhmAtadhanurmuktairmaheShubhiH
verses.translation: And gracefully she clove those arrows, darts, spears and axes, which were hurled, with large arrows shot from her resounding bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: And gracefully she clove those arrows, darts, spears and axes, which were hurled, with large arrows shot from her resounding bow.
verses.hindi: तब देवीने भी खेल-खेलमें ही धनुषकी टंकार की और उससे छोड़े हुए बड़े- बड़े बाणोंद्वारा दैत्योंके चलाये हुए बाण, शूल, शक्ति और फरसोंको काट डाला

verses.sanskrit: तस्याग्रतस्तथा काली शूलपातविदारितान् । खट्वाङ्गपोथितांश्चारीन्कुर्वती व्यचरत्तदा
verses.transliteration: tasyAgratastathA kAlI shUlapAtavidAritAn | khaTvA~NgapothitAMshchArInkurvatI vyacharattadA
verses.translation: And in front of her stalked Kali then, tearing the foes asunder with the onset of her darts and crushing them with her skull-topped staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: And in front of her stalked Kali then, tearing the foes asunder with the onset of her darts and crushing them with her skull-topped staff.
verses.hindi: तस्याग्रतस्तथा काली शूलपातविदारितान्‌ । खट्वाड़पोथितांश्वारीन्‌ कुर्वती व्यचरत्तदा

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुजलाक्षेपहतवीर्यान् हतौजसः । ब्रह्माणी चाकरोच्छत्रून्येन येन स्म धावति
verses.transliteration: kamaNDalujalAkShepahatavIryAn hataujasaH | brahmANI chAkarochChatrUnyena yena sma dhAvati
verses.translation: And Brahmani caused the foes to lose their courage by casting water on them from her earthen pot, and weakened their vigour, by whatever way she ran.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Brahmani caused the foes to lose their courage by casting water on them from her earthen pot, and weakened their vigour, by whatever way she ran.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणी भी जिस-जिस ओर दौड़ती, उसी-उसी ओर अपने कमण्डलुका जल छिड़ककर शत्रुओंके ओज और पराक्रमको नष्ट कर देती थी

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन तथा चक्रेण वैष्णवी । दैत्याञ्जघान कौमारी तथा शक्त्यातिकोपना
verses.transliteration: mAheshvarI trishUlena tathA chakreNa vaiShNavI | daityA~njaghAna kaumArI tathA shaktyAtikopanA
verses.translation: Maheshvara's Energy slew Daityas with her trident, and Vishnu's Energy with her discus, and Kumara's Energy, very wrathful, slew them with her javelin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maheshvara's Energy slew Daityas with her trident, and Vishnu's Energy with her discus, and Kumara's Energy, very wrathful, slew them with her javelin.
verses.hindi: माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन तथा चक्रेण वैष्णवी । दैत्याज्जघान कौमारी तथा शकक्‍्त्यातिकोपना

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्री कुलिशपातेन शतशो दैत्यदानवाः । पेतुर्विदारिताः पृथ्व्यां रुधिरौघप्रवर्षिणः
verses.transliteration: aindrI kulishapAtena shatasho daityadAnavAH | peturvidAritAH pR^ithvyAM rudhiraughapravarShiNaH
verses.translation: Torn to pieces by the down-rush of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra's Energy, Daityas and Danavas fell on the earth in hundreds, pouring out streams of blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Torn to pieces by the down-rush of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra's Energy, Daityas and Danavas fell on the earth in hundreds, pouring out streams of blood.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रशक्तिके वजप्रहारसे विदीर्ण हो सैकड़ों दैत्य-दानव रक्तकी धारा बहाते हुए पृथ्वीपर सो गये

verses.sanskrit: तुण्डप्रहारविध्वस्ता दंष्ट्राग्रक्षतवक्षसः । वाराहमूर्त्या न्यपतंश्चक्रेण च विदारिताः
verses.transliteration: tuNDaprahAravidhvastA daMShTrAgrakShatavakShasaH | vArAhamUrtyA nyapataMshchakreNa cha vidAritAH
verses.translation: Shattered by the boar-embodied Energy with blows from her snout, wounded in their breasts by the points of her tushes, and torn by her discus, demons fell down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Shattered by the boar-embodied Energy with blows from her snout, wounded in their breasts by the points of her tushes, and torn by her discus, demons fell down.
verses.hindi: वाराही शक्तिने कितनोंको अपनी थूथुनकी मारसे नष्ट किया, दाढ़ोंके अग्रभागसे कितनोंकी छाती छेद डाली तथा कितने ही दैत्य चक्रकी चोटसे विदीर्ण हो गये

verses.sanskrit: नखैर्विदारितांश्चान्यान् भक्षयन्ती महासुरान् । नारसिंही चचाराजौ नादापूर्णदिगम्बरा
verses.transliteration: nakhairvidAritAMshchAnyAn bhakShayantI mahAsurAn | nArasiMhI chachArAjau nAdApUrNadigambarA
verses.translation: And Narasimha's Energy roamed about in the battle, devouring other great Asuras who were torn by her claws, as she filled the intermediate region of the sky with her roaring.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Narasimha's Energy roamed about in the battle, devouring other great Asuras who were torn by her claws, as she filled the intermediate region of the sky with her roaring.
verses.hindi: नारसिंही भी दूसरे-दूसरे महादैत्योंको अपने नखोंसे विदीर्ण करके खाती और सिंहनादसे दिशाओं एवं आकाशको गुँजाती हुई युद्ध-क्षेत्रमें विचरने लगी

verses.sanskrit: चण्डाट्टहासैरसुराः शिवदूत्यभिदूषिताः । पेतुः पृथिव्यां पतितांस्तांश्चखादाथ सा तदा
verses.transliteration: chaNDATTahAsairasurAH shivadUtyabhidUShitAH | petuH pR^ithivyAM patitAMstAMshchakhAdAtha sA tadA
verses.translation: Asuras, demoralized by Shivaduti with her violent loud laughs, fell down on the earth; she then devoured those fallen ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asuras, demoralized by Shivaduti with her violent loud laughs, fell down on the earth; she then devoured those fallen ones.
verses.hindi: कितने ही असुर शिवदूतीके प्रचण्ड अट्टहाससे अत्यन्त भयभीत हो पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े और गिरनेपर उन्हें शिवदूतीने उस समय अपना ग्रास बना लिया

verses.sanskrit: इति मातृगणं क्रुद्धं मर्दयन्तं महासुरान् । दृष्ट्वाभ्युपायैर्विविधैर्नेशुर्देवारिसैनिकाः
verses.transliteration: iti mAtR^igaNaM kruddhaM mardayantaM mahAsurAn | dR^iShTvAbhyupAyairvividhairneshurdevArisainikAH
verses.translation: Seeing the enraged band of Mothers crushing the great Asuras thus by various means, the troops of the gods' foes perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the enraged band of Mothers crushing the great Asuras thus by various means, the troops of the gods' foes perished.
verses.hindi: ६३ ।। इस प्रकार क्रोधमें भरे हुए मातृगणोंको नाना प्रकारके उपायोंसे बड़े-बड़े असुरोंका मर्दन करते देख दैत्यसैनिक भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sanskrit: पलायनपरान्दृष्ट्वा दैत्यान्मातृगणार्दितान् । योद्धुमभ्याययौ क्रुद्धो रक्तबीजो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: palAyanaparAndR^iShTvA daityAnmAtR^igaNArditAn | yoddhumabhyAyayau kruddho raktabIjo mahAsuraH
verses.translation: Raktavija, a great Asura, seeing the Daityas, who were hard-pressed by the band of Mothers, intent on fleeing, strode forward to fight in wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raktavija, a great Asura, seeing the Daityas, who were hard-pressed by the band of Mothers, intent on fleeing, strode forward to fight in wrath.
verses.hindi: पलायनपरानू दृष्ट्वा दैत्यान्‌ मातृगणार्दितान्‌ | बल विद दा क्रुद्धो रक्तबीजो महासुर:

verses.sanskrit: रक्तबिन्दुर्यदा भूमौ पतत्यस्य शरीरतः । समुत्पतति मेदिन्यां तत्प्रमाणो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: raktabinduryadA bhUmau patatyasya sharIrataH | samutpatati medinyAM tatpramANo mahAsuraH
verses.translation: When from his body there falls to the ground a drop of blood, at that moment starts up from the earth an Asura of his stature.
verses.commentary: Sense: When from his body there falls to the ground a drop of blood, at that moment starts up from the earth an Asura of his stature.
verses.hindi: उसके शरीरसे जब रक्तकी बूँद पृथ्वीपर गिरती, तब उसीके समान शक्तिशाली एक दूसरा महादैत्य पृथ्वीपर पैदा हो जाता

verses.sanskrit: युयुधे स गदापाणिरिन्द्रशक्त्या महासुरः । ततश्चैन्द्री स्ववज्रेण रक्तबीजमताडयत्
verses.transliteration: yuyudhe sa gadApANirindrashaktyA mahAsuraH | tatashchaindrI svavajreNa raktabIjamatADayat
verses.translation: He, a great Asura, with club in hand, fought with Indra's Energy, and Indra's Energy then struck Raktavija with her thunderbolt;
verses.commentary: Sense: He, a great Asura, with club in hand, fought with Indra's Energy, and Indra's Energy then struck Raktavija with her thunderbolt;
verses.hindi: युयुधे स गदापाणिरिन्द्रशक्त्या महासुर: । ततश्रैन्द्री स्ववज़ेण रक्तबीजमताडयत्‌

verses.sanskrit: कुलिशेनाहतस्याशु बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् । समुत्तस्थुस्ततो योधास्तद्रूपास्तत्पराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: kulishenAhatasyAshu bahu susrAva shoNitam | samuttasthustato yodhAstadrUpAstatparAkramAH
verses.translation: blood flowed quickly from him when wounded by the thunderbolt. Thereupon stood up together fresh combatants, like him in body, like him in valour;
verses.commentary: Sense: blood flowed quickly from him when wounded by the thunderbolt. Thereupon stood up together fresh combatants, like him in body, like him in valour;
verses.hindi: वज़से घायल होनेपर उसके शरीरसे बहुत-सा रक्त चूने लगा और उससे उसीके समान रूप तथा पराक्रमवाले योद्धा उत्पन्न होने लगे

verses.sanskrit: यावन्तः पतितास्तस्य शरीराद्रक्तबिन्दवः । तावन्तः पुरुषा जातास्तद्वीर्यबलविक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: yAvantaH patitAstasya sharIrAdraktabindavaH | tAvantaH puruShA jAtAstadvIryabalavikramAH
verses.translation: for as many blood-drops fell from his body, so many men came into being, like him in courage, strength and valour.
verses.commentary: Sense: for as many blood-drops fell from his body, so many men came into being, like him in courage, strength and valour.
verses.hindi: यावन्तः पतितास्तस्य शरीराद्रक्तबिन्दव: । तावन्तः पुरुषा जातास्तद्वीर्यबलविक्रमा:

verses.sanskrit: ते चापि युयुधुस्तत्र पुरुषा रक्तसम्भवाः । समं मातृभिरत्युग्रशस्त्रपातातिभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: te chApi yuyudhustatra puruShA raktasambhavAH | samaM mAtR^ibhiratyugrashastrapAtAtibhIShaNam
verses.translation: And those men also who sprang from his blood fought there with the Mothers in a combat, dreadful because of the sweep of their very sharp weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: And those men also who sprang from his blood fought there with the Mothers in a combat, dreadful because of the sweep of their very sharp weapons.
verses.hindi: वे रक्तसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले पुरुष भी अत्यन्त भचड्कर अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंका प्रहार करते हुए वहाँ मातृगणोंके साथ घोर युद्ध करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च वज्रपातेन क्षतमस्य शिरो यदा । ववाह रक्तं पुरुषास्ततो जाताः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: punashcha vajrapAtena kShatamasya shiro yadA | vavAha raktaM puruShAstato jAtAH sahasrashaH
verses.translation: And again when his head was wounded by the fall of her thunderbolt, his blood poured forth; therefrom were born men by thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: And again when his head was wounded by the fall of her thunderbolt, his blood poured forth; therefrom were born men by thousands.
verses.hindi: पुनः वज्रके प्रहारसे जब उसका मस्तक घायल हुआ तो रक्त बहने लगा और उससे हजारों पुरुष उत्पन्न हो गये

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवी समरे चैनं चक्रेणाभिजघान ह । गदया ताडयामास ऐन्द्री तमसुरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vaiShNavI samare chainaM chakreNAbhijaghAna ha | gadayA tADayAmAsa aindrI tamasureshvaram
verses.translation: And Vishnu's Energy struck at this foe with her discus in the battle. Indra's Energy beat that lord of the Asuras with her club.
verses.commentary: Sense: And Vishnu's Energy struck at this foe with her discus in the battle. Indra's Energy beat that lord of the Asuras with her club.
verses.hindi: वैष्णवीने युद्धमें रक्तबीजपर चक्रका प्रहार किया तथा ऐन्द्रीने उस दैत्य-सेनापतिको गदासे चोट पहुँचायी

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवीचक्रभिन्नस्य रुधिरस्रावसम्भवैः । सहस्रशो जगद्व्याप्तं तत्प्रमाणैर्महासुरैः
verses.transliteration: vaiShNavIchakrabhinnasya rudhirasrAvasambhavaiH | sahasrasho jagadvyAptaM tatpramANairmahAsuraiH
verses.translation: The world was filled by the thousands of great Asuras, who were his equals, and who sprang from the blood that flowed from him when cloven by the discus of Vishnu's Energy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The world was filled by the thousands of great Asuras, who were his equals, and who sprang from the blood that flowed from him when cloven by the discus of Vishnu's Energy.
verses.hindi: वैष्णवीके चक्रसे घायल होनेपर उसके शरीरसे जो रक्त बहा और उससे जो उसीके बराबर आकारवाले सहस्रों महादैत्य प्रकट हुए, उनके द्वारा सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌ व्याप्त हो गया

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्या जघान कौमारी वाराही च तथासिना । माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन रक्तबीजं महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: shaktyA jaghAna kaumArI vArAhI cha tathAsinA | mAheshvarI trishUlena raktabIjaM mahAsuram
verses.translation: Kumara's Energy struck the great Asura Raktavija with her spear, and Varaha's Energy also struck him with her sword, and Maheshvara's Energy with her trident.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kumara's Energy struck the great Asura Raktavija with her spear, and Varaha's Energy also struck him with her sword, and Maheshvara's Energy with her trident.
verses.hindi: शवक्‍्त्या जघान कौमारी वाराही च तथासिना | माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन रक्तबीजं महासुरम्‌

verses.sanskrit: स चापि गदया दैत्यः सर्वा एवाहनत् पृथक् । मातॄः कोपसमाविष्टो रक्तबीजो महासुरः
verses.transliteration: sa chApi gadayA daityaH sarvA evAhanat pR^ithak | mAtR^IH kopasamAviShTo raktabIjo mahAsuraH
verses.translation: And the Daitya Raktavija, that great Asura, filled full of wrath, struck every one of the Mothers in turn with his club.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the Daitya Raktavija, that great Asura, filled full of wrath, struck every one of the Mothers in turn with his club.
verses.hindi: स चापि गदया दैत्य: सर्वा एवाहनत्‌ पृथक्‌ । मातृ: कोपसमाविष्टो रक्तबीजो महासुर:

verses.sanskrit: तस्याहतस्य बहुधा शक्तिशूलादिभिर्भुवि । पपात यो वै रक्तौघस्तेनासञ्छतशोऽसुराः
verses.transliteration: tasyAhatasya bahudhA shaktishUlAdibhirbhuvi | papAta yo vai raktaughastenAsa~nChatasho.asurAH
verses.translation: By the stream of blood, which fell on the earth from him when he received many wounds from the spears, darts and other weapons, Asuras came verily into being in hundreds.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the stream of blood, which fell on the earth from him when he received many wounds from the spears, darts and other weapons, Asuras came verily into being in hundreds.
verses.hindi: शक्ति और शूल आदिसे अनेक बार घायल होनेपर जो उसके शरीरसे रक्तकी धारा पृथ्वीपर गिरी, उससे भी निश्चय ही सैकड़ों असुर उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sanskrit: तैश्चासुरासृक्सम्भूतैरसुरैः सकलं जगत् । व्याप्तमासीत्ततो देवा भयमाजग्मुरुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: taishchAsurAsR^iksambhUtairasuraiH sakalaM jagat | vyAptamAsIttato devA bhayamAjagmuruttamam
verses.translation: And those Asuras who sprang from that Asura's blood pervaded the whole world; thereat the gods fell into the utmost terror.
verses.commentary: Sense: And those Asuras who sprang from that Asura's blood pervaded the whole world; thereat the gods fell into the utmost terror.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उस महादैत्यके रक्तसे प्रकट हुए असुरोंद्वारा सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌ व्याप्त हो गया। इससे देवताओंको बड़ा भय हुआ

verses.sanskrit: तान् विषण्णान् सुरान् दृष्ट्वा चण्डिका प्राहसत्वरम् । उवाच कालीं चामुण्डे विस्तीर्णं वदनं कुरु
verses.transliteration: tAn viShaNNAn surAn dR^iShTvA chaNDikA prAhasatvaram | uvAcha kAlIM chAmuNDe vistIrNaM vadanaM kuru
verses.translation: Seeing the gods dejected, Chandika spoke with haste; she said to Kali, 'O Chamunda! stretch out thy mouth wide;'
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the gods dejected, Chandika spoke with haste; she said to Kali, 'O Chamunda! stretch out thy mouth wide;'
verses.hindi: देवताओंको उदास देख चण्डिकाने कालीसे शीघ्रतापूर्वक कहा--“चामुण्डे! तुम अपना मुख और भी फैलाओ

verses.sanskrit: मच्छस्त्रपातसम्भूतान् रक्तबिन्दून् महासुरान् । रक्तबिन्दोः प्रतीच्छ त्वं वक्त्रेणानेन वेगिना
verses.transliteration: machChastrapAtasambhUtAn raktabindUn mahAsurAn | raktabindoH pratIchCha tvaM vaktreNAnena veginA
verses.translation: 'with this mouth do thou quickly take in the drops of blood and the great Asuras, which have come into being out of Raktavija at the descent of my weapon on him.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'with this mouth do thou quickly take in the drops of blood and the great Asuras, which have come into being out of Raktavija at the descent of my weapon on him.'
verses.hindi: मच्छस्त्रपातसम्भूतान्‌ रक्तबिन्दून्महासुरान्‌ | रक्तबिन्दो: प्रतीच्छ त्वं वक्त्रेणानेन वेगिना३

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयन्ती चर रणे तदुत्पन्नान्महासुरान् । एवमेष क्षयं दैत्यः क्षेणरक्तो गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: bhakShayantI chara raNe tadutpannAnmahAsurAn | evameSha kShayaM daityaH kSheNarakto gamiShyati
verses.translation: 'Roam about in the battle, devouring the great Asuras who sprang from him; so shall this Daitya, with his blood ebbing away, meet destruction.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Roam about in the battle, devouring the great Asuras who sprang from him; so shall this Daitya, with his blood ebbing away, meet destruction.'
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार रक्तसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले महादैत्योंका भक्षण करती हुई तुम रणमें विचरती रहो। ऐसा करनेसे उस दैत्यका सारा रक्त क्षीण हो जानेपर वह स्वयं भी नष्ट हो जायगा

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यमाणास्त्वया चोग्रा न चोत्पत्स्यन्ति चापरे । इत्युक्त्वा तां ततो देवी शूलेनाभिजघान तम्
verses.transliteration: bhakShyamANAstvayA chogrA na chotpatsyanti chApare | ityuktvA tAM tato devI shUlenAbhijaghAna tam
verses.translation: 'These fierce demons are being devoured by thee, and at the same time no others will be produced.' Having enjoined her thus, the goddess next smote him with her dart.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'These fierce demons are being devoured by thee, and at the same time no others will be produced.' Having enjoined her thus, the goddess next smote him with her dart.
verses.hindi: भक्ष्यमाणास्त्वया चोग्रा न चोत्पत्स्यन्ति चापरेः | इत्युक्त्वा तां ततो देवी शूलेनाभिजघान तम्‌

verses.sanskrit: मुखेन काली जगृहे रक्तबीजस्य शोणितम् । ततोऽसावाजघानाथ गदया तत्र चण्डिकाम्
verses.transliteration: mukhena kAlI jagR^ihe raktabIjasya shoNitam | tato.asAvAjaghAnAtha gadayA tatra chaNDikAm
verses.translation: Kali swallowed Raktavija's blood with her mouth. Then he struck Chandika with his club there;
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali swallowed Raktavija's blood with her mouth. Then he struck Chandika with his club there;
verses.hindi: मुखेन काली जगहे रक्तबीजस्य शोणितम्‌ । ततो5सावाजघानाथ गदया तत्र चण्डिकाम्‌

verses.sanskrit: न चास्या वेदनां चक्रे गदापातोऽल्पिकामपि । तस्याहतस्य देहात्तु बहु सुस्राव शोणितम्
verses.transliteration: na chAsyA vedanAM chakre gadApAto.alpikAmapi | tasyAhatasya dehAttu bahu susrAva shoNitam
verses.translation: and the blow of his club caused her no pain, even the slightest, but from his stricken body blood flowed copiously,
verses.commentary: Sense: and the blow of his club caused her no pain, even the slightest, but from his stricken body blood flowed copiously,
verses.hindi: किंतु उस गदापातने देवीको तनिक भी वेदना नहीं पहुँचायी। रक्तबीजके घायल शरीरसे बहुत-सा रक्त गिरा

verses.sanskrit: यतस्ततस्तद्वक्त्रेण चामुण्डा सम्प्रतीच्छति । मुखे समुद्गता येऽस्या रक्तपातान्महासुराः
verses.transliteration: yatastatastadvaktreNa chAmuNDA sampratIchChati | mukhe samudgatA ye.asyA raktapAtAnmahAsurAH
verses.translation: and from whatever direction it came, Chamunda takes it then with her mouth. The great Asuras who sprang up from the flow of blood into her mouth,
verses.commentary: Sense: and from whatever direction it came, Chamunda takes it then with her mouth. The great Asuras who sprang up from the flow of blood into her mouth,
verses.hindi: किंतु ज्यों ही वह गिरा त्यों ही चामुण्डाने उसे अपने मुखमें ले लिया। रक्त गिरनेसे कालीके मुखमें जो महादैत्य उत्पन्न हुए, उन्हें भी वह चट कर गयी और उसने रक्तबीजका रक्त भी पी लिया

verses.sanskrit: तांश्चखादाथ चामुण्डा पपौ तस्य च शोणितम् । देवी शूलेन वज्रेण बाणैरसिभिरृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: tAMshchakhAdAtha chAmuNDA papau tasya cha shoNitam | devI shUlena vajreNa bANairasibhirR^iShTibhiH
verses.translation: As fast as a drop of blood from Raktabija fell to the earth, there arose demons of great power equal to him in size.
verses.commentary: Sense: As fast as a drop of blood from Raktabija fell to the earth, there arose demons of great power equal to him in size.
verses.hindi: देवी शूलेन वज्ेण? बाणैरसिभिकष्टिभि: | जघान रक्तबीजं तं चामुण्डापीतशोणितम्‌

verses.sanskrit: जघान रक्तबीजं तं चामुण्डापीतशोणितम् । स पपात महीपृष्ठे शस्त्रसङ्घसमाहतः
verses.transliteration: jaghAna raktabIjaM taM chAmuNDApItashoNitam | sa papAta mahIpR^iShThe shastrasa~NghasamAhataH
verses.translation: while Chamunda drank up his blood. Stricken with that multitude of weapons, he fell on the earth's surface,
verses.commentary: Sense: while Chamunda drank up his blood. Stricken with that multitude of weapons, he fell on the earth's surface,
verses.hindi: स पपात महीपृष्ठे शस्त्रसड्घसमाहत:5 | नीरक्तश्न महीपाल रक्तबीजो महासुर:

verses.sanskrit: नीरक्तश्च महीपाल रक्तबीजो महासुरः । ततस्ते हर्षमतुलमवापुस्त्रिदशा नृप
verses.transliteration: nIraktashcha mahIpAla raktabIjo mahAsuraH | tataste harShamatulamavApustridashA nR^ipa
verses.translation: and the great Asura Raktavija became bloodless, O king. Thereat the thirty gods gained joy unparalleled, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: and the great Asura Raktavija became bloodless, O king. Thereat the thirty gods gained joy unparalleled, O king.
verses.hindi: राजन! इस प्रकार शस्त्रोंके समुदायसे आहत एवं रक्तहीन हुआ महादैत्य रक्तबीज पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा । नरेश्वर! इससे देवताओंको अनुपम हर्षकी प्राप्ति हुई

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मातृगणो जातो ननर्तासृङ्मदोद्धतः
verses.transliteration: teShAM mAtR^igaNo jAto nanartAsR^i~NmadoddhataH
verses.translation: The band of Mothers which sprang from them broke into a dance, being intoxicated with blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: The band of Mothers which sprang from them broke into a dance, being intoxicated with blood.
verses.hindi: और मातृगण उन असुरोंके रक्तपानके मदसे उद्धत-सा होकर नृत्य करने लगा

verses.sanskrit: ॐ राजोवाच
verses.transliteration: OM rAjovAcha
verses.translation: Om. The king spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Om. The king spoke:
verses.hindi: राजाने कहा--

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रमिदमाख्यातं भगवन् भवता मम । देव्याश्चरितमाहात्म्यं रक्तबीजवधाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: vichitramidamAkhyAtaM bhagavan bhavatA mama | devyAshcharitamAhAtmyaM raktabIjavadhAshritam
verses.translation: Wonderful is this that thou, Sir, hast related to me, the majesty of the goddess' exploits in connexion with the slaying of Raktavija;
verses.commentary: Sense: Wonderful is this that thou, Sir, hast related to me, the majesty of the goddess' exploits in connexion with the slaying of Raktavija;
verses.hindi: “३०” विचित्रमिदमाख्यातं भगवन्‌ भवता मम | देव्याश्वरितमाहात्म्यं रक्तबीजवधाश्रितम्‌

verses.sanskrit: भूयश्चेच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं रक्तबीजे निपातिते । चकार शुम्भो यत्कर्म निशुम्भश्चातिकोपनः
verses.transliteration: bhUyashchechChAmyahaM shrotuM raktabIje nipAtite | chakAra shumbho yatkarma nishumbhashchAtikopanaH
verses.translation: and I wish to hear further what deed did Shumbha do after Raktavija was killed, and what the very irascible Nishumbha did.
verses.commentary: Sense: and I wish to hear further what deed did Shumbha do after Raktavija was killed, and what the very irascible Nishumbha did.
verses.hindi: भूयश्वेच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं रक्तबीजे निपातिते | चकार शुम्भो यत्कर्म निशुम्भश्नातिकोपन:

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: चकार कोपमतुलं रक्तबीजे निपातिते । शुम्भासुरो निशुम्भश्च हतेष्वन्येषु चाहवे
verses.transliteration: chakAra kopamatulaM raktabIje nipAtite | shumbhAsuro nishumbhashcha hateShvanyeShu chAhave
verses.translation: After Raktavija was slain and other demons were killed in the fight, the Asura Shumbha gave way to unbounded wrath, and Nishumbha also.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Raktavija was slain and other demons were killed in the fight, the Asura Shumbha gave way to unbounded wrath, and Nishumbha also.
verses.hindi: ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ ४ ॥/ चकार कोपमतुलं रक्तबीजे निपातिते । शुम्भासुरो निशुम्भश्न हतेष्वन्येषु चाहवे

verses.sanskrit: हन्यमानं महासैन्यं विलोक्यामर्षमुद्वहन् । अभ्यधावन्निशुम्भोऽथ मुख्ययासुरसेनया
verses.transliteration: hanyamAnaM mahAsainyaM vilokyAmarShamudvahan | abhyadhAvannishumbho.atha mukhyayAsurasenayA
verses.translation: Pouring out his indignation at beholding his great army being slaughtered, Nishumbha then rushed forward with the flower of the Asura army.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pouring out his indignation at beholding his great army being slaughtered, Nishumbha then rushed forward with the flower of the Asura army.
verses.hindi: अपनी विशाल सेना इस प्रकार मारी जाती देख निशुम्भ अमर्षमें भरकर देवीकी ओर दौड़ा। उसके साथ असुरोंकी प्रधान सेना थी

verses.sanskrit: तस्याग्रतस्तथा पृष्ठे पार्श्वयोश्च महासुराः । सन्दष्टौष्ठपुटाः क्रुद्धा हन्तुं देवीमुपाययुः
verses.transliteration: tasyAgratastathA pR^iShThe pArshvayoshcha mahAsurAH | sandaShTauShThapuTAH kruddhA hantuM devImupAyayuH
verses.translation: In front of him and behind and on both sides great Asuras, biting their lips and enraged, advanced to slay the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of him and behind and on both sides great Asuras, biting their lips and enraged, advanced to slay the goddess.
verses.hindi: तस्याग्रतस्तथा पृष्ठे पार्श्रयोश्व॒ महासुरा: । संदष्टौष्पुटा: क्रुद्धा हन्तुं देवीमुपाययु:

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम महावीर्यः शुम्भोऽपि स्वबलैर्वृतः । निहन्तुं चण्डिकां कोपात्कृत्वा युद्धं तु मातृभिः
verses.transliteration: AjagAma mahAvIryaH shumbho.api svabalairvR^itaH | nihantuM chaNDikAM kopAtkR^itvA yuddhaM tu mAtR^ibhiH
verses.translation: Shumbha also went forward, mighty in valour, surrounded with his own troops, to slay Chandika in his rage, after engaging in battle with the Mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Shumbha also went forward, mighty in valour, surrounded with his own troops, to slay Chandika in his rage, after engaging in battle with the Mothers.
verses.hindi: महापराक्रमी शुम्भ भी अपनी सेनाके साथ मातृगणोंसे युद्ध करके क्रोधवश चण्डिकाको मारनेके लिये आ पहुँचा

verses.sanskrit: ततो युद्धमतीवासीद्देव्या शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः । शरवर्षमतीवोग्रं मेघयोरिव वर्षतोः
verses.transliteration: tato yuddhamatIvAsIddevyA shumbhanishumbhayoH | sharavarShamatIvograM meghayoriva varShatoH
verses.translation: Then occurred a desperate combat between the goddess and Shumbha and Nishumbha, who both, like two thunder-clouds, rained a most tempestuous shower of arrows on her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then occurred a desperate combat between the goddess and Shumbha and Nishumbha, who both, like two thunder-clouds, rained a most tempestuous shower of arrows on her.
