verses.hindi: ३. पा०--स च। २. पा०--तान्नादानम्बिका। ३. पा०--जज्ञे वाराह०। ४. पा०--ती। ३. पा०--जम्मुर्यतः। ३. पा०--न्यास्त०। २. पा०--तस्य ३. पा०--विस्तरं। २. पा०--वेगिता। 3. इसके बाद कहीं-कहीं “ऋषिरुवाच” इतना अधिक पाठ है। ४. पा०--चक्रेण। . पा०--श स्त्रसंहतितो हतः । 4५ 4 नवमो5डध्याय: निशुम्भ-वध ध्यान (३० बन्धूककाञ्चननिभं रुचिराक्षमालां पाशाड्कुशौ च वरदां निजबाहुदण्डै: । बिभ्राणमिन्दुशकला भरणं त्रिनेत्र- मर्धाम्बिकेशमनिशं वपुराश्रयामि ।। मैं अर्धनारीश्वरके श्रीविग्रहकी निरन्तर शरण लेता हूँ। उसका वर्ण बन्धूकपुष्प और सुवर्णके समान रक्त-पीतमिश्रित है। वह अपनी भुजाओंमें सुन्दर अक्षमाला, पाश, अंकुश और वरद-मुद्रा धारण करता है; अर्धचन्द्र उसका आभूषण है तथा वह तीन नेत्रोंसे सुशोभित है।) राजीवाच

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेदास्ताञ्छरांस्ताभ्यां चण्डिका स्वशरोत्करैः । ताडयामास चाङ्गेषु शस्त्रौघैरसुरेश्वरौ
verses.transliteration: chichChedAstA~nCharAMstAbhyAM chaNDikA svasharotkaraiH | tADayAmAsa chA~NgeShu shastraughairasureshvarau
verses.translation: Chandika with multitudes of arrows quickly split the arrows shot by them, and smote the two Asura lords on their limbs with her numerous weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika with multitudes of arrows quickly split the arrows shot by them, and smote the two Asura lords on their limbs with her numerous weapons.
verses.hindi: उन दोनोंके चलाये हुए बाणोंको चण्डिकाने अपने बाणोंके समूहसे तुरंत काट डाला और शणस्त्रसमूहोंकी वर्षा करके उन दोनों दैत्यपतियोंके अज़ोंमें भी चोट पहुँचायी

verses.sanskrit: निशुम्भो निशितं खड्गं चर्म चादाय सुप्रभम् । अताडयन्मूर्ध्नि सिंहं देव्या वाहनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nishumbho nishitaM khaDgaM charma chAdAya suprabham | atADayanmUrdhni siMhaM devyA vAhanamuttamam
verses.translation: Nishumbha, grasping a sharp scymitar and glittering shield, struck the lion, the noble beast that bore the goddess, on the head.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nishumbha, grasping a sharp scymitar and glittering shield, struck the lion, the noble beast that bore the goddess, on the head.
verses.hindi: निशुम्भने तीखी तलवार और चमकती हुई ढाल लेकर देवीके श्रेष्ठ वाहन सिंहके मस्तकपर प्रहार किया

verses.sanskrit: ताडिते वाहने देवी क्षुरप्रेणासिमुत्तमम् । निशुम्भस्याशु चिच्छेद चर्म चाप्यष्टचन्द्रकम्
verses.transliteration: tADite vAhane devI kShurapreNAsimuttamam | nishumbhasyAshu chichCheda charma chApyaShTachandrakam
verses.translation: When her animal was struck, the goddess quickly clove Nishumbha's superb sword with a horse-shoe-shaped arrow, and also his shield on which eight moons were pourtrayed.
verses.commentary: Sense: When her animal was struck, the goddess quickly clove Nishumbha's superb sword with a horse-shoe-shaped arrow, and also his shield on which eight moons were pourtrayed.
verses.hindi: ताडिते वाहने देवी क्षुरप्रेणासिमुत्तमम्‌ । निशुम्भस्याशु चिच्छेद चर्म चाप्यष्टचन्द्रकम्‌

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ने चर्मणि खड्गे च शक्तिं चिक्षेप सोऽसुरः । तामप्यस्य द्विधा चक्रे चक्रेणाभिमुखागताम्
verses.transliteration: Chinne charmaNi khaDge cha shaktiM chikShepa so.asuraH | tAmapyasya dvidhA chakre chakreNAbhimukhAgatAm
verses.translation: When his shield was cloven and his sword too, the Asura hurled his spear; and that his missile also, as it came towards her, she split in two with her discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: When his shield was cloven and his sword too, the Asura hurled his spear; and that his missile also, as it came towards her, she split in two with her discus.
verses.hindi: ढाल और तलवारके कट जानेपर उस असुरने शक्ति चलायी, किंतु सामने आनेपर देवीने चक्रसे उसके भी दो टुकड़े कर दिये

verses.sanskrit: कोपाध्मातो निशुम्भोऽथ शूलं जग्राह दानवः । आयातं मुष्टिपातेन देवी तच्चाप्यचूर्णयत्
verses.transliteration: kopAdhmAto nishumbho.atha shUlaM jagrAha dAnavaH | AyAtaM muShTipAtena devI tachchApyachUrNayat
verses.translation: Seeing Nishumbha — his brother, dear as his own life — slain, and his army being destroyed, Shumbha spoke in fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing Nishumbha — his brother, dear as his own life — slain, and his army being destroyed, Shumbha spoke in fury.
verses.hindi: कोपाध्मातो निशुम्भो5थ शूलं जग्राह दानव: । आयातं मुष्टिपातेन देवी तच्चाप्यचूर्णयत्‌

verses.sanskrit: आविद्याथ गदां सोऽपि चिक्षेप चण्डिकां प्रति । सापि देव्यास् त्रिशूलेन भिन्ना भस्मत्वमागता
verses.transliteration: AvidyAtha gadAM so.api chikShepa chaNDikAM prati | sApi devyAs trishUlena bhinnA bhasmatvamAgatA
verses.translation: And then, aiming his club, he flung it against Chandika; yet that was shivered by the goddess' trident and became ashes.
verses.commentary: Sense: And then, aiming his club, he flung it against Chandika; yet that was shivered by the goddess' trident and became ashes.
verses.hindi: तब उसने गदा घुमाकर चण्डीके ऊपर चलायी, परंतु वह भी देवीके त्रिशूलसे कटकर भस्म हो गयी

verses.sanskrit: ततः परशुहस्तं तमायान्तं दैत्यपुङ्गवम् । आहत्य देवी बाणौघैरपातयत भूतले
verses.transliteration: tataH parashuhastaM tamAyAntaM daityapu~Ngavam | Ahatya devI bANaughairapAtayata bhUtale
verses.translation: As that lordly Daitya then advanced with battle-axe in hand, the goddess struck him with a multitude of arrows and laid him low on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: As that lordly Daitya then advanced with battle-axe in hand, the goddess struck him with a multitude of arrows and laid him low on the ground.
verses.hindi: ततः परशुहस्तं तमायान्तं दैत्यपुड्भवम्‌ । आहत्य देवी बाणौघैरपातयत भूतले

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ निशुम्भे भीमविक्रमे । भ्रातर्यतीव सङ्क्रुद्धः प्रययौ हन्तुमम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasminnipatite bhUmau nishumbhe bhImavikrame | bhrAtaryatIva sa~NkruddhaH prayayau hantumambikAm
verses.translation: When his brother Nishumbha, who was terrible in prowess, fell to the ground, Shumbha in utmost fury strode forward to slay Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: When his brother Nishumbha, who was terrible in prowess, fell to the ground, Shumbha in utmost fury strode forward to slay Ambika.
verses.hindi: उस भयंकर पराक्रमी भाई निशुम्भके धराशायी हो जानेपर शुम्भको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ और अम्बिकाका वध करनेके लिये वह आगे बढ़ा

verses.sanskrit: स रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गृहीतपरमायुधैः । भुजैरष्टाभिरतुलैर्व्याप्याशेषं बभौ नभः
verses.transliteration: sa rathasthastathAtyuchchairgR^ihItaparamAyudhaiH | bhujairaShTAbhiratulairvyApyAsheShaM babhau nabhaH
verses.translation: And he, standing in his chariot, appeared to fill the entire sky with his eight arms, which were lifted far on high grasping his superb weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: And he, standing in his chariot, appeared to fill the entire sky with his eight arms, which were lifted far on high grasping his superb weapons.
verses.hindi: स रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गहीतपरमायुधै: । भुजैरष्टाभिरतुलैव्याप्याशेषं बभौ नभ:

verses.sanskrit: तमायान्तं समालोक्य देवी शङ्खमवादयत् । ज्याशब्दं चापि धनुषश्चकारातीव दुःसहम्
verses.transliteration: tamAyAntaM samAlokya devI sha~NkhamavAdayat | jyAshabdaM chApi dhanuShashchakArAtIva duHsaham
verses.translation: Beholding him approaching, the goddess sounded her conch, and made her bow also give forth from its string a note which was exceedingly hard to endure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beholding him approaching, the goddess sounded her conch, and made her bow also give forth from its string a note which was exceedingly hard to endure.
verses.hindi: तमायान्तं समालोक्य देवी शड्खमवादयत्‌ | ज्याशब्दं चापि धनुषश्चकारातीव दुःसहम्‌

verses.sanskrit: पूरयामास ककुभो निजघण्टास्वनेन च । समस्तदैत्यसैन्यानां तेजोवधविधायिना
verses.transliteration: pUrayAmAsa kakubho nijaghaNTAsvanena cha | samastadaityasainyAnAM tejovadhavidhAyinA
verses.translation: And she filled all regions with the clanging of her bell, which caused the vigour of all the Daitya hosts to die away.
verses.commentary: Sense: And she filled all regions with the clanging of her bell, which caused the vigour of all the Daitya hosts to die away.
verses.hindi: साथ ही अपने घंटेके शब्दसे, जो समस्त दैत्य-सैनिकोंका तेज नष्ट करनेवाला था, सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंको व्याप्त कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहो महानादैस्त्याजितेभमहामदैः । पूरयामास गगनं गां तथैव दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: tataH siMho mahAnAdaistyAjitebhamahAmadaiH | pUrayAmAsa gaganaM gAM tathaiva disho dasha
verses.translation: Then her lion filled the heaven, the earth and the ten regions of the sky with loud roars, which checked the copious flow of the exudation from the demons' rutting elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then her lion filled the heaven, the earth and the ten regions of the sky with loud roars, which checked the copious flow of the exudation from the demons' rutting elephants.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर सिंहने भी अपनी दहाड़से, जिसे सुनकर बड़े-बड़े गजराजोंका महान्‌ मद दूर हो जाता था, आकाश, पृथ्वी और दसों दिशाओंको गुँजा दिया

verses.sanskrit: ततः काली समुत्पत्य गगनं क्ष्मामताडयत् । कराभ्यां तन्निनादेन प्राक्स्वनास्ते तिरोहिताः
verses.transliteration: tataH kAlI samutpatya gaganaM kShmAmatADayat | karAbhyAM tanninAdena prAk.hsvanAste tirohitAH
verses.translation: Kali, springing upward, then struck the heaven and the earth with both her hands; the boom thereof drowned those previous sounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali, springing upward, then struck the heaven and the earth with both her hands; the boom thereof drowned those previous sounds.
verses.hindi: फिर कालीने आकाशमें उछलकर अपने दोनों हाथोंसे पृथ्वीपर आघात किया। उससे ऐसा भयंकर शब्द हुआ, जिससे पहलेके सभी शब्द शान्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: अट्टाट्टहासमशिवं शिवदूती चकार ह । वैः शब्दैरसुरास्त्रेसुः शुम्भः कोपं परं ययौ
verses.transliteration: aTTATTahAsamashivaM shivadUtI chakAra ha | vaiH shabdairasurAstresuH shumbhaH kopaM paraM yayau
verses.translation: Shivaduti uttered a loud inauspicious laugh. At those sounds the Asuras trembled; Shumbha gave way to utmost rage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Shivaduti uttered a loud inauspicious laugh. At those sounds the Asuras trembled; Shumbha gave way to utmost rage.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात्‌ शिवदूतीने दैत्योंके लिये अमज़्लजनक अट्टहास किया, इन शब्दोंको सुनकर समस्त असुर थर्रा उठे; किंतु शुम्भको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ

verses.sanskrit: दुरात्मंस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति व्याजहाराम्बिका यदा । तदा जयेत्यभिहितं देवैराकाशसंस्थितैः
verses.transliteration: durAtmaMstiShTha tiShTheti vyAjahArAmbikA yadA | tadA jayetyabhihitaM devairAkAshasaMsthitaiH
verses.translation: When Ambika cried out 'Stand, O evil-souled! stand!', the gods who had taken their stations in the air then called to her, 'Be thou victorious!'
verses.commentary: Sense: When Ambika cried out 'Stand, O evil-souled! stand!', the gods who had taken their stations in the air then called to her, 'Be thou victorious!'
verses.hindi: उस समय देवीने जब शुम्भको लक्ष्य करके कहा--'ओ दुरात्मन्‌! खड़ा रह, खड़ा रह,” तभी आकाशमें खड़े हुए देवता बोल उठे, जय हो, जय हो”

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भेनागत्य या शक्तिर्मुक्ता ज्वालातिभीषणा । आयान्ती वह्निकूटाभा सा निरस्ता महोल्कया
verses.transliteration: shumbhenAgatya yA shaktirmuktA jvAlAtibhIShaNA | AyAntI vahnikUTAbhA sA nirastA maholkayA
verses.translation: The spear flaming most terribly, which Shumbha approaching hurled—that, gleaming like a mass of fire as it came along, was driven aside by a great fire-brand.
verses.commentary: Sense: The spear flaming most terribly, which Shumbha approaching hurled—that, gleaming like a mass of fire as it came along, was driven aside by a great fire-brand.
verses.hindi: शुम्भने वहाँ आकर ज्वालाओंसे युक्त अत्यन्त भयानक शक्ति चलायी। अग्निमय पर्वतके समान आती हुई उस शक्तिको देवीने बड़े भारी लूकेसे दूर हटा दिया

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादेन शुम्भस्य व्याप्तं लोकत्रयान्तरम् । निर्घातनिःस्वनो घोरो जितवानवनीपते
verses.transliteration: siMhanAdena shumbhasya vyAptaM lokatrayAntaram | nirghAtaniHsvano ghoro jitavAnavanIpate
verses.translation: The vault between the three worlds reverberated with Shumbha's lion-like roaring, but the dreadful sound of the slaughter among his soldiers surpassed that, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: The vault between the three worlds reverberated with Shumbha's lion-like roaring, but the dreadful sound of the slaughter among his soldiers surpassed that, O king.
verses.hindi: उस समय शुम्भके सिंहनादसे तीनों लोक गूँज उठे। राजन्‌! उसकी प्रतिध्वनिसे वज्रपातके समान भयानक शब्द हुआ, जिसने अन्य सब शब्दोंको जीत लिया

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भमुक्ताञ्छरान्देवी शुम्भस्तत्प्रहिताञ्छरान् । चिच्छेद स्वशरैरुग्रैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: shumbhamuktA~nCharAndevI shumbhastatprahitA~nCharAn | chichCheda svasharairugraiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
verses.translation: The goddess split the arrows shot by Shumbha, and Shumbha the arrows that she discharged, each with her and his sharp arrows in hundreds and thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess split the arrows shot by Shumbha, and Shumbha the arrows that she discharged, each with her and his sharp arrows in hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: शुम्भमुक्ताञ्छरान्देवी शुम्भस्तत्प्रहिताञ्छरान्‌ । चिच्छेद स्वशरैरुग्रै: शतशो5थ सहस्रश:

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा चण्डिका क्रुद्धा शूलेनाभिजघान तम् । स तदाभिहतो भूमौ मूर्च्छितो निपपात ह
verses.transliteration: tataH sA chaNDikA kruddhA shUlenAbhijaghAna tam | sa tadAbhihato bhUmau mUrchChito nipapAta ha
verses.translation: Chandika, enraged thereat, smote him with a dart. Wounded therewith, he fell in a faint to the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika, enraged thereat, smote him with a dart. Wounded therewith, he fell in a faint to the ground.
verses.hindi: तब क्रोधमें भरी हुई चण्डिकाने शुम्भको शूलसे मारा। उसके आघातसे मूर्च्छित हो वह पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशुम्भः सम्प्राप्य चेतनामात्तकार्मुकः । आजघान शरैर्देवीं कालीं केसरिणं तथा
verses.transliteration: tato nishumbhaH samprApya chetanAmAttakArmukaH | AjaghAna sharairdevIM kAlIM kesariNaM tathA
verses.translation: Thereupon Nishumbha, regaining consciousness, seized his bow again and struck the goddess, and Kali and the lion, with arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Nishumbha, regaining consciousness, seized his bow again and struck the goddess, and Kali and the lion, with arrows.
verses.hindi: ततो निशुम्भ: सम्प्राप्य चेतनामात्तकार्मुक: । आजचघान शरैदेवीं कालीं केसरिणं तथा

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च कृत्वा बाहूनामयुतं दनुजेश्वरः । चक्रायुधेन दितिजश्छादयामास चण्डिकाम्
verses.transliteration: punashcha kR^itvA bAhUnAmayutaM danujeshvaraH | chakrAyudhena ditijashChAdayAmAsa chaNDikAm
verses.translation: And the Danava lord, that son of Diti, putting forth a myriad arms, again covered Chandika with a myriad discuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the Danava lord, that son of Diti, putting forth a myriad arms, again covered Chandika with a myriad discuses.
verses.hindi: फिर उस दैत्यराजने दस हजार बाँहें बनाकर चक्रोंके प्रहारसे चण्डिकाको आच्छादित कर दिया

verses.sanskrit: ततो भगवती क्रुद्धा दुर्गा दुर्गार्तिनाशिनी । चिच्छेद देवी चक्राणि स्वशरैः सायकांश्च तान्
verses.transliteration: tato bhagavatI kruddhA durgA durgArtinAshinI | chichCheda devI chakrANi svasharaiH sAyakAMshcha tAn
verses.translation: The goddess then, enraged—she, Durga who destroys the afflictions of adversity—split those discuses and those arrows with her own arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess then, enraged—she, Durga who destroys the afflictions of adversity—split those discuses and those arrows with her own arrows.
verses.hindi: तब दुर्गम पीड़ाका नाश करनेवाली भगवती दुर्गने कुपित होकर अपने बाणोंसे उन चक्रों तथा बाणोंको काट गिराया

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशुम्भो वेगेन गदामादाय चण्डिकाम् । अभ्यधावत वै हन्तुं दैत्यसैन्यसमावृतः
verses.transliteration: tato nishumbho vegena gadAmAdAya chaNDikAm | abhyadhAvata vai hantuM daityasainyasamAvR^itaH
verses.translation: Then Nishumbha, seizing his club, rushed impetuously at Chandika to slay her outright, with the Daitya host surrounding him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Nishumbha, seizing his club, rushed impetuously at Chandika to slay her outright, with the Daitya host surrounding him.
verses.hindi: यह देख निशुम्भ दैत्यसेनाके साथ चण्डिकाका वध करनेके लिये हाथमें गदा ले बड़े वेगसे दौड़ा

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापतत एवाशु गदां चिच्छेद चण्डिका । खड्गेन शितधारेण स च शूलं समाददे
verses.transliteration: tasyApatata evAshu gadAM chichCheda chaNDikA | khaDgena shitadhAreNa sa cha shUlaM samAdade
verses.translation: As he was just falling upon her, Chandika swiftly clove his club with her sharp-edged scymitar. And he took hold of a dart.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he was just falling upon her, Chandika swiftly clove his club with her sharp-edged scymitar. And he took hold of a dart.
verses.hindi: उसके आते ही चण्डीने तीखी धारवाली तलवारसे उसकी गदाको शीघ्र ही काट डाला। तब उसने शूल हाथमें लिया

verses.sanskrit: शूलहस्तं समायान्तं निशुम्भममरार्दनम् । हृदि विव्याध शूलेन वेगाविद्धेन चण्डिका
verses.transliteration: shUlahastaM samAyAntaM nishumbhamamarArdanam | hR^idi vivyAdha shUlena vegAviddhena chaNDikA
verses.translation: Chandika, with a dart hurled swiftly, pierced Nishumbha, the afflicter of the Immortals, in the heart, as he approached with dart in hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika, with a dart hurled swiftly, pierced Nishumbha, the afflicter of the Immortals, in the heart, as he approached with dart in hand.
verses.hindi: देवताओंको पीड़ा देनेवाले निशुम्भको शूल हाथमें लिये आते देख चण्डिकाने वेगसे चलाये हुए अपने शूलसे उसकी छाती छेद डाली

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नस्य तस्य शूलेन हृदयान्निःसृतोऽपरः । महाबलो महावीर्यस्तिष्ठेति पुरुषो वदन्
verses.transliteration: bhinnasya tasya shUlena hR^idayAnniHsR^ito.aparaH | mahAbalo mahAvIryastiShTheti puruSho vadan
verses.translation: When he was pierced by the dart, out of his heart issued another man of great strength and great valour, exclaiming 'Stand!'
verses.commentary: Sense: When he was pierced by the dart, out of his heart issued another man of great strength and great valour, exclaiming 'Stand!'
verses.hindi: शूलसे विदीर्ण हो जानेपर उसकी छातीसे एक दूसरा महाबली एवं महापराक्रमी पुरुष 'खड़ी रह, खड़ी रह” कहता हुआ निकला

verses.sanskrit: तस्य निष्क्रामतो देवी प्रहस्य स्वनवत्ततः । शिरश्चिच्छेद खड्गेन ततोऽसावपतद्भुवि
verses.transliteration: tasya niShkrAmato devI prahasya svanavattataH | shirashchichCheda khaDgena tato.asAvapatadbhuvi
verses.translation: When he stepped forth, the goddess, laughing aloud, then struck off his head with her scymitar; thereupon he fell to the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he stepped forth, the goddess, laughing aloud, then struck off his head with her scymitar; thereupon he fell to the ground.
verses.hindi: तस्य निष्क्रामतो देवी प्रहस्य स्वनवत्तत: । शिरश्विच्छेद खड्गेन ततो5सावपतद्भुवि

verses.sanskrit: ततः सिंहश्चखादोग्रदंष्ट्राक्षुण्णशिरोधरान् । असुरांस्तांस्तथा काली शिवदूती तथापरान्
verses.transliteration: tataH siMhashchakhAdogradaMShTrAkShuNNashirodharAn | asurAMstAMstathA kAlI shivadUtI tathAparAn
verses.translation: The lion then devoured those Asuras whose necks he had crushed with his savage teeth, and Kali and Shivaduti devoured the others.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lion then devoured those Asuras whose necks he had crushed with his savage teeth, and Kali and Shivaduti devoured the others.
verses.hindi: ततः सिंहश्नखादोग्रं+ दंष्टा क्षणणशिरोधरान्‌ । असुरांस्तांस्तथा काली शिवदूती तथापरान्‌

verses.sanskrit: कौमारीशक्तिनिर्भिन्नाः केचिन्नेशुर्महासुराः । ब्रह्माणीमन्त्रपूतेन तोयेनान्ये निराकृताः
verses.transliteration: kaumArIshaktinirbhinnAH kechinneshurmahAsurAH | brahmANImantrapUtena toyenAnye nirAkR^itAH
verses.translation: Some great Asuras perished, being pierced through by the spear held by Kumara's Energy; others were driven back by the water purified by the spell uttered by Brahma's Energy;
verses.commentary: Sense: Some great Asuras perished, being pierced through by the spear held by Kumara's Energy; others were driven back by the water purified by the spell uttered by Brahma's Energy;
verses.hindi: कौमारीकी शक्तिसे विदीर्ण होकर कितने ही महादैत्य नष्ट हो गये। ब्रह्माणीके मन्त्रपूत जलसे निस्तेज होकर कितने ही भाग खड़े हुए

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरीत्रिशूलेन भिन्नाः पेतुस्तथापरे । वाराहीतुण्डघातेन केचिच्चूर्णीकृता भुवि
verses.transliteration: mAheshvarItrishUlena bhinnAH petustathApare | vArAhItuNDaghAtena kechichchUrNIkR^itA bhuvi
verses.translation: and others fell, pierced by the trident wielded by Shiva's Energy; some were pounded to dust on the ground by blows from the snout of Varaha's Energy;
verses.commentary: Sense: and others fell, pierced by the trident wielded by Shiva's Energy; some were pounded to dust on the ground by blows from the snout of Varaha's Energy;
verses.hindi: माहेश्वरीत्रिशूलेन भिन्ना: पेतुस्तथापरे । वाराहीतुण्डघातेन केचिच्चूर्णीकृता भुवि

verses.sanskrit: खण्डं खण्डं च चक्रेण वैष्णव्या दानवाः कृताः । वज्रेण चैन्द्रीहस्ताग्रविमुक्तेन तथापरे
verses.transliteration: khaNDaM khaNDaM cha chakreNa vaiShNavyA dAnavAH kR^itAH | vajreNa chaindrIhastAgravimuktena tathApare
verses.translation: some Danavas were cut to pieces by the discus hurled by Vishnu's Energy; and others again by the thunderbolt discharged from the fingers of Indra's Energy.
verses.commentary: Sense: some Danavas were cut to pieces by the discus hurled by Vishnu's Energy; and others again by the thunderbolt discharged from the fingers of Indra's Energy.
verses.hindi: खण्डंः खण्डं च चक्रेण वैष्णव्या दानवा: कृता: । वज्ञेण चैन्द्रीहस्ताग्रविमुक्तेन तथापरे

verses.sanskrit: केचिद्विनेशुरसुराः केचिन्नष्टा महाहवात् । भक्षिताश्चापरे कालीशिवदूतीमृगाधिपैः
verses.transliteration: kechidvineshurasurAH kechinnaShTA mahAhavAt | bhakShitAshchApare kAlIshivadUtImR^igAdhipaiH
verses.translation: Some Asuras perished outright, some fled from the great battle, and others were devoured by Kali, Shivaduti and the lion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Asuras perished outright, some fled from the great battle, and others were devoured by Kali, Shivaduti and the lion.
verses.hindi: कुछ असुर नष्ट हो गये, कुछ उस महायुद्धसे भाग गये तथा कितने ही काली, शिवदूती तथा सिंहके ग्रास बन गये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: निशुम्भं निहतं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं प्राणसम्मितम् । हन्यमानं बलं चैव शुम्भः क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद्वचः
verses.transliteration: niśumbhaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraṃ prāṇasammitam | hanyamānaṃ balaṃ caiva śumbhaḥ kruddho'bravīdvacaḥ ||
verses.translation: Seeing Nishumbha — his brother, dear as his own life — slain, and his army being destroyed, Shumbha spoke in fury.
verses.wordMeaning: Shumbha and Nishumbha — pride and the ego's shadow — are twin demons, inseparable. When Nishumbha falls (the ego's outer defences collapse), Shumbha's fury intensifies — the last desperate assertion of the self that will not yield.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Shumbha and Nishumbha — pride and the ego's shadow — are twin demons, inseparable. When Nishumbha falls (the ego's outer defences collapse), Shumbha's fury intensifies — the last desperate assertion of the self that will not yield.…
verses.hindi: अपने प्राण-प्रिय भाई निशुम्भ को मारा हुआ देखकर, और सेना के नष्ट होते देखकर, शुम्भ क्रोध में बोला।
verses.science: Extinction bursts in behavioural psychology: when a reinforced behaviour pattern stops receiving its reward, it briefly intensifies before extinguishing. Therapists and coaches know this as "the storm before the breakthrough." Patients in withdrawal, people in the final stages of ending a destructive relationship, practitioners at the edge of a breakthrough — all experience the Shumbha moment: maximum fury just before the final release.
verses.lifeLesson: If you are in a process of transformation and your old patterns suddenly seem to return with maximum ferocity — louder, more insistent, more desperate than ever — do not interpret this as failure. Recognise: Nishumbha has fallen. Shumbha is making his last stand. Hold steady. The Goddess is not retreating; she is preparing the final stroke.

verses.sanskrit: बलावलेपदुष्टे त्वं मा दुर्गे गर्वमावह । अन्यासां बलमाश्रित्य युद्ध्यसे चातिमानिनी
verses.transliteration: balAvalepaduShTe tvaM mA durge garvamAvaha | anyAsAM balamAshritya yuddhyase chAtimAninI
verses.translation: 'O Durga, who art tainted with the arrogance of strength, bring not thy pride here, thou who, trusting in the strength of the other goddesses, dost fight in exceeding haughtiness!'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O Durga, who art tainted with the arrogance of strength, bring not thy pride here, thou who, trusting in the strength of the other goddesses, dost fight in exceeding haughtiness!'
verses.hindi: *दुष्ट दुर्ग! तू बलके अभिमानमें आकर झूठ-मूठका घमंड न दिखा। तू बड़ी मानिनी बनी हुई है, किन्तु दूसरी स्त्रियोंक बलका सहारा लेकर लड़ती है”

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: एकैवाहं जगत्यत्र द्वितीया का ममापरा । पश्यैता दुष्ट मय्येव विशन्त्यो मद्विभूतयः
verses.transliteration: ekaivāhaṃ jagatyatra dvitīyā kā mamāparā | paśyaitā duṣṭa mayyeva viśantyo madvibhūtayaḥ ||
verses.translation: I alone exist in this world — what second is there besides me? O wicked one, see — these my powers are now entering back into me alone.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devi's final, definitive statement before slaying Shumbha: "I alone exist." This is not arrogance — it is the highest metaphysics. All the forms that emerged to fight — Kali, the Matrikas, all the manifestations — now dissolve back into the one Devi.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devi's final, definitive statement before slaying Shumbha: "I alone exist." This is not arrogance — it is the highest metaphysics. All the forms that emerged to fight — Kali, the Matrikas, all the manifestations — now dissolve back into the one Devi.…
verses.hindi: इस जगत में केवल मैं ही हूँ — मेरे अतिरिक्त दूसरा कौन है? हे दुष्ट! देख, ये मेरी सभी शक्तियाँ मुझमें ही समा रही हैं।
verses.science: Physics of field unification: all the apparently distinct forces of nature — the strong and weak nuclear forces, electromagnetism, gravity — are theorised to be manifestations of a single underlying field that differentiated as the universe cooled. The Devi's "I alone exist" and the re-absorption of all her powers is the mythological image of field unification: the many resolving into the one ground from which they arose.
verses.lifeLesson: The final teaching of Chapter 10: everything that appears separate — your many selves, your conflicting desires, your different roles, the parts of you that fight each other — is ultimately one awareness. When you are most fragmented, remember: the same Devi who sent forth all these forms can call them home. You are not your fragments; you are the one who sent them forth. Rest in that.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समस्तास्ता देव्यो ब्रह्माणीप्रमुखा लयम् । तस्या देव्यास्तनौ जग्मुरेकैवासीत्तदाम्बिका
verses.transliteration: tataH samastAstA devyo brahmANIpramukhA layam | tasyA devyAstanau jagmurekaivAsIttadAmbikA
verses.translation: Then all those goddesses, Brahmani and the others, became absorbed into the body of the goddess; Ambika then remained alone indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those goddesses, Brahmani and the others, became absorbed into the body of the goddess; Ambika then remained alone indeed.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर ब्रह्माणी आदि समस्त देवियाँ अम्बिका देवीके शरीरमें लीन हो गयीं। उस समय केवल अम्बिका देवी ही रह गयीं

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: अहं विभूत्या बहुभिरिह रूपैर्यदास्थिता । तत्संहृतं मयैकैव तिष्ठाम्याजौ स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: ahaM vibhUtyA bahubhiriha rUpairyadAsthitA | tatsaMhR^itaM mayaikaiva tiShThAmyAjau sthiro bhava
verses.translation: Whereas I existed with my divine power in many forms here—that has been drawn in by me; truly alone I stand now. Be thou steadfast in combat!
verses.commentary: Sense: Whereas I existed with my divine power in many forms here—that has been drawn in by me; truly alone I stand now. Be thou steadfast in combat!
verses.hindi: मैं अपनी ऐश्वर्यशक्तिसे अनेक रूपोंमें यहाँ उपस्थित हुई थी। उन सब रूपोंको मैंने समेट लिया। अब अकेली ही युद्धमें खड़ी हूँ। तुम भी स्थिर हो जाओ

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं देव्याः शुम्भस्य चोभयोः । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानामसुराणां च दारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tataH pravavR^ite yuddhaM devyAH shumbhasya chobhayoH | pashyatAM sarvadevAnAmasurANAM cha dAruNam
verses.translation: Thereupon commenced a battle between them both, the goddess and Shumbha, while all the gods and the Asuras looked on—a battle without quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon commenced a battle between them both, the goddess and Shumbha, while all the gods and the Asuras looked on—a battle without quarter.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर देवी और शुम्भ दोनोंमें सब देवताओं तथा दानवोंके देखते-देखते भयडूकर युद्ध छिड़ गया

verses.sanskrit: शरवर्षैः शितैः शस्त्रैस्तथा चास्त्रैः सुदारुणैः । तयोर्युद्धमभूद्भूयः सर्वलोकभयङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: sharavarShaiH shitaiH shastraistathA chAstraiH sudAruNaiH | tayoryuddhamabhUdbhUyaH sarvalokabhaya~Nkaram
verses.translation: With showers of arrows, with sharp weapons and also with pitiless missiles, both engaged anew in a combat which set all the world in fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: With showers of arrows, with sharp weapons and also with pitiless missiles, both engaged anew in a combat which set all the world in fear.
verses.hindi: शरवर्ष: शितै: शस्त्रैस्तथास्त्रैश्नैव दारुणै: । तयोर्युद्धमभूद्धूय: सर्वलोकभयड्करम्‌

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि शतशो मुमुचे यान्यथाम्बिका । बभञ्ज तानि दैत्येन्द्रस्तत्प्रतीघातकर्तृभिः
verses.transliteration: divyAnyastrANi shatasho mumuche yAnyathAmbikA | babha~nja tAni daityendrastatpratIghAtakartR^ibhiH
verses.translation: And the lord of the Daityas broke the heavenly missiles, which Ambika discharged in hundreds, with weapons that parried them.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the lord of the Daityas broke the heavenly missiles, which Ambika discharged in hundreds, with weapons that parried them.
verses.hindi: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि शतशो मुमुचे यान्यथाम्बिका । बभज्ज तानि दैत्येन्द्रस्तत्प्रतीघातकर्तृभि:

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तानि तेन चास्त्राणि दिव्यानि परमेश्वरी । बभञ्ज लीलयैवोग्रहुङ्कारोच्चारणादिभिः
verses.transliteration: muktAni tena chAstrANi divyAni parameshvarI | babha~nja lIlayaivograhu~NkArochchAraNAdibhiH
verses.translation: And the supreme goddess in merest play broke the heavenly missiles that he discharged, with fierce shouts, ejaculations and other sounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the supreme goddess in merest play broke the heavenly missiles that he discharged, with fierce shouts, ejaculations and other sounds.
verses.hindi: असुरों ने जो बड़े-बड़े अस्त्र-शस्त्र चलाये, उनको देवी ने क्रोध में भरकर मुँह से पकड़ लिया और दाँतों से पीस डाला।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरशतैर्देवीमाच्छादयत सोऽसुरः । सापि तत्कुपिता देवी धनुश्चिच्छेद चेषुभिः
verses.transliteration: tataH sharashatairdevImAchChAdayata so.asuraH | sApi tatkupitA devI dhanushchichCheda cheShubhiH
verses.translation: Then the Asura covered the goddess with hundreds of arrows, and the goddess, enraged thereat, split his bow also with her arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Asura covered the goddess with hundreds of arrows, and the goddess, enraged thereat, split his bow also with her arrows.
verses.hindi: ततः शरशतैर्देवीमाच्छादयत सो<सुर: । सापिः तत्कुपिता देवी धनुश्चिच्छेद चेषुभि:

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ने धनुषि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथा शक्तिमथाददे । चिच्छेद देवी चक्रेण तामप्यस्य करे स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: Chinne dhanuShi daityendrastathA shaktimathAdade | chichCheda devI chakreNa tAmapyasya kare sthitAm
verses.translation: And when his bow was split, the lord of the Daityas took up his spear. The goddess split it, as he held it in his hand, with a discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: And when his bow was split, the lord of the Daityas took up his spear. The goddess split it, as he held it in his hand, with a discus.
verses.hindi: छिन्ने धनुषि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथा शक्तिमथाददे । चिच्छेद देवी चक्रेण तामप्यस्य करे स्थिताम्‌

verses.sanskrit: ततः खड्गमुपादाय शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत् । अभ्यधा वत तां देवीं दैत्यानामधिपेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tataH khaDgamupAdAya shatachandraM cha bhAnumat | abhyadhA vata tAM devIM daityAnAmadhipeshvaraH
verses.translation: Next the supreme monarch of the Daityas, seizing his scymitar and sunlike shield, on which a hundred moons were pourtrayed, rushed at the goddess at that moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Next the supreme monarch of the Daityas, seizing his scymitar and sunlike shield, on which a hundred moons were pourtrayed, rushed at the goddess at that moment.
verses.hindi: तत:ः खड्गमुपादाय शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्‌ । अभ्यधावत्तदाः देवीं दैत्यानामधिपेश्वर:

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापतत एवाशु खड्गं चिच्छेद चण्डिका । धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैर्बाणैश्चर्म चार्ककरामलम् । अश्वांश्च पातयामास रथं सारथिना सह
verses.transliteration: tasyApatata evAshu khaDgaM chichCheda chaNDikA | dhanurmuktaiH shitairbANaishcharma chArkakarAmalam | ashvAMshcha pAtayAmAsa rathaM sArathinA saha
verses.translation: Just as he was falling upon her, Chandika hastily split his scymitar with sharp arrows shot from her bow, and his shield also which was spotless as the sun's rays; and she felled his steeds, and his chariot together with its charioteer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as he was falling upon her, Chandika hastily split his scymitar with sharp arrows shot from her bow, and his shield also which was spotless as the sun's rays; and she felled his steeds, and his chariot together with its charioteer.
verses.hindi: उसके आते ही चण्डिकाने अपने धनुषसे छोड़े हुए तीखे बाणोंद्वारा उसकी सूर्य-किरणोंके समान उज्ज्वल ढाल और तलवारको तुरंत काट दिया

verses.sanskrit: हताश्वः स तदा दैत्यश्छिन्नधन्वा विसारथिः । जग्राह मुद्गरं घोरमम्बिकानिधनोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: hatAshvaH sa tadA daityashChinnadhanvA visArathiH | jagrAha mudgaraM ghoramambikAnidhanodyataH
verses.translation: With his steeds slain, with his bow split, without a charioteer, the Daitya then grasped his terrible mace, being ready to slay Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his steeds slain, with his bow split, without a charioteer, the Daitya then grasped his terrible mace, being ready to slay Ambika.
verses.hindi: फिर उस दैत्यके घोड़े और सारथि मारे गये, धनुष तो पहले ही कट चुका था, अब उसने अम्बिकाको मारनेके लिये उद्यत हो भयंकर मुद्गर हाथमें लिया

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेदापततस्तस्य मुद्गरं निशितैः शरैः । तथापि सोऽभ्यधावत्तां मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वेगवान्
verses.transliteration: chichChedApatatastasya mudgaraM nishitaiH sharaiH | tathApi so.abhyadhAvattAM muShTimudyamya vegavAn
verses.translation: As he was falling upon her, she clove his mace with sharp arrows; nevertheless, raising his fist, he rushed swiftly at her.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he was falling upon her, she clove his mace with sharp arrows; nevertheless, raising his fist, he rushed swiftly at her.
verses.hindi: चिच्छेदापततस्तस्य मुद्गरं निशितै: शरै: । तथापि सो<भ्यधावत्तां मुष्टिमुद्यम्प वेगवान्‌

verses.sanskrit: स मुष्टिं पातयामास हृदये दैत्यपुङ्गवः । देव्यास्तं चापि सा देवी तलेनोरस्यताडयत्
verses.transliteration: sa muShTiM pAtayAmAsa hR^idaye daityapu~NgavaH | devyAstaM chApi sA devI talenorasyatADayat
verses.translation: The lordly Daitya brought his fist down on the goddess' heart, and the goddess also smote him on his breast with her palm.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lordly Daitya brought his fist down on the goddess' heart, and the goddess also smote him on his breast with her palm.
verses.hindi: स मुष्टिं पातयामास हृदये दैत्यपुड्भव: । देव्यास्तं चापि सा देवी तलेनोरस्यताडयत्‌

verses.sanskrit: तलप्रहाराभिहतो निपपात महीतले । स दैत्यराजः सहसा पुनरेव तथोत्थितः
verses.transliteration: talaprahArAbhihato nipapAta mahItale | sa daityarAjaH sahasA punareva tathotthitaH
verses.translation: Wounded by the blow of her palm, the Daitya king fell suddenly on the earth; and again indeed he rose up,
verses.commentary: Sense: Wounded by the blow of her palm, the Daitya king fell suddenly on the earth; and again indeed he rose up,
verses.hindi: देवीका थप्पड़ खाकर दैत्यराज शुम्भ पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़ा, किन्तु पुनः सहसा पूर्ववत्‌ उठकर खड़ा हो गया

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्य च प्रगृह्योच्चैर्देवीं गगनमास्थितः । तत्रापि सा निराधारा युयुधे तेन चण्डिका
verses.transliteration: utpatya cha pragR^ihyochchairdevIM gaganamAsthitaH | tatrApi sA nirAdhArA yuyudhe tena chaNDikA
verses.translation: and springing upward he seized the goddess and mounted on high into the sky. There also Chandika, being without any support, fought with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: and springing upward he seized the goddess and mounted on high into the sky. There also Chandika, being without any support, fought with him.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्य च प्रगृह्मोच्चैदेवीं गगनमास्थित: । तत्रापि सा निराधारा युयुधे तेन चण्डिका

verses.sanskrit: नियुद्धं खे तदा दैत्यश्चण्डिका च परस्परम् । चक्रतुः प्रथमं सिद्धमुनिविस्मयकारकम्
verses.transliteration: niyuddhaM khe tadA daityashchaNDikA cha parasparam | chakratuH prathamaM siddhamunivismayakArakam
verses.translation: The Daitya and Chandika then fought at first with each other in the sky in a close combat, which wrought dismay among the Siddhas and munis;
verses.commentary: Sense: The Daitya and Chandika then fought at first with each other in the sky in a close combat, which wrought dismay among the Siddhas and munis;
verses.hindi: नियुद्ध॑ खे तदा दैत्यश्षण्डिका च परस्परम्‌ । चक्रतुः प्रथमं सिद्धमुनिविस्मपकारकम्‌

verses.sanskrit: ततो नियुद्धं सुचिरं कृत्वा तेनाम्बिका सह । उत्पाट्य भ्रामयामास चिक्षेप धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: tato niyuddhaM suchiraM kR^itvA tenAmbikA saha | utpATya bhrAmayAmAsa chikShepa dharaNItale
verses.translation: after carrying on the close combat for a very long time with him, Ambika lifted him up then and whirled him around and flung him on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: after carrying on the close combat for a very long time with him, Ambika lifted him up then and whirled him around and flung him on the earth.
verses.hindi: फिर अम्बिकाने शुम्भके साथ बहुत देरतक युद्ध करनेके पश्चात्‌ उसे उठाकर घुमाया और पृथ्वीपर पटक दिया

verses.sanskrit: स क्षिप्तो धरणीं प्राप्य मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वेगवान् । अभ्यधावत दुष्टात्मा चण्डिकानिधनेच्छया
verses.transliteration: sa kShipto dharaNIM prApya muShTimudyamya vegavAn | abhyadhAvata duShTAtmA chaNDikAnidhanechChayA
verses.translation: When flung thus he touched the earth, he raised his fist hastily and rushed, evil of soul as he was, with the wish to kill Chandika.
verses.commentary: Sense: When flung thus he touched the earth, he raised his fist hastily and rushed, evil of soul as he was, with the wish to kill Chandika.
verses.hindi: पटके जानेपर पृथ्वीपर आनेके बाद वह दुष्टात्मा दैत्य पुन: चण्डिकाका वध करनेके लिये उनकी ओर बड़े वेगसे दौड़ा

verses.sanskrit: तमायान्तं ततो देवी सर्वदैत्यजनेश्वरम् । जगत्यां पातयामास भित्त्वा शूलेन वक्षसि
verses.transliteration: tamAyAntaM tato devI sarvadaityajaneshvaram | jagatyAM pAtayAmAsa bhittvA shUlena vakShasi
verses.translation: Seeing him, the lord of all the Daitya folk, approaching, the goddess then pierced him in the breast with a dart and felled him down on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing him, the lord of all the Daitya folk, approaching, the goddess then pierced him in the breast with a dart and felled him down on the earth.
verses.hindi: तमायान्तं ततो देवी सर्वदैत्यजने श्वरम्‌ । जगत्यां पातयामास भिन्त्वा शूलेन वक्षसि

verses.sanskrit: स गतासुः पपातोर्व्यां देवी शूलाग्रविक्षतः । चालयन् सकलां पृथ्वीं साब्धिद्वीपां सपर्वताम्
verses.transliteration: sa gatAsuH papAtorvyAM devI shUlAgravikShataH | chAlayan sakalAM pR^ithvIM sAbdhidvIpAM saparvatAm
verses.translation: Shattered by the point of the goddess' dart, he fell lifeless on the ground, shaking the whole earth and its seas, islands and mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Shattered by the point of the goddess' dart, he fell lifeless on the ground, shaking the whole earth and its seas, islands and mountains.
verses.hindi: स गतासु: पपातोर्व्या देवीशूलाग्रविक्षत: । चालयन्‌ सकलां पृथ्वीं साब्धिद्वीपां सपर्वताम्‌

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नमखिलं हते तस्मिन् दुरात्मनि । जगत्स्वास्थ्यमतीवाप निर्मलं चाभवन्नभः
verses.transliteration: tataH prasannamakhilaM hate tasmin durAtmani | jagatsvAsthyamatIvApa nirmalaM chAbhavannabhaH
verses.translation: When that evil-souled demon was slain, the universe became placid, the earth regained perfect well-being, and the sky grew pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that evil-souled demon was slain, the universe became placid, the earth regained perfect well-being, and the sky grew pure.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उस दुरात्माके मारे जानेपर सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌ प्रसन्न एवं पूर्ण स्वस्थ हो गया। आकाश स्वच्छ दिखायी देने लगा

verses.sanskrit: उत्पातमेघाः सोल्का ये प्रागासंस्ते शमं ययुः । सरितो मार्गवाहिन्यस्तथासंस्तत्र पातिते
verses.transliteration: utpAtameghAH solkA ye prAgAsaMste shamaM yayuH | sarito mArgavAhinyastathAsaMstatra pAtite
verses.translation: Portent-clouds, which were full of flame before, became tranquil, and the rivers kept within their channels, when he was stricken down there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Portent-clouds, which were full of flame before, became tranquil, and the rivers kept within their channels, when he was stricken down there.
verses.hindi: उत्पातमेघा: सोल्का ये प्रागासंस्ते शमं ययु: । सरितो मार्गवाहिन्यस्तथासंस्तत्र पातिते

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे हर्षनिर्भरमानसाः । बभूवुर्निहते तस्मिन् गन्धर्वा ललितं जगुः
verses.transliteration: tato devagaNAH sarve harShanirbharamAnasAH | babhUvurnihate tasmin gandharvA lalitaM jaguH
verses.translation: I alone exist in this world — what second is there besides me? O wicked one, see — these my powers are now entering back into me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: I alone exist in this world — what second is there besides me? O wicked one, see — these my powers are now entering back into me alone.
verses.hindi: उस समय शुम्भकी मृत्युके बाद सम्पूर्ण देवताओंका हृदय हर्षसे भर गया और गन्धर्वगण मधुर गीत गाने लगे

verses.sanskrit: अवादयंस्तथैवान्ये ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । ववुः पुण्यास्तथा वाताः सुप्रभोऽभूद्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: avAdayaMstathaivAnye nanR^itushchApsarogaNAH | vavuH puNyAstathA vAtAH suprabho.abhUddivAkaraH
verses.translation: and others of them sounded their instruments, and the bevies of Apsarases danced; and favourable breezes blew; very brilliant grew the sun;
verses.commentary: Sense: and others of them sounded their instruments, and the bevies of Apsarases danced; and favourable breezes blew; very brilliant grew the sun;
verses.hindi: अवादयंस्तथैवान्ये ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणा: । ववुः पुण्यास्तथा वाता: सुप्रभो5 भूद्विवाकर:

verses.sanskrit: जज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शान्ताः शान्ता दिग्जनितस्वनाः
verses.transliteration: jajvalushchAgnayaH shAntAH shAntA digjanitasvanAH
verses.translation: and the tranquil sacred fires blazed freely, and tranquil became the strange sounds that had occurred in the regions of the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: and the tranquil sacred fires blazed freely, and tranquil became the strange sounds that had occurred in the regions of the sky.
verses.hindi: अग्निशालाकी बुझी हुई आग अपने-आप प्रज्वलित हो उठी तथा सम्पूर्ण दिशाओंके भयड्कर शब्द शान्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: देव्या हते तत्र महासुरेन्द्रे सेन्द्राः सुरा वह्निपुरोगमास्ताम् । कात्यायनीं तुष्टुवुरिष्टलाभाद् विकाशिवक्त्राब्जविकाशिताशाः
verses.transliteration: devyA hate tatra mahAsurendre sendrAH surA vahnipurogamAstAm | kAtyAyanIM tuShTuvuriShTalAbhAd vikAshivaktrAbjavikAshitAshAH
verses.translation: When the great lord of the Asuras was slain there by the goddess, Indra and the other gods led by Agni offered praise to her, Katyayani, because they had gained their desire; and their faces shone forth like blossoming lotuses, and their hopes became manifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the great lord of the Asuras was slain there by the goddess, Indra and the other gods led by Agni offered praise to her, Katyayani, because they had gained their desire; and their faces shone forth like blossoming lotuses, and their hopes became manifest.
verses.hindi: ३. पा०--पदु०। २. इसके बाद किसी-किसी प्रतिमें 'ऋषिरुवाच' इतना अधिक पाठ है। ३. पा०--हू०। २. पा०--सा च। ३. पा०--वत तां हन्तुं दैत्या०। ४. इसके बाद किसी-किसी प्रतिमें--“अश्वांश् पातयामास रथं सारथिना सह।” इतना अधिक पाठ है। ५. पा०--वेगवान्‌। एकादशो< ध्याय: देवताओं द्वारा देवीकी स्तुति तथा देवीद्वारा देवताओंको वरदान ध्यान (बालरविद्युतिमिन्दुकिरीटां तुड़कुचां नयनत्रययुक्ताम्‌ । स्मेरमुखीं वरदाडकुशपाशाभीतिकरां प्रभजे भुवनेशीम्‌ ।। मैं भुवनेश्वरी देवीका ध्यान करता हूँ। उनके श्रीअड़ोंकी आभा प्रभातकालके सूर्यके समान है। मस्तकपर चन्द्रमाका मुकुट है। वे उभरे हुए स्तनों और तीन नेत्रोंसे युक्त हैं। उनके मुखपर मुसकानकी छटा छायी रहती है और हाथोंमें वरद, अंकुश, पाश एवं अभय-मुद्रा शोभा पाते हैं।) ऋषिरुवाच ॥/ १ ॥/ “३»' देव्या हते तत्र महासुरेन्द्रे सेन्द्रा: सुरा वह्निपुरोगमास्ताम्‌ । कात्यायनीं तुष्टवुरिष्टलाभादः: विकाशिवकक्‍्त्राब्जविकाशिताशा:?

verses.sanskrit: देवि प्रपन्नार्तिहरे प्रसीद प्रसीद मातर्जगतोऽखिलस्य । प्रसीद विश्वेश्वरि पाहि विश्वं त्वमीश्वरी देवि चराचरस्य
verses.transliteration: devi prapannArtihare prasIda prasIda mAtarjagato.akhilasya | prasIda vishveshvari pAhi vishvaM tvamIshvarI devi charAcharasya
verses.translation: In this manner, whenever there shall be trouble arising from the demonic forces, I shall descend each time and destroy the enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner, whenever there shall be trouble arising from the demonic forces, I shall descend each time and destroy the enemies.
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--शरणागतकी पीड़ा दूर करनेवाली देवि! हमपर प्रसन्न होओ। सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌की माता! प्रसन्न होओ। विश्वेश्वरि! विश्वकी रक्षा करो। देवि! तुम्हीं चराचर जगत्‌की अधीश्वरी हो

verses.sanskrit: आधारभूता जगतस्त्वमेका महीस्वरूपेण यतः स्थितासि । अपां स्वरूपस्थितया त्वयैत- दाप्यायते कृत्स्नमलङ्घ्यवीर्ये
verses.transliteration: AdhArabhUtA jagatastvamekA mahIsvarUpeNa yataH sthitAsi | apAM svarUpasthitayA tvayaita\- dApyAyate kR^itsnamala~NghyavIrye
verses.translation: Thou alone hast become the support of the world, because thou dost subsist in the form of the earth! By thee, who existest in the form of water, all this universe is filled, O thou inviolable in thy valour!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou alone hast become the support of the world, because thou dost subsist in the form of the earth! By thee, who existest in the form of water, all this universe is filled, O thou inviolable in thy valour!
verses.hindi: तुम इस जगत्‌का एकमात्र आधार हो, क्योंकि पृथ्वीरूपमें तुम्हारी ही स्थिति है। देवि! तुम्हारा पराक्रम अलड्घनीय है। तुम्हीं जलरूपमें स्थित होकर सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌को तृप्त करती हो

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वैष्णवीशक्तिरनन्तवीर्या विश्वस्य बीजं परमासि माया । सम्मोहितं देवि समस्तमेतत् त्वं वै प्रसन्ना भुवि मुक्तिहेतुः
verses.transliteration: tvaM vaiShNavIshaktiranantavIryA vishvasya bIjaM paramAsi mAyA | sammohitaM devi samastametat tvaM vai prasannA bhuvi muktihetuH
verses.translation: Thou art Vishnu's energy, boundless in thy valour; thou art the germ of the universe, thou art Illusion sublime! All this world has been bewitched, O goddess; thou indeed, when propitious, art the cause of final emancipation on the earth!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou art Vishnu's energy, boundless in thy valour; thou art the germ of the universe, thou art Illusion sublime! All this world has been bewitched, O goddess; thou indeed, when propitious, art the cause of final emancipation on the earth!
verses.hindi: तुम अनन्त बलसम्पन्न वैष्णवी शक्ति हो। इस विश्वकी कारणभूता परा माया हो। देवि! तुमने इस समस्त जगत्‌को मोहित कर रखा है। तुम्हीं प्रसन्न होनेपर इस पृथ्वीपर मोक्षकी प्राप्ति कराती हो

verses.sanskrit: विद्याः समस्तास्तव देवि भेदाः स्त्रियः समस्ताः सकला जगत्सु । त्वयैकया पूरितमम्बयैतत् का ते स्तुतिः स्तव्यपरापरोक्तिः
verses.transliteration: vidyAH samastAstava devi bhedAH striyaH samastAH sakalA jagatsu | tvayaikayA pUritamambayaitat kA te stutiH stavyaparAparoktiH
verses.translation: Salutations again and again to the Devi who dwells in all beings in the form of power (shakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations again and again to the Devi who dwells in all beings in the form of power (shakti).
verses.hindi: देवि! सम्पूर्ण विद्याएँ तुम्हारे ही भिन्न-भिन्न स्वरूप हैं। जगत्‌में जितनी स्त्रियाँ हैं, वे सब तुम्हारी ही मूर्तियाँ हैं। जगदम्ब! एकमात्र तुमने ही इस विश्वको व्याप्त कर रखा है। तुम्हारी स्तुति क्या हो सकती है? तुम तो स्तवन करने योग्य पदार्थोंसे परे एवं परा वाणी हो

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूता यदा देवी भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायिनी । त्वं स्तुता स्तुतये का वा भवन्तु परमोक्तयः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhUtA yadA devI bhuktimuktipradAyinI | tvaM stutA stutaye kA vA bhavantu paramoktayaH
verses.translation: When as being the goddess who constitutes every created thing, and who bestows enjoyment and final emancipation, thou art praised—for thy praise again what sublime words can be sufficient?
verses.commentary: Sense: When as being the goddess who constitutes every created thing, and who bestows enjoyment and final emancipation, thou art praised—for thy praise again what sublime words can be sufficient?
verses.hindi: सर्वभूता यदा देवी स्वर्गमुक्तिप्रदायिनीः | त्वं स्तुता स्तुतये का वा भवन्तु परमोक्तय:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य बुद्धिरूपेण जनस्य हृदि संस्थिते । स्वर्गापवर्गदे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvasya buddhirUpeNa janasya hR^idi saMsthite | svargApavargade devi nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who abidest under the form of Intelligence in the heart of every living creature; O goddess, who bestowest Svarga and final emancipation, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who abidest under the form of Intelligence in the heart of every living creature; O goddess, who bestowest Svarga and final emancipation, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: बुद्धिरूपसे सब लोगोंके हृदयमें विराजमान रहनेवाली तथा स्वर्ग एवं मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाली नारायणी देवि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: कलाकाष्ठादिरूपेण परिणामप्रदायिनि । विश्वस्योपरतौ शक्ते नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: kalAkAShThAdirUpeNa pariNAmapradAyini | vishvasyoparatau shakte nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: Thou who, in the form of minutes, moments and other portions of time, dost bring results to pass; O thou who art mighty in the death of the universe, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou who, in the form of minutes, moments and other portions of time, dost bring results to pass; O thou who art mighty in the death of the universe, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: कला, काष्ठा आदिके रूपसे क्रमश: परिणाम (अवस्था-परिवर्तन)-की ओर ले जानेवाली तथा विश्वका उपसंहार करनेमें समर्थ नारायणी! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके । शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhike | śaraṇye tryambake gauri nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ||
verses.translation: O auspiciousness of all that is auspicious, O Shiva (the benevolent), O accomplisher of all purposes, O refuge, O three-eyed one, O Gauri, O Narayani — salutations to you.
verses.wordMeaning: The opening verse of the Shakradi Stuti — the most beloved daily prayer of the Shakta tradition. Eight names, each revealing a different face of the same reality: Mangala (all good), Shiva (benevolent), Sarvarthasadhike (the one who accomplishes all purposes),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The opening verse of the Shakradi Stuti — the most beloved daily prayer of the Shakta tradition. Eight names, each revealing a different face of the same reality: Mangala (all good), Shiva (benevolent), Sarvarthasadhike (the one who accomplishes all purposes),…
verses.hindi: हे सब मंगलों की मंगलरूपे! हे शिवे! हे सम्पूर्ण अर्थों की साधिके! हे शरण देने वाली! हे त्र्यम्बके! हे गौरि! हे नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है।
verses.science: Research on the psychological benefits of surrender (ACT therapy, compassion-focused therapy): genuine surrender to something larger than the ego — a higher purpose, the natural order, or the divine — is associated with significant reductions in anxiety, depression, and the exhaustion of constant self-reliance. "Sharanye" (the refuge) is the psychological state research calls "safe haven." The Devi Stuti is structured access to that state.
verses.lifeLesson: Recite or slowly read this verse — not as ritual but as genuine surrender. Say: "I am not in control of everything. I take refuge in the force that sustains all good, accomplishes all purposes, and shelters all who approach." That act of genuine surrender — even once — releases a kind of tension that willpower can never release.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशानां शक्तिभूते सनातनि । गुणाश्रये गुणमये नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sR^iShTisthitivinAshAnAM shaktibhUte sanAtani | guNAshraye guNamaye nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O eternal goddess, who constitutest the energy of creation, permanence and destruction, O thou abode of good qualities, who consistest of good qualities, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O eternal goddess, who constitutest the energy of creation, permanence and destruction, O thou abode of good qualities, who consistest of good qualities, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: तुम सृष्टि, पालन और संहारकी शक्तिभूता, सनातनी देवी, गुणोंका आधार तथा सर्वगुणमयी हो। नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: शरणागतदीनार्तपरित्राणपरायणे । सर्वस्यार्तिहरे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sharaNAgatadInArtaparitrANaparAyaNe | sarvasyArtihare devi nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who art devoted to the deliverance of the distressed and afflicted that seek refuge in thee, O goddess who takest away the affliction of all, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who art devoted to the deliverance of the distressed and afflicted that seek refuge in thee, O goddess who takest away the affliction of all, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: शरणमें आये हुए दीनों एवं पीड़ितोंकी रक्षामें संलग्न रहनेवाली तथा सबकी पीड़ा दूर करनेवाली नारायणी देवी! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: हंसयुक्तविमानस्थे ब्रह्माणीरूपधारिणि । कौशाम्भःक्षरिके देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: haMsayuktavimAnasthe brahmANIrUpadhAriNi | kaushAmbhaHkSharike devi nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who ridest in a heavenly car yoked with swans, who assumest the form of Brahmani, O goddess who sprinklest kusha-grass-steeped water, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who ridest in a heavenly car yoked with swans, who assumest the form of Brahmani, O goddess who sprinklest kusha-grass-steeped water, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: हंसयुक्तविमानस्थे ब्रह्माणीरूपधारिणि । कौशाम्भ:क्षरिके देवि नारायणि नमोस्तु ते

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलचन्द्राहिधरे महावृषभवाहिनि । माहेश्वरीस्वरूपेण नारायणि नमोऽस्तुते
verses.transliteration: trishUlachandrAhidhare mahAvR^iShabhavAhini | mAheshvarIsvarUpeNa nArAyaNi namo.astute
verses.translation: O thou who holdest a trident, the moon and a serpent, who art borne on a huge bull, with the natural character of Maheshvari, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who holdest a trident, the moon and a serpent, who art borne on a huge bull, with the natural character of Maheshvari, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: माहेश्वरीरूपसे त्रिशूल, चन्द्रमा एवं सर्पको धारण करनेवाली तथा महान्‌ वृषभकी पीठपर बैठनेवाली नारायणी देवी! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: मयूरकुक्कुटवृते महाशक्तिधरेऽनघे । कौमारीरूपसंस्थाने नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mayUrakukkuTavR^ite mahAshaktidhare.anaghe | kaumArIrUpasaMsthAne nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who art attended by the peacock and cock, who bearest a great spear, O sinless one; O thou who takest thy station in Kaumari's form, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who art attended by the peacock and cock, who bearest a great spear, O sinless one; O thou who takest thy station in Kaumari's form, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: मयूरकुक्कुटवृते महाशक्तिधरेडनघे । कौमारीरूपसंस्थाने नारायणि नमोस्तु ते

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गगृहीतपरमायुधे । प्रसीद वैष्णवीरूपे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sha~NkhachakragadAshAr~NgagR^ihItaparamAyudhe | prasIda vaiShNavIrUpe nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who holdest as thy finest weapons a conch, discus, club, and the bow Sharnga, be gracious, O thou who hast Vaishnavi's form; O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who holdest as thy finest weapons a conch, discus, club, and the bow Sharnga, be gracious, O thou who hast Vaishnavi's form; O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: शड़ख, चक्र, गदा और शार्क्रधनुषरूप उत्तम आयुधोंको धारण करनेवाली वैष्णवी शक्तिरूपा नारायणि! तुम प्रसन्न होओ। तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: गृहीतोग्रमहाचक्रे दंष्ट्रोद्धृतवसुन्धरे । वराहरूपिणि शिवे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: gR^ihItogramahAchakre daMShTroddhR^itavasundhare | varAharUpiNi shive nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who graspest a huge formidable discus, who hast uplifted the earth with thy tushes, O auspicious one, who hast a boar-like form, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who graspest a huge formidable discus, who hast uplifted the earth with thy tushes, O auspicious one, who hast a boar-like form, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: हाथमें भयानक महाचक्र लिये और दाढ़ोंपर धरतीको उठाये वाराहीरूपधारिणी कल्याणमयी नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहरूपेणोग्रेण हन्तुं दैत्यान् कृतोद्यमे । त्रैलोक्यत्राणसहिते नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: nR^isiMharUpeNogreNa hantuM daityAn kR^itodyame | trailokyatrANasahite nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who in the fierce man-lion form didst put forth thy efforts to slay the Daityas, O thou who art connected with the deliverance of the three worlds, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who in the fierce man-lion form didst put forth thy efforts to slay the Daityas, O thou who art connected with the deliverance of the three worlds, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: भयड्कर नृसिंहरूपसे दैत्योंके वधके लिये उद्योग करनेवाली तथा त्रिभुवनकी रक्षामें संलग्न रहनेवाली नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनि महावज्रे सहस्रनयनोज्ज्वले । वृत्रप्राणहरे चैन्द्रि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: kirITini mahAvajre sahasranayanojjvale | vR^itraprANahare chaindri nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who hast a diadem and a great thunderbolt, who art dazzling with a thousand eyes, and who tookest away Vritra's life-breath, O Aindri, Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who hast a diadem and a great thunderbolt, who art dazzling with a thousand eyes, and who tookest away Vritra's life-breath, O Aindri, Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: मस्तकपर किरीट और हाथमें महावज्र धारण करनेवाली, सहस्र नेत्रोंके कारण उद्दीप्त दिखायी देनेवाली और वृत्रासुरके प्राणोंका अपहरण करनेवाली इन्द्रशक्तिरूपा नारायणी देवि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: शिवदूतीस्वरूपेण हतदैत्यमहाबले । घोररूपे महारावे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: shivadUtIsvarUpeNa hatadaityamahAbale | ghorarUpe mahArAve nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who with the nature of Shivaduti slewest the mighty hosts of the Daityas, O thou of terrible form, of loud shrieks, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who with the nature of Shivaduti slewest the mighty hosts of the Daityas, O thou of terrible form, of loud shrieks, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: शिवदूतीरूपसे दैत्योंकी महती सेनाका संहार करनेवाली, भयड्ूकर रूप धारण तथा विकट गर्जना करनेवाली नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदने शिरोमालाविभूषणे । चामुण्डे मुण्डमथने नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: daMShTrAkarAlavadane shiromAlAvibhUShaNe | chAmuNDe muNDamathane nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who hast a face formidable with tushes, who art decorated with a garland of heads, O Chamunda, who grindest shaven heads, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who hast a face formidable with tushes, who art decorated with a garland of heads, O Chamunda, who grindest shaven heads, O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: दाढ़ोंके कारण विकराल मुखवाली मुण्डमालासे विभूषित मुण्डमर्दिनी चामुण्डारूपा नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मि लज्जे महाविद्ये श्रद्धे पुष्टि स्वधे ध्रुवे । महारात्रि महामाये नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: lakShmi lajje mahAvidye shraddhe puShTi svadhe dhruve | mahArAtri mahAmAye nArAyaNi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O Lakshmi, Modesty, Great Knowledge! O Faith, Nourishment, Svadha, Immoveable! O Great Night, Great Illusion! O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lakshmi, Modesty, Great Knowledge! O Faith, Nourishment, Svadha, Immoveable! O Great Night, Great Illusion! O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मी, लज्जा, महाविद्या, श्रद्धा, पुष्टि, स्वधा, ध्रुवा, महारात्रि तथा महा-अविद्यारूपा नारायणि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: मेधे सरस्वति वरे भूति बाभ्रवि तामसि । नियते त्वं प्रसीदेशे नारायणि नमोऽस्तुते
verses.transliteration: medhe sarasvati vare bhUti bAbhravi tAmasi | niyate tvaM prasIdeshe nArAyaNi namo.astute
verses.translation: O Mental Vigour, Sarasvati, Choice One! O Welfare, Wife of Babhru, Dark One! O Self-controlled Queen, be thou gracious! O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mental Vigour, Sarasvati, Choice One! O Welfare, Wife of Babhru, Dark One! O Self-controlled Queen, be thou gracious! O Narayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: मेथे सरस्वति वरे भूति बा भ्रवि तामसि | नियते त्वं प्रसीदेशे नारायणि नमोस्तुरें ते

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वरूपे सर्वेशे सर्वशक्तिसमन्विते । भयेभ्यस्त्राहि नो देवि दुर्गे देवि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: sarvasvarUpe sarveshe sarvashaktisamanvite | bhayebhyastrAhi no devi durge devi namo.astu te
verses.translation: O thou who hast the nature of all, Queen of all! O thou who possessest the might of all! From terrors save us, O goddess! O goddess Durga, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O thou who hast the nature of all, Queen of all! O thou who possessest the might of all! From terrors save us, O goddess! O goddess Durga, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: सर्वस्वरूपा, सर्वेश्वरी तथा सब प्रकारकी शक्तियोंसे सम्पन्न दिव्यरूपा दुर्गे देवि! सब भयोंसे हमारी रक्षा करो; तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते वदनं सौम्यं लोचनत्रयभूषितम् । पातु नः सर्वभूतेभ्यः कात्यायनि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: etatte vadanaM saumyaM lochanatrayabhUShitam | pAtu naH sarvabhUtebhyaH kAtyAyani namo.astu te
verses.translation: Kindly is this thy countenance, which is adorned with three eyes; may it guard us from all created things! O Katyayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: Kindly is this thy countenance, which is adorned with three eyes; may it guard us from all created things! O Katyayani, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: कात्यायनी! यह तीन लोचनोंसे विभूषित तुम्हारा सौम्य मुख सब प्रकारके भयोंसे हमारी रक्षा करे। तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालाकरालमत्युग्रमशेषासुरसूदनम् । त्रिशूलं पातु नो भीतेर्भद्रकालि नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: jvAlAkarAlamatyugramasheShAsurasUdanam | trishUlaM pAtu no bhIterbhadrakAli namo.astu te
verses.translation: Formidable with flames, exceedingly sharp, destroying the Asuras without quarter, may thy trident guard us from fear! O Bhadrakali, reverence be to thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: Formidable with flames, exceedingly sharp, destroying the Asuras without quarter, may thy trident guard us from fear! O Bhadrakali, reverence be to thee!
verses.hindi: भद्रकाली! ज्वालाओंके कारण विकराल प्रतीत होनेवाला, अत्यन्त भयड्कर और समस्त असुरोंका संहार करनेवाला तुम्हारा त्रिशूल भयसे हमें बचाये। तुम्हें नमस्कार है

verses.sanskrit: हिनस्ति दैत्यतेजांसि स्वनेनापूर्य या जगत् । सा घण्टा पातु नो देवि पापेभ्यो नः सुतानिव
verses.transliteration: hinasti daityatejAMsi svanenApUrya yA jagat | sA ghaNTA pAtu no devi pApebhyo naH sutAniva
verses.translation: Thy bell, that fills the world with its ringing and destroys the glories of the Daityas—may that bell guard us, O goddess, even us like children, from sins!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thy bell, that fills the world with its ringing and destroys the glories of the Daityas—may that bell guard us, O goddess, even us like children, from sins!
verses.hindi: देवि! जो अपनी ध्वनिसे सम्पूर्ण जगत्‌को व्याप्त करके दैत्योंके तेज नष्ट किये देता है, वह तुम्हारा घंटा हमलोगोंकी पापोंसे उसी प्रकार रक्षा करे, जैसे माता अपने पुत्रोंकी बुरे कर्मोसे रक्षा करती है

verses.sanskrit: असुरासृग्वसापङ्कचर्चितस्ते करोज्ज्वलः । शुभाय खड्गो भवतु चण्डिके त्वां नता वयम्
verses.transliteration: asurAsR^igvasApa~Nkacharchitaste karojjvalaH | shubhAya khaDgo bhavatu chaNDike tvAM natA vayam
verses.translation: Besmirched with the blood and fat of the Asuras as with mire, gleaming with rays in thy hand—may thy scymitar be for our welfare! O Chandika, to thee we bow!
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmirched with the blood and fat of the Asuras as with mire, gleaming with rays in thy hand—may thy scymitar be for our welfare! O Chandika, to thee we bow!
verses.hindi: चण्डिके! तुम्हारे हाथोंमें सुशोभित खड्ग, जो असुरोंके रक्त और चर्बीसे चर्चित है, हमारा मड़ल करे। हम तुम्हें नमस्कार करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: रोगानशेषानपहंसि तुष्टा रुष्टा तु कामान् सकलानभीष्टान् । त्वामाश्रितानां न विपन्नराणां त्वामाश्रिता ह्याश्रयतां प्रयान्ति
verses.transliteration: rogAnasheShAnapahaMsi tuShTA ruShTA tu kAmAn sakalAnabhIShTAn | tvAmAshritAnAM na vipannarANAM tvAmAshritA hyAshrayatAM prayAnti
verses.translation: Thou destroyest all sicknesses, when gratified; but when wrathful, destroyest all longed-for desires. No calamity befalls men who have sought unto thee! They who have sought unto thee become verily a refuge themselves!
verses.commentary: Sense: Thou destroyest all sicknesses, when gratified; but when wrathful, destroyest all longed-for desires. No calamity befalls men who have sought unto thee! They who have sought unto thee become verily a refuge themselves!
verses.hindi: देवि! तुम प्रसन्न होनेपर सब रोगोंको नष्ट कर देती हो और कुपित होनेपर मनोवाञ्छित सभी कामनाओंका नाश कर देती हो। जो लोग तुम्हारी शरणमें जा चुके हैं, उनपर विपत्ति तो आती ही नहीं। तुम्हारी शरणमें गये हुए मनुष्य दूसरोंको शरण देनेवाले हो जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कृतं यत्कदनं त्वयाद्य धर्मद्विषां देवि महासुराणाम् । रूपैरनेकैर्बहुधात्ममूर्तिं कृत्वाम्बिके तत्प्रकरोति कान्या
verses.transliteration: etatkR^itaM yatkadanaM tvayAdya dharmadviShAM devi mahAsurANAm | rUpairanekairbahudhAtmamUrtiM kR^itvAmbike tatprakaroti kAnyA
verses.translation: This slaughter that thou hast now wrought on the great Asuras who hate righteousness, O goddess, by multiplying thy body in many forms—O Ambika, what other goddess achieves that?
verses.commentary: Sense: This slaughter that thou hast now wrought on the great Asuras who hate righteousness, O goddess, by multiplying thy body in many forms—O Ambika, what other goddess achieves that?
verses.hindi: देवि! अम्बिके!! तुमने अपने स्वरूपको अनेक भागोंमें विभक्त करके नाना प्रकारके रूपोंसे जो इस समय इन धर्मद्रोही महादैत्योंका संहार किया है, वह सब दूसरी कौन कर सकती थी

verses.sanskrit: विद्यासु शास्त्रेषु विवेकदीपे- ष्वाद्येषु वाक्येषु च का त्वदन्या । ममत्वगर्तेऽतिमहान्धकारे विभ्रामयत्येतदतीव विश्वम्
verses.transliteration: vidyAsu shAstreShu vivekadIpe\- ShvAdyeShu vAkyeShu cha kA tvadanyA | mamatvagarte.atimahAndhakAre vibhrAmayatyetadatIva vishvam
verses.translation: In the sciences, in the scriptures, which need the lamp of discrimination, and in the ancient sayings, who but thou, within the pit of selfishness, wherein is exceeding great darkness, causes this universe to whirl about most grievously?
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sciences, in the scriptures, which need the lamp of discrimination, and in the ancient sayings, who but thou, within the pit of selfishness, wherein is exceeding great darkness, causes this universe to whirl about most grievously?
verses.hindi: विद्याओंमें, ज्ञानको प्रकाशित करनेवाले शास्त्रोंमें तथा आदिवाक्यों (वेदों)-में तुम्हारे सिवा और किसका वर्णन है? तथा तुमको छोड़कर दूसरी कौन ऐसी शक्ति है, जो इस विश्वको अज्ञानमय घोर अन्धकारसे परिपूर्ण ममतारूपी गढ़ेमें निरन्तर भटका रही हो

verses.sanskrit: रक्षांसि यत्रोग्रविषाश्च नागा यत्रारयो दस्युबलानि यत्र । दावानलो यत्र तथाब्धिमध्ये तत्र स्थिता त्वं परिपासि विश्वम्
verses.transliteration: rakShAMsi yatrograviShAshcha nAgA yatrArayo dasyubalAni yatra | dAvAnalo yatra tathAbdhimadhye tatra sthitA tvaM paripAsi vishvam
verses.translation: Wherever dwell Rakshasas and virulently-poisonous Nagas, wherever foes exist, wherever the powers of the Dasyus, and where flaming fire appears amid the ocean, there abiding thou dost safeguard the universe!
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever dwell Rakshasas and virulently-poisonous Nagas, wherever foes exist, wherever the powers of the Dasyus, and where flaming fire appears amid the ocean, there abiding thou dost safeguard the universe!
verses.hindi: रक्षांसि यत्रोग्रविषाश्ष नागा यत्रारयो दस्युबलानि यत्र । दावानलो यत्र तथाब्धिमध्ये तत्र स्थिता त्वं परिपासि विश्वम्‌

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरि त्वं परिपासि विश्वं विश्वात्मिका धारयसीह विश्वम् । विश्वेशवन्द्या भवती भवन्ति विश्वाश्रया ये त्वयि भक्तिनम्राः
verses.transliteration: vishveshvari tvaM paripAsi vishvaM vishvAtmikA dhArayasIha vishvam | vishveshavandyA bhavatI bhavanti vishvAshrayA ye tvayi bhaktinamrAH
verses.translation: O queen of the universe, thou safeguardest the universe! Thou hast the nature of the universe, for thou upholdest the universe. Thou art the lady worthy to be praised by the lord of the universe. They are the refuge of the universe, who bow in faith before thee!
verses.commentary: Sense: O queen of the universe, thou safeguardest the universe! Thou hast the nature of the universe, for thou upholdest the universe. Thou art the lady worthy to be praised by the lord of the universe. They are the refuge of the universe, who bow in faith before thee!
verses.hindi: विश्वेश्वरि! तुम विश्वका पालन करती हो। विश्वरूपा हो, इसलिये सम्पूर्ण विश्वको धारण करती हो। तुम भगवान्‌ विश्वनाथकी भी वन्दनीया हो। जो लोग भक्तिपूर्वक तुम्हारे सामने मस्तक झुकाते हैं, वे सम्पूर्ण विश्वको आश्रय देनेवाले होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: देवि प्रसीद परिपालय नोऽरिभीते- र्नित्यं यथासुरवधादधुनैव सद्यः । पापानि सर्वजगतां प्रशमं नयाशु उत्पातपाकजनितांश्च महोपसर्गान्
verses.transliteration: devi prasIda paripAlaya no.aribhIte\- rnityaM yathAsuravadhAdadhunaiva sadyaH | pApAni sarvajagatAM prashamaM nayAshu utpAtapAkajanitAMshcha mahopasargAn
verses.translation: O goddess, be gracious! Protect us wholly from fear of our foes perpetually, as thou hast at this very time saved us promptly by the slaughter of the Asuras! And bring thou quickly to rest the sins of all the worlds and the great calamities which have sprung from the maturing of portents!
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess, be gracious! Protect us wholly from fear of our foes perpetually, as thou hast at this very time saved us promptly by the slaughter of the Asuras! And bring thou quickly to rest the sins of all the worlds and the great calamities which have sprung from the maturing of…
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, be gracious! Protect us wholly from fear of our foes perpetually, as thou hast at this very time saved us promptly by the slaughter of the Asuras! And bring thou quickly to rest the sins of all the worlds and the great calamities which have sprung from the maturing of…
verses.hindi: देवि प्रसीद परिपालय नो5रिभीते- नित्यं यथासुरवधादधुनैव सद्य: । पापानि सर्वजगतां प्रशमं* नयाशु उत्पातपाकजनितांश्व महोपसर्गान्‌

verses.sanskrit: प्रणतानां प्रसीद त्वं देवि विश्वार्तिहारिणि । त्रैलोक्यवासिनामीड्ये लोकानां वरदा भव
verses.transliteration: praNatAnAM prasIda tvaM devi vishvArtihAriNi | trailokyavAsinAmIDye lokAnAM varadA bhava
verses.translation: To us who are prostrate be thou gracious, O goddess, who takest away affliction from the universe! O thou worthy of praise from the dwellers in the three worlds, bestow thou boons on the worlds!
verses.commentary: Sense: To us who are prostrate be thou gracious, O goddess, who takest away affliction from the universe! O thou worthy of praise from the dwellers in the three worlds, bestow thou boons on the worlds!
verses.hindi: विश्वकी पीड़ा दूर करनेवाली देवि! हम तुम्हारे चरणोंपर पड़े हुए हैं, हमपर प्रसन्न होओ। त्रिलोकनिवासियोंकी पूजनीया परमेश्वरि! सब लोगोंको वरदान दो

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: वरदाहं सुरगणा वरं यन्मनसेच्छथ । तं वृणुध्वं प्रयच्छामि जगतामुपकारकम्
verses.transliteration: varadAhaM suragaNA varaM yanmanasechChatha | taM vR^iNudhvaM prayachChAmi jagatAmupakArakam
verses.translation: I am ready to bestow a boon. O ye hosts of gods, choose whatever boon ye desire in your mind; I grant it as a thing that benefits the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am ready to bestow a boon. O ye hosts of gods, choose whatever boon ye desire in your mind; I grant it as a thing that benefits the worlds.
verses.hindi: देवताओ! मैं वर देनेको तैयार हूँ। तुम्हारे मनमें जिसकी इच्छा हो, वह वर माँग लो। संसारके लिये उस उपकारक वरको मैं अवश्य दूँगी

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः
verses.transliteration: devA UchuH
verses.translation: The gods spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods spoke:
verses.hindi: देवता बोले--

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाबाधाप्रशमनं त्रैलोक्यस्याखिलेश्वरि । एवमेव त्वया कार्यमस्मद्वैरिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvAbAdhAprashamanaM trailokyasyAkhileshvari | evameva tvayA kAryamasmadvairivinAshanam
verses.translation: O queen of all, complete thou thus indeed the pacification of every trouble of the three worlds, and the destruction of our enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: O queen of all, complete thou thus indeed the pacification of every trouble of the three worlds, and the destruction of our enemies.
verses.hindi: सर्वेश्वरि! तुम इसी प्रकार तीनों लोकोंकी समस्त बाधाओंको शान्त करो और हमारे शत्रुओंका नाश करती रहो

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते अष्टाविंशतिमे युगे । शुम्भो निशुम्भश्चैवान्यावुत्पत्स्येते महासुरौ
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate.antare prApte aShTAviMshatime yuge | shumbho nishumbhashchaivAnyAvutpatsyete mahAsurau
verses.translation: When the twenty-eighth age has arrived, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, two other great Asuras shall be born, Shumbha and Nishumbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twenty-eighth age has arrived, in the Vaivasvata Manvantara, two other great Asuras shall be born, Shumbha and Nishumbha.
verses.hindi: देवताओ! वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरके अट्बाईसवें युगमें शुम्भ और निशुम्भ नामके दो अन्य महादैत्य उत्पन्न होंगे

verses.sanskrit: नन्दगोपगृहे जाता यशोदागर्भसम्भवा । ततस्तौ नाशयिष्यामि विन्ध्याचलनिवासिनी
verses.transliteration: nandagopagR^ihe jAtA yashodAgarbhasambhavA | tatastau nAshayiShyAmi vindhyAchalanivAsinI
verses.translation: Then, born as the offspring of Yashoda's womb in the cowherd Nanda's house, and dwelling on the Vindhya mountains, I will destroy them both.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, born as the offspring of Yashoda's womb in the cowherd Nanda's house, and dwelling on the Vindhya mountains, I will destroy them both.
verses.hindi: तब मैं ननन्‍्दगोपके घरमें उनकी पत्नी यशोदाके गर्भसे अवतीर्ण हो किन्ध्याचलमें जाकर रहूँगी और उक्त दोनों असुरोंका नाश करूँगी

verses.sanskrit: पुनरप्यतिरौद्रेण रूपेण पृथिवीतले । अवतीर्य हनिष्यामि वैप्रचित्तांश्च दानवान्
verses.transliteration: punarapyatiraudreNa rUpeNa pR^ithivItale | avatIrya haniShyAmi vaiprachittAMshcha dAnavAn
verses.translation: And again, becoming incarnate in a very terrible form on the face of the earth, I will slay the Vaiprachitta Danavas;
verses.commentary: Sense: And again, becoming incarnate in a very terrible form on the face of the earth, I will slay the Vaiprachitta Danavas;
verses.hindi: पुनः अत्यंत भयानक रूप धारण करके मैं पृथ्वी पर अवतार लूँगी और वैप्रचित्त नामक दानवों का वध करूँगी।

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयन्त्याश्च तानुग्रान् वैप्रचित्तान् महासुरान् । रक्ता दन्ता भविष्यन्ति दाडिमीकुसुमोपमाः
verses.transliteration: bhakShayantyAshcha tAnugrAn vaiprachittAn mahAsurAn | raktA dantA bhaviShyanti dADimIkusumopamAH
verses.translation: and when I devour those fierce and great Vaiprachitta Asuras, my teeth shall become red like the flowers of the pomegranate.
verses.commentary: Sense: and when I devour those fierce and great Vaiprachitta Asuras, my teeth shall become red like the flowers of the pomegranate.
verses.hindi: उन भयंकर महादैत्योंको भक्षण करते समय मेरे दाँत अनारके फूलकी भाँति लाल हो जायँगे

verses.sanskrit: ततो मां देवताः स्वर्गे मर्त्यलोके च मानवाः । स्तुवन्तो व्याहरिष्यन्ति सततं रक्तदन्तिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tato mAM devatAH svarge martyaloke cha mAnavAH | stuvanto vyAhariShyanti satataM raktadantikAm
verses.translation: Hence the gods in Svarga and men in the world of mortals, praising me, shall always talk of me as 'Red-toothed' (Raktadantika).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the gods in Svarga and men in the world of mortals, praising me, shall always talk of me as 'Red-toothed' (Raktadantika).
verses.hindi: तब स्वर्गमें देवता और मर्त्यलोकमें मनुष्य सदा मेरी स्तुति करते हुए मुझे 'रक्तदन्तिका' कहेंगे

verses.sanskrit: भूयश्च शतवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यामनम्भसि । मुनिभिः संस्मृता भूमौ सम्भविष्याम्ययोनिजा
verses.transliteration: bhUyashcha shatavArShikyAmanAvR^iShTyAmanambhasi | munibhiH saMsmR^itA bhUmau sambhaviShyAmyayonijA
verses.translation: And again, after a period of a hundred years during which no rain and water shall fall, praised by the munis I shall be born, but not womb-begotten, on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: And again, after a period of a hundred years during which no rain and water shall fall, praised by the munis I shall be born, but not womb-begotten, on the earth.
verses.hindi: भूयश्व शतवार्षिक्यामनावृष्टयामनम्भसि । मुनिशि: संस्तुता भूमौ संभविष्याम्ययोनिजा

verses.sanskrit: ततः शतेन नेत्राणां निरीक्षिष्याम्यहं मुनीन् । कीर्तयिष्यन्ति मनुजाः शताक्षीमिति मां ततः
verses.transliteration: tataH shatena netrANAM nirIkShiShyAmyahaM munIn | kIrtayiShyanti manujAH shatAkShImiti mAM tataH
verses.translation: Then, because I shall behold the munis with a hundred eyes, mankind shall therefore celebrate me as 'Hundred-eyed' (Shatakshi).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, because I shall behold the munis with a hundred eyes, mankind shall therefore celebrate me as 'Hundred-eyed' (Shatakshi).
verses.hindi: और सौ नेत्रोंसे मुनियोंकी ओर देखूँगी। अतः मनुष्य “शताक्षी” इस नामसे मेरा कीर्तन करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहमखिलं लोकमात्मदेहसमुद्भवैः । भरिष्यामि सुराः शाकैरावृष्टेः प्राणधारकैः
verses.transliteration: tato.ahamakhilaM lokamAtmadehasamudbhavaiH | bhariShyAmi surAH shAkairAvR^iShTeH prANadhArakaiH
verses.translation: Next, O ye gods, I shall support the whole world with the life-sustaining vegetables, which shall grow out of my own body, during a period of heavy rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Next, O ye gods, I shall support the whole world with the life-sustaining vegetables, which shall grow out of my own body, during a period of heavy rain.
verses.hindi: देवताओ! उस समय मैं अपने शरीरसे उत्पन्न हुए शाकोंद्वारा समस्त संसारका भरण-पोषण करूँगी। जबतक वर्षा नहीं होगी, तबतक वे शाक ही सबके प्राणोंकी रक्षा करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: शाकम्भरीति विख्यातिं तदा यास्याम्यहं भुवि । तत्रैव च वधिष्यामि दुर्गमाख्यं महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: shAkambharIti vikhyAtiM tadA yAsyAmyahaM bhuvi | tatraiva cha vadhiShyAmi durgamAkhyaM mahAsuram
verses.translation: I shall gain fame on the earth then as Shakambhari; and in that very period I shall slay the great Asura named Durgama.
