verses.commentary: Sense: I shall gain fame on the earth then as Shakambhari; and in that very period I shall slay the great Asura named Durgama.
verses.hindi: ऐसा करनेके कारण पृथ्वीपर 'शाकम्भरी” के नामसे मेरी ख्याति होगी। उसी अवतारमें मैं दुर्गम नामक महादैत्यका वध भी करूँगी

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गादेवीति विख्यातं तन्मे नाम भविष्यति । पुनश्चाहं यदा भीमं रूपं कृत्वा हिमाचले
verses.transliteration: durgAdevIti vikhyAtaM tanme nAma bhaviShyati | punashchAhaM yadA bhImaM rUpaM kR^itvA himAchale
verses.translation: Thereby my name shall become celebrated as the goddess Durga. And again, when taking a terrible form on mount Himavat,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby my name shall become celebrated as the goddess Durga. And again, when taking a terrible form on mount Himavat,
verses.hindi: दुर्गा देवीति विख्यातं तन्‍्मे नाम भविष्यति । पुनश्चाहं यदा भीम॑ रूप॑ कृत्वा हिमाचले

verses.sanskrit: रक्षांसि भक्षयिष्यामि मुनीनां त्राणकारणात् । तदा मां मुनयः सर्वे स्तोष्यन्त्यानम्रमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: rakShAMsi bhakShayiShyAmi munInAM trANakAraNAt | tadA mAM munayaH sarve stoShyantyAnamramUrtayaH
verses.translation: I shall destroy Rakshasas for the sake of delivering the munis; all the munis, bowing their bodies reverently, shall laud me then;
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall destroy Rakshasas for the sake of delivering the munis; all the munis, bowing their bodies reverently, shall laud me then;
verses.hindi: इससे मेरा नाम “दुगदिवी” के रूपसे प्रसिद्ध होगा। फिर जब मैं भीमरूप धारण करके मुनियोंकी रक्षाके लिये हिमालयपर रहनेवाले राक्षसोंका भक्षण करूँगी, उस समय सब मुनि भक्तिसे नतमस्तक होकर मेरी स्तुति करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: भीमादेवीति विख्यातं तन्मे नाम भविष्यति । यदारुणाख्यस्त्रैलोक्ये महाबाधां करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: bhImAdevIti vikhyAtaM tanme nAma bhaviShyati | yadAruNAkhyastrailokye mahAbAdhAM kariShyati
verses.translation: hence my name 'The terrible goddess' (Bhimadevi) shall become celebrated. When the Asura named Aruna shall work great trouble in the three worlds,
verses.commentary: Sense: hence my name 'The terrible goddess' (Bhimadevi) shall become celebrated. When the Asura named Aruna shall work great trouble in the three worlds,
verses.hindi: भीमा देवीति विख्यातं तन्मे नाम भविष्यति । यदारुणाख्यस्त्रैलेक्ये महाबाधां करिष्यति

verses.sanskrit: तदाहं भ्रामरं रूपं कृत्वासङ्ख्येयषट्पदम् । त्रैलोक्यस्य हितार्थाय वधिष्यामि महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: tadAhaM bhrAmaraM rUpaM kR^itvAsa~NkhyeyaShaTpadam | trailokyasya hitArthAya vadhiShyAmi mahAsuram
verses.translation: I shall take a bee-like form, the form of innumerable bees, and shall slay the great Asura for the welfare of the three worlds,
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall take a bee-like form, the form of innumerable bees, and shall slay the great Asura for the welfare of the three worlds,
verses.hindi: तदाहं भ्रामरं रूप॑ कृत्वाउसंख्येयषट्पदम्‌ । त्रैलोक्यस्य हितार्थाय वधिष्यामि महासुरम्‌

verses.sanskrit: भ्रामरीति च मां लोकास्तदा स्तोष्यन्ति सर्वतः । इत्थं यदा यदा बाधा दानवोत्था भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ yadā yadā bādhā dānavotthā bhaviṣyati | tadā tadāvatīryāhaṃ kariṣyāmyarisaṃkṣayam ||
verses.translation: In this manner, whenever there shall be trouble arising from the demonic forces, I shall descend each time and destroy the enemies.
verses.wordMeaning: The Devi makes the same promise as Krishna in the Bhagavad Gita (Chapter 4) — repeated manifestation to restore balance when evil overwhelms good.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devi makes the same promise as Krishna in the Bhagavad Gita (Chapter 4) — repeated manifestation to restore balance when evil overwhelms good.…
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार जब-जब भी दैत्यों से उत्पन्न बाधा होगी, तब-तब मैं अवतरित होकर शत्रुओं का संहार करूँगी।
verses.science: Systems theory and homeostasis: all living systems have built-in self-correcting mechanisms. When a system is overwhelmed by disorder (the "asura" principle), corrective forces (the "devi" principle) naturally emerge to restore balance. This is not metaphysics — it is the fundamental operating principle of biological systems from cells to ecosystems. The Goddess's promise is a mythological description of the universe's self-healing capacity.
verses.lifeLesson: Whenever the "demons" in your life — fear, addiction, destructive patterns, toxic relationships — seem overwhelming, remember the Devi's promise: the power to restore balance is inherent in existence itself. You are not alone in the fight. Something within you and within life itself is on the side of your healing and wholeness.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तदावतीर्याहं करिष्याम्यरिसङ्क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tadA tadAvatIryAhaM kariShyAmyarisa~NkShayam
verses.translation: at each such time I shall become incarnate and accomplish the foes' destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: at each such time I shall become incarnate and accomplish the foes' destruction.
verses.hindi: उस समय सब लोग “भ्रामरी” के नामसे चारों ओर मेरी स्तुति करेंगे। इस प्रकार जब-जब संसारमें दानवी बाधा उपस्थित होगी, तब-तब अवतार लेकर मैं शत्रुओंका संहार करूँगी

verses.sanskrit: ॐ देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: OM devyuvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The goddess spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Om. The goddess spoke:
verses.hindi: चाय आता ३७० | छ आओ ३. पा०--लम्भा०। २. पा०--वक्त्रास्तु वि०। ३. पा०--मुक्ति। ४. पा०--माड्ल्ये। ३. पा०--पुष्टे। २. पा०-ररात्रे। 3. पा०--महामाये। ४. शान्तनवी टीकाकारने यहाँ एक श्लोक अधिक पाठ माना है, जो इस प्रकार है--'सर्वतःपाणिपादान्ते सर्वतो$क्षिशिरोमुखे। सर्वत:श्रवणघ्नाणे नारायणि नमोस्तु ते ।॥। ” ५. पा०--ददासि कामान्‌। ६. पा०--च शमं। ३. पा०--कुले। २. पा०--क्षययिष्यामि। (क्षपयिष्यामि इति वा)। द्वादशो<5 ध्याय: देवी-चरित्रोंके पाठका माहात्म्य ध्यान (३० विद्युद्दामसमप्रभां मृगपतिस्कन्धस्थितां भीषणां कन्याभि: करवालखेटविलसद्धस्ताभिरासेविताम्‌ । हस्तैश्नक्रगदासिखेटविशिखांश्चापं गुणं तर्जनीं बिभ्राणामनलात्मिकां शशिधरां दुर्गा त्रिनेत्रां भजे ।। मैं तीन नेत्रोंवाली दुगदिवीका ध्यान करता हूँ, उनके श्रीअड़ोंकी प्रभा बिजलीके समान है। वे सिंहके कंधेपर बैठी हुई भयड्कर प्रतीत होती हैं। हाथोंमें तलवार, ढाल लिये अनेक कन्याएँ उनकी सेवामें खड़ी हैं। वे अपने हाथोंमें चक्र, गदा, तलवार, ढाल, बाण, धनुष, पाश और तर्जनी मुद्रा धारण किये हुए हैं। उनका स्वरूप अग्निमय है तथा वे माथेपर चन्द्रमाका मुकुट धारण करती हैं।) देव्युवाच

verses.sanskrit: एभिः स्तवैश्च मां नित्यं स्तोष्यते यः समाहितः । तस्याहं सकलां बाधां शमयिष्याम्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: ebhiH stavaishcha mAM nityaM stoShyate yaH samAhitaH | tasyAhaM sakalAM bAdhAM shamayiShyAmyasaMshayam
verses.translation: And whoever with mind composed shall praise me constantly with these hymns, I will quiet down every trouble for him assuredly.
verses.commentary: Sense: And whoever with mind composed shall praise me constantly with these hymns, I will quiet down every trouble for him assuredly.
verses.hindi: देवताओ! जो एकाग्रचित्त होकर प्रतिदिन इन स्तुतियोंसे मेरा स्तवन करेगा, उसकी सारी बाधा मैं निश्चय ही दूर कर दूँगी

verses.sanskrit: मधुकैटभनाशं च महिषासुरघातनम् । कीर्तयिष्यन्ति ये तद्वद्वधं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः
verses.transliteration: madhukaiTabhanAshaM cha mahiShAsuraghAtanam | kIrtayiShyanti ye tadvadvadhaM shumbhanishumbhayoH
verses.translation: And those who shall celebrate the destruction of Madhu and Kaitabha, the slaughter of the Asura Mahisha, and the slaying of Shumbha and Nishumbha likewise;
verses.commentary: Sense: And those who shall celebrate the destruction of Madhu and Kaitabha, the slaughter of the Asura Mahisha, and the slaying of Shumbha and Nishumbha likewise;
verses.hindi: जो मधु-कैटभका नाश, महिषासुरका वध तथा शुम्भ-निशुम्भके संहारके प्रसड़का पाठ करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नवम्यां चैकचेतसः । श्रोष्यन्ति चैव ये भक्त्या मम माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: aShTamyAM cha chaturdashyAM navamyAM chaikachetasaH | shroShyanti chaiva ye bhaktyA mama mAhAtmyamuttamam
verses.translation: and those also who shall listen in faith to this poem of my sublime majesty on the eighth day of the lunar fortnight, on the fourteenth and on the ninth, with intent mind—
verses.commentary: Sense: and those also who shall listen in faith to this poem of my sublime majesty on the eighth day of the lunar fortnight, on the fourteenth and on the ninth, with intent mind—
verses.hindi: तथा अष्टमी, चतुर्दशी और नवमीको भी जो एकाग्रचित्त हो भक्तिपूर्वक मेरे उत्तम माहात्म्यका श्रवण करेंगे

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां दुष्कृतं किञ्चिद्दुष्कृतोत्था न चापदः । भविष्यति न दारिद्र्यं न चैवेष्टवियोजनम्
verses.transliteration: na teShAM duShkR^itaM ki~nchidduShkR^itotthA na chApadaH | bhaviShyati na dAridryaM na chaiveShTaviyojanam
verses.translation: to them shall happen no wrong-doing whatever, nor calamities that arise from wrong-doing, nor poverty, nor indeed deprivation of their desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: to them shall happen no wrong-doing whatever, nor calamities that arise from wrong-doing, nor poverty, nor indeed deprivation of their desires.
verses.hindi: न तेषां दुष्कृतं किज्चिद्‌ दुष्कृतोत्था न चापद: । भविष्यति न दारिद्र्यं न चैवेष्टवियोजनम्‌

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुभ्यो न भयं तस्य दस्युतो वा न राजतः । न शस्त्रानलतोयौघात् कदाचित् सम्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: shatrubhyo na bhayaM tasya dasyuto vA na rAjataH | na shastrAnalatoyaughAt kadAchit sambhaviShyati
verses.translation: Never shall he experience fear from enemies, from robbers, nor from kings, nor from weapon or fire or water-flood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Never shall he experience fear from enemies, from robbers, nor from kings, nor from weapon or fire or water-flood.
verses.hindi: इतना ही नहीं, उन्हें शत्रुसे, लुटेरोंसे, राजासे, शस्त्रसे, अग्निसे तथा जलकी राशिसे भी कभी भय नहीं होगा

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्ममैतन्माहात्म्यं पठितव्यं समाहितैः । श्रोतव्यं च सदा भक्त्या परं स्वस्त्ययनं महत्
verses.transliteration: tasmAnmamaitanmAhAtmyaM paThitavyaM samAhitaiH | shrotavyaM cha sadA bhaktyA paraM svastyayanaM mahat
verses.translation: Hence this poem of my majesty must be read by men of composed minds and listened to by them always with faith, for it is the supreme course of blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence this poem of my majesty must be read by men of composed minds and listened to by them always with faith, for it is the supreme course of blessings.
verses.hindi: इसलिये सबको एकाग्रचित्त होकर भक्तिपूर्वक मेरे इस माहात्म्यको सदा पढ़ना और सुनना चाहिये। यह परम कल्याणकारक है

verses.sanskrit: उपसर्गानशेषांस्तु महामारीसमुद्भवान् । तथा त्रिविधमुत्पातं माहात्म्यं शमयेन्मम
verses.transliteration: upasargAnasheShAMstu mahAmArIsamudbhavAn | tathA trividhamutpAtaM mAhAtmyaM shamayenmama
verses.translation: Now may this poem of my majesty quell all kinds of calamities, which arise from grievous pestilence, and the three-fold portent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now may this poem of my majesty quell all kinds of calamities, which arise from grievous pestilence, and the three-fold portent.
verses.hindi: उपसर्गानशेषांस्तु महामारीसमुद्धवान्‌ । तथा त्रिविधमुत्पातं माहात्म्यं शमयेन्मम

verses.sanskrit: यत्रैतत्पठ्यते सम्यङ्नित्यमायतने मम । सदा न तद्विमोक्ष्यामि सान्निध्यं तत्र मे स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yatraitatpaThyate samya~NnityamAyatane mama | sadA na tadvimokShyAmi sAnnidhyaM tatra me sthitam
verses.translation: Where this poem is duly read constantly at my sanctuary, I will never forsake that place, and there my presence is fixed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where this poem is duly read constantly at my sanctuary, I will never forsake that place, and there my presence is fixed.
verses.hindi: मेरे जिस मन्दिरमें प्रतिदिन विधिपूर्वक मेरे इस माहात्म्यका पाठ किया जाता है, उस स्थानको मैं कभी नहीं छोड़ती। वहाँ सदा ही मेरा संनिधान बना रहता है

verses.sanskrit: बलिप्रदाने पूजायामग्निकार्ये महोत्सवे । सर्वं ममैतन्माहात्म्यम् उच्चार्यं श्राव्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: balipradAne pUjAyAmagnikArye mahotsave | sarvaM mamaitanmAhAtmyam uchchAryaM shrAvyameva cha
verses.translation: At the offering of the bali, and during worship, in the ceremonies with fire, and at a great festival, all this story of my exploits must verily be proclaimed and listened to.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the offering of the bali, and during worship, in the ceremonies with fire, and at a great festival, all this story of my exploits must verily be proclaimed and listened to.
verses.hindi: बलिदान, पूजा, होम तथा महोत्सवके अवसरोंपर मेरे इस चरित्रका पूरा-पूरा पाठ और श्रवण करना चाहिये

verses.sanskrit: जानताजानता वापि बलिपूजां यथा कृताम् । प्रतीक्षिष्याम्यहं प्रीत्या वह्निहोमं तथाकृतम्
verses.transliteration: jAnatAjAnatA vApi balipUjAM yathA kR^itAm | pratIkShiShyAmyahaM prItyA vahnihomaM tathAkR^itam
verses.translation: I will accept with kindliness both the bali worship that is paid, and the oblation by fire that is offered, by him who understands or him who understands not.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will accept with kindliness both the bali worship that is paid, and the oblation by fire that is offered, by him who understands or him who understands not.
verses.hindi: जानता<जानता वापि बलिपूजां तथा कृताम्‌ | प्रतीच्छिष्याम्यहं: प्रीत्या वह्लिहोमं तथा कृतम्‌

verses.sanskrit: शरत्काले महापूजा क्रियते या च वार्षिकी । तस्यां ममैतन्माहात्म्यं श्रुत्वा भक्तिसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sharatkAle mahApUjA kriyate yA cha vArShikI | tasyAM mamaitanmAhAtmyaM shrutvA bhaktisamanvitaH
verses.translation: For the destruction of evil-doers, out of the desire for the good of the people and for the establishment of dharma — I appear age after age.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the destruction of evil-doers, out of the desire for the good of the people and for the establishment of dharma — I appear age after age.
verses.hindi: शरत्कालमें जो वार्षिक महापूजा की जाती है, उस अवसरपर जो मेरे इस माहात्म्यको भक्तिपूर्वक सुनेगा, वह मनुष्य मेरे प्रसादसे सब बाधाओंसे मुक्त तथा धन, धान्य एवं पुत्रसे सम्पन्न होगा--इसमें तनिक भी सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाबाधाविनिर्मुक्तो धनधान्यसमन्वितः । मनुष्यो मत्प्रसादेन भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarvAbAdhAvinirmukto dhanadhAnyasamanvitaH | manuShyo matprasAdena bhaviShyati na saMshayaH
verses.translation: shall assuredly through my favour be delivered from every trouble, and be blessed with riches, grain and children.
verses.commentary: Sense: shall assuredly through my favour be delivered from every trouble, and be blessed with riches, grain and children.
verses.hindi: शरत्कालमें जो वार्षिक महापूजा की जाती है, उस अवसरपर जो मेरे इस माहात्म्यको भक्तिपूर्वक सुनेगा, वह मनुष्य मेरे प्रसादसे सब बाधाओंसे मुक्त तथा धन, धान्य एवं पुत्रसे सम्पन्न होगा--इसमें तनिक भी सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा ममैतन्माहात्म्यं तथा चोत्पत्तयः शुभाः । पराक्रमं च युद्धेषु जायते निर्भयः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: shrutvA mamaitanmAhAtmyaM tathA chotpattayaH shubhAH | parAkramaM cha yuddheShu jAyate nirbhayaH pumAn
verses.translation: From listening to this poem of my majesty moreover come splendid issues and prowess in battles, and a man becomes fearless.
verses.commentary: Sense: From listening to this poem of my majesty moreover come splendid issues and prowess in battles, and a man becomes fearless.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा ममैतन्माहात्म्यं तथा चोत्पत्तय: शुभा: । पराक्रमं च युद्धेषु जायते निर्भय: पुमान्‌

verses.sanskrit: रिपवः सङ्क्षयं यान्ति कल्याणं चोपपद्यते । नन्दते च कुलं पुंसां माहात्म्यं मम शृण्वताम्
verses.transliteration: ripavaH sa~NkShayaM yAnti kalyANaM chopapadyate | nandate cha kulaM puMsAM mAhAtmyaM mama shR^iNvatAm
verses.translation: When men listen to this poem of my majesty, enemies pass to destruction, and prosperity accrues, and their family rejoices.
verses.commentary: Sense: When men listen to this poem of my majesty, enemies pass to destruction, and prosperity accrues, and their family rejoices.
verses.hindi: मेरे माहात्म्यका श्रवण करनेवाले पुरुषोंके शत्रु नष्ट हो जाते हैं, उन्हें कल्याणकी प्राप्ति होती तथा उनका कुल आनन्दित रहता है

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिकर्मणि सर्वत्र तथा दुःस्वप्नदर्शने । ग्रहपीडासु चोग्रासु माहात्म्यं शृणुयान्मम
verses.transliteration: shAntikarmaNi sarvatra tathA duHsvapnadarshane | grahapIDAsu chogrAsu mAhAtmyaM shR^iNuyAnmama
verses.translation: Let a man listen to this poem of my majesty everywhere, at a ceremony for securing tranquillity, and after seeing an ill-dream, and when planets are greatly eclipsed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let a man listen to this poem of my majesty everywhere, at a ceremony for securing tranquillity, and after seeing an ill-dream, and when planets are greatly eclipsed.
verses.hindi: शान्तिकर्मणि सर्वत्र तथा दुःस्वप्रदर्शने । ग्रहपीडासु चोग्रासु माहात्म्यं शूणुयान्मम

verses.sanskrit: उपसर्गाः शमं यान्ति ग्रहपीडाश्च दारुणाः । दुःस्वप्नं च नृभिर्दृष्टं सुस्वप्नमुपजायते
verses.transliteration: upasargAH shamaM yAnti grahapIDAshcha dAruNAH | duHsvapnaM cha nR^ibhirdR^iShTaM susvapnamupajAyate
verses.translation: Thereby portents turn into calm, and also dreadful eclipses of the planets, and also an ill-dream which men have seen; and a sweet dream appears.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby portents turn into calm, and also dreadful eclipses of the planets, and also an ill-dream which men have seen; and a sweet dream appears.
verses.hindi: इससे सब विघ्न तथा भयड्कर ग्रह-पीड़ाएँ शान्त हो जाती हैं और मनुष्योंद्वारा देखा हुआ दुःस्वप्न शुभ स्वप्नमें परिवर्तित हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: बालग्रहाभिभूतानां बालानां शान्तिकारकम् । सङ्घातभेदे च नृणां मैत्रीकरणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bAlagrahAbhibhUtAnAM bAlAnAM shAntikArakam | sa~NghAtabhede cha nR^iNAM maitrIkaraNamuttamam
verses.translation: It produces peacefulness in children who have been possessed by the demon that seizes children, and it is the best promoter of friendship among men when union is dissolved;
verses.commentary: Sense: It produces peacefulness in children who have been possessed by the demon that seizes children, and it is the best promoter of friendship among men when union is dissolved;
verses.hindi: बालग्रहोंसे आक्रान्त हुए बालकोंके लिये यह माहात्म्य शान्तिकारक है तथा मनुष्योंके संगठनमें फूट होनेपर यह अच्छी प्रकार मित्रता करानेवाला होता है

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वृत्तानामशेषाणां बलहानिकरं परम् । रक्षोभूतपिशाचानां पठनादेव नाशनम्
verses.transliteration: durvR^ittAnAmasheShANAM balahAnikaraM param | rakShobhUtapishAchAnAM paThanAdeva nAshanam
verses.translation: it is the most potent diminisher of the power of all men of ill livelihood; verily through reading it comes the destruction of Rakshasas, goblins and Pishachas.
verses.commentary: Sense: it is the most potent diminisher of the power of all men of ill livelihood; verily through reading it comes the destruction of Rakshasas, goblins and Pishachas.
verses.hindi: यह माहात्म्य समस्त दुराचारियोंके बलका नाश करनेवाला है। इसके पाठमात्रसे राक्षसों, भूतों और पिशाचोंका नाश हो जाता है

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं ममैतन्माहात्म्यं मम सन्निधिकारकम् । पशुपुष्पार्घ्यधूपैश्च गन्धदीपैस्तथोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: sarvaM mamaitanmAhAtmyaM mama sannidhikArakam | pashupuShpArghyadhUpaishcha gandhadIpaistathottamaiH
verses.translation: All this poem of my majesty brings a man near unto me. And by means of cattle, flowers, arghya offerings and incenses, and by the finest perfumes and lamps,
verses.commentary: Sense: All this poem of my majesty brings a man near unto me. And by means of cattle, flowers, arghya offerings and incenses, and by the finest perfumes and lamps,
verses.hindi: मेरा यह सब माहात्म्य मेरे सामीप्यकी प्राप्ति करानेवाला है। पशु, पुष्प, अर्घ्य, धूप, दीप, गन्ध आदि उत्तम सामग्रियोंद्वारा पूजन करनेसे, ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन करानेसे, होम करनेसे, प्रतिदिन अभिषेक करनेसे, नाना प्रकारके अन्य भोगोंका अर्पण करनेसे तथा दान देने आदिसे एक वर्षतक जो मेरी आराधना की जाती है और उससे मुझे जितनी प्रसन्नता होती है, उतनी प्रसन्नता मेरे इस उत्तम चरित्रका एक बार श्रवण करनेमात्रसे हो जाती है। यह माहात्म्य श्रवण करनेपर पापोंको हर लेता और आरोग्य प्रदान करता है

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां भोजनैर्होमैः प्रोक्षणीयैरहर्निशम् । अन्यैश्च विविधैर्भोगैः प्रदानैर्वत्सरेण या
verses.transliteration: viprANAM bhojanairhomaiH prokShaNIyairaharnisham | anyaishcha vividhairbhogaiH pradAnairvatsareNa yA
verses.translation: by feasts given to brahmans, by oblations, by sprinkled water day and night, and by various other objects of enjoyment, by gifts yearly—
verses.commentary: Sense: by feasts given to brahmans, by oblations, by sprinkled water day and night, and by various other objects of enjoyment, by gifts yearly—
verses.hindi: मेरा यह सब माहात्म्य मेरे सामीप्यकी प्राप्ति करानेवाला है। पशु, पुष्प, अर्घ्य, धूप, दीप, गन्ध आदि उत्तम सामग्रियोंद्वारा पूजन करनेसे, ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन करानेसे, होम करनेसे, प्रतिदिन अभिषेक करनेसे, नाना प्रकारके अन्य भोगोंका अर्पण करनेसे तथा दान देने आदिसे एक वर्षतक जो मेरी आराधना की जाती है और उससे मुझे जितनी प्रसन्नता होती है, उतनी प्रसन्नता मेरे इस उत्तम चरित्रका एक बार श्रवण करनेमात्रसे हो जाती है। यह माहात्म्य श्रवण करनेपर पापोंको हर लेता और आरोग्य प्रदान करता है

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिर्मे क्रियते सास्मिन् सकृदुच्चरिते श्रुते । श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथारोग्यं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: prItirme kriyate sAsmin sakR^iduchcharite shrute | shrutaM harati pApAni tathArogyaM prayachChati
verses.translation: the favour which comes by such means, such favour is won from me when this story of my noble exploits is once heard. When heard, it takes away sins and confers perfect health.
verses.commentary: Sense: the favour which comes by such means, such favour is won from me when this story of my noble exploits is once heard. When heard, it takes away sins and confers perfect health.
verses.hindi: प्रीतिममे क्रियते सास्मिन्‌ सकृत्सुचरिते श्रुते । श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथा<5<रोग्यं प्रयच्छति

verses.sanskrit: रक्षां करोति भूतेभ्यो जन्मनां कीर्तनं मम । युद्धेषु चरितं यन्मे दुष्टदैत्यनिबर्हणम्
verses.transliteration: rakShAM karoti bhUtebhyo janmanAM kIrtanaM mama | yuddheShu charitaM yanme duShTadaityanibarhaNam
verses.translation: This celebration of my births preserves created beings from evil spirits; and from this story of my exploits in battles, the annihilation of the wicked Daityas,
verses.commentary: Sense: This celebration of my births preserves created beings from evil spirits; and from this story of my exploits in battles, the annihilation of the wicked Daityas,
verses.hindi: मेरे प्रादुर्भावका कीर्तन समस्त भूतोंसे रक्षा करता है तथा मेरा युद्धविषयक चरित्र दुष्ट दैत्योंका संहार करनेवाला है

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिञ्छ्रुते वैरिकृतं भयं पुंसां न जायते । युष्माभिः स्तुतयो याश्च याश्च ब्रह्मर्षिभिः कृताः
verses.transliteration: tasmi~nChrute vairikR^itaM bhayaM puMsAM na jAyate | yuShmAbhiH stutayo yAshcha yAshcha brahmarShibhiH kR^itAH
verses.translation: when it is heard, no fear that is caused by enmity springs up among men. And the hymns which ye have composed, and those composed by brahman rishis,
verses.commentary: Sense: when it is heard, no fear that is caused by enmity springs up among men. And the hymns which ye have composed, and those composed by brahman rishis,
verses.hindi: इसके श्रवण करनेपर मनुष्योंको शत्रुका भय नहीं रहता। देवताओ! तुमने और ब्रह्मर्षियोंने जो मेरी स्तुतियाँ की हैं

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा च कृतास्तास्तु प्रयच्छन्तु शुभां मतिम् । अरण्ये प्रान्तरे वापि दावाग्निपरिवारितः
verses.transliteration: brahmaNA cha kR^itAstAstu prayachChantu shubhAM matim | araNye prAntare vApi dAvAgniparivAritaH
verses.translation: and those composed by Brahma, bestow a splendid mind. He who is surrounded by a raging fire in a forest or on a lonesome road,
verses.commentary: Sense: and those composed by Brahma, bestow a splendid mind. He who is surrounded by a raging fire in a forest or on a lonesome road,
verses.hindi: तथा ब्रह्माजीने जो स्तुतियाँ की हैं, वे सभी कल्याणमयी बुद्धि प्रदान करती हैं। वनमें, सूने मार्गमें अथवा दावानलसे घिर जानेपर

verses.sanskrit: दस्युभिर्वा वृतः शून्ये गृहीतो वापि शत्रुभिः । सिंहव्याघ्रानुयातो वा वने वा वनहस्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: dasyubhirvA vR^itaH shUnye gR^ihIto vApi shatrubhiH | siMhavyAghrAnuyAto vA vane vA vanahastibhiH
verses.translation: or who is encompassed by robbers in a desolate spot, or who is captured by enemies, or who is prowled after by a lion or tiger or by wild elephants in a forest,
verses.commentary: Sense: or who is encompassed by robbers in a desolate spot, or who is captured by enemies, or who is prowled after by a lion or tiger or by wild elephants in a forest,
verses.hindi: निर्जन स्थानमें, लुटेरोंके दावमें पड़ जानेपर या शत्रुओंसे पकड़े जानेपर अथवा जंगलनमें सिंह, व्याप्र या जंगली हाथियोंके पीछा करनेपर

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञा क्रुद्धेन चाज्ञप्तो वध्यो बन्धगतोऽपि वा । आघूर्णितो वा वातेन स्थितः पोते महार्णवे
verses.transliteration: rAj~nA kruddhena chAj~napto vadhyo bandhagato.api vA | AghUrNito vA vAtena sthitaH pote mahArNave
verses.translation: or who is under the command of an enraged king, or who is sentenced to death, or who has fallen into bonds, or who is whirled around by the wind, or who stands in a ship in the wide sea,
verses.commentary: Sense: or who is under the command of an enraged king, or who is sentenced to death, or who has fallen into bonds, or who is whirled around by the wind, or who stands in a ship in the wide sea,
verses.hindi: कुपित राजाके आदेशसे वध या बन्धनके स्थानमें ले जाये जानेपर अथवा महासागरमें नावपर बैठनेके बाद भारी तूफानसे नावके डगमग होनेपर

verses.sanskrit: पतत्सु चापि शस्त्रेषु सङ्ग्रामे भृशदारुणे । सर्वाबाधासु घोरासु वेदनाभ्यर्दितोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: patatsu chApi shastreShu sa~NgrAme bhR^ishadAruNe | sarvAbAdhAsu ghorAsu vedanAbhyardito.api vA
verses.translation: or who is in the most dreadful battle with weapons falling upon him, or who is afflicted with pain amidst all kinds of terrible troubles—
verses.commentary: Sense: or who is in the most dreadful battle with weapons falling upon him, or who is afflicted with pain amidst all kinds of terrible troubles—
verses.hindi: और अत्यन्त भयड्ूकर युद्धमें शस्त्रोंका प्रहार होनेपर अथवा वेदनासे पीड़ित होनेपर, कि बहुना सभी भयानक बाधाओंके उपस्थित होनेपर

verses.sanskrit: स्मरन् ममैतच्चरितं नरो मुच्येत सङ्कटात् । मम प्रभावात्सिंहाद्या दस्यवो वैरिणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: smaran mamaitachcharitaM naro muchyeta sa~NkaTAt | mama prabhAvAtsiMhAdyA dasyavo vairiNastathA
verses.translation: such a man, on calling to mind this story of my exploits, is delivered from his strait. Through my power lions and other dangerous beasts, robbers and enemies,
verses.commentary: Sense: such a man, on calling to mind this story of my exploits, is delivered from his strait. Through my power lions and other dangerous beasts, robbers and enemies,
verses.hindi: स्मरन्ममैतच्चरितं नरो मुच्येत सडुकटात्‌ | मम प्रभावात्सिंहाद्या दस्यवो वैरिणस्तथा

verses.sanskrit: दूरादेव पलायन्ते स्मरतश्चरितं मम
verses.transliteration: dUrAdeva palAyante smaratashcharitaM mama
verses.translation: from a distance indeed, flee from him who calls to mind this story of my exploits.
verses.commentary: Sense: from a distance indeed, flee from him who calls to mind this story of my exploits.
verses.hindi: जो मेरे इस चरित्रका स्मरण करता है, वह मनुष्य संकटसे मुक्त हो जाता है। मेरे प्रभावसे सिंह आदि हिंसक जनन्‍्तु नष्ट हो जाते हैं तथा लुटेरे और शत्रु भी मेरे चरित्रका स्मरण करनेवाले पुरुषसे दूर भागते हैं

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: The rishi spoke:

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा सा भगवती चण्डिका चण्डविक्रमा
verses.transliteration: ityuktvA sA bhagavatI chaNDikA chaNDavikramA
verses.translation: Having spoken thus, the adorable Chandika, who is fierce in prowess,
verses.commentary: Sense: Having spoken thus, the adorable Chandika, who is fierce in prowess,
verses.hindi: यों कहकर प्रचण्ड पराक्रमवाली भगवती चण्डिका सब देवताओंके देखते-देखते वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। फिर समस्त देवता भी शत्रुओंके मारे जानेसे निर्भय हो पहलेकी ही भाँति यज्ञभागका उपभोग करते हुए अपने-अपने अधिकारका पालन करने लगे। संसारका विध्वंस करनेवाले महाभयड्कर अतुलपराक्रमी देवशत्रु शुम्भ तथा महाबली निशुम्भके युद्धमें देवीद्वारा मारे जानेपर शेष दैत्य पाताललोकमें चले आये

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । तेऽपि देवा निरातङ्काः स्वाधिकारान्यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: pashyatAM sarvadevAnAM tatraivAntaradhIyata | te.api devA nirAta~NkAH svAdhikArAnyathA purA
verses.translation: vanished there, while the gods were gazing indeed on her. The gods also, relieved from fear, their foes being slain, all resumed their own dominions as before,
verses.commentary: Sense: vanished there, while the gods were gazing indeed on her. The gods also, relieved from fear, their foes being slain, all resumed their own dominions as before,
verses.hindi: पश्यतामेवः देवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । ते5पि देवा निरातड्का: स्वाधिकारान्‌ यथा पुरा

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञभागभुजः सर्वे चक्रुर्विनिहतारयः । दैत्याश्च देव्या निहते शुम्भे देवरिपौ युधि
verses.transliteration: yaj~nabhAgabhujaH sarve chakrurvinihatArayaH | daityAshcha devyA nihate shumbhe devaripau yudhi
verses.translation: participating in their shares of sacrifices. And the Daityas—when Shumbha, that most fierce foe of the gods, had been slain by the goddess in fight,

verses.sanskrit: जगद्विध्वंसके तस्मिन् महोग्रेऽतुलविक्रमे । निशुम्भे च महावीर्ये शेषाः पातालमाययुः
verses.transliteration: jagadvidhvaMsake tasmin mahogre.atulavikrame | nishumbhe cha mahAvIrye sheShAH pAtAlamAyayuH
verses.translation: he who brought ruin on the world and who was peerless in prowess, and when Nishumbha also, great in valour, was slain—the rest all came to Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: he who brought ruin on the world and who was peerless in prowess, and when Nishumbha also, great in valour, was slain—the rest all came to Patala.

verses.sanskrit: एवं भगवती देवी सा नित्यापि पुनः पुनः । सम्भूय कुरुते भूप जगतः परिपालनम्
verses.transliteration: evaM bhagavatI devI sA nityApi punaH punaH | sambhUya kurute bhUpa jagataH paripAlanam
verses.translation: Thus that adorable goddess, although everlasting, yet taking birth again and again, accomplishes the safeguarding of the world, O king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus that adorable goddess, although everlasting, yet taking birth again and again, accomplishes the safeguarding of the world, O king.
verses.hindi: एवं भगवती देवी सा नित्यापि पुन: पुन: । सम्भूय कुरुते भूप जगत: परिपालनम्‌

verses.sanskrit: तयैतन्मोह्यते विश्वं सैव विश्वं प्रसूयते । सा याचिता च विज्ञानं तुष्टा ऋद्धिं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: tayaitanmohyate vishvaM saiva vishvaM prasUyate | sA yAchitA cha vij~nAnaM tuShTA R^iddhiM prayachChati
verses.translation: By her this universe is bewitched; she verily gives birth to the universe. And when besought, she bestows knowledge; when gratified, she bestows prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: By her this universe is bewitched; she verily gives birth to the universe. And when besought, she bestows knowledge; when gratified, she bestows prosperity.
verses.hindi: वे ही इस विश्वको मोहित करतीं, वे ही जगत्‌को जन्म देतीं तथा वे ही प्रार्थना करनेपर सन्तुष्ट हो विज्ञान एवं समृद्धि प्रदान करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तं तयैतत्सकलं ब्रह्माण्डं मनुजेश्वर । महादेव्या महाकाली महामारीस्वरूपया
verses.transliteration: vyAptaM tayaitatsakalaM brahmANDaM manujeshvara | mahAdevyA mahAkAlI mahAmArIsvarUpayA
verses.translation: All this egg of Brahma, O king, is pervaded by her, who is Mahakali at Mahakala, and who has the nature of the great destroying goddess Mahamari.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this egg of Brahma, O king, is pervaded by her, who is Mahakali at Mahakala, and who has the nature of the great destroying goddess Mahamari.
verses.hindi: राजन! महाप्रलयके समय महामारीका स्वरूप धारण करनेवाली वे महाकाली ही इस समस्त ब्रह्माण्डमें व्याप्त हैं

verses.sanskrit: सैव काले महामारी सैव सृष्टिर्भवत्यजा । स्थितिं करोति भूतानां सैव काले सनातनी
verses.transliteration: saiva kAle mahAmArI saiva sR^iShTirbhavatyajA | sthitiM karoti bhUtAnAM saiva kAle sanAtanI
verses.translation: She indeed is Mahamari at the fated time; she indeed is creation, the Unborn; she indeed, the Eternal, gives stability to created beings at their fated time.
verses.commentary: Sense: She indeed is Mahamari at the fated time; she indeed is creation, the Unborn; she indeed, the Eternal, gives stability to created beings at their fated time.
verses.hindi: वे ही समय-समयपर महामारी होती और वे ही स्वयं अजन्मा होती हुई भी सृष्टिके रूपमें प्रकट होती हैं। वे सनातनी देवी ही समयानुसार सम्पूर्ण भूतोंकी रक्षा करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: भवकाले नृणां सैव लक्ष्मीर्वृद्धिप्रदा गृहे । सैवाभावे तथालक्ष्मीर्विनाशायोपजायते
verses.transliteration: bhavakAle nR^iNAM saiva lakShmIrvR^iddhipradA gR^ihe | saivAbhAve tathAlakShmIrvinAshAyopajAyate
verses.translation: She indeed is Lakshmi, bestowing prosperity on the houses of men while she abides with them; and she indeed, when she is absent, becomes the goddess of Ill Fortune unto their destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: She indeed is Lakshmi, bestowing prosperity on the houses of men while she abides with them; and she indeed, when she is absent, becomes the goddess of Ill Fortune unto their destruction.
verses.hindi: भवकाले नृणां सैव लक्ष्मीवृद्धिप्रदा गृहे । सैवाभावे तथालक्ष्मीविनाशायोपजायते

verses.sanskrit: स्तुता सम्पूजिता पुष्पैर्गन्धधूपादिभिस्तथा । ददाति वित्तं पुत्रांश्च मतिं धर्मे गतिं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: stutA sampUjitA puShpairgandhadhUpAdibhistathA | dadAti vittaM putrAMshcha matiM dharme gatiM shubhAm
verses.translation: When hymned and worshipped with flowers, and with incense, perfumes and other offerings, she bestows wealth and sons, and a mind brilliant in righteousness, and a happy course.
verses.commentary: Sense: When hymned and worshipped with flowers, and with incense, perfumes and other offerings, she bestows wealth and sons, and a mind brilliant in righteousness, and a happy course.
verses.hindi: पुष्प, धूप और गन्ध आदिसे पूजन करके उनकी स्तुति करनेपर वे धन, पुत्र, धार्मिक बुद्धि तथा उत्तम गति प्रदान करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: ॐ ऋषिरुवाच
verses.transliteration: OM R^iShiruvAcha
verses.translation: Om. The rishi spoke:
verses.hindi: ऋषि कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं भूप देवीमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । एवं प्रभावा सा देवी ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ bhūpa devīmāhātmyamuttamam | evaṃprabhāvā sā devī yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ||
verses.translation: Thus has been told to you, O king, this most excellent Devi Mahatmyam. Such is the power of that Goddess by whom this world is sustained.
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Medhas concludes the entire Saptashati with this verse: the power by which the world is sustained (dharana) is the Devi's power. Not merely the power by which demons are slain — but the continuous sustaining power that holds the universe together from moment to moment.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Medhas concludes the entire Saptashati with this verse: the power by which the world is sustained (dharana) is the Devi's power. Not merely the power by which demons are slain — but the continuous sustaining power that holds the universe together from moment to moment.…
verses.hindi: हे राजन्! यह सर्वोत्तम देवीमाहात्म्य तुम्हें सुनाया गया। यही शक्ति उस देवी की है, जिसके द्वारा यह जगत धारण किया जाता है।
verses.science: Cosmological fine-tuning: the physical constants — the gravitational constant, the mass of the electron, the cosmological constant — are tuned to extraordinary precision to allow complex structures to exist and persist. A change of even fractional amounts in several of these constants would produce a universe where nothing coheres for more than an instant. This "sustaining power" — the fine-tuned coherence of existence — is what the Devi Mahatmyam calls the Goddess. Whatever underlies the continuous coherence of reality is Devi.
verses.lifeLesson: The final verse asks: what holds your life together? Not your willpower or planning — what sustains the ground beneath all of that? The heartbeat continuing without effort, the immune system running silently, the love persisting even when not consciously generated — this sustaining power is the Goddess. You have just heard 13 chapters about her. Now rest. She is carrying this.

verses.sanskrit: विद्या तथैव क्रियते भगवद्विष्णुमायया । तया त्वमेष वैश्यश्च तथैवान्ये विवेकिनः
verses.transliteration: vidyA tathaiva kriyate bhagavadviShNumAyayA | tayA tvameSha vaishyashcha tathaivAnye vivekinaH
verses.translation: Moreover, knowledge is conferred by her who is the adorable Vishnu's Illusive power. By her thou and this vaishya and other men of discrimination
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, knowledge is conferred by her who is the adorable Vishnu's Illusive power. By her thou and this vaishya and other men of discrimination
verses.hindi: वे ही विद्या (ज्ञान) उत्पन्न करती हैं। भगवान्‌ विष्णुकी मायास्वरूपा उन भगवतीके द्वारा ही तुम, ये वैश्य तथा अन्यान्य विवेकी जन मोहित होते हैं, मोहित हुए हैं तथा आगे भी मोहित होंगे। महाराज! तुम उन्हीं परमेश्वरीकी शरणमें जाओ

verses.transliteration: mohyante mohitAshchaiva mohameShyanti chApare | tAmupaihi mahArAja sharaNaM parameshvarIm
verses.translation: are bewitched, and celebrated men were bewitched; and others shall become bewitched. Go unto her, the supreme queen, as to a place of refuge, O great king.
verses.commentary: Sense: are bewitched, and celebrated men were bewitched; and others shall become bewitched. Go unto her, the supreme queen, as to a place of refuge, O great king.
verses.hindi: वे ही विद्या (ज्ञान) उत्पन्न करती हैं। भगवान्‌ विष्णुकी मायास्वरूपा उन भगवतीके द्वारा ही तुम, ये वैश्य तथा अन्यान्य विवेकी जन मोहित होते हैं, मोहित हुए हैं तथा आगे भी मोहित होंगे। महाराज! तुम उन्हीं परमेश्वरीकी शरणमें जाओ

verses.sanskrit: आराधिता सैव नृणां भोगस्वर्गापवर्गदा
verses.transliteration: ArAdhitA saiva nR^iNAM bhogasvargApavargadA
verses.translation: She indeed, when propitiated by men, bestows enjoyment, Svarga and final emancipation from existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: She indeed, when propitiated by men, bestows enjoyment, Svarga and final emancipation from existence.
verses.hindi: आराधना करनेपर वे ही मनुष्योंको भोग, स्वर्ग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करती हैं

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha
verses.translation: Markandeya spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandeya spoke:
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुरथः स नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: iti tasya vachaH shrutvA surathaH sa narAdhipaH
verses.translation: Having heard this his speech, king Suratha, that lord of men,
verses.commentary: Sense: Having heard this his speech, king Suratha, that lord of men,
verses.hindi: क्रौष्टकिजी! मेधामुनिके ये वचन सुनकर राजा सुरथने उत्तम व्रतका पालन करनेवाले उन महाभाग महर्षिको प्रणाम किया। वे अत्यन्त ममता और राज्यापहरणसे बहुत खिन्न हो चुके थे

verses.sanskrit: प्रणिपत्य महाभागं तमृषिं संशितव्रतम् । निर्विण्णोऽतिममत्वेन राज्यापहरणेन च
verses.transliteration: praNipatya mahAbhAgaM tamR^iShiM saMshitavratam | nirviNNo.atimamatvena rAjyApaharaNena cha
verses.translation: fell prostrate before the illustrious rishi who performed severe penances, and being downcast by his excessive regard for self and by the deprivation of his kingdom,
verses.commentary: Sense: fell prostrate before the illustrious rishi who performed severe penances, and being downcast by his excessive regard for self and by the deprivation of his kingdom,
verses.hindi: क्रौष्टकिजी! मेधामुनिके ये वचन सुनकर राजा सुरथने उत्तम व्रतका पालन करनेवाले उन महाभाग महर्षिको प्रणाम किया। वे अत्यन्त ममता और राज्यापहरणसे बहुत खिन्न हो चुके थे

verses.sanskrit: जगाम सद्यस्तपसे स च वैश्यो महामुने । सन्दर्शनार्थमम्बाया नदीपुलिनमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: jagAma sadyastapase sa cha vaishyo mahAmune | sandarshanArthamambAyA nadIpulinamAsthitaH
verses.translation: went forthwith to perform austerities; and the vaishya, O great muni, in order to get a vision of Amba, took up his station on a sand-bank in a river.
verses.commentary: Sense: went forthwith to perform austerities; and the vaishya, O great muni, in order to get a vision of Amba, took up his station on a sand-bank in a river.
verses.hindi: महामुने! इसलिये विरक्त होकर वे राजा तथा वैश्य तत्काल तपस्याको चले गये और वे जगदम्बाके दर्शनके लिये नदीके तटपर रहकर तपस्या करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: स च वैश्यस्तपस्तेपे देवीसूक्तं परं जपन् । तौ तस्मिन् पुलिने देव्याः कृत्वा मूर्तिं महीमयीम्
verses.transliteration: sa cha vaishyastapastepe devIsUktaM paraM japan | tau tasmin puline devyAH kR^itvA mUrtiM mahImayIm
verses.translation: And the vaishya practised austerities, muttering the sublime hymn to the goddess. They both made an earthen image of the goddess on that sand-bank,
verses.commentary: Sense: And the vaishya practised austerities, muttering the sublime hymn to the goddess. They both made an earthen image of the goddess on that sand-bank,
verses.hindi: स च वैश्यस्तपस्तेपे देवीसूक्तं परं जपन्‌ । तौ तस्मिन्‌ पुलिने देव्या: कृत्वा मूर्ति महीमयीम्‌

verses.sanskrit: अर्हणां चक्रतुस्तस्याः पुष्पधूपाग्नितर्पणैः । निराहारौ यतात्मानौ तन्मनस्कौ समाहितौ
verses.transliteration: arhaNAM chakratustasyAH puShpadhUpAgnitarpaNaiH | nirAhArau yatAtmAnau tanmanaskau samAhitau
verses.translation: and paid worship to it with flowers, incense, fire and libations of water. Abstaining from food, restraining themselves, concentrating their minds on her, keeping their thoughts composed,
verses.commentary: Sense: and paid worship to it with flowers, incense, fire and libations of water. Abstaining from food, restraining themselves, concentrating their minds on her, keeping their thoughts composed,
verses.hindi: वे वैश्य उत्तम देवीसूक्तका जप करते हुए तपस्यामें प्रवृत्त हुए। वे दोनों नदीके तटपर देवीकी मृण्मयी मूर्ति बनाकर पुष्प, धूप और हवन आदिके द्वारा उनकी आराधना करने लगे। उन्होंने पहले तो आहारको धीरे-धीरे कम किया; फिर बिलकुल निराहार रहकर देवीमें ही मन लगाये एकाग्रतापूर्वक उनका चिन्तन आरम्भ किया

verses.sanskrit: ददतुस्तौ बलिं चैव निजगात्रासृगुक्षितम् । एवं समाराधयतोस्त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्यतात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: dadatustau baliM chaiva nijagAtrAsR^igukShitam | evaM samArAdhayatostribhirvarShairyatAtmanoH
verses.translation: they both offered the bali offering also, sprinkled with blood drawn from their own limbs. When they continued with subdued souls to propitiate her thus for three years,
verses.commentary: Sense: they both offered the bali offering also, sprinkled with blood drawn from their own limbs. When they continued with subdued souls to propitiate her thus for three years,
verses.hindi: वे दोनों अपने शरीरके रक्तसे प्रोक्षित बलि देते हुए लगातार तीन वर्षोतक संयमपूर्वक आराधना करते रहे

verses.sanskrit: परितुष्टा जगद्धात्री प्रत्यक्षं प्राह चण्डिका
verses.transliteration: parituShTA jagaddhAtrI pratyakShaM prAha chaNDikA
verses.translation: Chandika, who upholds the world, well-pleased, spoke in visible shape.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chandika, who upholds the world, well-pleased, spoke in visible shape.
verses.hindi: इसपर प्रसन्न होकर जगत्‌को धारण करनेवाली चण्डिका देवीने प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन देकर कहा

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: यत्प्रार्थ्यते त्वया भूप त्वया च कुलनन्दन । मत्तस्तत्प्राप्यतां सर्वं परितुष्टा ददामिते
verses.transliteration: yatprArthyate tvayA bhUpa tvayA cha kulanandana | mattastatprApyatAM sarvaM parituShTA dadAmite
verses.translation: What thou dost solicit, O king, and thou, O rejoicer of thy family, receive ye all that from me; well-pleased I bestow it.
verses.commentary: Sense: What thou dost solicit, O king, and thou, O rejoicer of thy family, receive ye all that from me; well-pleased I bestow it.
verses.hindi: राजन! तथा अपने कुलको आनन्दित करनेवाले वैश्य! तुमलोग जिस वस्तुकी अभिलाषा रखते हो, वह मुझसे माँगो। मैं सन्तुष्ट हूँ, अतः तुम्हें वह सब कुछ दूँगी

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha
verses.translation: Markandeya spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandeya spoke:
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: ततो वव्रे नृपो राज्यमविभ्रंश्यन्यजन्मनि । अत्रैव च निजं राज्यं हतशत्रुबलं बलात्
verses.transliteration: tato vavre nR^ipo rAjyamavibhraMshyanyajanmani | atraiva cha nijaM rAjyaM hatashatrubalaM balAt
verses.translation: Then the king chose a kingdom that should not perish in another life, and in this life his own kingdom, wherein the power of his enemies should be destroyed by force.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the king chose a kingdom that should not perish in another life, and in this life his own kingdom, wherein the power of his enemies should be destroyed by force.
verses.hindi: तब राजाने दूसरे जन्ममें नष्ट न होनेवाला राज्य माँगा तथा इस जन्ममें भी शत्रुओंकी सेनाको बलपूर्वक नष्ट करके पुनः अपना राज्य प्राप्त कर लेनेका वरदान माँगा

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि वैश्यस्ततो ज्ञानं वव्रे निर्विण्णमानसः । ममेत्यहमिति प्राज्ञः सङ्गविच्युतिकारकम्
verses.transliteration: so.api vaishyastato j~nAnaM vavre nirviNNamAnasaH | mametyahamiti prAj~naH sa~NgavichyutikArakam
verses.translation: Then the vaishya also, whose mind was downcast, chose knowledge—to be wise, knowing 'what is mine' and 'what I am'—knowledge that causes the downfall of worldly attachments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the vaishya also, whose mind was downcast, chose knowledge—to be wise, knowing 'what is mine' and 'what I am'—knowledge that causes the downfall of worldly attachments.
verses.hindi: वैश्यका चित्त संसारकी ओरसे खिन्न एवं विरक्त हो चुका था और वे बड़े बुद्धिमान थे; अतः उस समय उन्होंने तो ममता और अहंतारूप आसक्तिका नाश करनेवाला ज्ञान माँगा

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच
verses.transliteration: devyuvAcha
verses.translation: The goddess spoke:

verses.sanskrit: स्वल्पैरहोभिर्नृपते स्वं राज्यं प्राप्स्यते भवान्
verses.transliteration: svalpairahobhirnR^ipate svaM rAjyaM prApsyate bhavAn
verses.translation: O king, thou shalt obtain thine own kingdom in a very few days,
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, thou shalt obtain thine own kingdom in a very few days,
verses.hindi: राजन! तुम थोड़े ही दिनोंमें शत्रुओंको मारकर अपना राज्य प्राप्त कर लोगे। अब वहाँ तुम्हारा राज्य स्थिर रहेगा

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा रिपूनस्खलितं तव तत्र भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: hatvA ripUnaskhalitaM tava tatra bhaviShyati
verses.translation: after slaying thine enemies; it shall be steadfast for thee there;
verses.commentary: Sense: after slaying thine enemies; it shall be steadfast for thee there;
verses.hindi: राजन! तुम थोड़े ही दिनोंमें शत्रुओंको मारकर अपना राज्य प्राप्त कर लोगे। अब वहाँ तुम्हारा राज्य स्थिर रहेगा

verses.sanskrit: मृतश्च भूयः सम्प्राप्य जन्म देवाद्विवस्वतः
verses.transliteration: mR^itashcha bhUyaH samprApya janma devAdvivasvataH
verses.translation: and when dead, thou shalt gain another birth from the god Vivasvat,
verses.commentary: Sense: and when dead, thou shalt gain another birth from the god Vivasvat,
verses.hindi: मृत्यु के अनन्तर तुम भगवान सूर्यदेव के अंश से जन्म लेकर पृथ्वी पर सावर्णि नाम से आठवें मनु बनोगे।

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णिको मनुर्नाम भवान्भुवि भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sAvarNiko manurnAma bhavAnbhuvi bhaviShyati
verses.translation: and shalt be a Manu on earth, by name Savarnika.
verses.commentary: Sense: and shalt be a Manu on earth, by name Savarnika.
verses.hindi: भगवान सूर्यदेव से दूसरा जन्म पाकर तुम सावर्णि मनु के नाम से प्रसिद्ध होओगे।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यवर्य त्वया यश्च वरोऽस्मत्तोऽभिवाञ्छितः
verses.transliteration: vaishyavarya tvayA yashcha varo.asmatto.abhivA~nChitaH
verses.translation: And, O excellent vaishya, the boon which thou hast besought of me,
verses.commentary: Sense: And, O excellent vaishya, the boon which thou hast besought of me,
verses.hindi: वैश्यवर्य! तुमने भी जिस वरको मुझसे प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छा की है, उसे देती हूँ। तुम्हें मोक्षके लिये ज्ञान प्राप्त होगा

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रयच्छामि संसिद्ध्यै तव ज्ञानं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: taM prayachChAmi saMsiddhyai tava j~nAnaM bhaviShyati
verses.translation: I bestow it for thy full perfection; knowledge shall be thine.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bestow it for thy full perfection; knowledge shall be thine.
verses.hindi: वैश्यवर्य! तुमने भी जिस वरको मुझसे प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छा की है, उसे देती हूँ। तुम्हें मोक्षके लिये ज्ञान प्राप्त होगा

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
verses.transliteration: mArkaNDeya uvAcha
verses.translation: Markandeya spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandeya spoke:
verses.hindi: एवं देव्या वरं लब्ध्वा सुरथ: क्षत्रियर्षभ: । सूर्याज्जन्म समासाद्य सावर्णिर्भविता मनु: ।। क्लीं ३5 ।। मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--

verses.sanskrit: इति दत्त्वा तयोर्देवी यथाभिलषितं वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti dattvA tayordevI yathAbhilaShitaM varam
verses.translation: Thus has been told to you, O king, this most excellent Devi Mahatmyam. Such is the power of that Goddess by whom this world is sustained.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus has been told to you, O king, this most excellent Devi Mahatmyam. Such is the power of that Goddess by whom this world is sustained.
verses.hindi: इति दत्त्वा तयो्देवी यथाभिलषितं वरम्‌

verses.sanskrit: बभूवान्तर्हिता सद्यो भक्त्या ताभ्यामभिष्टुता । एवं देव्या वरं लब्ध्वा सुरथः क्षत्रियर्षभः
verses.transliteration: babhUvAntarhitA sadyo bhaktyA tAbhyAmabhiShTutA | evaM devyA varaM labdhvA surathaH kShatriyarShabhaH
verses.translation: the goddess vanished forthwith, while extolled by them both in faith. Having thus gained the boon from the goddess, Suratha, the noble kshatriya,
verses.commentary: Sense: the goddess vanished forthwith, while extolled by them both in faith. Having thus gained the boon from the goddess, Suratha, the noble kshatriya,
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन दोनोंको मनोवाञ्छित वरदान देकर तथा उनके द्वारा भक्तिपूर्वक अपनी स्तुति सुनकर देवी अम्बिका तत्काल अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। इस तरह देवीसे वरदान पाकर क्षत्रियोंमें श्रेष्ठ सुरथ सूर्यसे जन्म ले सावर्णि नामक मनु होंगे

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याज्जन्म समासाद्य सावर्णिर्भविता मनुः
verses.transliteration: sUryAjjanma samAsAdya sAvarNirbhavitA manuH
verses.translation: shall obtain a new birth through the Sun, and shall be the Manu Savarni.
verses.commentary: Sense: shall obtain a new birth through the Sun, and shall be the Manu Savarni.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन दोनोंको मनोवाञ्छित वरदान देकर तथा उनके द्वारा भक्तिपूर्वक अपनी स्तुति सुनकर देवी अम्बिका तत्काल अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। इस तरह देवीसे वरदान पाकर क्षत्रियोंमें श्रेष्ठ सुरथ सूर्यसे जन्म ले सावर्णि नामक मनु होंगे
